[Official French Translation](https://delitoon.com/webtoon/so-sweet)  
[Official Chinese Translation](https://ac.qq.com/Comic/comicInfo/id/646939)  
[Official Japanese Translation](https://www.sukima.me/book/title/BT0000802748/)  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: The Prince's First Love
description: The flawless Prince Nazaire changes schools in hopes of wooing a bride… only to encounter the tyrant Cassius Li! At first, the two cannot stand one another, as they constantly infuriate each other. Yet between ball dances, rescues, and secret rendezvous, Nazaire and Cassius begin seeing each other for who they truly are. But love between a prince and a commoner could never happen, and if Nazaire hopes to ascend the throne, he will have to give up Cassius. Torn between love and duty, can the prince and tyrant reach their happily ever after?

title: Oshikoi Capriccio
description:
Mitsu Himekawa, a second-year high school student, secretly loves BL. Together with her best friend Rui Majiima, she spends her days fantasizing about her male classmates. One day, one of her observation targets, Shou Kagomiya, tells her, “Himekawa, you actually like Rui Majima, don't you?”, shocking her.

A chaotic love triangle (?) woven by a BL-loving gyaru and a handsome yuri-loving guy!

title: The Song of Wind and Trees
description:
It is 1880 at the all-boys school, Lacombrade Academy in France. Serge Battour is a cheerful and kind new student who is trying to fit in with the rest of the student body, despite the taboo of his Romani heritage, made obvious by his dark skin. However, his roommate Gilbert Cocteau, known for sleeping with anyone at the school to manipulate them to his advantage, is not helping the situation, especially when he makes it his personal goal to bring about Serge's downfall.   
  
Originally serialized in the 1970s, The Song of Wind and Trees is considered by many to be the first true yaoi manga as well as the first shota manga. In 1979, this series was awarded the prestigious Shogakukan Manga Award for shounen/shoujo manga.  
  
A bit of warning: the work includes scenes of rape and child abuse.

title: When Our Names Match
description:
Jin and Junghyeok are childhood friends, but they have been in a cold war for years! What happens when their souls swap? One day, both of them found their old name tags from middle school and went to bed with old memories in mind… to wake up in the body of the one that they hate the most!   
  
How will they deal with day to day life?   
  
Is there a way back?

title: Koi no Ghost
description:
A heartwarming ghost comedy BL by the author of *Ore ga Shuyaku na Wake ga Nai!* ☆

One day, high school student Aragaki notices that a ghost is haunting him. Aragaki thought he was the only person who can see the ghost, until his crush and classmate, Asahikawa, points it out! What's more, Asahikawa says that the ghost told him that Aragaki likes him...? Could this eerie situation actually lead to Aragaki finding love through the help of this ghost?

title: Hibari ga Naitara Tsukamaete
description:
"In order to meet you, I…"  
  
Enomoto, currently a college student, often finds himself reminiscing the days spent with his childhood friend Shimura, who had always been beside him up until six years ago. Due to a sudden transfer, Enomoto didn't get to ask Shimura where he was moving and he hadn't heard anything from him since.  
  
Until one day, he suddenly reunites with Shimura in his Philosophy class in college. Enomoto is over the moon, but Shimura seems to feel differently…

title: Ane ni Narisumashite Ikemen ni Kokuhaku Suru Otouto no Hanashi
description: The story of a younger brother who impersonates his sister and confesses to a handsome man.

title: Inoue-kun Hajimemasen ka?
description: After being saved twice from an asthma attack, first year student Inoue falls in love with Karasuma, a boy who's not interested in love. After being rejected several times, Inoue recieves warnings that Karasuma is a dangerous person… but will that change his feelings?

title: Glow!
description:
Ever since he was a kid, Morisaki Aki has been loved by the spirit of misfortune. After starting high school, he is coerced by his upperclassmen, Akabane and Tokunaga, into joining the gardening club – but as it turns out, said club was just a cover for… the loan shark club!  
  
Aki gets involved with upperclassmen that not even the teachers would want to cross. And thus begins his unfortunate high school life. However, unbeknownst to him, mysterious feelings begin to bloom. These three guys with their clashing personalities grow together to paint a bold graffiti tag of teenage angst!

title: Misukhan Pyohyeon
description: Jaewon has known that he likes males since he confessed his feelings to a boy named Yoonsung in elementary school, but when Yoonsung tells him that liking other boys is weird, Jaewon tries to hide his "weird" feelings and push them away. Now in high school, he's developed a strong crush on his kind, handsome classmate Karam, and Jaewon decides it's time to finally confront the reality that he might be gay. He asks for advice over the internet and befriends another gay student named Junseo, who becomes Jaewon's emotional support in his quest to win Karam's heart.

title: My Childhood Friend Was a God
description: This is a story of a special boy who becomes a God once he turns 18 and his ordinary childhood friend.

title: Kimi wa Natsu no Naka
description:
Chiharu Saeki and Wataru Toda are two high school students who share a common hobby: they love to watch movies. After they meet, they become fast friends until one day, their relationship takes a sudden twist. What does it mean to love someone? What can you really do about it? Follow the story of their adolescence and witness their relationship as it unfolds through a brilliant summer.  
  
***[All English chapters have been removed due to official licensing by KodanshaUSA/PenguinRandomHouse]***

title: Koinimo Naranai
description:
"That's the first time I've seen crying so beautiful."  
  
Tajima finds himself taken in by Koga's crying face – but little did he know, the reason behind those tears was the death of his goldfish at the hand of Tajima's cat, Buuta. While figuring out how to apologize for that, he stumbles across a secret of Koga's.

title: Sasori to Otome: Scorpio & Virgo
description: Saotome is a novelist who is currently having a writer's block. He has been assigned a new editor and the new person turned out to be Sasasori, his ex-classmate from high school. Saotome is now left feeling awkward because the two actually had a pseudo-romantic relationship back then.

title: Tokyo Babylon
description:
"Do you know that the cherry blossoms are so beautiful because of the corpses buried under them?"  
  
Teenaged Subaru Sumeragi is the 13th head of the Sumeragi clan. Together with his twin sister Hokuto and the   
mysterious veterinarian Seishirou, Subaru travels around Tokyo, calming the ghosts that threaten the city.

title: Boku to Koi no Hanashi wo Shinaika
description:
"Yana" is an infamous playboy who dumps people left and right. But his true identity is one with a pure heart pining for "Metsuki", the area's worst delinquent. He saved Yana at the entrance ceremony and the latter fell for him immediately! Yana never stops yapping about his love day in and day out for Metsuki, who's tired of all this crap. So he asked Yana if he could kiss him like they do in shoujo manga. And...?!

Emeichi's newest, love story between two clumsy high school boys starts here!!!

title: The Unfeeling Me
description: As a zombie with memory loss, school life is still a must! While fighting with his instinctive hunger for humans, he also falls in love with his destined lover. Only, it seems like not only does the lover know how he became a zombie, but he was also a schemer behind the scenes. In a SM danmei, the truth of the zombie gradually emerges.

title: Hinekure Chaser
description:
"My hero alone… is how it was supposed to be! Why is that guy always by his side?!"  
  
Hirokawa Hozumi was saved by Odajima Yamato, whom he then fell in love with, changing schools to chase after him. Because Yamato's childhood friend Misaki is always by his side, Hozumi becomes frustrated. Everyday, he takes out his anger on Misaki and Yamato gets angry with him. Although he is happy to be the recipient of any feelings Yamato has for him, Yamato one day punishes him with a kiss…?

title: Shounen no Kyoukai
description:
Yuka is childhood friends with the timid and quiet Kaoru. Once they got into middle school, Yuka decided to ignore Kaoru.  
  
But when the time for the gender examination arrived, their lives began to change.  
  
Omegaverse  


---

title: Change Revenge
description: This necklace shall transform its wearer into their desired form... A boy who obtained this magical necklace x the prince he yearns for. What will become of this love whose true nature cannot come to light...?

title: Mimasaka-kun to Mayoeru Kobuta
description: Satou-kun, with his fluffy body and heart, spends his days in peace. One day, while being surrounded by tough-looking guys, he was rescued by a fiercer-looking gentleman…?!

title: Kimi ni Furu Kotonoha wa
description:
Một ngày nọ, Komatsu Hinata, một học sinh trung học yêu tiểu thuyết, gặp một tên lưu manh tóc vàng ở tàu điện trên đường đến trường.
Hinata rất vui khi cũng có người quan tâm đến cuốn tiểu thuyết yêu thích của mình và vô tình bị kích động, nhưng cậu lưu manh lại có những lời lẽ không hay và điều đó làm Hinata tổn thương nên đã vô tình thốt ra những lời quá đáng.
Nghĩ rằng họ sẽ không bao giờ gặp lại nhau nhưng Hinata lại gặp lại tên lưu manh trên trường và hóa ra cậu lại là Igarashi Yukito, bạn cùng lớp chưa bao giờ đến trường kể từ hôm nhập học–?
Một câu chuyện tình yêu xảy đến với hai người chưa từng biết đến tình yêu.

title: Akai Ito no Shikkou Yuuyo
description:
College student Keiji possesses the dubious talent of being able to see the red string of fate. One day, he suddenly notices a red thread tied to his own finger! He is tickled pink on catching sight of it and immediately follows the thread, but the thread leads to his own kouhai named Hiro!  
  
"My soul mate is a guy!?"

title: Amahara-kun+
description: The main character is a trap, whose sole purpose is to convert others into trap by whatever means possible. He seeks boys with feminine features or behaviors and through very comedy based tactics convinces them to embrace the trap life style.

title: Classmate Relationship?
description: By chance, Fang Tang came across Ah Shu, someone he noticed long ago. The two became classmates and intimate friends. A refreshing and pure love school life manhua.

title: Welcome Back, Aureole
description: Bright and sociable Kazu and sober and serious Moto have been friends since they were kids. Even if they grew apart and became friends with different groups of people in high school, they still knew and understood each other well. However, Kazu slowly starts to become aware of Moto as more than just his friend…

title: Oko-sama Star
description: At high school, Kaido seems to be a scary delinquent, but he’s leading a second life as the star of a sentai superhero live show! When sentai superfan classmate Honda discovers Kaido’s secret, Kaido will stop at nothing to make sure it doesn’t get out, but despite himself, the charismatic performer finds himself falling for his biggest fan… [Kodansha]

title: Osananajimi no Kao ga Yosugite Sakaraenai
description:
More than childhood friends, less than lovers.  
  
Akane, a high school student who loves pretty faces and is an idol otaku, is being pressed by his handsome childhood friend, Harumi.  
"Wake me up", "Kiss me", "Stay here".  
Akane can't resist when he's begging, but he's too thick-headed to notice Harumi's affection for him.  
They are in a state of "Are they not dating yet?" because they've been really close to each other since they were young.  
But at one point, Harumi gets serious and approaches Akane…?!

title: Utsukushii Kare
description:
High schooler at the bottom of the social ladder x Beautiful King of the topmost caste! Nagira Yuu’s big hit series, now a manga!!

Beautiful, aloof, he reigns over the class. Kiyoi has the innate qualities of a king.
At the start of a new term, in the middle of the stifling classroom, Hira, who is silent, friendless, and at the bottom of the class’s social ladder, has his heart captured in a single glance by classmate Kiyoi. Though in this world there should be no chance of them ever interacting with each other, Hira, who is treated as a gofer, suddenly finds himself with Kiyoi’s phone number entered into his phone! A single world from Kiyoi, even the spare change he receives, is precious. These lonely, suffocating feelings, could they be love? A love story interweaving two opposites begins!

title: Mr. Snail
description:
As September comes, a new semester has begun at Shan Ming High School. The school doctor, Song Yue, has also welcomed a new roommate - canteen chef, Xu Xiaodao. Mr. Song thinks Xu is like the "Snail Girl". Ever since he starting living here, the dorm has been super clean. Not only does he clean, he also cooks all the meals and does all the laundry! This is truly suspicious! Things get even weirder when Mr. Song realizes Xu Xiaodao knows a little bit too much about him and is a little bit too clingy. Furthermore, Xu Xiaodao cares for him way too much?? Things are not as simple as they seem…  
  
Artist's weibo: [@一根腿毛\_mudage](https://weibo.com/u/7317135023)

title: Endou-kun no Jikken Note
description: Tsuda and Endou have come to realize they can't stay the way they are forever. If asked about their relationship, they don't know how to answer. What do they need to stay together? It's not enough. They want more. They can't stop their feelings…

title: Boy's Love
description: Chungho never breaks the dress code and Park Jun always does- along with his earrings and (naturally) curly hair. But it so happens that Chungho's the one who always gets into trouble while Jun is treated like the perfect son of Buk Cheon High. They have nothing in common, but are still best friends. However, Chungho has a secret he can't tell anyone, especially to Jun… and that secret is… ♥

title: Don’t Say You Love Me
description: I treated you as a brother, so how could you just confess to me?! I only wanted to avoid you but ended up getting you hurt in an accident. I’m sorry. If I had another chance, I definitely wouldn’t run away again. However… that chance came so fast. I suddenly travelled back three years ago and met you again. The you who doesn’t yet know me.

title: Do You Know a Fairy?
description: Due to his unique ability of seeing guardian fairies, Eun-Oh is deemed to be a loner. One day, the new transfer student Jae Hwi approached him without hesitation! "I feel good whenever I'm with you." After being told such words, Eun-Oh started to have a change of heart…

title: Koi no Tsuru wa Hanarerarenai
description: Yuu practiced archery in his grandfather’s dojo until he met Hajime. Both join their school's archery club and aim for nationals, but in reality Yuu has no interest in tournaments despite possessing amazing talent and ability, in fact joining the club was due to Yuu's secret feelings for Hajime.

title: Akai Ringo no Nakami Jijou
description: Yuya is a transfer student who has been unable to adapt to a new class because of his difficulty in getting along with people and also due to a complex that he has been trying to hide. He thought he was used to being alone and was ready to live his life that way at his new school, but his charismatic classmate Keiji plans otherwise!

title: #BLgokko
description: #BL Pretend: A game on the internet where men pair up to form a couple, upload flirtatious pictures to SNS, and enjoy the reaction they get from girls. It’s basically pretend-play, but some of them are actually dating… Among the players, Gorou, a gloomy guy with a strong desire for approval, is looking for a partner to participate in the popular 'BL Pretend' on SNS! One day, an intimidating classmate approaches Gorou and asks him to be his partner for the game-!?

title: Kojika Counter!
description: Do bố thuyên chuyển công tác nên Setoguchi Hotori buộc phải theo học tại một ngôi trường ngỗ ngược do đám học sinh cá biệt tàn phá và mỗi ngày đến trường cậu đều bị bắt nạt. Cuối cùng, sau nhiều tuần bị bắt nạt, Setoguchi nhận ra chìa khóa mở cánh cửa tự do của cậu là tiếp cận Kuse, thủ lĩnh của nhóm cá biệt. Nhưng liệu Setoguchi sẽ đi được bao xa…

title: Natsu no Teppen ni Saku
description:
“If only I could be Yousuke’s boyfriend.”


I’ve known Yousuke since I was young, he’s my best friend and we’ve always been together. Every summer, Yousuke and our group of friends would hit the beach, watch fireworks, go to festivals… That’s how I thought we’d be spending our days this summer, until that one day when Yousuke got a girlfriend.

Seeing Yousuke’s girlfriend by his side made my chest ache. Seeing Yousuke fully devoting himself to his part-time job just to go on a date with his girlfriend bothered me. It didn’t take long before I realised that this was the very definition of “jealousy”. My feelings for Yousuke grew with each passing day, until one day, my feelings overflowed…

They’re more than just childhood friends or best friends… The coming-of-age story of two clumsy and honest high-school boys!

title: Long Period
description:
I hope this feeling disappears quickly.
I'll say the opposite again and again.

Yuusei, a high school student, "hates" his childhood friend Itsuki.
Itsuki, who is a popular genius and a bundle of talent, has been taken out to various places and thrown around for a long time.
Right now, I'm trying to avoid Itsuki so that I don't get involved with him as much as possible, but he keeps getting tangled up with me.
That's why this love will never disappear.
This feeling will never come true.

title: Drunken Truth
description:
Gitaek always dreamed of being in a relationship with someone who’s his ideal preference: caring, thoughtful and has a good body. After being absent for a while, he goes to his club’s meeting room and finds a new student—Jungwoo—who fits this preference and ends up confessing to Jungwoo while he’s drunk. Jungwoo is touched and a little flustered by the first confession he has ever received but, while getting to know each other, Jungwoo finds out that Gitaek’s drinking habit is confessing…  
  
Can the two have a happy ending after an unintended push and pull?

title: Kojirase Josou Danshi no Ren'ai Jijou
description: It’s a story about a boy whose hobby is cross-dressing getting confessed to by a classmate and what follows them afterwards.

title: Plug in
description:
Han Taejun is a famous bully in the school, but he is popular because of his height and good looks.  
He has a crush on 'Jisook', a girl he encountered on a school trip.  
Lovesick, he scavenged all over the school chasing her trail, but he couldn't find her.  
Somehow he is annoyed by Jiwoon, who is in the same class, because he looks very similar to "that girl."  
But… she's the same person as him!  


---

[Official Chinese Translation](https://manga.bilibili.com/detail/mc28077)

title: Ore no Kiss dake Oboete yo
description:
Kousei is straight-forward, kind to everyone, and considered an oasis by his class. However, his tolerance for erotic things is that of a grade schooler and he isn't very good when it comes to love... Because of that, he keeps this inferiority complex a secret.

On the other hand, Nao is always surrounded by girls. 

One day, Kousei happens to see Nao kissing a girl...

After Kousei reveals he worries about not seeming mature enough, Nao tells him, "You could just kiss someone and get it over with?" 

A kiss with...Nao? Could he do something like that?

The class' most popular guys being brought closer to each other is set in motion!?
 
A love story that deepens with heart pounding kisses!

title: Give Me Some Attention
description:
A new school year is one where everyone is excited to make new friends. Meanwhile, self-appointed loner Nam Sumin plans to not talk to anyone and lie low. However, contrary to his earnest wishes, he ends up in the same class and roommates with Lee Jaeha, the epitome of a social butterfly… 

Talk about a dreadful connection…!

title: Poker Face Josou Danshi to.
description:
Masa is a high school boy who has the ability to see someone's three sizes just by looking at them. He got that ability because of his mad obsession with fashion and style, thanks to his idol "SEN".

When Masa eagerly wishes to meet his idol in person, the time that he could finally meet with SEN has come, but when he meets her in person, he realizes that there's something off. 

Indeed, SEN has a secret that Masa didn't realize until he met her in person...

title: Nagahama To Be, or Not to Be
description: Nagisa may look like a delinquent, but he's just a typical teen trying to figure out what to do with his life. Nagisa's best friend, Issa, already knows what his own passion is: fish! Issa often skips school to work at the Nagahama fish market, and the two boys hang out near the ocean almost every day. When Nagisa suspects that Issa has a girlfriend, it turns his world upside down. Is he in love with his best friend? Could his best friend possibly like him back?

title: A Shoulder to Cry On
description: Dayeol hears two guys fooling around in the nurse’s office and accidentally knocks over the curtain rod. When the nurse walks in on the scene, devilishly handsome Taehyun tells her that Dayeol tried to make out with him. Before Dayeol can correct the misunderstanding, the rumor spreads and his archery scholarship is in jeopardy. To make matters worse, Taehyun doesn’t show the slightest bit of remorse; in fact, he shamelessly begins hanging around Dayeol. It’s not long before the two begin walking the thin line between hate and love.

title: Toratsuki-kaicho, Teawase negaimasu!!
description: Saruta Torasuke, an idiot who loves to fight, senses the hidden strength of student council president Fujishiro Senju, and challenges him to a match. In the midst of their fight, something changes in Fujishiro...?

title: Hug Shite! Kaeru-san
description:
A BL story about two polar opposites in their youth♡ Takanashi, the student council president, is good-looking, smart, and admired by all the students. Recently, he has been sneaking off to a frog-branded milk tea shop - for every cup he buys, he gets a hug from a frog mascot. It's a soothing hug that relieves the pressures of everyday life. Before he knows it, he's curious about the person inside...

A classmate who seems rugged but is always there for him x A student council president who seems like a perfect superhuman but is actually too cute!

title: Suki de Gomen
description: For 6 years, Kouta has been harboring a secret crush on his childhood best friend and well-known playboy Haruto. All this time, he's accepted that his crush will stay just that, unrequited. However, one day, it seems like Haruto has noticed…? Little by little, their relationship is changing!

title: Together With Woo Rae
description: Rae rejects an invitation to go to a semester-end party from the most popular student on campus, Sungwoon, But what happens when Rae's new part-time job is at a strange bunny boy costume bar… and his customer is a drunk Sungwoon?!

title: Wizdoms
description: Deep in the forest lies a mysterious school of magic: Wizdoms, an institution attended by beastmen of all kinds. These studious fantasy creatures have come to live, learn, and perhaps even fall in love in this enchanting space. In this collection of BL stories by master mangaka Nagabe, follow the beauty and surprising humor of magical beasts with human hearts.

title: Don't Provoke a Reborned Bamboo Horse
description:
Qiao Yu, the man I humbly guarded for more than 10 years, unexpectedly cheated in front of me!   
This is not the worst part. While I was fleeing from the difficult situation, I had an accident with the elevator. I fell into darkness together with the elevator. When I woke up again, I'm back to where I first meet him!   
Qiao Yu, if I'm unable to avoid meeting you once again, I'll make sure to protect my heart and never to fall in love with you again! Remember!   
It's not wise to provoke your bamboo horse.  
  
Español  
Yu Qiao, el hombre al que he estado protegiendo humildemente durante más de diez años, ¡me engañó delante de mí! Eso no fue lo peor de todo. Mientras huía desesperadamente, tuve un accidente en el ascensor. Caí en la oscuridad junto con el ascensor. ¡Al despertar de nuevo, había regresado al momentos antes de conocerlo! Yu Qiao, si realmente no puedo evitar encontrarme contigo de nuevo, me aseguraré de proteger mi corazón y de no enamorarme otra vez de ti. ¡Nunca más

title: Ushiro no Seki no Katou-kun
description:
Owada, an ordinary boy and also the “Villager A” in his class, can't help but be curious about Katou, a boy who belongs to the "Royalties" sitting behind him. 

Owada gathers up his courage and tries to talk to him, but Katou just ignores him with crystal-like eyes. However, one day, Owada accidentally touches Katou-kun’s secret that no one knows...! 

This is Umeda Miso’s debut comic that tells a story about a tender love.

title: Merry Marbling
description: When he was young, Lee-ahn found and returned a large bag of money and garnered fame as a "Christmas Angel." Since then, Lee-ahn has been very conscious of how others perceive him. Yugeon, who has just moved into Lee-ahn's building, could care less about the gazes of people around him. He acts out at school and even ditches classes. When she learns of Yugeon's arrival, Lee-ahn's mother hopes that he will take care of the outsider for the sake of his reputation. Reluctantly, Lee-ahn obeys his mother. However, Yugeon realizes that Lee-ahn used him for his own image. When Yugeon threatens to tell Lee-ahn's schoolmates about it, Lee-ahn gets defensive... "I don't care if you tell them. Just know, whatever happens next is not my responsibility." I was just going to end things with no regrets... Just wait! Do whatever you want!! Like a beautiful marbling that doesn't mix with water, these two create a beautiful dissonance.

title: Fake Slackers
description: After classes were divided, not only were the two infamously and widely known "problem youths" placed into the same class, they became deskmates. They were obviously exam prodigies but they pretended to be slackers, their entire beings immersed in this skit. They had to compete for last place during exams; playing games every day on the surface but studying seriously behind others' backs. Come and gossip about the two guys in our class who always have to compete for last place: the one who always plays tricks in solitude (He Zhao) x the one who would rather destroy humanity than concede (Xie Yu).

title: Dependency X
description: A perverted Alpha seme and a contributing Omega uke. The dailies of a young love, a display of affection that kills many normal people, "My reliance on you, is like the earth revolving around the sun, the planet revolving around the sun, and the universe revolving around the stars "

title: Ashita mo Kimi ni Ai ni Iku
description:
University student Saku longs to have a fairytale romance, but even though he has no trouble getting with girls, they all break up with him for the same reason: he doesn't make their heart flutter at all!

And then there's Misumi, the university's resident heartthrob who's wildly popular with the girls, and who's taken a sudden interest in Saku. He doesn't laugh at Saku's fantasies and listens to them sincerely, and if Saku is nearby, he'll go to him without fail. Misumi seems to always say or do the right things that make his own heart start to flutter a little, so Saku starts to look to him for tips and techniques on how to make his fairytale romance come true.

But before he knows it, he's suddenly falling in love with Misumi instead...?!

title: Finally Living Together With My Anti-Fan
description: Popular idol Juna is forced to leave the group due to a homosexual scandal. Half a year later, he enters campus as "Han JunRan", a university student. However, by a twist of fate, his roommate turns out to be his number one anti-fan!? Living together with his anti-fan will turn out to be a complicated experience…

title: Sunshine & Bright Stars
description: Realistic and nuanced slice of school life. A cute, positive, and enthusiastic junior bumps into a girl who does hip-hop, and is emotionally shy and slow despite looking cool. The sweet, tangled-up, heartwarming, and GL story of chasing love.

title: Can't Say No
description: As one knows, talking too much can cause problems. This happened to Guan Cheng when he misspoke during Latin Dance and accidentally caught the attention of Yu Yunfei, who slowly intrudes on his life. “Wait, this man, where have I seen him before?" What will this dense and straightforward man do when he meets an overly attractive male?

title: The Grown Dog Bullies Its Owner
description:
"You there, be mine!"

School grass Xia Zhixing, unwilling to reveal his identity as a streamer, borrows the face of the mysterious top student Lin Lang.

Unexpectedly, the student that resembled a cute little puppy had actually desired him for a long time...

"Senior, the reward I want is you."

title: Kimi no Sumire
description: Recently transferred to a new school, Sumire meets Toujou, a boy they all call, “The school’s solitary Madonna.” After stepping between a fight with Toujou and some others, he takes a liking to Sumire and they begin to spend their school days together. Although beautiful on the outside, Toujou is surprisingly brusque. Despite not making any effort to interact with others, he’s surprisingly sweet to Sumire, which gets Sumire’s heart thumping. One day, after Toujou’s injured in a fight, he suddenly kisses Sumire…!

title: Kawaikunai ne, Kouhai-kun
description:
"You're really not cute!!!"  
  
Akutsu is still only an underclassman but he's got all the girls' attention. Plus, not only is he good in his studies, he's also the ace of the baseball club.  
  
Even though Ida doesn't want have anything to do with Akutsu but somehow they're often together…?  
  
Don't tell me he actually likes me!?

title: Kataomoi x Kataomoi
description:
One day, high-school student Hanamoto is called out by a guy named Furuya, who's in a different class. At first, he thinks that Furuya might be trying to confess to him, but it turns out that he just "wants to be friends." Hanamoto is nonplussed – and perhaps a bit disappointed – but he agrees, and soon finds himself spending more and more time together with Furuya.  
  
But what, really, is this innocent-looking boy's reason for brazenly seeking out Hanamoto's acquaintance?

title: Hyena-kun wa Mitomenai
description:
A special short story for the kemomimi series! The boy that first appeared in *Thoroughbred wa Yuruganai* is…?

title: The Constellation of Us
description: Asterism is both a bland and cruel story between a rebellious boy and an obedient student. Like how two shooting stars fly towards each other, converging and separating without even a single word, the two gradually find their place in each other's lives. The pair become each other's model, and this might just be the strongest display of their feelings.

title: PUNKS △ TRIANGLE
description: Chiaki, a student at a clothing college, had a dream. It is to have Ai, a charismatic model who changed Chiaki's life, walk down the runway wearing clothes he made. When he finds out that his dream will come true if he wins the competition, he becomes enthusiastic, but despairs when his co-production partner turns out to be Enaga, who is both unattractive and extremely clumsy. One night, Chiaki gets tangled up with a delinquent, but it is Ai who saves him. He also sexily asks him to teach him how to have a night out...? The heart-pounding dilemma of an extremely pure boy who is torn between a "mysterious model" and a "natural-looking, hot-headed guy" (actually the same person)!

title: What's Your Name?
description: A stern student volunteer responsible for attendance and adherence to school rules is kissed on the forehead by a mysterious delinquent! Despite repeat violations, he has yet to learn the delinquent's name.

title: Kousuke X Natsuki
description:
[#BL Manga] [Omegaverse]
*Even if they can't put their gratitude and love into words…*
A story about two people who deeply understand each other!
A Puppy-like Alpha × Tsundere Omega Childhood Friends Omegaverse Story
When he goes into heat, the uke becomes honest...
This is the daily life of Kousuke × Natsuki!

title: Gisou Honey Trap
description: Keiichirou Mishima is a 15-year-old guy living with his mom until she suddenly decides to fly to Paris to be with Keiichirou's dad. His mom arranges with his uncle Shirasaki to let him stay at his mansion with his two cousins Marie and Tomari, who he met many years before when he stayed with them for a short while. However, Keiichirou has forgotten nearly everything about back then, including why his cousins apparently now hate him.

title: Seishun Radio Pinchers
description: A sporty blond has joined the Robot Research Club?

title: At the End of the Road
description:
After a car accident, Taemin finds himself in the body of Siwon, who was a victim of bullying at school. No longer a pushover, he starts standing up for himself but then meets Woojin, an old friend from the past. Somehow, Woojin immediately picks up Tamin's 'scent' from Siwon. What happened between these two in the past and how will it affect their future?

title: A Wisdom Tooth
description: The unspeakable secrets between a handsome dentist and his patient's classmate.

title: Bokura ni Namae o Tsukeru Nara
description: In the third year of high school, Izumi Tohsaka reunited with his younger brother, Kaoru Yano. Seven years after my parents divorced, I decided to live together in a dormitory shared room again. Lower voice, red-dyed hair, mature look, unknown surname… Izumi is attracted to him who has changed everything and doesn't even realize he is his younger brother. Even though they are supposed to be siblings, this emotion in my heart…?

title: Rejoice in Your Enemies
description: His beloved crush was snatched up by the nerdy new student.  Furious, Ren Zhichu tries to harass that nerd at every chance he gets. Unexpectedly, during their interactions with each other, Ren Zhichu actually develops feelings for that nerd...

title: Seiheki o Kuruwaseru, Otoko no Ko Tenkousei ga Arawareta!
description: Takehiko who has the soul of a "real boy" who always insists on Katsuragi to be a real boy, but Katsuragi bullies Takehiko the Tsundere.

title: The Guy Inside Me
description:
Who would've thought that rivals, the academic tyrant, Xu Sheng, and the top student, Zhao Zhan, would exchange bodies a few times and then start to like each other secretly! After many clueless situations the two became closer to each other, after they experience some funny stories and incidents, they finally understand their feelings for each other.  
  
¿Quién hubiera pensado que los rivales, el tirano académico, Xu Sheng, y el mejor estudiante, Zhao Zhan, intercambiarían cuerpos unas cuantas veces y luego empezarían a gustarse en secreto? Después de muchas situaciones sin pistas los dos se acercaron más el uno al otro, después de experimentar algunas historias e incidentes divertidos, finalmente entienden sus sentimientos por el otro.

title: Himegoto +
description: Hime's younger brother Kaguya joins the public morals committee because he wants to save Hime from the clutches of the student council vice president.

title: Himegoto (Febri)
description: Hime Arikawa's large amount of debt left to him by his parents is paid off by the Shimoshina High School student council. In return, Hime has to join the student council and spend his high school life cross-dressing.

title: Life Senjou no Bokura
description:
The serious Ito and the child-like Nishi meet by chance during a single player game of “White Line Game” on the way home from school.  
Falling in-love, Ito gets frustrated over the fact that they only get to rendezvous on the white line and suddenly kisses Nishi.  
  
From high school, college and then to adulthood… A deeply moving work depicting the lives of two men who are madly in love with unchanging feelings within changing realities.

title: Raising A Bat
description: High school senior Min-kyum has been left to his own defenses after his parents kicked him out of their lives. His new house is in a shabby neighborhood, the site of several mysterious assaults that have left victims with bite marks on their necks and blood loss symptoms. After moving in, Min-kyum heads out for a meal…then somehow wakes up at home with strange marks on his neck. He tries to shrug it off, but his deskmate at the new school looks suspiciously pale and familiar…

title: Fools
description: Eungi has been in college without being engaged with others. One day by encounter, he finds the secret of underclassman Jeongwoo. Why are you so nervous to forget? A love story that’s both easy and difficult.

title: Caramel Honey
description:
Ayato transfers into a new school, hoping for a fresh start. Sadly for him, the school turns up to be filled with deliquents, and the most feared of them all has his eye set on him. It doesn't help that whenever Ayato accidentally takes off his glasses, everyone around him suddenly becomes completely smitten by him!  


---

title: Last Paradise
description: This is a story about Myunghan, who has just entered high school, Sihoo, his childhood friend, Seungchan, who suddenly appears between the two, and the strange triangle that develops between the three of them.

title: #B ga L suru 4 Page Anthology ~Sono Toki Boku wa, Koi wo Shita!~
description:
“I think I’ve fallen for you…”  

A 4-page shorts collection of BL stories depicting such moments. Includes works of 29 popular and talented authors. Look forward to it.

title: That Summer
description: Kim Jumi's life is like that of any other teenager preparing for her CSAT's: all work and no play. But one summer day, she witnesses something on the rooftop of her school… From then on, she finds herself getting tangled up with two boys who are in a complicated relationship.

title: You Are My All
description:
The delinquent Kusunoki admires one person - and that is an upperclassman from another school who saved him while he was being beat up; brimming with manliness (but physically small) - Hayato-san. Though large in both body and attitude, Kusunoki is completely submissive to Hayato. He becomes Hayato's underling and escorts him to and back from school, cooks him lunch, and thinks of Hayato all the time when they can't meet. Kusunoki realizes that his feelings are of love through his friend's remarks. Just being subservient to him is not enough, but he wants to do more with the cute and cool Hayato-san…  
However, his confessions are always being disturbed by Hayato's nasty friend, Misao, and Hayato himself, who is very simple-minded and pure…

title: Aoi Hitomi no Bakemono
description:
Ever since he was born, Tatsumi Kodama has possessed blue eyes, a familial trait that grants them supernatural abilities. Whenever he meets gazes with someone, he can see every thought that person has ever thought. But forced to live on an isolated island with other blue-eyed family members, this power has only proved itself a curse. His childhood friend is Kei Arima, the adopted son of a family who looks after the secluded members of the Kodama family.

Tatsumi is well-aware of Kei's romantic interest in him, but he refuses to acknowledge his feelings. The burden of bearing blue eyes is insurmountable, and as Tatsumi slowly distances himself from Kei, their bond grows fractured. Will Tatsumi ever be able to meet Kei's gaze?

title: Ashita wa Kitto Tomodachi Janai, Yone
description: Akari và Mikage là bạn thời thơ ấu từ khi học mẫu giáo. Akari thích Mikage, nhưng không nói cho cậu ấy biết. Akari muốn ủng hộ hạnh phúc của Mikage, người được các bạn nữ chú ý. Tuy nhiên, Mikage đã từ chối cô gái vừa tỏ tình và nói "Chúng ta hông thể vì tôi có người tôi thích rồi."

title: Horror Anthology Comic Shikaku Kureta Ai
description:
From just beyond your field of vision—

The gem of horror anthologies, “Comic Shikaku (Blindside),” returns with an all-new lineup!

Nine brand-new stories that explore the thin boundary where love and madness meet.

title: The Part-time Housekeeper!
description:
Fired from his part-time job and out of money, Han Jaemin ends up having a one night stand with a rude but handsome guy. But when he finally gets a new job, Han Jaemin finds that he is his new boss?!  
  
(Snow Flower Scans)

title: Koi wa Inamono Komarimono
description:
One day, Takeda, an overly serious model student, suddenly received a passionate confession of love from his rival Fukamachi, a frivolous elite who's top tier in looks, brains and athletic abilities. Takeda has only ever seen Fukamachi in a hostile manner and he's been going all out in rejecting the latter's persistent advances.

Then one night, he got dragged into helping Fukamachi who was out helping his private detective brother to look for a lost cat. That's when Takeda saw an unexpected side of Fukamachi who he always thought he would never be able to get along with...

This is the bumpy high school romance between a carefree, frivolous and handsome natural genius and an overly serious and straight-laced model student who just don't get along. Less...

title: Untouchable
description: A bad boy on the surface, a good kid on the inside; A bully on the surface, but a mischievous little devil on the inside. Two teenagers with different lives and different personalities develop a wonderful friendship by sheer chance. How will they make it last? "Untouchable" is here to answer that!

title: Na man ui Gyeyakcheonsa
description: After being traumatised from getting forcefully outed, Yeonho, a closeted gay, is a "single-for-life" who has never dated anyone. One day, Yeonho gets hit by a shooting star, and he woke up to see someone, who calls himself "Cupid", sharing his bed! The strange man promised to end Yeonho's one-sided crushes, but will he really…?

title: Kyun to Shite, Yamagami-kun!
description:
Ookawa and Yamagami were childhood friends, close like brothers...or were they? Their relationship became strained after Yamagami, who used to be a bit of a dodder, transformed into a high-spec, elite, glasses-wearing guy.

"Oh, I wish I had a kinder, cuter female childhood friend."

Whether Ookawa's wish was granted or it was a whim of the gods, Yamagami was cursed with the following: "When he sneezes, he turns into a woman" and "When he feels love, he turns back into a man." (Ookawa is cursed to remain a virgin forever.) The key to this "love" lies with his awful childhood friend, Ookawa...!?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Nonfiction Phrase
description: Movie lover Seo Dongju and genius composer Han Dawoon's first encounter couldn't be worse! But after they accidentally reunite at school and get acquainted, they grow more and more curious about each other… The two boys’ chaotic and heart-fluttering melody unfolds~

title: Someone else's BL Manhwa
description:
Seunghee may seem like a regular high school boy, but he's got a few secrets: he loves to cross-dress and read BL comics. He's looking for a match that will accept him, but it's classmate Seungtaek who spies him on a date gone bad. Now that someone at school knows he's gay, can Seunghee's life remain ordinary the way he likes it?  


---

title: Harem Manga no Shujinkou daga Douseiaisha nano de Mainichi ga Tsurai
description:
---
**Note:**
- This manga contains storyboard drafts the author created for Jump Magazine to be considered for serialization. [Source](https://twitter.com/kuzushinsetsu/status/742325718541967360)

**Link:**
- Alternate Official Raw - [Pixiv](https://www.pixiv.net/user/14502453/series/57948) (Note: The chapter order is reversed), [Niconico Redirect](https://manga.nicovideo.jp/comic/21927)

title: Koibito ga Ubu Sugite Komaru
description: Hasegawa, a quiet high school student who had been suddenly confessed to by Hiyama, the class' outgoing and cheerful guy. When Hasegawa asked, "What do you do when you're dating?" Hiyama's proposal was a diary exchange. Despite the unexpected innocence, Hasegawa accepted the confession. Two classmates who had never spoken in class gradually closed the gap and discovered love—a pure and innocent youth story!

title: Okubyoumono ni I Love You
description: Due to his scary face, Shougo has been alone since entering university. But unexpected events lead him to become close with Hina, from the same university. Shougo, elated at the fact he's become friends with the cool and kind Hina, finds out that Hina breaks out into hives when people treat him with affection - a "love allergy"?!

title: Cherry Pink & Sugar High
description:
Since he was a child, Yukishiro Ibuki has always had a complex of getting red-faced whenever someone gets close to him. But thanks to his efforts, he successfully creates a persona of being the "aloof student council president"! His high school life is smooth-sailing... until his childhood friend Kagachi Rin, who knows his past, transfers into his school! Ibuki is wary of Rin's assertive advances, but...?

This is the start of an electrifying "special training" with his childhood friend who gets too close.

title: Itadakimasu, wa Koi no Aji
description:
A high school boy's lunchbox is filled with excitement! A BL about young love between a picky eater and a cooking fanatic!　

Mizuno, a cooking fanatic, is so preoccupied about what other people eat that he even keeps a close eye on his classmates' lunches. He's particularly taken aback by the picky eater, Hashimoto, and worries that someday he'll get sick, and after a certain chain of events, Mizuno gets stuck with making Hashimoto's lunches for him! At first, Mizuno isn't crazy about the idea, but as he watches Hashimoto's face as he eats his perfectly balanced and nutritious packed lunches with gusto, Mizuno starts to enjoy his lunch time as well...

title: Sensei no Sensei
description: On the day of the school entrance ceremony, novice teacher Ooji (α), reunites with Yasumi (β), the counselor who once saved him during his student days. This reunion waters the seeds of his past love…

title: Gunjou no Subete
description: Makihara Kai and Mizushiro Ren have been in the same class from the beginning of middle school up to their second year of high school. But then they're separated in their last year. In the days where nothing ever changes, small ripples begin to form and hidden feelings begin to bloom. You want to say it, but you can't. Those words hidden for ages deep in your heart… when they come out, what will the answer be?

title: Garden in the Closet
description:
Kouki is a high school student with a large build who fits in effortlessly with the guys. Yet deep down, he often feels bewildered by the topics of their conversations and finds himself unable to openly share his extensive knowledge of plants. 

One day, a transfer student named Misaki joins their class. However — for some reason — Misaki remains completely invisible to Kouki alone. While everyone around him interacts with Misaki as if nothing's wrong, Kouki is left wondering: What kind of expressions is he wearing as he speaks to him? 

Before he knows it, Kouki finds himself constantly tracking Misaki with his eyes; through him, he is destined to confront a world he never knew existed.

**Alt Raw:** [Pixiv](https://comic.pixiv.net/works/13052), [Cmoa](https://www.cmoa.jp/title/356612/vol/7/)

title: Nonke to Gachi no Osananajimi
description: On Valentine’s day. The top ikemen (cool boy) in the school, Hiko, is the most popular in the school among the girls again this year! At this time, the girls all gather, aiming for the ikemen Hiko… “Take this! My heart’s desire!” Reverberating through the hallways is a passionate confession. And the person who delivered the handmade chocolates was his childhood “boyfriend”!    The Hiko who wants to stay friends and the Ken-chan who wants to become lovers, the intersection of the two different meanings of “like”–…? An earnest and simple “pure romance”? Comedy!

title: Watashi wo Misete, Ore wo Mite
description: High school student Mochizuki loves to dress up as a woman. While he was out cross-dressing one day, fellow student Amano, who's known for being a playboy, tries to pick him up! Not wanting to be found out, Mochizuki runs away. However, the next day at school, Amano discovers the truth and tells him he'll keep his secret under a certain condition…

title: Boku-tachi wa Mada Aoku: Daigaku Nyuugaku-hen
description: Issei Saegusa is a young man who met Touru Arochi, a brusque transfer student, during his senior year of high school. After a series of twists and turns, the two are accepted into the same university. The morning of the entrance ceremony arrives with great anticipation. Although Issei wants to spend more time with Touru, he doesn't want to neglect his studies, either, because he is studying aerospace engineering. Toru, on the other hand, wants to improve his social skills in university. Then, he meets someone new right away...?

title: Gwak Hajun Gwanchalilji
description:
Cha In-woo, a shy student with zero presence, becomes partners with Kwak Ha-jun, who looks exactly like his favorite game character. While Cha In-woo is excited to bond with him while working on homework assigned by his teacher, Cha In-woo suddenly finds himself drawn into a cruel bet by Kwak Ha-jun...

A heartwarming romantic comedy between two high school students!

title: Run Wild
description:
As soon as Jiang Cheng finds out he's adopted, he's abandoned by his adoptive family and sent to live with his deadbeat father, who has a gambling addiction. Everything about his new life, from his pathetic father to the unfamiliar environment, makes Jiang Cheng depressed. But then he meets Gu Fei, who's like a shining bright light in this run-down city, and the two become each other's salvation and hope.
(Source: Tappytoon)

title: Naisho ni Shite ne
description:
English:  
Akane is a second year student who enjoys his student life. Tojo, one of Akane’s classmates, is Akane’s new roommate. Until last year Tojo was an ordinary, serious and excellent student, but one day, he suddenly dyed his hair red, got a piercing and started wearing fashionable clothes? The roommate's life began in surprise. One day, Akane saw Tojo sneaking out of the dormitory in the middle of the night! Tojo was Ignoring the dormitory rules and going out to work at night. What is going on? Seems like Tojo has something he wants to keep secret, Akane worries that something might happen to him and is unable to remain indifferent?!  
Welcome to <<Must stay secret>>

title: The Panther's Pet
description: In a world where beastmen and humans coexist, Gaku attends a college that consists of mainly beastman, a rarity in the world. Despite being the subject of his study, he's still not had much close interaction with them... That is until a chance encounter under the tree with Rui. Rui's the resident troublemaker who just so happens to be a leopard beastman. Soon a casual favor quickly leads Gaku into catching the eye of real predator!

title: Doushitemo Yaritakute Gakuen
description: Four idiot high school students attending a boys school for idiots are on a quest to get girlfriends! For this, they need to better understand the female mind! They somehow make the logical leap that the best way to do so is through doing gay stuff with each other. Armed with BL manga, they start their pleasure investigation!

title: Smells Like Green Spirit
description: Mishima, a student at a school in the countryside, is bullied by his classmates. The reason is because he's seemingly gay. In reality, Mishima does like guys, so he doesn't resist their bullying, and instead, finds solace in secretly cross-dressing. One day on the rooftop, Mishima finds the lipstick he'd lost before in the hands of Kirino, one of the bullies… and Kirino was about to put on the lipstick that Mishima used on his own lips. This is the story of young boys looking for a place they can really be themselves…

title: Guang Xiang
description: A story about two youthful boys–one named Yu Xiao Guang, the other named Lin Xiang–who have to deal with the problems forced upon them by both society and their families. How will they console each other during the tough teenage years? What will be the true nature of their friendship? And what does the future hold for them?

title: Hontou wa Suki na no ni
description: The two, Natsuki and Naoto, have grown together since kindergarten. As they grew older things changed a lot. Naoto now instead of being a crybaby and shy child has become a formidable man, which makes Natsuki feel attracted without knowing why. What will happen to the attraction that is starting to feel Natsuki? If Naoto realize … what would you do …?

title: Yoake no Polaris
description:
*"You're a student!" "So what?"*

While carrying Yura, the beautiful English teacher, the flirty Haga impulsively kisses him in the midst of the sports festival, in front of the whole school, no less! Yura summons him to the counseling office after school the next day. Unexpectedly, the teacher finds himself being hit on by Haga, much to his dismay. Although he started off just wanting to tease him at first, Haga ends up being serious about Yura, who’s a little coarse and cute, and wants to kiss him over and over again?!

title: Sorry I Couldn't Protect You!
description: Is this fate? Chess, a close friend of Benjamin, appears before him looking for a roommate. Will this meeting rekindle the friendship they once had? Or will this turn out into something better? Watch out as their story unfolds . . .

title: Ai no Jikken
description:
“I like you, Yuichi”  
  
“Huh?!”  
  
“I wanted to tell you before I took time off school. Is that weird? I’m sorry.”  
  
Yuichi was suddenly confessed to by his childhood friend, Chihiro.  
  
Chihiro will be taking time off school… What’s going on?!  
  
However, Yuichi begins to notice Chihiro’s increasing number of injuries and unsettled emotions, as well as the strong attraction he feels towards Chihiro, whose true feelings only hurt himself.  
  
Young, inexperienced and clumsy. But that’s what makes them all the more sinful and heartwarming!  
  
A story of a life changing romance between two childhood friends.

title: Shoutotsu! Futatsuboshi Sakusen
description:
"I love you." "That's disgusting."  
  
The fidgety and red-faced kouhai who confessed to him turned out to be Shuichirou. Although Atsushi rebuffs Shuichirou in less than 3 seconds, the latter relentlessly confesses his love every day. Even saying his type is "girls with big boobs" doesn't stop Shuichirou.  
  
In the midst of that, Atsushi tries to get Shuichirou to back off by doing perverted things to him…?!

title: Mahou Shounen Majorian
description: Iori is a timid, feminine boy. Masaru is an aggressive boy who leads the other boys in bullying Iori. One day, they encounter a pair of strange extraterrestrial bunnies who turn them into magical girls in order to fight aliens that are invading their town.

title: Yoake ni Furu
description: This story takes place a few years after Hoshino and Sudou have settled down together. Sudou's son Shouta is in high school now and so is his former classmate Daiki from elementary school. How has their relationship changed?

title: Hatsukoi
description: Hirono Yuusa always believed he was special and destined for greatness – until tragedy struck in his final year of middle school. Now jaded and disillusioned, he's completely given up on trying to be anything more than ordinary. But when he starts to notice classmate Himekawa Ichigo struggling to do his best against all odds, he can't help but want to cheer him on.

title: High School Return of a Gangster
description: A gangster dies saving a bullied teen — and wakes up in the boy’s body. Living the school life he always dreamed of, he vows revenge for the boy’s suffering. But when the boy's long-time crush begins to suspect he’s not who he says he is, things start to spiral...

title: Two&Too
description: Ah, the young and in love. Read to see where Shen Nantang's lighthearted university endeavors take him!

title: Bìyè Dào Jìshí
description: With graduation just around the corner, a straight boy was confessed to by his classmate. Faced with an unexpected confession, Wu Ying first refused. But the other party keeps persisting to be close to him “in this way”…

title: Back To School
description: Chiwoo’s got issues. Upon returning to school after the “incident” last year, he vows to keep to himself and stay out of trouble until graduation. Easier said than done: his bad boy reputation has made him the talk of the school, and Kyujin - class president and model student - won’t stop being friendly. Trouble arrives soon enough in the shape of Jihyun, a tattooed hunk from Chiwoo’s dark past. It’s gonna be a tough year…

title: Hankei 15cm no Hatsukoi
description: A story of a bright and straightforward high schooler and his pure, devoted childhood friend. Keita and Tomoya are childhood friends living in adjacent apartments. They always thought they'd remain friends forever, but one day Tomoya suddenly announces that he’s moving and reveals his long-held feelings.

title: Boku no Geboku ni Nare!
description: Yukinari Takase is a huge masochist who instantly takes a liking to Rion Tachibana, a menacing trap who just transferred into his class. After Rion believes Takase has uncovered his secret, he decides to make Takase his servant in order to keep his mouth shut. (From: MU)

title: Igarashi-kun to Nakahara-kun
description: Merry Christmas: Former reclusive boy Fuyugo Nakahara in class 2-E made his high school debut as a quiet and cool lone wolf in order to dispel the trauma of his past. And with him, the serious yet charismatic Sakura Igarashi from class 2-F. In the spring of their second year of high school, these two seemingly distant individuals come together and what follows next is…?

title: Outside Flower
description:
"Mister, are you a virgin?"  
  
Masamoto, a 29-year-old guy. He has serious problems relating to people, in addition to being single. But, to change that, one day he decides to go to a gay meeting place and get a date. But, while he was hesitating whether to go in or not, a high school student appears who seems to be lost, Sakuya, and he catches his eye. This action immediately caused him to run away from the place. But one day, the two of them meet again at the cinema. After talking for a while, both realize that they have similar tastes. But then, Sakuya-san says he'll help Masamoto get a partner…?!

title: Sensei Anone
description: Ineffectual high-school teacher Kakenshi catches his (male) student Nakamura using school computers after-hours to make naughty crossdressing webcam shows. Kakenshi persuades Nakamura to stop, but only because Nakamura has a new hobby: seducing Kakenshi! Will Kakenshi surrender his heterosexuality and give in to his cute crossdressing student's affections? An ecchi rom-com aimed at crossdressing fans, from the boys-in-skirts (otokonoko) magazine Oto☆Nyan.

title: Seikaku Kuzu de Nani ga Warui
description:
Hanaura auto-proclaimed himself to be trash, and among other things, he chose to be alone in his classroom. However, all of a sudden, he is confessed to by the most popular guy in school, Tsuzuki!?  
  
Hanaura can't reject him properly – his time together with Tsuzuki ends up being perfect, but when it comes to himself, he can't return those feelings to begin with…

title: Heartthrob
description: Being the new kid in school is never easy. Especially not for a wallflower like Eun-jae, who has spent most of his childhood in and out of hospitals because of his weak heart. Now, his only wish is to live and experience life as a normal high schooler. Unfortunately, the high school experience for him not only means attending classes and making friends, but also getting bullied for looking like an omega. But things aren’t all bad. Not when you consider his regular encounters with Jin-hyeon, the popular kid in school. As accidents and coincidences keep bringing them together, Eun-jae realizes he had met Jin-hyeon a long time ago… even if the latter doesn’t remember. And although a throbbing heart has always been a cause for concern, Eun-jae discovers a heart can throb for sweeter reasons too.

title: Sonna Me de Mitekure
description: Mikado – a narcissistic, spoiled, school-idol type rich boy – falls in love at first sight with an awkward, plain-looking scholarship student who's completely immune to his charms.

title: Osananajimina Kimi Ga Tamaranaku Daisuki ！
description: 高校1年生な橙田旭には、隣に住む同い年の幼なじみがいる。彼の名前は紫ノ宮和音、旭にとって唯一の推しで大天使で世界一尊い存在。可愛くて時にかっこいい…そんな和音がたまらなく大好きな旭のハピネスコメディー!

title: Tonari no Ren-kun wa Chotto Kowai
description:
These two guys are nothing alike, but they've been friends since elementary school. Ren looks scary at first glance, but he's soft and mushy in front of Tadaomi! If only they knew about their feelings towards each other....

Notes:
- Originally published on Twitter and Pixiv.
- Includes 14 extra chapters.

title: Chameleon wa Tenohira ni Koi o Suru.
description:
Nội dung: 

Nam diễn viên Fujinaga (sinh viên năm hai đại học) yêu thích diễn xuất. Nhưng cậu thường xuyên trượt các buổi thử giọng nên dần mất tự tin. Đó cũng là lúc cậu gặp Keito (sinh viên đại học năm thứ nhất) bị khiếm thính bẩm sinh. Mặc dù đây là lần đầu tiên Fujinaga trải nghiệm ngôn ngữ ký hiệu nhưng cậu vẫn có thể đọc được chuyển động của tay trong nháy mắt vì cậu đã luôn hành động với mong muốn "truyền tải" thông điệp nhiều hơn bất kỳ ai khác.
Cuối cùng, cậu quyết định thử ngôn ngữ ký hiệu bằng cử chỉ, điều này khiến Keito ngạc nhiên vì tài năng của cậu trong quá trình học tập.

Sinh viên đại học khiếm thính x diễn viên không mấy thành công. Một câu chuyện tình yêu cảm động kết nối những trái tim thông qua ngôn ngữ ký hiệu

title: Kawaii Futago no Neru to Rune
description:
Two cute twins who are both boys!
An adorable 4-koma about being loved, protected, and living a healthy life.

title: Gyaru-kun no Koi wa Kitto
description:
You don't know how I feel, so why are you being kind to me?

Yoshi, who is super-cheerful, has a secret after-school date with Fuji, a sober boy who is the complete opposite.
It's supposed to be "practice for Fuji-kun to find a lover", but Yoshi secretly has a crush on Fuji!?
If love is revealed, this relationship will end
But his heart throbs at times when Fuji-kun is too cool!
In fact, whereabouts of the love of the super brave Gal-kun...

A plain handsome guy who doesn't know love x a brave gal-kun who is timid about love.

title: Futago no Ouji ni Futago de Konyaku Shita kedo "Ja nai Hou" dakara Yami Mahou wo Kiwameru
Hallway to the Abyss
description:
He was a teacher who knew his student was gay and still desired his body.
After running away from everything, he became a wanderer and took the name Mos-san.

Yanagida struggled with the pain of being in love with the same sex. 
He committed attempted rape on a student when he was a teacher, and ran away from there. 
Before he knew it he had become Mos, a pitiful demon who had thrown his past away, but had no choice but to keep on living. 
He thought he'd lost everything but a single boy reached out his hand to him.

Seven years have passed since the painful but passionate story of 'Smells Like Green Spirit.'

title: 1cm Inexperienced Us
description:
Lee Hae-min who attends the elite school, Choegang High School!  
The reason why he, who is a model student, transferred to Choi Hwa High School, the complete opposite of Choegang High School, was to find a handsome man..?!

title: Lemon Soda Flavor Kiss
description: "A kiss from my best friend!?" Rio and Leo have been childhood friends since kindergarten. However, as they start their last year of high school, they're in separate classes for the first time. It's during this first day of the new school year that Leo suddenly confesses to Rio and kisses him.... What's going on!?

title: Haru to Natsu to Nacchan to Aki to Fuyu to Boku
description:
Ephemeral but beautiful days that are in danger of shattering...

Shima and Natsuo lives in a normal countryside that you can find almost anywhere. They are normal high school boys that you can find almost anywhere. However, their blissful love is unique only to them and cannot be found anywhere else.

title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure - Clamp in Wonderland: JoJo's Bizarre Married Life (Doujinshi)
description:
Meet Jotaro Kujo and Noriyaki Kakyoin. Both high school students who have special powers called Stands, they traveled around the world to defeat the villainous DIO Brando and save Jotaro's mother Holy. But now… they're married?  
  
A doujin based on the Stardust Crusaders arc of the long running series JoJo's Bizarre Adventure. It's made by CLAMP, a group known for series like xxxHolic, Tsubasa: Reservoir Chronicle, and Cardcaptor Sakura. Because of its… content, it is considered a rite of passage for many a fledgling JoJo fan (alongside the infamous Duwang scans).  
  
Contains spoilers to Part 3.

title: Miki no Houkago -after school-
description:
This is a continuation of the previously published Miki no Houkago.  
  
After Itsuki finds out that his classmate, Miki, has been crossdressing after school, he's worried, but goes along with it.   
One day on a school trip, they find themselves alone in a room…

I thought the distance between us would stay like this?" A love story between a cool catcher and a stupid baseball pitcher, childhood friends and battery-mates. The pitcher Yuudai and Shoutarou, the catcher, have been childhood friends and a battery since they can remember. The third year baseball players retired and now it's time for the the second year players to start aiming for the Koushien! However, before the autumn tournament, Yuudai suddenly starts to have the yips, which leads to an unexpected change in their lives. After embracing the same dream and chasing the white ball for 10 years, the distance between the two swayed... What will become of them?

title: Iyahaya Atami-kun
description: A handsome boy, the most handsome in his school, who is constantly receiving and rejecting girls' confessions. What they don't know is that he is in love with another boy.

title: Boku wa Shitteiru
description:
High school student, Sunao, was commuting to school when he noticed a salaryman on the bus. On his ring finger, were teeth marks hidden by a ring. Who left those marks? Is it a sign of possession? Or maybe…  
  
Before he knew it, Sunao's head was filled with fantasies about him. One day, he runs into the salaryman at his part time job at an izakaya. He drunkenly confronts Sunao and kisses him…!?  
  
These straightforward and painful emotions are too young to be called love. A love between a high school student and a salaryman!  
  
Also included is an extra, "6th Year Obsession," featuring the two of them after the events of the main story!

title: Houkago Edge
description: Tobari's always loved cute and feminine things, which sparked his eventual venture into drag. One day, while he was out in public dressed as a high school girl, he bumps into fellow classmate Inui. It's annoying to Tobari how amusing Inui finds this surprise encounter, but at least he's promised not to tell anyone. But with no plans of letting him off for this hobby, Inui proposes something outrageous. He is twisted and unstable, but for some reason, his words are reassuring.

title: Distance Between Us
description: “I wanna graduate so I don't have to see him ever again...” Under the blue sky, Hyunwoo’s youth spins in a circle. Same class, next seat in the bus, and his bright smile. The smallest things take quite a strain on Hyunwoo’s heart, seeking for jealousy and dictatorship. Wanting to get closer, but still keeping the distance. Why is love so complicated? Today as well, the distance between Hyunwoo and Chanhee stays the same as ever.

title: Endou-kun no Kansatsu Nikki
description: Because of changes in seating arrangements, high school student Tsuda ends up behind the quiet and expressionless Endou. Their interactions are born from a trivial incident, and he begins to see a side of Endou that he has never gotten to know before. That mole, slender nape, and soft hair. The subtle faces that he makes and little changes in his attitude. But Tsuda, who used to be indifferent about others and never made any deep connections, now feels impatient about the distance between Endou and himself. What on earth is drawing these feelings?

title: Koi ni Naru ni wa Yayakoshii
description:
*The most popular guy at school has his heart set on someone...and it's me?!*

On the behalf of his twin sister, Tsuzumi, Chikage asks Issei out, a popular honor student at his school. Not wanting Issei to date his sister, he approaches him hoping to get rejected. To his shock and dismay, Issei accepts the confession! Furious, Chikage plays along and the two start going out—all while pretending to be Tsuzumi. As their relationship progresses, Chikage learns more about the unexpected sides of Issei, and little by little, he begins to let his guard down around him. Then one day, Chikage discovers the truth behind his confession...!

title: Love is an Illusion! - Superstar
description:
Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences.

title: Koi wa Nanairo Shichihenge!?
description: The first girl that Reio falls in love with at a cosplay festival turns out the be an older guy, Haruto! He was shocked at first, but he slowly begins to fall for him…

title: Haruno to Natsukawa.
description: On his first day of high school, Haruno decides to have a coming out and goes to school in a girl's uniform, much to his childhood friend Haruno's surprise.

title: Wo Xihuan Ni De Xinxi Su
description:
As a good-looking Beta with a good family background, Duan Jiayan has lived a smooth sailing life for more than ten years, until he met Lu Xingci in high school.

Lu Xingci’s family situation is better than his, he is taller than him and plays basketball better than him. Needless to say, his grades are a whole tier above Duan Jiayan’s. Even his friends can’t help but occasionally praise Lu Xingci.

Most importantly, every girl that Duan Jiayan has set his sights on, all admitted that they have liked Lu Xingci for a few years already.

Since then, Duan Jiayan has never thought well of Lu Xingci, till the day he received his new medical report. He is a late-blooming Omega, and because he became an Omega this late, it came with dire consequences. Now Alphas will feel the need to beat up other people whenever they come near Duan Jiayan. He himself is now allergic to every Alpha’s pheromone, except Lu Xingci’s.

title: Kyou, Sukitte Iimasu
description:
University student, Rintarou, is in love with his rental boyfriend, Asahi. Knowing that it is all pretend doesn't stop his heart from racing when confronted by Asahi's kindness. Every time they meet, his feelings continue to grow stronger.
One day, as Rintarou finds himself unable to make another rental appointment out of concern he won't be able to stop his feelings from growing, he stumbples across Asahi in town. While Rintarou is taken aback by the uncharacteristically serious look on Asahi's face, Asahi starts leaning in for a kiss...?!

Fifth chapter is a completed oneshot known as KOI WA KITSUNE MOUYOU.

title: Nande Omae ga Ki ni Nannen!?
description:
"But the guy I like should be that one!"

Having moved to Tokyo from the countryside, the gay Azuma met Kyoutarou and fell in love at first sight!
He's so happy to have met his type, but Azuma feels a hostile presence behind him.
He turns around to see Miyako glaring at Azuma from behind his glasses.
Apparently, he too has had a crush on Kyoutarou for many years...
Azuma wants to get closer to Kyoutarou, but Miyako keeps annoyingly getting in the way.
But, as the three of them spend time together, Miyako's bad first impression, that made Azuma think he was an "sneaky bastard", began to change little by little.

title: Kimi no Kao ga Suki da
description:
c.1-3 : Kimi no Kao ga Suki da Can you fall in love with someone by looking at them? Chikawa is a high-school art student who likes staring at Naozumi. He can’t look away. He even gets teased for spending his free time in art class drawing Naozumi’s face. One afternoon, Naozumi agrees to model for Chikawa on an art piece. Together in the quiet space of the art room, Chikawa begins to wonder. If you’re always looking at someone, does that mean you can see them for who they truly are?  
  
c.4-6 : Soine Boyfriend Note: Soine Boyfriend 「添い寝ボーイフレンド」

title: A Model Best Friend
description: "I want a childhood friend like this".

title: Stay Gold
description: Yuuji has to live with his deadbeat brother and his sister's children. After years of peaceful cohabitation, his teenage nephew shows up with golden hair, upsetting his whole environment. What is this uncle supposed to do?

title: Itoshii Bokura
description:
"The reason I'm here right now is thanks to Ryuu."

Ryuu, with a complex about his looks, lives unable to stand up to his classmates who pick on him. One day, his classmate who's as beautiful as a celebrity, Fukuda Ema, calls out to him.

Ryuu rejects him saying "we're from two different worlds," but they were actually childhood friends back in first grade.

Ema, who used to be insecure about his looks just like Ryuu, has grown not just physically but mentally, says it's all thanks to Ryuu and quickly starts to close the distance between them...

Super beautiful popular boy × kind-hearted insecure boy glow-up love!

title: Saiaku no Jinsei
description: Kawashima is a third year high school student who's always had a shitty life. He has a violent personality so people constantly misjudge him and his actions. One day he meets Sayama, a first year who's good at everything but has zero ambitions in life. Thanks to his easy-going personality, he becomes the only person who's ever tried to understand Kawashima. These two will have a huge impact on each other's lives.

title: Nekura to Gyaru Otoko
description:
He was supposed to be a friend I hated so much, but even so, I really wanted to meet him again.

When Tomo-chan finds out that his old friend, Hana-kun, who moved away when they were in elementary school, is now attending the same school as him they finally meet again.

Tension increases between the two of them because they can't stop thinking of each other.

What's going to happen next in this story?

title: A Strange Joke
description:
This is the story of two people living out their campus romance, the returning transfer student Min who has a tough time with love and the department legend Joon who's scared of romance.  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Ore ni wa Zenbu Kikoeteru!
description:
When he was a child, high school student Miyahira Asahi started helping people to be like a popular superhero he saw. But he's always just a "good guy".
Even though he's excited to change classes and insists "This year I'll get a girlfriend!", he ends up in the same class as cool and good-looking school idol Genda Kaede.
When he goes to bed frustrated, an angel appears before his eyes and tells him, "I'm giving you telepathic powers." He thought it was just a dream, but the next morning, he could hear people's inner voices when he touched them...!?

To take advantage of his ability, and become the most popular guy in school, he decides to explore Kaede's thoughts, but...

A hectic youth love comedy that begins with telepathy

title: Katappashi Kara Zenbu Koi
description: Out of the blue, childhood friend Takaoka confesses to Iwami! When popular playboy and ladies man Takaoka says "I love you", he doesn't believe it one bit. Is he making fun of the virgin!? A modern high-school boys' adolescent love development.

title: Natsuharu
description: A romantic comedy depicting the high school life of an ordinary high school boy and a cross-dressing boy.

title: The Matchmaking Club
description: Asuka and her friends decide to help their always angry, strict teacher Hiroji find love to save their club!

title: Himeno-kun wa Hime ni Naritakunai
description:
Himeno-kun has become the princess of his boys' school because of his face and the surname "Himeno".
Just when he was thinking of how to get rid of this position, Yurine Himekawa, a transfer student with a feminine face and an elegant aura appeared! Himeno tries to push his "princess" title to him, but...?

title: Boarding House Number 5
description: “Come on in! It’s your first time at a boarding house, right?” The unemployed Sulwon has taken over his parents’ boarding house so they could return to their hometown to farm. A story about life with boarding house tenants of all kinds!

title: Liquor Gummies
description: Xiang Qihong, a college student who has been unwilling to go to school for a long time, was entrusted by a university professor and a friend one day to help take care of their nephew! So now all of a sudden there's an older student/neighbour who had an elusive personality. Can Xiang Qihong get along well with the other party if he is so used to living alone?

title: Chotto Damatte
description: Saika Dengo is a person with the super-natural power to talk directly to people’s minds. One day he gets accused of talking to much in his mind by some random guy . Their first meeting doesn’t go well when the guy is rude to Saika. When they meet again the guy tells Saika that he can hear his thoughts inside his head. The guy then confirms that it’s only Saika’s thoughts that he can hear. When Saika tries to think of why this is happening the guy suddenly kisses him to try to silence his thoughts. The guy then suggests they go out so that hearing Saika’s thoughts isn’t so creepy. When that goes wrong, Saika feel’s bad and decides he also wants to know more about the guy. Finally, Saika asks for the guys name. Find out what happens with these two!

title: You Will Hate Me
description:
NamGung JunWon is the elementary school archenemy of MinSoo, and someone who should've been long forgotten. But much to MinSoo's surprise, when a new and super handsome transfer student starts to create a buzz… it’s none other than NamGung JunWon himself.
