JunWon approaches him saying "I'll certainly make you like me" but MinSoo thinks otherwise and proclaims, "I'll make you hate me!"  
  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Kurayami ni Strobe
description:
Arata, who is in love with his childhood friend Miyamoto, always eavesdrops on the confessions his friend receives from girls but Miyamoto constantly rejects these confessions, saying he already has someone he likes. One day, Miyamoto catches Arata eavesdropping and asks: "Want to know who?"

Note, Utsusemi ni Tomoru was never included in a volume release and as such should not be numbered as part of volume 1.

title: Sekai ga Hajimaru Asa ni Umi wo Mito
description:
Ao lives with his father, who has a bad drinking habit, in a town with a beautiful view of the sea. He spends his time trying to be as inconspicuous as possible, both at his high school and at home, as if he's holding his breath. One day, while on the way home from school, he meets Minato smoking a cigarette on the station platform. Minato, who works at a bento shop in spite of his blonde hair and piercings, can't stand the fact that Ao eats food from the convenience store every day, so he offers him a suggestion: "Instead of making you a bento every day, comment on my cooking"...?
The story of two young men who meet in a seaside town, and their once-in-a-lifetime true love.

title: Usotsuki Boyfriend
description: This is the story of Sakaki Yuuto, a 17-year-old highschooler who ends up with an unusual job: breaking up relationships by making girls fall in love with him. Unfortunately, in spite of his good looks, he is useless when it comes to women. While his younger brother chases the males and his older brother guides them from behind the scenes, will he be able to successfully play his part and charm the target? And most importantly, will he be able to obey the number one rule of the 'Breakup House', to never fall in love with the target?

title: Become a Girl at Night
description: He comes across a cute girl on the way home in the late night. Out of kindness, he helps "her" get out of trouble and decided to let "her" stay just one night at his house. But "she" doesn't seem to interest him much, by contrast, "she" is kicked out of his bed when "she" is trying to sleep with him…

title: Kore ga Saigo no Koi no Hanashi
description:
“I want to live with you forever.”
At his wits end over a failed love, Asami is a reincarnated individual and he’s ready to jump from the rooftop of a building to keep his connection to his lover when he’s rescued by a fellow classmate named Suzu. Insisting he’ll help find Asami’s previous lover, the pair spend peaceful days together until Suzu tells him he found his lover…? 
At the same school, there is another story about an unforgettable view that bring two other people together.

title: Number Call
description:
After being cornered, a path opens up.  
  
Ever since he was little, he's been carrying the weight of the name "Eighto". Through the power of "8", he is drawn to a classmate, Hatta Tomoya, nicknamed "Hachi". Exchanging greetings and small talk, his daily exchanges with Hachi steadily build up. These begin to instill change in Eighto. Before labeling this as friendship, if you were to give this feeling a name, it would be \_\_\_\_.

title: Akuyaku Fureijou-sama to Oyobi!
description: Nao Ōgami, a devoted fujoshi deeply passionate about BL, met a tragic fate in a sudden traffic accident—or so it appeared. To her astonishment, she found herself reincarnated as Clathiras Levanta, the antagonist character in the game Asteria Academy Chronicles!  In the game, Clathilas embodies the archetypal villainess: she mercilessly torments the heroine and ultimately meets her own demise—a predetermined fate. However, instead of being overwhelmed by such a sorrowful outcome… the reborn Nao Ōgami discovers something even more urgent:  This world lacks any notion of Boys’ Love?!

title: Serious Joke
description: In March, when the new semester begins, Han Seok, who was attacked by a cat on his way to school first meets Han Ki Woon, who takes care of the cat that attacked him. The two meet again in the same classroom by chance and Han Ki Woon, who hits the wall like he's strangely frivolous, continues to be interested in Han Seok!

title: Kimi no Amai ni oi
description: Kouta and Tougo are childhood friends who live in Kansai. Kouta, who loves sweets, made a promise with the successor of a Japanese confectionery shop, Tougo, when they were kids, being that they would get married if the latter could make delicious Kaiten-yaki. After becoming high school students and confirming that neither of their feelings have changed, they became lovers and were lovey dovey every day. Though recently, a popular western confectionery shop has opened nearby, and Tougo's shop is in a big pinch! Furthermore, when Kouta accepts an invitation from the handsome store manager of the western confectionery shop, Satoru, the relationship between the Kouta and Tougo takes a turn for the worst…?!

title: Kimidori
description: "Will you take pictures of ghosts for me?" Shouma, whose hobby is photography, meets a person while searching for a photography subject after school. The person, with tears in his beautiful yellow-green eyes, was drawing a picture of someone without a face. Shouma, who couldn't forget him (Ukuhara Akira), visits his class the next day and asks him to become his model. He refuses bluntly, but Shouma, who can't give up, persistently tries to find out more about Akira ...? A curious and lively photographer x A hazel-eyed boy with a closed-off heart.. The clumsy and conflicted youth of immature high school boys.

title: There's No Middle Ground! None!
description: A man who walks the heavens, and a man who threads on earth. Two people with completely different personalities met and started a fluffy love story!

title: Eoneun Jeom
description:
Saet-byeol, a sharp-tongued Omega hiding his secondary gender, has no intention of ever finding a mate. But everything changes when he discovers that his classmate Yul, an emotional Alpha with a fate complex, is his destined pair. The catch? Yul believes Saet-byeol is a Beta and mistakes his feelings for simple friendship.

Determined to ignore his growing attraction, Saet-byeol keeps his distance. When Jae-young, an openly dominant Omega, transfers into their class and immediately captures Yul’s attention, Saet-byeol finds it harder and harder to keep his own heart frozen.

A cold-blooded secret, a one-sided fate, and a love triangle that defies logic. How long can they keep their true desires buried before everything starts to melt?

title: Soshite Bokura wa Warai Au
description: A childhood friend, who he has had an unrequited love for, for many years, is dating another childhood friend. Unable to heal the wounds of his broken heart, Takashi, who is suffering alone on the rooftop, is suddenly joined by Yota who appears in front of him. After meeting Yota, Takashi gradually becomes more positive. A story of two clumsy people who meet after school.

title: Kore ga Koi na Wake ga Nai
description: Cold-hearted and diligent Iida Kaoru is deeply hurt when his underclassman rejects him. But along comes Yanagi Yuzuru of the sports club, tall and totally straight, who suddenly tells him: "It was love at first sight! Please treat me like trash!". It was such a masochistic and passionate confession. Iida was honestly conflicted over it, but as they’re guys, he decides to meet with him every day to take care of their sexual needs.

title: Gakkou no Sensei
description: In the morning of his first day on the job, novice teacher Tada Haruyuki got into trouble with the principal… and he was promptly fired! On the day that he is finally appointed to another position, he encounters a little boy with round eyes on a snowy mountain road. The little boy shows him the way to his new school, but no matter how he looks at it, the school seems weird?! What exactly is waiting for Haru here?!

title: Moyuru Haru ni Deiau Bokura
description: Takanashi Haru, a plain and unassuming boy with black hair and glasses, secretly has a crush on the popular teacher Nanjou. His crush is accidentally discovered by his classmate, Sanada Kazuki, a flashy and popular guy who is the complete opposite of Takanashi. Sanada takes an interest in Takanashi's unrequited love for Nanjou and tries to help Takanashi attract the teacher's attention.  But as Takanashi starts spending more time with Sanada, he begins to experience Sanada's kindness... Maybe Sanada isn't just the flashy guy he appears to be...? What will become of this usual pairing...!?

title: Komatta Toki ni wa Hoshi ni Kike!
description:
Fujishima Takara, a high school student, will soon start living in a dorm due to having lost all of his family except for his father, who's always away for work. Takara has to share a room with Hosaka Kiyomine. Living together isn't easy, and many rows ensue. Kiyomine is very introverted, while Takara is just the opposite. At first, the two get on each other's nerves because of those differences. But things turn towards friendship and later on towards love.  


---

title: Young Bad Education
description:
**Vol 1: Young Bad Education**

**Vol 2: Young Good Boyfriend**

Locked out of his home one day, Mizusawa runs across Takatsu, his homeroom teacher, drunk on a bench. In a stupor, Takatsu confesses he has been watching Mizusawa for three years and kisses him. Mizusawa had no interest in 37-year-old Takatsu…until that day. With a smirk on his face, Mizusawa begins teasing Takatsu about the incident, much to Takatsu's horror. But, when Takatsu starts attending marriage interviews, Mizusawa realizes he wants his homeroom teacher.

title: Confession from Tomorrow
description:
Today's high school's entrance ceremony! Even after middle school, 'Dajoon' is still popular. But 'Siyoon' feels a strange sense of incompatibility with him…  
  
One day, when Siyoon happens to go to Dajoon's place, what he sees is… his violent side?!

title: Onnanoko Tokidoki Otokonoko
description:
Yuusuke & Akira used to be childhood friends, but haven't seen each other in 10 years after Akira's father was temporarily transferred for his job. Now cute Akira has come back and is living next door, and she's looking to keep Yuusuke to the promise he made to her when they were little.  
  
The problem? Akira is actually a guy!

title: Fire Train
description: The clue to the missing persons case is hidden behind a child who is both beautiful and sinister.

title: Kono Ore ga Omae Nanka Suki na Wakenai
description: Fujima Taisei is a high schooler who has grown up spoiled by the people around him because of his pretty face. There is only one event that he considers to be a stain on his perfect life – when a student named Okachi Machi, whom Taisei had grown close to in order to get others' attention, told him that actually he had never been his friend at all. Now Taisei wants revenge. What will happen these two?!

title: Cut
description: My red string is connected to yours. A confession received from a peculiar childhood friend. And so, Seunghyun and Donghwa begin dating. While in the middle of a normal date, plain old Donghwa gains the ability to see the red string, and notices that Seunghyun’s red string is going off in some other direction…!

title: Hoshigari-chan no Kareshi Ka Keikaku
description: The two of them know each other's fap material, and they even rub each other out. Such childhood friends are Junto and Sato. One day, the AV that a classmate lent them showed a**l sex! Sato, gushing with curiosity, says that he wants to try it, and begs Junto to put it in. Junto gives in to the seduction, and…!

title: My Fiance is a Hottie
description: #Pretty Boy #Doesn't-want-to-away #Good-Looking #Good-Looking #Good-Looking #Good-Money "Hello, I'm Kim Minjae. An 18 year old fiance who is the same age as you." Suddenly came to Woo-joo who returned home a week after running away from home.

title: Heesu in Class 2
description: Heesu's world revolves around Chanyoung, his best friend and secret crush. He doesn't mind cheering Chanyoung from the sidelines or listening to all his girl problems. He doesn't care if people only know him as "Chanyoung's friend." Then one day, Heesu starts hearing his name everywhere. On the bus, in the halls, during lunch… Turns out, there's a rumor going around school (Got a love problem? Find Heesu in Class 2 and he'll tell you what to do!) and with that, Heesu suddenly finds himself the center of attention. But how could he give anyone advice? He doesn't even know what to do about his own crush!

title: Kiyona Yubisaki, Bukiyona Tsumasaki
description: Ichigaya and Tomoki are high school students who don't really know each other. One day, Tomoki falls asleep during class and wakes up to find that the "cool" Ichigaya has painted his nails with a classmate's nail polish. The only way to get it off is to go to the home of Ichigaya. There, Tomoki steps into the lonely life of Ichigaya.

title: The Chronicle of Teenage Boys
description:
Simple and shy, the boy has a crush on his class president, but the two-faced class president teases and rebuffs him! Oh my, will the first spring of his life be a good one or not?  
  
This story is divided into two stages: their high school years and adulthood.  
  
- [Author Twitter [NSFW]](https://twitter.com/dalegeyu)  
- [Author Pixiv [NSFW]](https://www.pixiv.net/en/users/18133979)  
\_\_\_  
  
Ele, que é inocente e tímido, começou a desenvolver sentimentos pelo representante de sua classe, mas o representante tem suas emoções em altos e baixos! Ah, será que na primeira primavera de sua vida, poderá dar frutos?  
  
Nt. Essa história é dividida em duas etapas: eles jovens e a idade adulta.

title: Tonari no Hana wa Kyou mo Ichiban Kakkoii
description:
Unbeatable in fights, blond combed-back hair, and has a flower-shaped scar on his forehead. No one has heard rumors about “Hanaoni'', the legendary delinquent, for half a year.
Shion is a highschool student who adores and idolizes Hanoni, and aims to be a “cool deliquent”. He copies Hanaoni’s appearance and spends his days getting involved in fights with thugs.
Azami, who is Shion’s classmate and a member of the disciplinary committee,treats his injuries and watches over him.
Thugs came to Shion and tried to pick a fight with him, and…!?

title: Tadashii Ace no Kouryakuhou
description:
Chapters: 
1 
Hiroto Fujiki is the ace on his high school baseball team. He takes an interest in one of his groupies, only to find out that "she" is not who "she" appears to be.  

2 
Ayumu Tsumori is acting as the manager of his school's baseball team, and he borrows a book from his sister to help improve their chances in an upcoming match. Following the book's instructions, Ayumu starts cross-dressing for the team.  
  
3
Masaki Mizuhara fills in on his sister's baseball team, and catches the eye of the team's ace pitcher Hirona Fujiki, the sister to Hiroto from the first oneshot.

4 Hypnotism Trick

5 Ani Tsura
Kazuki Hasegawa started drifting apart from his younger brother Kazuomi after he started getting interested in anime, specifically a certain magical girl anime he's particularly obsessed with. Kazuomi has been doing bad on his tests, so Kazuki agrees to dress up as Kazumi from the magical girl anime so that he'll put more effort into studying.

6 Khaki P to Sumire-hime
Rei Ka

After living in December 24th, Christmas Eve on endless repeat- Mokhwa seems to be the only one who's aware of the existence of the time loop. And on this repeated day, he spends time with his childhood friend 'Choi Gyun' despite having cut ties with him a long time ago.

title: Heart of Thomas
description:
As winter draws to a close, German boarding school student Thomas Werner dies one morning. He leaves behind a single letter addressed to his fellow student Juli that reads "Here is my love. Here is the sound of my heart."  
  
With his faith shaken to the core by the words, the scholarly Juli sinks to the depths of despair. His cynical roommate Oscar finds himself watching over Juli's fragile mental state while keeping his own feelings for Juli under wraps. Then new student Eric enters the school - and he has an uncanny resemblance to the deceased Thomas…  
  
Enter the world of a boy's boarding school in Germany where all will be revealed about the suffering and redemption that comes with love. Even today, this early work of Hagio Moto is still regarded as a brilliant masterpiece.  
  
This is volumes 11-12 of Hagio Moto Works  
  
1 Bianka (ビアンカ)  
2 Tou no Aru Ie (塔のある家)  
3 Cake Cake Cake (ケーキケーキケーキ)  
4 Sara Hill no Seiya (セーラ・ヒルの聖夜)  
5 Sangatsu Usagi ga Shuudande (３月ウサギが集団で)  
6

title: Kitto Kiss o Suru Toki
description: Shin and Mitsuya – and Shin's little brother, Satoru – have been friends since childhood, and Shin is super proud of his hot best friend and his adorable little bro. But when Shin finds out that Mitsuya isn't being entirely honest when he professes to have never kissed anyone before, he can't help but wonder just who Mitsuya has kissed before…

title: Cinema Next Door
description: The walls are thin, and it's hard not to know what your neighbor is up to, especially when they cry loudly every time they watch a movie.

title: Suki ni Nattara Dame Desu ka?
description: After Kaname jokingly called out his teacher Natori for ogling a male student, Natori-sensei was so shaken up that he couldn't teach properly. Later when Kaname was called into Natori's office, Kaname confessed that he himself is gay and that Natori doesn't need to worry about rumors. Even though Kaname has no intention of blackmailing Natori, he decided that he'll spend his time teasing Natori.

title: Hitorijime Boyfriend
description:
"Would you like to break up with me again or to be held – which would you prefer?" My former friend with the beautiful face, whom I've run into again after so long, only says things that cause me trouble.  
  
In the winter of sixth grade, Kensuke was upset about having to separate from his best friend Hasekura in middle school, and he ended up breaking off their friendship. Three years have passed since then, and Hasekura comes in contact with Kensuke like nothing had changed. Kensuke was happy they could repair their friendship, but Hasekura says something completely out of left field…

title: Kiss Shite Sugar-kun!
description: While reciting dialogue from a play in the empty archery clubroom, Satou's naked body is discovered by Yanagawa, the ace of the Archery Club. Suddenly, Satou embraces Yanagawa. The feeling of Satou's white, smooth skin and the shape of his buttocks get stuck in Yanagawa's head. The next day, Yanagawa's archery slump magically ends, and now he feels great. Is this some sort of "good luck charm" where they need to hug each other every day!?

title: Himegoto Comic Anthology
description:
An anthology of 15 one-shots based on Himegoto.  
  
1. Josou Yamemasu! (女装やめます!)  
2. Kaguya-sama ga Miteru (かぐや様が見てる)  
3. Present (プレゼント)  
4. Nichiyoubi no Himegoto (日曜日のひめゴト)  
5. Kono Naka ni Hitori, Otokonoko ga Imasu. (この中 に一人、男の娘がいあす。)  
6. Atsui? Kanbyou (あつ～い? 看病)  
7. Arikawa-ke no Shokutaku (有川家の食卓)  
8. Niizuma x Otokonoko = Saikyou (新妻 x 男の娘 = 最強)  
9. Taisetsu na Oyoufuku (大切なお洋服)  
10. Nouryousai (納涼祭 )  
11. Hime Inu Keikaku (ひめ犬計画)  
12. Sono Mama no Kimi de (そのままの君で)  
13. Himegoto Bro's  
14. Morimori Ohime-chan (盛り盛りおひめちゃん)  
15. Pantsu o Shokusu toiu Koto (ぱんつを食すということ)

title: Doukyuusei A
description: Asaoka, the delinquent who rules the high school, and Saji, his taciturn classmate. Asaoka looks down on Saji for being unremarkable and friendless, but one day, a single comment from Saji completely changes their relationship…

title: Nyubiwa Oldeubiui Gongsaeng-Gwangye
description:
Kwon Jungwoo is a player of the Tamer Class in the MMORPG game 'The Hymn of Karel'. After failing to receive the class buffs he’s been waiting eternally for, Kwon Jungwoo decides to abandon his last remaining hope for the game. And then, he coincidently meets 'ChaRongRong', a newbie player, while offloading his high value items at the auction market. Since he was going to quit the game away,  and with the intention of just helping out a newer player,  he light-heartedly initiated a harmless friendship that… 

[Party] ChaRongRong: Bcuz of how far Ive come
[Party] ChaRongRong: Even if a sick melee asks me to party up
[Party] ChaRongRong: I wont abandon you, Hyung
[Party] Mocha: What an honor lolol
[Party] Mocha: but if a kickass melee asks to you party up, just do it
[Party] Mocha: itll be easier… 

Jungwoo should definitely not let Cha Rong Rong's words go as if they were just coquetry but..

title: Bokura no Katakoi Melancholy
description: Kanei Tomoya came back to his previous high school to be a substitute teacher in Physical Education. He met his fellow teachers on his first day and everything is sailing smoothly until Seta Kousuke came, his arts teacher back in high school. Everything became worse when he accidentally broke Seta-sensei's phone and was asked to be his lover in the span of his four months stay. Now will this "relationship" turn into something good or something bad?

title: Nanairo Sekai
description:
1: The Glasses Thief  
A cute story about a boy with bad eyesight and the girl who is in love with him.  
  
2: Convenience Store Honey  
A boy worries about his quiet boyfriend.  
  
3: Adult Uniform  
A girl wonders why her childhood friend does not speak to her anymore.  
  
4: Refrigerator Chocolate  
Satoru is going to have heart surgery with a 50/50 chance of survival. One day, he comes across a girl in a refrigerator…

title: Yoimachi Apartment
description:
Takao, who has started living alone as he got into university, lost consciousness due to being famished after noticing, he’s got no money. As he collapsed, he was saved by Tougo – a university student living next to his apartment, who also belongs to the occult research society. The next day, after coming across Tougo again, Takao was told by him: ‘They come out, you know. Here, I mean.’ – apparently ghosts appear in this apartment. Then Takao, being frightened by the emergence of strange happenings such as mysterious voices and rapping sounds in his apartment – at that moment, Tougo came and saved him ––
A pure love between a kind senpai who likes occult things and looking after others X lonely kouhai who has a natural disposition of attracting haunted things.

title: Negative-kun to Positive-kun
description: Extremely negative Fujiwara-kun and overly positive Tachibana-kun are… a couple. While eating lunch hand-in-hand, they have their dates. In the midst of a bustling routine, this duo's carefree tale of love occurs – a small part of which is shared in this book.

title: Rainy Days, Yesterday
description:
A story about two high school boys, Ume and Take, whose relationship seems to revolve around rainy days.

*I keep running away because I feel irritated at this impatience, my own small world, and something that I can’t even name…*

title: Ashita wa Ieru Kana
description:
Oda Ayumi is in love with her childhood friend, Ootani Ichita, who is actually also in love with her but is too shy to take the next step.  
  
Ootani was practicing practicing his confession when he was overheard by classmate Takatsuki. Now Takatsuki is helping Ootani… even for a good friend, isn't he too dedicated?

title: Special Relationship Law
description:
Everyone has their own little secrets.
My secret is about a special someone,
who isn't like anyone else.

title: School Bully's Online Dating Got Overturned
description:
[Showoff Gap Moe School Bully X Ice Cold Possessive Academic Lord]
Yu Yang thought he had picked up a cold and shy chick on the Internet, but when online date appeared, the other party turned out to be a 1.8 meters New Campus Academic Lord! The other party also witnessed his online date flop!
Yu Yang: I treated you as my enemy, but you miss me?
The two campuses merged, long-distance relationship became next door class. Yu Yang immediately went to the toilet after class, pretending to pass by the window of his next door class boyfriend coincidentally.

title: Bad Luck
description:
A girl found out she has the power to curse anyone around her.  
  
(Hilarity ensues.)

title: Soshite Akuma wa Seigi wo Kataru
description: At Chesthill, a boys' school where the students are judged only for how right their acts are without regards for their wealth or birth, the top student is granted the position of “Angel”, head of the “Angel Council” who guides his fellow students to be right. Taiga, a teacher arrived from a country in the far east firmly believes in that which is right and aims to guide his students towards being right, but one student, Lucas, the black sheep of the school nicknamed “the devil” has other plans than going along with the ideals of rightness that the school embodies. After the Angel is murdered and Taiga is framed for the murder, he has no choice but to accept Lucas' offer to save him and follow the mad, coquettish Devil in his quest to solve the mystery of the Angel's murder and become the new Angel.

title: Koi to Mirror
description: "The way the person I loved was in love with me was like a mirror reflecting me..." One day after school, Ao, a second-year high school student, is confessed by a classmate. It was the person who his crush likes. He's torn between wanting the person he loves to be happy and his uncontrollable infatuation. This is a coming-of-age love story interwoven with three unrequited loves!

title: One Night with a Contract Boyfriend
description: Jeong Hyun and Han Seong were friends, but ended up having a "contract relationship" due to Hyun's confession. Hyun, who has a dream where he breaks up with Sung(Seong), will later find out that it was a prophetic dream…?!

title: Bokura no Koi to Seishun no Subete
description: The Vice-President of Archery Club, Chiharu Mukaitera, was in deep slump. Due to great pressure, Chiharu couldn’t shoot arrows as he wanted. Chiharu receives a guidance from a genius newbie, Nagaame Fushimi. Chiharu, who is good at cooking, satisfies and fills up Nagaame’s stomach, and Nagaame persistently attacks Chiharu saying he wants to eat meals together. Chiharu promises him to do so since he thought taking care of one’s health condition is important for archery, but Chiharu finds himself being drawn to Nagaame’s archery posture….. The popular drama CD ‘My Love (Boku Koi)’ series, finally coming out as a comic!

title: Kawaiku Naitemo Nigashite Agenai
description:
Aoba is a first year high school student who is really close with his older brother's best friend, Shima. After he entered the same high school, he has been having lunch and going back home together with them, especially with Shima.

But he finds himself feeling unsettled when Shima sometimes looks at him with a burning gaze that seems as if it's coiling around him!

title: Danshi Koukouseiteki Kazoku Keikaku!
description: Hino-kun is good-looking – and a rumored delinquent. Although in reality, he is a kind-hearted high school student who looks after his young nephew. He can see that Mizusawa-kun is good at making sweets, so for the sake of his fatherless nephew, he asks him to, "Please marry my older sister!" But instead, he receives a reverse proposal from Mizusawa saying, "I want to marry you."…?!

title: Touching Melody
description: How certain were you that it wasn’t a dream? Was there a certain moment where you’d think ‘Ah, deja vu’. This happened to the MC who met a senior from his dreams, even though their graduation tore them apart… They met again via teleportation?! Just what is happening? How are they able to teleport and switch places?!

title: Sora and Hara
description: Hara Manabu is a gay man who feels somewhat adrift in the world. He spends his days teaching at an all-boys school, his nights out on the town. While at a gay bar, he meets a young man named Sorano and feels an instant connection. But things become complicated when he sees Sorano again—as it turns out, the young man is a new student at Hara’s school. Can Hara navigate the feelings he has for a student?

title: Nemuri Neko wa Kuchizuke de Mezamenai
description:
☆An extra omake drawn manga. One morning, Akira Yamada, a baseball club manager who worked hard to clean the room before morning training, got kissed by a male student who had fallen down from a tree!!! The criminal who stole the lips of Yamada, who is serious and stiff and a pure baseball player, is the endlessly sleeping classmate, Niimi Asa. Niimi was penalized for arriving late to help out the baseball club and Akira was forced to chaperone him. After that, Yamada often became the prey of Niimi’s troublesome habits. He was hugged and kissed…and his innocent baseball lover heart was shaken. What’s more troublesome is the name Niimi calls while sleeping. It seems Niimi is having a physical relationship with his childhood friend, Kagerura Sho.  
  
“So… You have to be lovers, otherwise, you shouldn’t do it?”

title: Wakabaryou de, Kimi to
description: Higuchi is a student dorming at an all-boys school. He's at the age where he wants a girlfriend, but every time he does, he gets dumped soon after. The one to console him is his straight-laced roommate, Hidaka. However, once an underclassman from the track team, Kosaka, appears, how will their relationship change!?

title: Scent
description:
Gaon is a boy who turned into a vampire, having inherited the condition from his mother. He discovered that his one and only friend, Dong-yi, likes his older brother.   
  
Gaon loses all control when he smells the scent of blood. Aware of his unstability, he asked Dongyi for his help in order to safely graduate college, and in return promised to help him get closer to his brother. However, to the contrary of his plans, the possessive, cold-hearted Yohan came to take an interest in Dongyi, and the budding relationship between the two is slowly starting to get on Gaon's nerves.

title: Hello Again
description: Onoda is avoiding his childhood friend Hiroto because of what he did in the past, while Hiroto is wondering what happened and why he is being avoided. But because Onoda was ignoring a teacher in school, Hiroto had to drag him into the counselor's office, and as a result their friendship started blooming again. Will Hiroto find out why he is being avoided?

title: Bulpyeonhan Donggeoin
description: Haewon, who suddenly had to find a new room, decided to live with his brother’s friend, Minjae, when the latter told him that he would give him a room. While Haewon kept wondering about his roommate’s attitude for no reason, he suddenly began to recall his forgotten highschool past.

title: Onborobachi
description:
The accidental meeting on that rainy day started everything…  
  
Koutarou keeps running into his old classmate from elementary school, Kaneo. Upon being ignored the first few times, Kaneo finally tells Koutarou to never talk to him again. What will happen between the two?

title: Shokuinshitsu no Himegoto
description: Nishio, a stoic math teacher, doesn't get along very well with Sakaki, the beloved gym teacher. However, after one drunken night, Nishio finds himself in Sakaki's bed where he is suddenly kissed and confessed to…?

title: Koi wa Kitsune Mouyou
description: A young boy from the fox tribe comes down from the mountain to attend school and find a mate, and ends up falling for the school's outcast.

title: Dekiai Honey Baby
description: Rio's family moved when he was a kid. Although he thought he didn't need any friends but became close with the neighbor's son, Watanabe Takeru. Years later, they are already in high school but Rio is trying to avoid Takeru since junior high - when he realized his feelings were deeper than friendship.

title: Usotsuki Ookami wa Ai o Kataru
description:
Kujo, whose dormant vampire blood has awakened by an inherited genetic mutation, lives his life keeping others at a distance, afraid his true identity will be discovered.

One day, an out-of-season transfer student, Kyo Oogami, appears.

Although it should be their first meeting, Kujo is unsettled by the way Oogami watches him—like a predator stalking its prey.

That same day after school, when the two of them unexpectedly end up alone together, Oogami reveals that he is a werewolf…?

title: Irony Dress ni Sayonara
description:
A shriek was heard as a sailor uniform skirt fluttered, and Meguru thought himself a lucky perv until he caught a glimpse of… a guy's boxer shorts?  
  
"Quit staring, old fart!"  
  
By chance, he ended up inviting the high school boy in a girl's uniform, Keiichi, to his place, with the mystery of why he wears that uniform still unsolved. Unwittingly, however, Meguru discovered the reason behind Keiichi's uniform…  


---

title: A Yankee Who Actually Enjoys Wearing Women's Clothes
Courting a Prince
description:
A genius student that is ignorant to the ways of Boys Love.  
A sister with aspirations of becoming a BL mangaka that wants to use her younger brother’s writing and make her characters come to life.  
Wait; there was actually a dreamy prince-like boy that resembles the lead character in real life?!

title: P.S. Waiting for You by the Lake
description: Leo and Alexis lived in the same small town when they were kids and were best buddies. The two loved to spend their summers at the Green Rock Lake summer camp near town. But during the summer when they were eleven, Alexis ended his friendship with Leo over a stupid reason. After that, the two did not see each other again because of their families' situation. But during the summer when they were eighteen, the two met once again at Green Rock Lake...

title: For you 99%
description: Jun entered the same high school as his best friend who is also his unrequited love, Doha. Jun suggests to start a fake relationship with Doha who have no intention of dating despite his popularity as dating practice but… Can Jun protect this relationship despite having Dami who has fallen for Doha at first sight as an obstacle?

title: Gakuran no Nakamade Sawatte Hoshii
description: An all-boys school is good – since being recruited into the student council by Sawane, we continued our relationship of friends with benefits. Is this taboo? Or is it immoral? Regardless, I don't care, because I love Sawane. I have Sawane, and aside from me, Sawane doesn't……

title: Lovers' Kiss
description:
When a rumor starts going around about Rikako and the school's notorious bad boy, Fujii, she decides 
they might as well make the rumors true. But things don't go exactly as planned and she starts developing feelings for him.
This two-volume series focuses on Rikako, her sister and their friends/classmates in a series of loosely-linked stories.

title: Iincho wa ♂
description: This series is titled class Rep is a boy in drag(Iincho is Otokonoko), it is basically the crazy antics between the class rep and her straight man friend, and their back and forth interactions with one another as she attempts to seduce and he attempts to deflect.

title: Spinach Bouquet
description: Country life is supposed to be idyllic, isn’t it? A peaceful place full of amiable neighbors with big hearts, right? That’s what Jiwoo is looking forward to… But out of all the next-door neighbors to have, he gets Dongchan. Curt, stand-offish, and inscrutable, Dongchan isn’t the most welcoming of folks. In fact, he looks like he doesn’t want Jiwoo and his family here at all. Bemused but not daunted, Jiwoo tries his best to adjust to life in the country…until it turns out that someone is trying to chase his family away from here. Jiwoo has his suspicions, but will he be able to find the real culprit? (Source: Lezhin)

title: Takara-kun and Amagi-kun
description: Takara Shun, a high school student who belongs to a popular group in the class, and Taichi Amagi, a pure boy who is not a conspicuous type but is liked by people, realize their love for each other. Even though they start dating in secret, it is difficult to be honest.

title: Nekoka Danshi no Shitsukekata
description: After having been apart from his older brother for 10 years, Ninomiya Michiru has finally returned to Japan to live with said brother, Shiou. But what surprises lie in store for him after all these years?

title: Ni Suo Bu Zhidao De Wo
description:
"Some thoughts can't be spoken, so we can only let them rot in our hearts and bear it alone."

Faced with a repressed life, debt that falls upon him out of nowhere, and the confused feelings between two teenagers ..... How will the youthful them face all of this? This is the other side of youth, the story you don't know.

title: Futariyogari na Melty Charm
description:
"Wait, why the hell am I kissing this guy right now?!!"

The story is set in a certain magic school.
Eve, a dog beastfolk, is excited about the "Buddy Selection Ceremony". The moment his Buddy is announced, everyone is in an uproar.

That is because his Buddy is none other than "Aura", a genius wolf beastfolk who has some dark rumors surrounding him! (Just who is this guy?!)

Even so, Eve approaches him to try and become friends with him, but Eve coldly rejects him with an "I don't have the energy to talk to you"! He's harsh and their magics are the polar opposites of each other, so they couldn't be a worse match...

Can you really live together with someone like that...?!

A fluffy, chaotic Buddy BL!!
Mysterious Lone Wolf x Cheerful Puppy!!

title: Bukiyou na Silent
description: Toono Satoru was just asked to go on a date by Tamiya Keigo, but all Satoru does is stare blankly at him without saying a word. The truth is that Satoru is so happy right now he could burst! He's had a crush on Tamiya for the longest time and never thought the feelings might be mutual. Unfortunately for Satoru, his emotions never show on his face and he barely ever talks. Naturally, this causes all sorts of misunderstandings. Will he be able to express his true feelings for Tamiya? Will Tamiya ever learn to read Satoru's expressionless face?

Gi Tae and Seon Wu decided to have their first hot experience on January 1, becoming adults. However, for some reason, Gi Tae continues to be late on December 31st.  
Can the two really overcome this adversity and spend the burning January 1st?!

title: Koishii Revival
description: First-year university student Higurashi is suddenly reunited with Yoyama, a senior from his high school track and field club. However, Yoyama has lost all of his memories from high school due to a traffic accident. One day, as bits and pieces of Yoyama's memory start to return, he asks Higurashi "You confessed to me...?"

title: Mad Dog
description:
Some people thirst for power while others want nothing more than to live low. Hamin has always been resentful of the label that comes with being his father’s son—he didn’t ask to be born into a mob family! After much trial and error, Hamin finally breaks ties with his family and begins to live the life he's dreamed about. That is, until he gets kidnapped and finds himself under the protection of a certain Kwon Sehyuk. All Hamin wants is his "normal" life back, but Sehyuk is as far from normal as a person can get...
*(Official English synopsis)*

---
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://www.lezhin.jp/ja/comic/mad_dog)

title: Idol-kun wa Koi wo Shiranai
description:
It's my first time experiencing this feeling… So please, be my friend!  
  
The popular idol Hinato attends a part-time school while hiding the fact that he's an idol. Meanwhile, he wants to become closer to the only person that he gets along with, Tomoya, so he confesses(?!): "Please be my friend," but…

title: Tondari Hanetari
description:
Togawa Manabu was invited to join the badminton club by his senior, Takasu Eiji, who was one year ahead of him. Takasu declared that he would be playing doubles with Togawa, who was a beginner at badminton. However, it was Komatsu, an experienced badminton player, who had objected to this. Thus, sparking a fight over Takasu! 

Upon the stage of the frolic and sometimes dispirited badminton club, the youthful days of the young boys unfold.

title: Ruriiro de Kimi wo Kazatte
description: Despite attending a prestigious art school and majoring in Japanese art, Shinagawa finds himself without inspiration or motivation to draw. One day, he meets a male nude model with a beautiful body. Shinagawa begs the man to model for him, but is coldly rejected.

title: Ore No Osananajimi No Seibetsu Ga Wakaranai
description: My childhood friend, the one I promised to marry, has finally come home. But the person standing before me is nothing like I remember. 'Wait... are you a guy? Or a girl? Which is it?' As confusion swirls in my mind, my heart won't stop racing. Is it okay to think they're cute? Or would that be wrong?

title: Muteki no Baby Blue
description:
Ritsu, a high school boy from the countryside, is enjoying school life with his classmate Shion - playing in a band, getting scolded by the teacher, eating ramen, and more.
He thought he would continue the rest of his days like this... but one day, Shion kisses him!
What will become of these feelings that have just burst out of him?
The youth of these two lovable idiots begins★

title: Kuro Ookami to Kin Kitsune
description: Kuzunoha is a Fox, a member of the Vulpine Faction at his school for Beastlings, and while he gets along well with his kind and the Feline Faction, the Lupine Faction scares the mess out of him because they still practice the ancient rite of pelt reaping, where in traditional ceremonies, they skin their fellow beasts. But when he wanders into the forest on an urgent errand and winds up stumbling into the middle of a hunt, he must rely on the help of a Wolf classmate of his to reach safety, because Kuzunoha isn't all he appears to be at first blush…

title: Brothers
description: Chris Watanabe is a high-school teacher. When his father remarries, he finds himself with an English step-brother named Wataru. Wataru transfers to Chris' school, and just as the four of them are starting their new life together, their parents die in a plane crash. Now Chris and Wataru are living alone together. The elder is cute and the younger cool; what will their new life hold for them!?

title: Haru to Yuzu wa Mada Shitenai
description: Haruhito and Yuzuki are childhood friends who just started dating. Just when their feelings finally got requited, and their relationship seemed to be smooth-sailing, Yuzuki feels frustrated that they haven’t shared the kind of closeness most couples have... So he tries to take the initiative, but it seems like Haruhito has some issues...?!

title: Hatsumi Senpai wa Hoketsu
description:
"I wouldn't mind trying it with you, senpai."

Hatsumi, a third-year substitute on the baseball team, flinches everytime at the slightly excessive skinship from Hinagi, a second-year regular.

One day, however, Hatsumi witnesses Hinagi kissing another member of the club and begins to feel unsettled.

A sensitive BL between a senior who is always an substitute and a junior who is a regular.

title: Wakarete Yaranai!
description:
"We're pretending to be lovers, right...?" "Let's break up."

Akira Watase is dating his best friend, Fumiya Watari. But it's all a camouflage! In order to keep girls away, Akira is playing the role of Watari's lover, who's famous among the female students at school. Watari even kissed him to prove it to the girls!? Akira was depressed, saying that his youth is completely over, but for some reason, he keeps pretending they're dating...?

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

title: Koi Nante Shinai!
description: While he cannot explain it, Udou Ryuuji is absolutely certain of one thing: he loathes Kujou Ritsuki to the very core of his being. There's just something about his good looks and the way he has all the girls eating out of his hand that pisses Ryuuji off royally – so when he accidentally discovers the deep dark secret behind Ritsuki's part-time job, he's of course going to milk it for all it's worth…right?

title: Natsu ni Mebuku wa Koi no Oto
description:
During my second year of high-school, a transfer student, Yamauchi, arrived in my class. Although he appeared to be an ordinary guy, he was unexpectedly antisocial! I wanted him to quickly get along with the rest of class, so I called out to him, but things didnt go as I wanted no matter how I tried.  
  
"That's how it is…" I thought.  
  
But out of the blue, Yamauchi smiled at me and since then I couldn't get it out of my mind.  
  
"Hey, Yamauchi… can you smile for me once more?"

title: Kanemochi-kun to Binbou-kun
description: Meiji Haruhito just can't understand Misaki, but quickly falls for him anyway. However, Haruhito's love life is under threat. Not from a cute girl or ex-lover, but from his own grandfather. The boys' grandfathers knew each other when they were young and Haruhito's grandpa is delighted when he meets Misaki, who looks and acts like his late friend and (unrequited) love.

title: Yamete Kudasai, Mabushii Desu
description: Sasano grew up in an all female household and he loves pretty things, including Koga, a schoolmate in another class.

title: Nigate na Koibito
description: A straight-forward coming-out love story between a cool high school boy and a handsome classmate who fall in love!! Kasahara, a high school student , is outed as gay at school and then isolated from his class. The only person whose attitude doesn't change is his classmate, Katou. Irritated by Katou's kindness, Kasahara blurts out, "What would you do if I told you I like you?" However, upon hearing this, Kato makes a bold move, saying, "I like you too!!" And so they start dating!?

title: Tenjou no Shita ni Koi
description: "I left my parents who work overseas and came back to Japan to start my high school life. Then, they asked me to live with their boss' sons. There are four of them. The youngest only 3 years old, the second and third son are my seniors at school, and the oldest is a social worker. They are on good terms with each other. But, the more I know them, I feel there's something different with my feelings …"

title: 2-Week Summer Secret
description: A shy boy becomes roommates with a Yankee during a 2 week homestay. How will their relationship change during this short time...?

title: Shuugakuryokou de Nakayokunai Group ni Hairimashita
description: Hioki, an ordinary high school student, is feeling down after being placed in a new class without any of his friends. Just as he fears facing the upcoming school trip alone, he finds himself grouped with the super cool and popular Watarai. Though initially intimidated, Hioki's nervousness fades as Watarai constantly stays by his side, always looking out for him. As the two slowly grow closer and open up, Watarai's deep obsession begins to show...

title: Pretty Wimps
description: Yukihira has been in love with his teacher, Abe Hiroshi, for a long time and wants to confess before graduation, but doesn't know how to go about it. Confused, he ends up stalking Abe and discovers his biggest secret.

title: Koi ni Nare!
description: Komatsu Shin was shaken when he was found out to be gay, but his roommate Nakajima was unaffected – he even arranged a blind date for him! However, the guy who showed up was actually the dorm supervisor, Shindo-sensei!

title: Kore wa Koi ni Fukumaremasu ka
description: Popular guy Hiiragi Tsukasa saves his classmate, Asahina Iori, from an attempted rape. His initial impression of Asahina was that of a quiet and studious guy. But Asahina is surprisingly plagued by his problem with attracting guys. Hiiragi proposes that they pretend to start dating in order to keep the guys off of him. But after promising to protect Asahina from the others, he himself begins to fall for Asahina.

title: Between the Years
description: That was the boy I loved, accompanying me through verdant days and brilliant, fleeting years.

title: Between Us
description:
*"Can't we let just one day pass by quietly?"*  
  
The late-teen romance between Inha, who is gay and can’t take the struggle, and his caretaker Woojoo!  
  
[Official French translation](https://m.delitoon.com/webtoon/betweenus)

title: Arai-kun to Haruma-senpai
description:
Twitter webcomic self-published by Akahachi

Prequel chapter can be purchased on [Toranoana](https://ecs.toranoana.jp/joshi/ec/item/040030934488/).

title: The Monsoon In June
description: Seungwoon has decided that it's time to leave his lonely days behind to adopt a newer more cheerful high school life, which is when he meets Hae-in. The two are seemingly different, but Seungwoon can't help but be drawn to him. Throw in monsoon, fights, and the task of growing up, will their friendship survive?

title: Boys Rumble
description: For Saijou Misao, a high school teacher in his thirties, love has become such a distant concept for him that even his students make fun of him for it. One night, while drinking alone at a bar, he runs into Takashi Ryouhei, a teaching materials sales rep that he barely knows. However, he's never seen Takashi look like this before...

title: Kohinata-san Chi no Chounan wa Fukigen
description: The handsome "mom", Kano, joins the house of Kohinata: a family of six, all men. The oldest son, Kaname, could not accept Kano due to something that happened in the past. What will happen next?

title: Shen Sheng
description:
Shen Sheng has always been obedient and never once deviated from the course set for him by his family and society. Everything changes when Cheng Mu–a literature professor–comes into his life. By accident, Shen Sheng discovers the young professor's secret. At the same time, the teacher also finds out about Shen Sheng's unique talent. Their lives will never be the same again…

---

 Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Heart Stain
description:
"Teacher, I… I have someone I like. It's… a man."  
Woo Hyun likes his homeroom teacher and didn't want anyone to know until after graduation, but he was caught by his best friend, Do Ha. After that, Do Ha's attitude changed. Woo Hyun thought he had disappointed him by liking men, despite their promise to be honest with each other.  
"I— I'm saying that I like you." was Do Ha's response.  
And so, Woo Hyun made a proposition, wanting to give up on his teacher:  
"Let's date… but only until graduation."

title: Toriaezu Kiss Shite Kudasai
description: Nenji, touch me again! High-schooler, Taira has got a one-sided crush on his buddy, Nenji. One day, Taira invites Nenji over to his place to watch some of his older brother’s porn collection, but in the heat of it all, they get turned on and things progress.

title: Kuro Tenkousei
description: Two mysterious transfer students investigate a school where, in the past two months, three student have fallen to their deaths.

title: Atsumare! Gakuen Tengoku
description: Sui and Sou are a pair of twins who are starting high school. Though raised by occultist parents, they were supposed to have a very normal high school life. However, once they arrived at campus they not only encountered werewolves but also vampires and even sorcerers! As more strange people appear one by one, will the twins' secret be uncovered?

title: Two Way Trial - Youth
description: A collection of stories between two boys when they were still students.

title: Fubin BL (Anthology)
description:
1: Yasashii Dakeno – Suzuki Tsuta
A terminally ill patient and a mysterious boy.

2: Okite Saisho ni Suru Koto wa – Shimura Takako
I want you to touch me; I want us to have sex; I want you to like me; I want you to love me. As a brother, and not as a brother.

3: Love In Motion – Kumota Haruko
A super sadistic gay high school student and his kind teacher.

4: Yukiiro Machiboke – Mikage Tsubaki
One fateful night, the doctor Hanabusa saves a dirty street urchin and patches him up. Now this filthy child is determined to thank him.

8: Kosha Ura no Natsu – Sakurabi Hashigo
The heartbroken Manabu-kun keeps meeting up with his senpai in the back of the school, who appears to be keeping a secret.

title: Did the Nerd Manage to Flirt With the Cutie Today?
description: The moment omega, Wan Xing Shu transferred into the class, he became the target of the cunning Alpha, Chu He Zhou. After a series of services from the Alpha, who managed to flirt the omega to the point that his heart beats fast, his weak legs shaking and he wishes to be pushed down by the Alpha. Until a second year Alpha bully called Wan Xing Shu “Brother”, Chu He Zhou was confused. What is his soft and cute omega hiding?

title: Hitomazu wa Horyuu
description: Yuki likes his dorm roommate, Kanome. But Kanome already has someone he likes. One day, Yuki learns that Kanome's love is unrequited, and in order to criticize him for giving up without saying anything, Yuki ends up confessing to him. Full of self-hatred, Yuki runs away from his dorm room and moves from room to room with his friends, but...?

title: Hatsukoi Counter Attack
description: The reunion between a once-cool guy who's now one of the shortest boys in his year, with average grades and so-so sports skills, and the feminine-looking crybaby who used to hide behind him all the time, who's now smart, handsome and popular.

title: Kimi to Janakya Koi mo Dekinai
description: Misaki has always been in love with his childhood friend, Nachi. However, it's been four years since Nachi left for university. Although Misaki grew up to be a popular handsome high school student, he still only loves Nachi... but now Nachi is a teacher at Misaki's school!?

title: Tell Me You Can Hear It
description: "Do-kwon has a secret: he has a huge weakness for pretty faces. One look at the face of a pretty boy gets him internally screaming. And lo and behold, Ryeo-soo is one of the prettiest boys he’s ever seen in real life. Do-kwon is busy mentally drooling over him every time they interact. Man, it’s a good thing nobody can hear his silent fanboying, right? Except, Ryeo-soo has a secret, too. He can hear other people’s thoughts. And he’s really having a blast listening to Do-kwon’s. In fact, there’s something else he wants to hear from Do-kwon…"

title: Love Monster
description: Akira grew up thinking of his friend Itsuki as something of a little brother – until Itsuki confessed he's been in love with Akira for years. But while Itsuki is content to keep their relationship the same as it's always been, while he waits for Akira to process the affections he’s just been presented with, Akira finds himself growing increasingly – and inexplicably – irritated with the cool demeanor Itsuki manages to adopt in front of someone he supposedly is in love with.

title: Subarashii Kiseki ni Yasashii Kimi to
description: Enoki is practically the poster-boy for what a typical nerd looks like: short and slight, complete with big round glasses and social awkwardness. His main hobby is playing video games, and he's used to not having many friends at school. Then, he meets Shirataki, a former member of the baseball club and his exact opposite; tall, muscular and sporty. Despite their many differences, the spark of friendship between the two boys begins to grow into something more...

title: Princess♂ of the All Boys School (Napping)
description: Oneshot by Koshou about a cute boy with a popular napping face.

title: Bokura no Shikisai
description:
The daily life of high school boy who can’t say “I love you” to his beloved classmate because he’s also a boy. But his days are changed to meet a mysterious elderly man who might be also gay…

[Official English](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/610952/our-colors-by-gengoroh-tagame/)

title: Shiba wa Kyou mo Baka!
description: Maybe I was confessed to by my childhood friend !? An energetic and foolish high school boy, Shiba isn't sure if he was confessed to by his childhood friend Ryou. To find out if he can also like boys, Shiba offers to give Ryou a massage. While Shiba comes to the conclusion that he can date Ryou, Ryou rejects him?!

title: Chibi Demo Iiyo
description: Wataru and Souta met in their first year of high school and have been best friends since. Souta has a tendency to make fun of Wataru's small build and he doesn't miss a chance to make a comment about it. There is only one thing that bothers Wataru, and that is Souta always treating him like a child. But will Souta ever find out the secret Wataru has been hiding?

title: Yukidoke no Koi
description: On a snowy day, under the shadow of blooming cherry blossoms, Somita sees a man crying by himself. Later, Somita discovers the man is none other than Someya-sensei, a popular teacher at his high school. Somita makes friendly overtures towards his teacher, and as they get to know each other little by little, Somita realises his feelings for Someya-sensei. But Someya is still haunted by an unrequited love…

title: In August
description:
There was a confession letter in the time capsule that my childhood friend and I buried. While office worker Buntarou is on his way to his hometown for summer vacation, he reunites with his childhood friend, Ittetsu, with whom he hasn’t spoken in fourteen years.  
Inspired by the letters from the time capsule, Buntarou and Ittetsu entwine their bodies as they start a relationship that they call a “thoughtless love affair”…  
This summer’s encounters will heal the wounds that they’ve carried in their hearts without knowing it.

title: Kyoushi mo Iroiro Aru Wake de
description: Komori Tadamachi loves teaching at an elementary school, the only problem is fellow teacher Takigawa Kyou. Always being compared to the perfectly composed and devastatingly handsome Takigawa is really destroying Komori's self-esteem. Still, Komori finds himself being drawn in by Takigawa's effortless charm…

title: Aiseyo Bakemono
description: Reiji Kuze is the son of doctors and the new transfer student in his last year of high school. As someone whose socioeconomic background and academic grades are in the top 98th percentile, Reiji immediately stands out like a sore thumb in his new school. And in high school, standing out means you will be targeted. Presumed to be a delicate prince swimming in cash, Reiji gets picked on by the third strongest person in the school... and beats him and his entire gang to a pulp without breaking a sweat. As if Reiji didn't stand out enough already, he seems to have caught the interest of the king of the hill, Akira Ohara, the cat-like lone-wolf that nobody can seem to tame...

title: About Good Boys
description:
Santa Claus will leave his presents in front of the windows of only the good children. It’s the December that calls the winter. You, who was everyone’s good child is starting to move me, who is full of cuts and bruises. After that day the relationship between you and I is constantly moving. I can’t even get a single day of proper sleep…. Will we be able to smile in the Christmas only meant for good children?  
  
- [Original Webcomic on Lezhin](http://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/about_the_good_kids)  
- [Original Webcomic on BomToon](http://www.bomtoon.com/comic/ep_list/about_GB)  
- [Original Webcomic on Comica](http://www.comica.com/webtoon/episode/101609/)  
- [Original Webcomic on Naver](http://nstore.naver.com/comic/detail.nhn?productNo=2427368)  
- [Official Japanese Translation](https://www.sukima.me/book/title/shinepartners0000005/)

title: Idol Kinsei
description:
Ikuto enrolled in a school with a dormitory to escape the feeling of inferiority to his successful older twin brother, Takuto. There, Ikuto met the idol Sin from the group Double Moon, whom he was a big fan of.

Except... Tsukishima Shinnosuke - or Sin - was a completely different persona off stage. He was a super flirty man!

Ikuto felt troubled by Shinnosuke's antics at first, but he started to realize that perhaps he could love him in another way. However, he could never be sure when Shinnosuke was being serious or not.

Could real love grow between an honorary student and a popular idol?

title: Katakoi Opera
description: Akuta falls in love easily and almost without fail. His childhood friend, Ao, has been crushing on him for ten years. Always protecting Akuta, Ao destroys any hope of Akuta's unrequited love reciprocating his feelings, as Akuta always returns to Ao's side when he is heartbroken. Ao, who has been thinking "I have to make him realize these intense feelings and this painful desire," will eventually…?

title: Hello Again
description: Ever since he was young, HeeMin has always liked his neighbour, SeonWoo hyung. HeeMin had given up on SeonWoo after he had moved away. However, coincidentally, SeonWoo is searching for a roommate and HeeMin is able to meet him once again. But, the love rival that has appeared in front of HeeMin now is none other than his older brother, YooMin!

title: Deawanakereba Yokatta no
description: Yuzuru is not very popular in high school. Despite his beautiful face, his closed personality prevents him from making friends. If he goes home as soon as classes are over, it's not for pleasure but to take care of his sick older brother. Now, after many years, he reunites with his childhood friend, Kotarou. Being open and friendly, Kotarou doesn't hesitate to invite Yuzuru to hang out with him and his friends after class, in spite of his constant protests. Worried about his brother, will Yuzuru choose to repel or seize that hand?

title: Oko-sama Box
description: Kawasaki and Fujita have been best friends since early childhood. Kawasaki has secretly been carrying a torch for his cheerful buddy, but Fujita only has eyes for the girls around him. The delicate balance of their relationship is shaken when Fujita gets himself a girlfriend in high school. What is Kawasaki supposed to do with his feelings now?

title: Behind the Scandal
description: Chan’s always been the one to blend in, unlike his friend Dowoon the celebrity. From the States, Dowoon’s always gotten attention wherever he goes for his height and his looks. It’s really no surprise Chan fell for him at first sight… but he’s been keeping his feelings a secret since high school. But then one day, just like that, Dowoon asks Chan to be his boyfriend. Bewildered, Chan tries to laugh it off as a joke but he can’t seem to stop thinking about it. Then on the very same day, Chan comes across an article saying Dowoon is romantically involved with some other woman. Was Dowoon being serious about what he said, or was he simply playing a mean prank? Just what could his mixed signals mean? What’s going on behind the scandal?

title: Kare ga Masuku wo Hazusu Toki
description: Due to some incidents in the past, Jirou has started hiding his face behind a mask. One day, he was followed by a creepy stalker but was saved by a man named Fuji. Not only that, he saved Jirou two days in a row. Since then, Fuji, who learned of Jirou’s trouble, became his companion on his way home.

title: False Memories
description:
Wan’s got a face that scares everyone away before he can really become friends with anyone. So when Ha-woon befriends Wan on his first day at his new school, Wan is elated. Ha-woon must be an angel! It doesn’t take long, though, for Ha-woon to betray him in a terrible way, and Wan discovers Ha-woon might be more devil than angel. But then an accident happens that gives Wan a second chance at friendship with his angel. And it all starts with one big, fat lie.  
  
French   
Wan a un visage qui fait peur à tout le monde, avant de pouvoir vraiment devenir ami avec n'importe qui. Alors, quand Ha Woon se lie d'amitié avec Wan lors de son premier jour dans sa ouvelle école, Wan est ravi. Ha Woon doit être un ange ! Cela ne prend pas longtemps, cependant, pour que Ha Woon le trahisse d'une manière terrible, Wan découvre que Ha Woon pourrait être plus diabolique qu'un ange. Mais alors un accident se produit ce qui donne à Wan une seconde chance d'amitié avec son ange. Et tout commence par un t

title: Aisaseteyo Sensei
description:
"I can’t just pretend like it’s nothing. I’ve fallen in love with you, Sensei." University Professor, Hatano Hotaru made a mistake last night- He slept with a student, a straight one at that. “In the end he’ll get tired of me. I don’t want to fall in love with a straight guy.” Or so he thought, but this younger boy won’t let him go…?
A BL about sweet, cute, and passionate love!

title: Sorekara, Kimi o Kangaeru
description: Takashi and Yasu live in a small, boring countryside town devoid of anything interesting. They’ve been friends since childhood – always together. Still the closest of friends, even now in high school. However, Yasu holds feelings for Takashi that go beyond friendship. Without Yasu being able to put his feelings to words, the season changes to exams season, and Takashi confesses that he'll be taking Tokyo University's exams…

title: Coming Out Note
description: After failing the first blind date in his life, Oh Do-Kyung calls the friend who arranged the date. He's in the bathroom. During their conversation, his friend says something which angers Do-Kyung, which leads him to accidentally shouting his secret. His secret is that he is gay. To his shock, he realizes that there are other people in the bathroom: friends from his college department and even a senior student that he is on good terms with. Worried about whether or not they heard his secret, Do-Kyung's life completely changes.

title: Kyonyuu Suki Nanoni BL Kai ni Tensei Shimashita
description:
Nagare loves boobs. And he gets his wish to be reincarnated in a world of boobs…except these are man boobs. A zany BL isekai comedy full of titillation and satirical jabs at manga cliches of all kinds!

(Source: K Manga)

title: Onii-chan Complex
description: Haruki's younger brother Natsuki dresses like a girl and always clings to him. This is starting to cause problems after Haruki gets into high school, so he tries to think of a way to work things out with Natsuki.

title: Kinyoubi no Houkago wa Houshi to Kiss wo
description: Ishigami often ends up getting involved with delinquents, which gives others the impression that he's a scary kind of guy, isolating him from his peers. In order to help restore his image, he pairs up with Suzumura, a member of the disciplinary committee, to do community service. Suzumura happens to be famously flirty, and after the community service, he suggests kissing practice...

title: Rock 'n Roll
description:
High school students Mayama and Sayama. They’re childhood friends and best friends—the two of them do everything together. But lately, it seems like Sayama has been getting a lot of attention…?

Inseparable Childhood Friends: Signs of Change in Their Everyday Lives

title: Uso wa Hitotsu mo Tsuitemasen
description:
"From now on, keep an eye on me, okay?" Ichinose Kaname and Aizawa Ryo are high school boys who live in the same dorm room and practice together after school despite belonging to different clubs . One day, Ryo is suddenly asked by Kaname to "protect him." Kaname says it's because the seniors in his dorm are teasing him too much, and Ryo accepts. However, when it comes down to it, Kaname has an even more serious agenda...

Chiaki-kun Mimamori Kurabu (Spinoff From)

title: Katasumi no Kioku
description:
Sumino, a first-year high school student, enrolls in a prestigious soccer school in Kamakura but breaks his leg soon after joining the team. Unable to practice and feeling out of place, he spends his days wandering aimlessly and his nights partying. Then one day, he meets Aoki, an older man working at an izakaya, and slowly begins to experience emotions he has never felt before. A story of one unforgettable summer, both the worst and the best.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Romance Debut!!
description: Yuzuki had a quiet, dull junior high school life. However, now he's finally made his "debut" upon entering high school. With his new hair, clothes, and attitude, he was able to join the popular group of students, but for some reason, it's his dull classmate Shitara who’s popular with the girls.

title: ROUGE
description: Gang fights and Yakuza dabblings. Sophomores versus seniors. Blood, rape and power. Mayhem rules Kishuu Private High School when sophomore Nagato transfers into the all boys school. Battle-tested and oblivious to the hierarchy, the newcomer soon piques the senior leader's interest. When Nagato is suddenly confronted and defeated by the latter's lap dog, Ai, he vows to get back at his foe. Little does he know that Ai harbours a dark past behind his beautiful poker face…

title: Rough♥Boyfriend
description:
1-2.5: ♥ Boyfriend  
Naoto is Hajime's childhood friend. Naoto may look cute but then again, his attitude gets on everyone's nerves. Even though Naoto's like that, Hajime still has his eyes on him. The problem is, Naoto hates homosexuals – so much that he wishes they will become extinct and rot in hell!  
  
3-3.5: All About My Brother  
Shinji has always loved his younger brother, Haruki, more than any older brother should. Yet when he receives an unexpected warning letter demanding payment on a delinquent loan, he is left speechless. With everything Haruki could ever ask for provided by loving parents, he demands to know what could it be that would cause Haruki to be so greedy and irresponsible. Can Shinji really handle the truth behind Haruki's unusually selfish actions? Will he give up on Haruki altogether?  
  
4-5.5: Piano Lesson  
After his parents' divorce, Hara Shuuji left Tokyo to live with his mother and attend the local school. With hopes of starting a new and peaceful scho

title: Picking Light
description:
Growing up happens inadvertently, Li Chuan and A-Cheng both people are like playful demons, in the shadow of the schoolyard and on the basketball court, they pass it quietly.  
*Free up to episode 23 on Wecomics*

title: Love Kids!!
description:
High schoolers Rin and Kyo are childhood friends from kindergarten. They're so close that there's virtually nothing they don't know about each other.   
  
Rin, who had been pining for Takahashi-kun, his father's lover, for many years, finally gave up, wishing instead for his father and Takahashi's happiness. After his broken heart was comforted by Kyo, Rin is finally able to stand up again, but then suddenly, Kyo confesses to him…?!

title: Never Mind, Darling
description:
After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day.
Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon’s heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—”We just kissed”—only adds fuel to the fire.
As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart’s desires.

title: Tweeting Love Birds
description:
Ohtaka is pissed! University baseball is not what he expected, and it’s all because of Chun, the odd little person who blithely chirps and constantly circles in his tall shadow. Everything Chun does only deepens Ohtaka’s scowl. His irritation skyrockets when Chun demands Ohtaka stay in the baseball club for his sake and steals Ohtaka’s first kiss!  
  
When two people from Chun's past are thrown in Ohtaka's face, his agitation suddenly turns territorial – and he's not sure why…  
  
Will Ohtaka figure out this unfamiliar game that plays for keeps? Get ready for a fast pitch of romantic comedy and surprising love!

title: Kowamote Danshi no Bentou ga Umai Riyuu
description:
"Mizukawa-kun, I made a bento for you."

Huh?? Why?? Why did this scary-looking guy make me a bento!?

It is now lunch time. Mizukawa is your average boy who was just about to have his usual bread for lunch when Tsuchiya, his classmate who's constantly shrouded in dangerous rumours, suddenly gave him a bento.

"You'll get hungry just eating bread and it's unhealthy too."

Huh? Is Tsuchiya actually a nice guy? And his bento is actually delicious...

This is the debut commercial work from the promising new manga artist, Machida March! With Tsuchiya's bento being the catalyst, thus begins an innocent love story between the average boy, Mizukawa and Tsuchiya, the scary-looking boy who's good at cooking.

title: Neko to Mahou wa Kiss de Hodokeru
description: Lucas, an inferior student at a magic school suddenly had cat ears and tail! He's unable to block strong curses so he asks Dylan for help. Dylan, unlike his younger self, is now a cold and arrogant student council member who somehow still cares for Lucas, his childhood friend. "While investigating, I found out that the only way to solve this curse is... To have sex with a man!" And then Dylan said, "The curse, I'll remove it!"

title: The Lonely Sub Will Find Love With Only One Dom
description:
Golden Retriever Dom x Pretty Loner Sub
[Reverse Submissive] Dom/Sub Universe.
—
Alfonso is a Sub who boasts the school's top grades and abilities however, powers of a Dom are ineffective to him. That is until he meets Asuka, a new student and a Dom.
Asuka challenges Alfonso to a duel with the condition that if he wins, Alfonso will become his partner.
Alfonso accepts with the intention of beating the cocky junior, but his body suddenly reacts to Asuka's unexpected words...!

title: Kimi to Deattekara Boku wa
description:
"It's about time you gave up."
Honda, a gay and shy high school teacher, is forced to consult with Endo, a student who doesn't decide his career path at all, but Endo makes him mean.
However, Endo gradually opened his heart to Honda, who was devoted to it.
On the contrary, the gentle hand touching the suddenness, the strong eyes staring at me, and the straight and feverish thoughts of Endo, who is increasing day by day, keep running away saying that I can't...
A single-minded Spadari high school student x a high school teacher who has given up on love is frustrating and sweet, youth love.
The two of us are conscious in the bath together.

title: Becoming Human!
description:
The only pearl in the world that could turn Fox Fang into a human was accidentally swallowed by one of his classmates! In order to become human, the fox has to go great lengths to "provoke a man into bed". But who would have thought that he'd fall into the other man's trap?!  
  
Official Translation: [Thai](https://www.comico.in.th/titles/2049), [Chinese](https://manga.bilibili.com/m/detail/mc28073), [French](https://delitoon.com/webtoon/il-%C3%A9tait-juste-une-fois)  
Official English translation on Comico's [Pocket Comics app](https://www.comico.io/pocket-comics)

title: Oretachi One Set
description:
"We are friends… but can I touch you?"
The two topmost handsome guys in the school have a secret they can’t tell anyone!
-A cool, mysterious guy and a flirty, cheery guy!!-

title: Doushiyou mo nai, Boku no Hatsukoi.
description:
Yugi has been hiding his feelings. 
One day he finds out that his crush, Takeuchi, has been dumped by his girlfriend. Yugi dashes over to him to confess his feelings. Surprised by Yugi's pushy behavior, Takeuchi also starts to sense a change in himself. 
Watch these two clumsy people fall in love for the first time in this coming-of-age story!

title: Renai Hensachi Kaisouroku
description:
While reminiscing about the good old days at a middle school reunion, Kusui is unable to stop thinking about his first love: his middle school boyfriend Chizuwa, a petite classmate with a shy smile. A special guest crashes the party, and this confident man in a suit turns out to be none other than Chizuwa, who’s here to confront Kusui about the end of their relationship. 
The debut work of promising author Shinachaso!

title: Boku Dake o Mite Kure
description: The main character, Yoh, was in love with his childhood friend Taishi. He was happy and had no doubts about his daily routine of taking care of Taishi, who was crippled. Except that he is a man and he has fallen in love with a "woman"...

title: Otona-chan
description: A high school student, "Otona-chan" is popular among both guys and girls with his cute looks. But instead of being treated like a child, he wants to be treated like an adult and really admires cool adults. And then comes a student teacher to his class, who is very much adult-like and he falls hard…

title: Dounimo Nannai Soushi Souai
description:
When they were in elementary school, Keita gave Genji a cruel nickname. After that, he was saddled with being teased every day by his classmates! Every time they came face to face, it was nothing but fight, fight, fight for those two.  
  
However, that relationship came to a sudden end when Keita changed schools. Then, many years later, they met again in high school…  
Genji, the player and Keita, the handsome hunk.  
  
Is the distance between their hearts close, or far apart? The heat of wanting to touch but not touching. When these polar opposites are attracted to each other… will it be the birth of a strong couple?!

title: Tonari no Banken
description: Hana and Kiyo are childhood friends who are now university students. They have been together since  nursery school and their houses are even next door to each other. It was natural for Hana to be with Kiyo anytime and anywhere without any feelings of discomfort.  However, one day, Hana noticed that Kiyo was popular with girls and with that, their relationship suddenly starts to change.

title: Classmate no Josou o Tetsudattara Kawai Sugite Furue ga Tomaranai Ken
description: A collection of mildly ecchi stories focusing on crossdressing high-school boys and the boys who like them, mostly from the boys-in-skirts (otokonoko) magazine Oto☆Nyan.

title: Lucky Number 13
description:
Satou Hiroshi is the kind of polite, innocent, cute boy who's popular with guys and girls alike. But word-of-mouth has it that anyone who dates him will be plagued by a series of unfortunate events and near-death experiences – eventually being forced to institute a break-up "under pain of death"…  
  
Will bespectacled, "uncool", baseball-crazy Tsumabuki Kasumi prove these rumours wrong – or experience them first-hand? But after falling for Hiroshi's cute smile upon their (rather weird) first meeting, he's determined to tempt fate and find out whether he can finally break out of this unlucky streak and strike it lucky in his love life!

title: Peach Love
description: Mae High School’s number one, Peach, ends up falling for the wooden doll carving innocent boy Love! However, Peach is the man who stands at the summit of a bloody world where only the fittest may survive. From his conclusion that there will be a limit to protecting Love, Peach makes a reckless plan of making Peach the number one… A manhwa with action and zeal as good as shounen, and with love between diverse wacky teenage boys is beginning!

title: Houkago no Love Call
description: Ueda Wataru, a high school teacher, was rejected by someone he'd loved back when he was a student himself. Because of this, he has been timid in love ever since. However, he's now fallen in love with his student's father, Ippongi Kazushi, a Yakuza. Ueda can't help being fascinated with the good looking Ippongi's sweet words, even though he knows that he shouldn't…

title: Sunde Mitsukete Kirameite
description:
I should have wanted to go back to my friends.  I want to get closer than that.
