Hayakawa Akira, a third-year high school student, changes seats and sits next to his childhood friend Kuno Sumika.

Akira, who has many friends and is active, and Sumiya, who likes astronomy and is quiet.
The two grew up in the house next door from an early age and were their best friends despite their opposite personalities.
However, when I was in elementary school, I had a trivial quarrel, and I couldn't say "I'm sorry" to each other, so I was estranged.

Akira feels awkward to start preparing for the school festival in the same group,
Sumiya has been kind to me as before ...

title: Kouki to Haru
description:
「A world of just the two of us would be fine, you know.」

Koki Taguchi, a second-year high schooler, is secretly dating Haru Higashino — a popular actor who attends the performing arts track at the same school. Dating another guy, on top of someone who lives in the entertainment world, comes with many restrictions. But the feeling of just wanting to be together never changes.

Marui Yuuno's beloved social media series, which cuts to the heart of what it means to "like" someone, is finally collected in print.

title: Gochisou-sama
description: Hiroto, a part-timer without a steady job, is on his lunch break in the park when a cute little boy appears in front of him and stares enviously at his bento. The child looks so irresistibly cute and hungry, Hiroto shares his lunch with the boy. When the child's father, Suguru, finally shows up and sees his picky-eater son enjoying a meal, he offers Hiroto a housekeeping job! The father is a pilot and cannot be home all the time, and needs a caretaker for the boy and their beautiful home. Just as things start going well for Hiroto, he begins to fall for Suguru…and learns that the previous housekeeper had to resign because of romantic involvement with the dashing pilot! Can Hiroto keep his emotions in check?

title: Sensei ni wa Kanawanai
description: "Do you really understand what kind of place an all boy school is?" To scare this teacher off I pushed him down on the infirmary bed, but… how did I end up under him!?

title: Seichoutsuu
description: Subaru Kashino travels to a high school in the countryside for a sports training camp where he meets Kei Natsume,  a library committee member.  Subaru expectedly finds himself curious about the boy in the library. Then one night Subaru has a sensual dream about his new friend. When it's time to return to Tokyo, Natsume suggests instead of calling each other to write letters. Confused, but intrigued, Subaru decides to start writing to Natsume.

title: Neko Neko Honey
description: Nekoya Ai is a cute teenager who turns into a cat uncontrollably when he is under emotional distress. After being cornered by delinquents, he gets help from a scary-looking guy who turns out to be a real cat lover and his classmate to top it off. Will Ai be able to keep his shapeshifting condition a secret?

title: Hibi mo Tsumoreba Koi to Naru
description: When he was young, Oto would visit his grandma in the summer. But, because he was from Tokyo, Oto had no friends to play with and sat alone in the shade. That was until a boy two years older named Sora came and invited Oto to play with him and his friends. To Oto, Sora was his knight in shining armor and was destroyed when he disappeared the following summer, making Oto regret not communicating his true feelings for Sora. Several years pass, and it's finally Sora's last year of high school. All he wants is to focus on studying for his university entrance exams. Sora thought his only distraction would be his loudmouth best friend, but on his first day back, he runs into an old face - or rather, that old face runs into him, professing his love for Sora all the while.

title: Boku wa, Onna no ko
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
- He said "I'm a girl"  
  
- Rakuen ni Ikou (Let's go to the Paradise)  
  
- Shounen no Musume (Boy's Daughter)  
  
- The Theme of Akemi ver. Teruo  
  
- The Theme of Akemi ver. Yoshio  
  
- The Theme of Akemi ver. Haruo  
  
- The Flower  
Contains the Transient Son character Yuki.  
  
- Sweet 16  
A short, bittersweet story in which a girl realizes she's in love with her tutor, who's in love with someone else. The other main plot point is the main character's dread of the upcoming school marathon.

title: Sono Koi ni wa Wake ga Aru
description: Aoi, a first year student in all-boys high school, is a violent but beautiful boy. Viewing his good looks as a burden, he ruthlessly rejects every guy that approaches him. Until one day, Aoi notices Azuma, who's been "observing" him quietly from the sidelines. To his surprise, Azuma's attitude actually makes him feel safe, and he slowly falls in love?!

title: Hanabatake to Wakarebanashi
description: Takuya, Yuiji, and Aki are childhood friends who have always been together. Takuya secretly likes Aki, but she suddenly gets a boyfriend. Takuya nurses his broken heart with Yuiji, who suddenly confesses that he's always liked Takuya.

title: Ato no Matsuri
description: A boy with female features is chosen by his fellow drama club members to act as a fake girlfriend for their club, so they can practice on him before they actually get themselves girlfriends. This is series that started as a one shot and after a 1 1/2 year hiatus was given its very own series

title: Lovely Allergen
description: Yue Zhishi and Song Yu are not blood related brothers, Yue Zhishi, who was fostered by the Song family since childhood, loves to cling to his older brother, Song Yu, who is three years older than him. However, Song Yu always deliberately maintains a distance. Song Yu, the brother who pretends to be indifferent, and Yue Zhishi, the brother who is a clingy little puppy. But what others don't know is that he understands his own heart, he choose to exercise self-control and maintain a distance because… Yue Zhishi is Song-Yu’s only allergen.

title: Seishun Girigiri Overline
description:
"You're gonna regret it if you stay with me."  
  
Oshima heard the rumors that his boyfriend, Hiyama, is quitting baseball. Upon hearing the upsetting news, and after being told that he's a nuisance to the baseball team and his boyfriend's career, he tries to convince Hiyama to stay on the team. What will happen to their clumsy love story after they graduate high school?!

title: Suki tte Iu na!
description:
Tokita Eiji, the handsome Student Council President whom the entire student body admires, and Okamoto Oriya, who leads a very ordinary school life: the two don't have anything in common at all, but one day, Oriya suddenly gets romanced passionately by Eiji…!  
  
"Oriya, I think that we should get married soon."  
  
What will Oriya do with Eiji's perverted love?!

title: Ginger Honey
description: On his way home from school, Minoru discovers his older brother, Yoshino, making out with his male gym teacher! To confuse the matter even more, he also notices his brother's best friend, Seto, shooting longing glances at Yoshino! And for some reason, that revelation makes Minoru's chest hurt. Could what he's feeling actually be love?!

title: Amadare no Koro
description: Suguru and Yoshiichi were neighbors who were always together, until the day Suguru decided to move away. When they entered junior high, as promised, Suguru came back. But he was unable to transition into their high school, so he is thinking of applying for other schools. Yoshiichi's image of the Suguru who's always by his side shatters a bit. He became upset, lonely and jealous.

title: Mayoi Neko to Koi no Ashiato
description: Miyane Kokoro comes back to the city he'd moved away from 7 years prior, due to his parents' transfer. Now attending the same school he'd visited so many times as a kid, Kokoro can't wait to see Chanko – the stray cat that lives there – again, even if it's past curfew. However, his attempt to find Chanko fails when he ends up getting caught by the school nurse, Hiragi.

title: Yukimura-sensei to Kei-kun
description: Yukimura-sensei is famous for being beautiful. It's true that he's both terribly beautiful and capable… However, he's also somewhat ferocious. Although Kei is treated coldly by him, he continues to stay over at sensei's place for spiritual nourishment. Kei is constantly stunned by sensei's sweet love-struck side, yet the atmosphere around him freezes when he finds out about sensei's ex-boyfriend. Will he be able to make such a charming person fall in love with him?!

title: To the Yesterday You
description:
We’ve been together since we were kids…  
  
But then you left me without warning.  
  
“I’m here from the future to save you.”

title: Braid into Love
description: A young boy finds himself fascinated by the long hair of the boy in class who sits in front of him.

title: Docchi ni Suru?
description:
You're asking what we're deciding? Of course – who's gonna put it in first!  
  
The super normal university student, Hiroo Eiji has a problem. That is, he can't become popular because he always has two extremely handsome but forceful childhood friends, Haruki and Ikumi, beside him. However, when he received the first love letter in his life, both childhood friends confessed, saying, "You can't go out with a girl. I've been in love with you all this time…" and then they set him up and do super perverted stuff with him…?!

title: Ookina Noichi to Chiisana Hinayuki
description: Tanda Nao is filled with concern because his cherished childhood friend Hinayuki has been hanging around with a classmate he doesn't trust: Noichi. Hinayuki is petite, delicate, and docile, while Noichi is big, quiet, and rough... Nao is worried because he doesn't know why they are together!? Could it be that these two are in some kind of relationship ...!?

title: Sahara-sensei to Toki-kun
description:
My heart can’t stop pounding!! A physical education teacher X A Yankee’s frustrating romantic comedy!!

Toki-Kun is a yankee who gets into fights. But despite his appearance he is actually a gentle guy. He gains favor with Mr. Sahara, who is not only a physical education teacher but his homeroom teacher. The loud gong of a straight-gay unrequited love echoes out!!

title: Candy Man
description: Kyuyeon has an alternate persona in an online game, he pretends to be a female player with a character named “Yorong” only to rip off items from other clueless users. One of “her” diehard fans named “Yeommin” showers Kyuyeon with gifts day and night. He’s happy but at the same time, Kyuyeon feels a bit pressured about Yeommin because he’s always asking “Yorong” for a date. To top it all off, Kyuyeon finds out that Yeommin is his handsome classmate called Kimin Yeom. How is he going to get out of trouble?

title: Amanojaku Gambler
description: “I want you to fall in love with me, so I can’t lose!” Kajio witnesses Nanase Dai, who goes to the same cram school as him, coming out of a pachinko parlor. He’s charmed by Nanase’s attitude, which is the exact opposite of the honor student he sees at school, and confesses to him without thinking. Despite being rejected, Kajio makes a bet that if he’s able to get Nanase to fall for him within one month, Nanase has to go out with him – and Nanase, who loves gambling, accepts the challenge. In the final summer of their high school lives where love is wagered, what will happen to these two in one month?!

title: Yowamushi Danshi, Renai Hajimemasu
description: Kawachi's enjoying another day of watching (more like stalking) his favorite guy, the very nice Yuto Shinozuka, from the shadows. As he's peeping on Yuto putting away some stuff in the gym storage room, something unbelievable happens…! Caught witnessing Yuto showing his true self, Kawachi panics and blurts out that he'll keep quiet if Yuto pleasures him! Kawachi feels terrible because what he's doing is basically blackmail! But, he just can't help himself. A relationship that starts with blackmail… Can it work!?

title: Kirakira no Hibi
description:
1-5) Every morning high-school student Nanami catches sight of this one surfer he secretly begins to admire. Incidentally, however, it is later on a certain day that they reunite in a classroom! Turns out that this one-year-older senpai, named Shuu, is in fact one who, while characteristically mature, is unsociable to the extent that he’s even notorious for being someone difficult to approach. Even so, for some reason, Nanami becomes the sole person that he can smile at and laugh with, over and over again… As they repeatedly spend more time together after school, by midsummer, Nanami finds himself receiving a kiss near the seaside?! And so, a story of dazzling first love ensues.  
  
6-7) Kamatte Kawaii Hito  
In order to overcome his debilitating fear of cats, Natsumi Hayato goes to visit a cat cafe. But could his reaction to one of the staff he meets there be even more difficult to conquer than his phobia?

title: We Met in Ueno
description: The meeting in Ueno between Lin Ge and Hiroki Asano began with a misunderstanding, but the two gradually built up their friendship despite language and cultural differences. This is a cute and funny story of a Chinese boy and a Japanese boy!

title: Blue de Roix
description:
Izumi, a high school student, possesses the mysterious ability to see “wings” on certain people’s backs. He has since hidden this power, but after reuniting with the man called “Mana”, his everyday life suddenly changes?  
  
An inter-species love between a blue eyed high school student and a blue winged demon!!

title: Bokura ni Matsuwaru Et Cetera
description:
Main story: Iku and Keita are childhood buddies. Naturally, having been friends for as long as they can remember, when one started to play baseball, so did the other. During their final year in middle school, Keita's baseball career abruptly ended as a result of the severe injuries he sustained when saving Iku from being hit by a truck.  
  
Presently, they go to the same high school. But ever since that accident, Iku has distanced himself from both the game and his friend, presumably out of guilt. What does Keita think about this?

title: Otona Gokko
description: Mitsuru goes out night after night looking for strangers to have sex with. Rumours are flying around school that he's a prostitute, but this is fine with Mitsuru, who prefers to be alone. Transfer student Hasegawa is irritated by this attitude and he begins to follow him around. Will Mitsuru's loneliness finally be abated as Hasegawa keeps forcing himself into his life?

title: Luminograph
description:
On campus, he looked straight at a classmate holding the camera.  
To Okamoto, who was more lively than usual today, he appeared refreshing and was immediately interested in him.  
The other day, the distance between them closes immensely when Okamoto helps out a very drunk Yonezu, the one holding the camera. However, just one kiss creates a gap in their relationship….

title: Koi no Tsuzuki ni Hitsuyou Nano wa
description: Aki tries to find the guy who helped him at the station three days ago. The only clues he has are the showy blond hair, the school uniform, and the weird stuffed toy.

title: Kakko Warui Hinata-kun
description:
Meet Hinata-kun, an attractive, straight-A student.  
  
There's nothing he loves more than being called "cool!" ♪  
  
That's why when Kagami, who's even taller and smarter than him, asks him out, he's at a complete loss as to what to do! No matter how many times he turns him down, Kagami refuses to give up, and after he holds a secret over Hinata, the two of them wind up stuck together to study!  
  
This love story follows the trials and tribulations of Kagami-kun, the tease, and a stubborn Hinata-kun as they study for their finals. ☆  
  
Other short stories include adolescent boys who have to share rooms in a school dorm, and more! ☆

title: A Trace of You
description: After a terrible fire all but consumes Sihoo’s home, his life has finally gone back to normal except…he has no memories. An amnesiac, he can’t remember much beyond his own name and the café he works at. Then, one day, his former classmate Yesung Min walks in and helps Sihoo remember everything that ever mattered: they were in love. From the ashes of his life, comes an old flame.

title: Oyajina!
description: It's romance, unbridled lust, and the scandalous relationship of a lesbian and her best friend… all while being a man in your forties? Thanks to a chemical leak, all the teenage girls in Tokyo have magically turned into middle aged salarymen! Who knew sexiness came with bald spots, parted hair, and neatly-trimmed mustaches? Chinatsu and Tomoe were the best friends two teenage girls could have, but will they be something more as over-the-hill office workers?

title: Hi-Fi Rendezvous
description: Childhood friends Tsutsuji and Kouji live in a tiny village. Due to the lack of students, their school is scheduled to be closed at the end of the year; they'll be its final batch. The two of them have always been together, but at this rate they may be separated after graduation…

title: Chemistry Has "Reactions"
description:
"One boy upset over his soft, cute appearance. The other boy, because of that boy's pretty and cute appearance, deliberately provokes and fans his anger to reveal his own Masochistic traits. What will happen between them?"   
  
The story begins with random scenes from the boys' current friendship before taking an in depth look back at how these two began.

title: Debiluzu Hanii
description:
Popular phys-ed teacher Toshimitsu Sugaya has been given the assignment of keeping an eye on a gang of thugs in the school, particularly their leader Tatsumi Yoshino, the "Devil of Nami High." However, he soon finds out that not only is Yoshino a decent guy, but he's been idolizing Sugaya for over a year! It doesn't take long for Yoshino to win over the reluctant teacher and the two start a secret love affair. Can a teacher/student relationship really work and how long can these two hide their secret?  


---

title: Bibibi!!
description: A comedy about two boys who switch bodies with two of the girls in their class.

title: Kawaisa Amatte Nanika ga Hyakubai
description:
1-3: You're Hopelessly Cute  
Mikuni Renji had always been serious in every love relationship. It was his bad luck to meet with people who only used him for their own satisfaction. Ichinomiya Shinobu, the sadistic younger flower shop prince who was his company supplier, fell in love with Mikuni through constant teasing. Trouble came when Ichinomiya met Mikuni and his ex-partner on the street. Will Mikuni get dumped again?  
  
4: The Clumsy Door Keeper  
A friendly high-school student falls for his reclusive classmate.   
  
5-6: Sorry, But I Love You  
The son of a "Mama" realizes his love for his coworker, who also happens to be a cross-dresser, like his parent.

title: Please Tell Me Today's Fortune!
description:
My day always starts with 'Today's Fortune'. I follow whatever it says including lucky colors, places, and objects. What?! I'm going to receive a love confession today? I've been waiting all day, but there's no news. Suddenly Eunchan, the most popular boy in school, confesses to me!  
  
- [![](https://i.imgur.com/dQCXZkU.png) Author’s Twitter](https://twitter.com/rmqhada)

title: The Light of Summer
description: Sungha is loved by men and women of all ages for his mature and kind character. But he has scars that can’t be shown to just anyone… Woojoo is the only friend he can open up to. The day after the final exam, Sungha gathers the courage to overcome his wounds and try to change. This is the story of Sungha and Woojoo healing each other.

title: Goraihou Gakuen e Youkoso!
description:
Goraihou Academy — A world leading bourgeois school where mysterious creatures gather. In order to protect the academy, the members of the student council with attractive appearances and fickle personalities stand up to…?!  
  
We meet Sakuragawa Shinya, Goraihouji Tadato, and Mashiba Naoki. Handsome and talented Shinya is more or less the main character. Together with Tadato, the president of the student council whose father also happens to be chairman of the board of directors for the school, and Naoki, who is always hitting on an uninterested Shinya, Shinya discovers the haunted secrets of Goraihou Gakuen.  
  
Things begin to change when a dark creature is discovered hiding within the school. The trio go to investigate and find Gen-san. And from there on they solve mysteries and hauntings and other paranormal events within the school.

title: Tsukiaitai Kareshi
description: Tobari, who has bad luck, finds himself in big trouble. It all starts when Saeki, the most popular guy in school, confesses his love to him in front of the whole school...!? Emuemuo's cute trouble love!!

title: Shuuden Elegy
description:
Kenji and Tama first met on a station platform. Tama's eyes were red from crying after being dumped by his boyfriend and he was curled up like a ball, just like a cat. Under his watchful glare, Kenji actually thought that "love at first sight" really does exist. Even though Kenji falls more and more in love with him every time they meet, Tama still laughs and cries whenever he talks about his ex-boyfriend. Yet, suddenly, he kisses him…  
  
"It's because I like you that I want you to cheer you on."  
  
"I want you to know that such kindness exists, too."

title: Ichi Ni no San!
description:
While messing around with each other in junior high school, Choco groped his best friend Bun's chest. From then on, Bun has been harbouring impure feelings for Choco. But the naive Choco straightforwardly declared: "Bun-chan, I like you!"  
  
Bun knows perfectly well that he meant it in a platonic way. Still, he can't help feeling depressed. To save their friendship, Bun tries his best to hide his true feelings from Choco.

title: Fair Bianca
description: Photography club member Yano received an unexpected confession from upperclassman Akutsu, the handsome but often oblivious school charmer. But Akutsu, having confessed, continues to treat Yano just as he did before. Akutsu's easy acceptance of all confessions towards him, coupled with him treating his own confession of love to Yano as a thing of the past, confuses Yano. Yano becomes more and more aware of Akutsu and also increasingly anxious…

title: Tingling Boy
description: A slight tingle in your heart yearning for love.

title: The Flashpoint of Young Men
description: Though he seems completely indifferent to romance, high-schooler Manabu works part time as a writer for an erotic magazine. One day, right when some classmates were about to pick a fight with him, he was saved by Yamaguma, an underclassman. Apparently Yamaguma, who is popular but unfamiliar with romance, is upset about his older sister working at a nightclub. While trying to desensitize Yamaguma of his excessive reaction to Manabu's erotic writing, they…? The heat of their connected hands is the folly of youth. A bittersweet diary of first love.

title: Kimi to Mita Houkiboshi o Sagashite
description: A story about two high school friends, Ohara and Kawai, who share a love for astronomy.

title: Kataomoi to Parade
description:
Close friends since childhood, Touma has a long intensifying unrequited love for Takaya.  
  
"I want to be his princess", "He is my hero" – though he has a rough personality and mouth, Touma thinks like a maiden and is hurt every day by his own servile thinking and self-deprecation as he cannot express his love.  
  
And it doesn't help that Takaya has gotten himself a girlfriend since starting university, and as Takaya's "nursemaid" and close friend, Touma can't avoid close contact.  
  
At the same time, club senpai Yonezawa and a mysterious woman have gotten close to Touma; and here starts the harsh and painful changes in unrequited love for Touma –  
  
"But my world is filled even with just one word from you."

title: Kawaii Akuma
description: Akiyoshi Tooru is the perfect student with glasses. Unfortunately, he’s always been told that he was 'cute' and 'pretty' which forced him to develop an inferiority complex as a young man. The very same Akiyoshi received a confession from a boy of rare beauty, Naruse Fuuta. Of course, Akiyoshi rejected the confession from another man. However, Naruse lost it, underwent a complete change of attitude, and attacked him! Now knowing the fearsome nature of Naruse, what fate awaits the fleeing Akiyoshi?!

title: I Want to Kill the Yandere Prince Everyday
description: Trouble brews for a sucker for pretty faces! A dirt-poor commoner and ray of sunshine, Jiang Jiao Jiao(straight guy) falls for Zhong Ming Yu's (male) looks at first sight! After an unexpected accident, the once cold and aloof young lord has transformed into a dainty, fragile ["Little Sister Lin"](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lin_Daiyu), even using his good looks to win the affections of the other party!! However, as their relationship deepens, Jiang Jiao Jiao begins to uncover Ming Yu’s dark, obsessive tendencies and a massive family secret spanning two generations...

title: Reset
description: “No matter how many rejections you get, I’ll always be by your side…” Sou, a senior of the basketball club, is Touma’s childhood friend and lover. Although Sou is popular among his teammates and friends, male and female, once he has a steady partner, he gets obsessed with them, and eventually clings to Touma in tears when the relationship ends. Their relationship began in secret when Touma took advantage of Sou’s heart of glass. No matter how deep their relationship goes, Touma is on pins and needles, wondering if Sou will find out the truth. Maki, a teammate who noticed Sou’s distorted possessiveness finds it hard to leave Touma alone…!

title: The Unrecognized You
description: After striking up a conversation with a mascot-costumed part-timer at a flower shop, Dohee ends up on the bad side of the school delinquent, Yang Hyun! He starts confiding his true feelings to the mascot… but it turns out the one inside the costume is actually Yang Hyun?!

title: SPACE
description: Chiaki Kirino is a regular high school boy with nothing. No family, no money… and no home in the near future – unless he finds a job before graduation. His heart is also empty, always looking at the same boy, Fujio, never finding the courage to start a conversation, partly because he knows he has nothing to offer. Just being in the same space with Fujio makes him content, or so he thinks. But one day Fujio comes and sweeps him off his feet in a sudden confession. What is really happening, and how should he react to this?

title: Shouwaru Ookami ga Koi wo Shita Rashii
description: The mysterious former student council president, Shirou Akagi and the inexpressive disciplinary committee member, Nao Kousaka: how will those two damaged boys find their respective love?

title: Meet up at somewhere in Scorpio
description:
“You'll never like me.”
Takamura, a high school student, returns to the town where he lived as a child and, by chance, finds himself in the same class as Rei, a boy he had a crush on in elementary school. Homare also remembers Takamura, and feeling something akin to fate, Takamura begins to harbor a faint crush on him once again. However, when he witnesses Rei entering a hotel with a boy after class, he is surprised and asks him about it. Rei tells him that it was just a friendship, but his next words are: “I have no idea what it's like to fall in love with someone...”

title: Hatsukoi Lovers
description:
Mamori Kusunoki's childhood friend Wakaba Kisaki has been dressing and acting as a girl for years, stemming from a promise to get married when they were kids.  
  
(Source: MU)

title: Charao-kun to Haraguro-kun no Himitsu
description:
Niina Keito is always surrounded by girls who're into casual relationships because of his showy looks and "playboy" demeanour, but he's actually a pure-hearted shoujo fan who's never even had sex before! On the other hand, there's Takizawa Ryou: the picture of a studious, courteous prince in front of the girls but secretly a mean-spirited guy who doesn't care for them one bit.  
  
These two polar opposites are newly stepbrothers and therefore forced to live under one roof, but this, as well as the fact that their true personalities are completely different from their chosen images, are the two secrets they've both agreed to keep for each other.  
  
But one day, quite out of the blue, Takizawa kisses Niina and says, "Choose me. I'll love you for who you are"!?

title: Boys Love
description: By coincidence two high-school boys who take the same train become friends and more. As their relationship changes, they realize that they are different from others – but are they mistaken?

title: Keyaki Shoutengai Sakura no Yu
description:
Tatsumi Azuma, a third-year student at Keyaki High School, accidentally bumps into and fractures Shunpei Eguchi’s hand. Shunpei Eguchi is a second-year student at the same high school, rumoured to "kill anyone who makes eye contact with him."

Out of fear of retaliation, Tatsumi pleads with Shunpei that he would do “anything”… Who knew that Tatsumi would end up helping out at Shunpei’s family-run Sakura Bathhouse?!

Brought to you by Tsubaki Yuzu, the heart-warming story of a fierce, intimidating junior and a sociable, bespectacled senior!

title: Between the Stars
description:
Yoon Byeol’s world is turned upside down when his brother, Hyesung, gets into an accident. But when Byeol visits him in the hospital, he’s surprised to find him in an expensive private room and learns that Hyesung received compensation for the incident. When he goes to confront Sung Woon, the person who pushed his brother down the stairs, Byeol is met with another surprise: Woon knows about a dark side of Hyesung that is hard to believe. What is their relationship, and why would Woon push him?

**Note:** only the Korean side stories are explicit with lightsabers. The official English, Japanese, Thai, S.Chinese, and T.Chinese are heavily censored.

title: Sayonara, Osananajimi
description: Neighbors their whole lives, high school students Shouei and Itsuki have grown up like brothers. Their relationship as best friends hasn't changed from Kindergarten until now....the day Itsuki suddenly confessed.

title: Spring Snow
description:
Gong Shiwoo has been secretly living on the school's rooftop when an encounter with student Cha Hajin and his subsequent daily visits put an end to the teenager's privacy. It doesn't take long for him to stop minding Hajin's presence though, and soon a special bond begins to form between the two teenagers.  
  
(Snow Flower Scans)

title: Bromance
description: In a quiet high school Yu Shu and Jin Zhan are best friends, but from the view of others, they are more than just that.

title: Hanyuu-sensei no Ryou Seikatsu
description: Hanyuu wants nothing else but become a teacher who guides the students in life, yet fails the admission each time, not only that but is mistaken for a boy in his teens. Unexpectedly though he finally makes it to working in a school… as a student?!

title: Utsusemi ni Akari
description: Spin-off of Kurayami ni Strobe featuring Sawayama & Hase.

title: Seishun Girigiri Outline
description:
With a deep gaze, Oshima received a confession of "I love you!!" from his classmate, Hiyama.  
  
And naturally, astounded by his confession, Oshima rejected him as he didn't believe in love between men and that made Hiyama become discouraged.  
  
Trying to face with an earnest feeling, he's immediately become interested in Hiyama. However, Oshima can't be honest with himself… Are they friends? Or lovers? Be that as it may, their relationship will change!!

title: Bara Sensou
description: Bored in class, a girl begins drawing BL. The girl sitting in front of her turns around, and then…!?

title: Your Color
description:
A love story centered around two men: one with a blushing disorder, and another with color-blindness to red. 

Struggling to overcome the insecurities around his uncontrollable flush, we follow the life of Ryouta who cannot get himself to convey his love to Narumiya.

title: Tsumasaki ni Kourozu
description:
From [MangaUpdates](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series.html?id=79231):  
  
1-3. **Tsumasaki ni Kourozu**  
Iwai Arata was recommended by his professor to work part-time under a rather eccentric mycologist, Murota. The mycologist seemed hard to approach at first. But slowly as he got used to Iwai's presence, he became friendlier in his own way, showing Iwai a whole new world and giving him guidance with life. Though every day was fun and exciting, a sense of unease began to creep into Iwai's heart (from Echochi Scans)  
  
4. **Lingering Light**  
Tsumasaki ni Kourozu - Extra  
  
5. **A Fish's Warmth**  
Hirotaka has a secret. When people fall asleep, he sees fishes swimming out of their bodies, wandering and playing, and going back when they awaken. But, the deeper one's secret is, the more solitary he becomes.  
  
6. **Excursion at Midnight**   
A Fish's Warmth - Extra  
  
7. **August, End of Summer**  
When Haruhiko's grandfather dies, he stays behind in the old house for the me

title: Lychee ☆ Light Club Collaboration
description:
Commemorating the 15th anniversary of the publication of "Litchi Hikari Club",
Furuya Usamaru x Yama Wayama, "Lychee" special collaboration book!
All 184 pages, many colors!

 ★ Furuya Usamaru's unpublished spin-off "Yumemil Ganpatch" (43P)
 Palm edition depicting Zera and Jaibo "Yumemil Black Rose" (4P)

★ Wayama Yama personally produced this before her debut, and its quality was highly praised by some.
 Wayama Edition "Lychee" Derivative Short Manga Collection

★ Many color illustrations of "Lychee" by Furuya and Wayama, which have not been included in the book yet.
 (Comes with two comment exchanges on each work)

★ Furuya x Wayama, the long-awaited first dialogue "Born under the same black star"

title: Our Youth
description: Jin Hyuk, a model student who only knows how to study, and Lim Heechan, who is at the center of the (social) class. Jin-hyuk is irritated by Heechan's group that only does stupid, reckless, and useless acts that ruin the mood in the class. He swore to keep ignoring them, but on his way home from school, he saw Hee-chan being beaten by his father... curiosity strikes him as he saw his bruised face. Can the relationship between the two, of different worlds, who seem unlikely to get along at all, get closer?

title: Fuyou Kareshi
description:
Suzuki, who works at a retail store for interior goods, is ordered to change stores. He was not successful at getting along with his boss at this new workplace, but he became familiar with the transport company's employee, Irie, who was always entering and leaving Suzuki's workplace. Often, after work, the two went drinking together.  
  
One day, when Suzuki was drinking with Irie, suddenly he was pushed down and told: "Be my sugar baby"…!?

title: Kaichou, Kannami-san ga Hen desu
description:
**A twin body-swapping BL!**
Seikain Academy is an institution for the children of the elite. Amongst its students are twins Ouri and Himeri, who differ from each other in every way imaginable. The eldest twin, Ouri, is a listless member of the soccer team, while his younger sister, Himeri, is on the honor roll and serves as an assistant to the student council. Suddenly, a twist of fate causes them to switch bodies. In order to switch back, Ouri must seduce Tsukasa Houdou—the student council president—while in his sister's body! Meanwhile, Himeri discovers her brother's secret crush...?

title: ALIEN STAGE - Ivan x Till Collection
description: This is a collection of Ivan × Till art logs, doujinshis, and illustrations from several talented artists of high quality.

title: Love and Baseball
description: Let onto the team, and then quickly sent back to the second string players… An unlucky man. Is Sakagou's season about to open?!

title: Let Dai
description:
Is this desire for freedom the very thing that entrapped us.  
  
Let Dai is a tragic tale of forbidden love and unforgivable betrayal. Set in a soulless neo-Seoul ruled by young punks and pleasure seekers, an amoral teenager named Dai is the living embodiment of the city's beauty and cruelty. As the leader of the vicious Furies gang, Dai seduces everyone who lays eyes on him, only to blind them to his own barbaric nature. When an honest schoolboy named Jaehee rescues a beautiful girl from being mugged by the Furies, he can't possibly realize how this brief encounter will plunge him into a downward spiral of unbridled passion and unfathomable pain. From his brutal gang initiation to an unspeakable act committed against his girlfriend, Jaehee wavers uncomfortably between revulsion and fascination. And in Dai he finds a tender, caring friend one moment and a heartless sociopath the next, awakening strange and unhealthy desires in Jaehee that he could never before have imagined.

title: Kemonotachi wa Wana no Naka
description:
As the only two boys in a class of an only-recently-co-ed school…  
  
The only natural thing to happen is that they should fall for each other, right?  
  
But of course, in such an environment one is bound to worry a bit.

title: Kokoro Kikai
description: "Are we all really alive?" Shinobu, a high school student, questions as he spends each day just passing the time away.

title: The Skeleton in the Closet
description:
There's a person I like, but it's a secret.  

**Warning: This manhua was dropped by the artist.**

title: Hajime to Masamune (to Oppai)
description: I want to rub breasts! Masamune, a high school boy who is curious about sex, is dying to touch boobs. However, when it comes to the boobs that are close at hand, it's only his childhood friend, Hajime's (another boy). That's okay! When Masamune tried touching it, it was hard, strong, and not fluffy at all. But? "Maybe I'm in love with Hajime-kun's (boobs)??" Blossoming love of two childhood friends over boobs!

title: Hikyoumono da to Waratte Kure
description:
"Want to try out a man's body?"  
  
Kakeru, a socially awkward exchange student. Yuudai, who is always the center of attention. And Ryou, Yuudai's childhood friend. Under other circumstances, these three would never have gotten along, but before they knew it, they'd become a group of best friends.  
  
However, when Ryou starts dating a girl, Kakeru finds out that Yuudai harbors feelings for Ryou. Kakeru, who has a secret crush on Yuudai, takes this as a chance to suggest the two become fuck buddies, so that he can teach Yuudai "how men love each other"…  
  
The consequences of this lie soon start to haunt Kakeru.

title: DistopiA: Mikansei na Sekai
description:
"Seriously, I'll finish you within three hours."   
  
That's what Kirishima Haru had in mind when he entered the virtual world of a dating sim. Haru's had it all since childhood: looks, charisma, good grades, athletic talent and girls – but in this virtual world, Haru would meet the only thing he wants and is unable to attain. At the edge of the incomplete world, the love story of a player and a NPC unfolds.

title: Torikago Syndrome
description: Ayase is an orphan who has been held by a mysterious man whom he has never seen. One day he transfers to an academy where there are no rules and where teachers cannot enter the students' dorms. Who is the real person who sets the rules within the academy?

title: Houkago no Ghost
description: Bị phạt vì thua trò chơi, Shinji buộc phải chụp ảnh trong phòng khoa học sau giờ học. Vì là một người rất ghét ma nên cậu vô cùng sợ hãi. Sau khi rụt rè đi vào phòng khoa học, cậu tìm thấy một hồn ma tên là Sagara. Sagara thích cậu và bảo cậu phải quay lại nếu không, cậu sẽ bị nguyền rủa. Đến phòng khoa học sau giờ học trở thành chuyện thường ngày cho đến một ngày, Sagara nói rằng cậu ấy sẽ biến mất và hôn Shinji.

title: Haikyu!! - Shisseishou Oikawa Tooru no Hanashi (Doujinshi)
description: Oikawa loses his voice and Iwaizumi eventually has to resort to desperate tactics to enable Oikawa to speak again.

title: Nánpèi Shēngcún Gōnglüè
description: Multiple transmigration locations versus multiple drop-dead handsome appearances. Qi Yan transmigrated after he died and is permanently locked by the system to return to various worlds as a different male supporting character each time to target a different male lead, all the while sabotaging the female lead. Despite experiencing multiple sources of seductions, he can effortlessly retain his loyalty to his one true love—but is that truly possible?

title: Kawaii Ano Ko to Futari de Date
description: A fun little comic about a cute girl I posted on Twitter (@cak221).

title: Yamete Kudasai, Koishii Desu
description: In the process of getting their respective childhood friends Sasano and Koga together, Sugiyama and Hibiya grow closer and feelings deepen into something perhaps more than friendship. Maintaining this ambiguous relationship, they enter their second year of high school, but something may change when a transfer student starts asking around for Sugiyama!

title: Koi Janai Kedo
description: Ever since he had sex with his childhood friend Shinonome, the uptight student council vice president, Yukimura, felt caught in a whirlwind. He found himself invaded by Shinonome in his own bedroom, in the library, everywhere…! Out of desperation, his only defense was to treat Shinonome coldly so as to keep his sanity intact. However, it only pushed Shinonome to go to new extremes…!! Will the headstrong, stubborn vice president finally come to terms with his feelings…!?

title: Kohitsuji Project
description: Kohitsuji Project is about a boy being accepted into a prestigious school not knowing he is the "sheep" that is meant to let the vampires learn that humans are not to be treated like food!

title: Rental Kareshi ni Hiru mo Yoru mo Moteasobaretemasu!?
description:
Yuu pretends he can't have a girlfriend because he has a secret he can't tell anyone - he likes boys. 
But before he gets busy studying for exams, he wants some dating experience! 
Yuu takes the plunge and applies for a rental boyfriend. On the day of the date, his rental boyfriend - Makoto, was surprised to see a boy and whispered: "I like your face." Yuu keeps getting distracted by his words and behaviors. 
It makes Yuu wonder... what's Makoto's real identity?

title: Saiaku na Futari no Hajimari wa
description: Hinami Takashi is always transferring schools because of his parents' jobs and he has gotten pretty bored of the attention. He uses the rumors about him to achieve his goal, which is to maintain his mediocre daily life and to quietly go on to the next school – until the rumors about his classmate Sakura make him take a special interest in him. It seems like Takashi isn't as ordinary as he pretends to be…

title: Utsukushii Tamashii
description:
Akane, top student, who can't make ends meet even with his part-time job.  
  
Hamuro, 2nd best, who uses his wealth to bring Akane under his thumb.

title: The Blurry Viewfinder
description: After an accident that made him unable to distinguish people's faces, the main character is shocked when he realises that he can see the new transfer student properly, and thinks he's found The One.

title: Tsuzuki wa Asa Made
description: Mikazuchi Dorm, a dormitory where male high school students reside, is led by its bright and popular dormitory captain, Amano, and his supportive helper, the vice dormitary captain Hanyuu. Amano always jokingly referred to Hanyuu as his "wife" – but this would only hurt Hanyuu, who held onto an unrequited love for Amano these past 3 years…

title: School Life
description: A love story of a struggling crush. Can Minho’s love be achieved?

title: Give Me Time Enough For a Love Song
description:
School life based story; Ning Yi & Lin Yiming  
  
weibo super topic (updates posted here too): <https://weibo.com/p/10080889a03c5e6d441fd208bd18d567d8efcc/>

title: Usotsuki wa Shinshi no Hajimari
description:
Do these two men have any redeeming qualities whatsoever? Quirky story with some questionable humor.  
  
Med school student Jonathan pockets psychotropic drugs from the university hospital and deals them to college students. But when he's inevitably discovered by his professor, Paul Thomas Haskins, Jonathan must give up his body in exchange for the professor's silence!

title: Samayou Maboroshi
description:
Kiyohito, the president of the student council, makes his way to the old building after school to investigate rumors of a ghost that haunts there.

There, he meets a mysterious long-haired man named Shichiro, who is both "Janitor" and "Son of the school's chairman" . The rumored ghost is a prank played by Shichiro to "bring back the Seven Wonders to the school"...! Kiyoto tries to stop the prank, but inadvertently ends up helping Shichiro!

The seven wonders of the school, the secret of his late brother, and his unspoken feelings...

A neo-occult BL with a touch of romance and a touch of horror!

title: Last Summer Sparkle
description:
Every day is more exciting when your best friend becomes your lover...!
Kyouhei is a third-year high school student whose future plan form is still blank.
Lately, Kyouhei has found himself preoccupied—all because his best friend, Eiji, confessed to him.
Ever since the entrance ceremony, they've been inseparable. But now, Kyouhei wonders—will Eiji's confession change everything between them? 
He can’t stop worrying about it, but before he knows it, his heart has already started pounding at the sight of Eiji whose cuteness he never noticed!

title: I Want to Know You
description: Kujou Akito, rich-smart-scary guy who's actually an otaku, is caught by his friend, Takaya Jin, buying an anime figure. The latter takes a picture and then demands that Akito be with him for 5 days, saying "I know about you more than you know about me".

title: Ore ga Suki tte Ittara Dou Suru?
description:
"Be the same reason I am. Everything you do to me."

High school boys Ippo and Tokio have been friends since elementary school. The distance between them, which was once so close they could carry each other on their backs, grew wider as time passed. This was to hide "certain feelings" Ippo has for Tokio. But one day, when he dozed off during class, the feelings he had been hiding started to overflow because of Tokio.

title: Kimi to Hamu Hamu shitai no da!
description: Kamiya, who loves small animals, discovers that Matsuyuki, a kendo rival from another school, can transform into a hamster...!?

title: Cute Winter Days
description: [KK Original Contribution Plan] Medical student Ji Dong and French student Xiao Feng are bamboo horses who grew up together. They make new friends after entering school. The friendship, family love, and daily life of these people

title: The Return Of The Prince
description: Satake Kou attended the wedding of his sister where he was reunited with his cousin, Fumihiro, who used to be a very dumb fat guy – but it seems that he has now transformed into a charismatic prince! Kou became undeniably self-conscious about this while not being aware of Fumihiro's high regards towards him since they were little. Fumihiro's admiration has turned into something complex. How would Kou respond to Fumihiro's feelings?

title: Complex
description: Junichi and Tatsuya are two childhood friends who just so happen to love each other. We explore each step of their lives, from grade school to the golden years, through the good times and the bad, revealing that a relationship between two men is nothing but complex.

title: Hoshi ni Ochiru Efude
description:
Ryousei and Shougo are two artists involved in a continuous and ambiguous sexual relationship. Shougo thought that claiming Ryousei as his own would alleviate the feelings of helplessness, regret and loneliness that are plaguing him. Ryousei, although captivated by Shuugo, began to realize that he was just being used.  
  
An opportunity eventually arrives for both Shougo and Ryousei to display their paintings at Shougo's elder brother's art exhibition in Tokyo. Shougo, who has had a complex about his elder brother ever since childhood, thought that "I may be able to return to Tokyo if this goes well", which gradually increased the pressure to succeed. Beneath the starry sky, a paint brush paints a story of youthful love.

title: Ousama ni Kiss!
description: On the outskirts of Tokyo, Toubuisazaki High School is known for its mottos of "Yakuza are your friends!" and "Seize the chief's weakness!" Amidst these scary rumors is the king of the school, high school student Maki: a person with an abrasive personality, who thinks of his classmates as servants. It's a mystery that Yoshifumi, the school nurse, loves him.

title: Kimi to Parade
description: Kikuchi woke up one fine morning to a message from his ex-girlfriend telling him that she was seeing someone else. Having to go to work after such a crappy experience, he was faced with his university friend Sera's boyfriend, Akaboshi, who also happened to be his adorable student. Usually Akaboshi is rather stoic and aloof, but in front of Sera, he just brimmed with so much happiness. Sadly, Sera harboured a secret that will threaten their relationship and poor Kikuchi, being Sera's good friend, knew about it. As a result, he is caught in between. It didn't help that Kikuchi's falling for his student too…

title: In A Heartbreak
description: After being heartbroken by his crush towards senior, he is immediately confessed love by another senior. Also, they are twins?! It is a tough love between two brothers towards one student.

title: Koi wa Genjitsushugi de Yumemigachi
description:
Two people who met through ivies.  
A relationship that started from a shared secret.  
A man who became the home tutor of a shut-in high-schooler.  
A teacher and student that chose to separate.  
  
Honest, inexperienced, and pure through and through –  
This is a collection of 4 of such love stories.

title: Tsuchi no Shita de Matsu
description: The Biology Club operates quietly in the old building of an all-boys high school. There gathers a group of teenagers with their romantic troubles and the resident talkative dog who looks over them. These are their slightly warped and naive love stories.

title: I'll Like You More Tomorrow
description: After being placed in a different class from his usual group of friends, all Do Jihwan wants is to spend an uneventful and quiet year in school. That plan goes down in shambles upon meeting one Kang Chanyoung, a popular and up-to-beat guy who has no qualms in saying what’s on his mind.

title: Haikei, Niisan-sama
description: Yutaka gets his yearly letter from his beloved older brother, but this summer something about it is different…

title: Interval
description:
Track team member Kashiwagi Ayumu has put aside his secret feelings for his classmate, Shinohara Takahito.  
  
One day, his track club senpai, Sawatari Atsushi, realizes Ayumu's feelings, and embraces Ayumu against his will in attempt to cure his own boredom.  
  
Sawatari seems cold hearted, but suddenly reveals a tenderness to the resisting Ayumu, however…?!

title: The Timekeeper's Final Summer
description:
“I will die this summer.” Eden is a member of the Timekeeper family, who possess the ability to travel back in time. Their date of death has been set since the day they were born… and the summer of 2018 is when Eden is destined to die. On that fateful day, , he decides to confess his feelings to his longtime crush. But Jay, who is straight and only cherishes Eden as a friend, is flustered by Eden’s confession and reacts badly. Caught up in his thoughts, Eden is met with a fatal accident—and thus his time travel begins. He finds himself on the last day of the high school summer camp training where he first met Jay. Given the opportunity, will Eden be able to change anything that happened on that day, 20 years ago?  
  
(Snow Flower Scans)

title: Knocked Up Boys
description: Hisui, a high school student with a reputation of being a womaniser, gets the surprise of his life when a baby is left at his doorstep. Could it be his? With no other family to speak of, Hisui can only rely on help from his childhood friend, but their relationship is a little… complicated.

title: Anata no Kotoba no Togirema wo.
description: High school seniors Akira and You are in different classes, but they have been close friends since they were kids. Akira knows there’s always been something strange about him that even he can’t understand, and it is that whenever he comes to treasure something, it soon disappears. Ever since he realized this, he has made sure not let himself get attached to anything. However, the day before graduation, something happens that puts Akira’s way of thinking to the test.

title: Yakozen
description:
Chie, Monji's childhood friend, is having troubles with the man she's in love with, as she deeply loves him but he's not really willing to reciprocate: he'll play around but won't get serious, and she breaks down crying because of it while Monji has to comfort her. After an outing with his three male friends, Monji is happy to leave with Chiba (who still seems somewhat disinterested). However, Chiba ends up steering Monji in the direction of a love hotel.  
  
There, Monji is uncomfortable and seems upset, and we learn that he had actually confessed his love to Chiba – but it's a similar situation to Chie, where Chiba doesn't seem like he's serious about wanting a relationship with Monji, but is willing to have sex with him.

title: Senpai no Mizugi
description: Honda is on the swim team while his high school senior, Momotani-senpai, acts as his private coach after quitting swimming. One night after they get drunk together, Honda finds Momotani wearing a woman's swimsuit, seducing him! How will Momotani react to his attraction to him, and will their friendship be affected?

title: Hey, you can forget about me.
description: Kazuki Hanaoka, a member of the light music club, and Kihito Hasegawa, ace of the soccer team and most popular guy in school. Despite being in the same class they had never spoken, until an accident reveals they share a love for the same band. This fateful encounter will change their lives forever, but just how long can a good thing last…?

title: Goshujinsama to wa Iwasemasen!
description: Matsuoka is a transfer student whose wish is to make 100 friends. He gets along with his classmates almost at once, and it all looks be smooth sailing, until he crosses paths with the school's most feared delinquent, Sougo! One thing leads to another and… Sougo ends up becoming Matsuoka's slave!?

title: Glasstaion Shoukougun
description: Class president Nijou is a talented athlete, popular honor student... and a total people-pleaser who can't stop living up to others' smothering expectations of him. When his teacher asks him to check on Toomi, a classmate who's stopped coming to school, that chance meeting leads to an unexpected connection that neither young man expects. Toomi sees right through his diligent facade, and Nijou can't forget the cool comfort of Toomi's undemanding touch. But when Nijou discovers the reason behind Toomi's frequent absences — that he's been working as an online cam "girl" — he doesn't know how to react. How can he bring up what he knows? And how will it change their relationship?

title: Keppeki Danshi Kouryakuhou
description:
Things are not as they seem when straight-A student Takumi finds himself tutoring class clown Sakura.  
Even though he senses that something is off, Takumi continues to help Sakura study until one fateful encounter changes everything…

title: Mizuiro no Machi Made
description:
"I'm going to transfer."  
  
Homare is a high school boy who loves both girls and boobs, and then there's Kazu, his cool childhood friend who spoils such an honor. Even though they went to school together every morning, Kazu's transfer had already been decided, but on the way home, he suddenly kissed me?!  
  
"I didn't want you to forget when I've moved."

title: Seishun Outsider
description:
<No matter how captivated you are, this cannot become love>  
  
“I like you.”  
  
After ranting about his recent break up, Hisashi received a confession from Kazuya.  
  
It slipped out of Kazuya's mouth by accident. Because of his mistake, Kazuya was frazzled and didn't want to know Hisashi's reply. He told Hisashi that he'd like them to remain good friends, and Hisashi agreed.  
  
But as Kazuya wants to express his affection towards Hisashi, and Hisashi considers getting back with his girlfriend, Kazuya slowly becomes more and more depressed each day…  
  
A heart wrenching love story between a student who doesn't know much about love x a pure-hearted delinquent.

title: Onna no Ko Kenkyuukai
description:
Yuuma Yamabuki has just moved to a new town where he meets Laira, a cross-dressing boy who asks for Yuuma's help. Yuuma must cross-dress to follow Laira back to his all-girl school where he meets the others in the Girl Research Society.  
  
(Source: MU)

title: A High School With Only Men
King wa Nakayoku Naritakunai
description: “On the contrary, I'm curious about my seniors" Shifuji Shido, who is good-looking and literary and martial arts, is a "king of the school" that is recognized by both himself and others. When I looked at the popular junior, Atsouto Okawa, for some reason he liked it――!? I'm swayed by younger handsome guys!

title: Oredake Minaito XX Shichauzo
description: Keiichi is good looking, yet he can't get a girlfriend and he worries about still being a virgin! However, the reason why he can't get a girlfriend is because his cute childhood friend Michiru is obsessed with him and has secretly been blocking any girl who goes near him!

title: The Story of Someone I Know
description:
[As soon as you want to reveal your secret, it turns to be a spell.]*  
  
There is a secret in every love.  
And sometimes you want to reveal that secret that you’ve been hiding deep inside your heart.  
  
When the long unrequited love becomes burdensome;  
When you wander between love and friendship;  
When you can't be sure of your feelings;  
When you don't have the courage to speak from your heart..  
People often reveal their secrets like this:   
  
"This is about someone I know…"  
  
The one at the end of a long unrequited love, Baek Jaehyun  
The one who started a new unrequited love, Cha Seungtae  
The one who loves without knowing what love is, Jung Woojin  
The one who doesn’t know it’s love, but still loves, Lee Seung  
  
I would like to ask you through a common, unrequited love, that you may have heard of at least once somewhere.   
  
What kind of secret love do you have?

title: Toraneko no Shitsukekata
description: The cute-faced but super strong delinquent, Kotarou, and the excellent, sports all-rounder honors student, Yamato. The two are seen as polar opposites, but they​'re actually in a lovey-dovey relationship. Seeing his beloved Yamato's nape and lips fills Kotarou's mind with "perverted thoughts". But when he's touched, he panics and throws a punch…?!

title: Ore dake ga Shitte iru
description: Although high-schooler Arima Shougo is actually terrified of anything related to the supernatural, he was forced to join his high school's "Occult Research Club" because he can see ghosts. A series of events leads him to a chance encounter with the ghost of Yoshizawa Takumi, a junior student who is rumored to have committed suicide. Arima helps fulfill Yoshizawa's only wish that keeps him lingering with regret. While doing so, Yoshizawa's kind and gentle personality underneath his calm and collected expression slowly captivates Arima. What will happen on the final day that Arima fulfills that wish completely...?

title: Houkago Guitar
description: Psycho Pandas: A oneshot about two teens hiding who they are from the rest of society, one perceived as a genius and the other perceived as a delinquent, and how their true selves come together.

title: Kare no Tokubetsu na Kare
description: Despite being good looking, all Hiraoka Tatsuya ever wanted was to lead a peaceful and ordinary life. However, his life turns upside down with the addition of a new student, Suruga Daichi, a famous actor. As the student council president, Tatsuya is assigned to look after him. What will happen to him now…?

title: Omi-sensei no Binetsu
description: Omi Tsukasa, who still holds a flame for his close friend and first love, Su-chan, becomes a new teacher assigned to his old school. There he spots Su-chan's doppelganger, a student named Sugimoto. Upon finding out that Sugimoto is Su-chan's nephew, Omi starts having an interest in him, much to the annoyance of his target of interest.

title: The Perfect Replacement
description:
My twin sister's been replaced!
My sister is perfect — so much so that she's been chosen as the hero of another world called Rowold. While she's off saving this new world, she's been replaced by Moomyung, an aloof Rowoldian. He's not the most convincing substitute, so I'm helping him out. But I'm learning from him too.

title: Tok, Tok
description: Jae Hyeok, who lost hope in dreams due to a certain event, finds his life sparkling with light again as he spends time with one of the seniors at his school club.

title: The Transfer Student Who Came Down to Earth
description: It's Christmas Eve. Failing to confess to Yuji Sunbae, Gyunwoo meets a boy dressed in a space suit who's fallen like a shooting star. It's been a month since he's taken care of the strange boy who has nowhere to go, and today is the day of the high school entrance ceremony! Gyunwoo is excited to hear that he's attending the same school as Yuji Sunbae, but a transfer student who looks ex.act.ly. like Yuji Sunbae appears in front of him…

title: Tenjite Koi to Iki
description: Một ngày nọ, trong dãy phòng học cũ của trường, giáo viên dạy cấp 3 Yoshitake tìm thấy một tờ báo xưa từ thập niên 60. Trên đó ghi tên Yosuke Haruoki, tác giả một truyện ngắn, và Mikumo Sakagami, nhân vật chính trong câu chuyện ấy. Sau một loạt những sự trùng hợp kỳ lạ, Yoshitake và Yahiro, đồng nghiệp của mình, bắt đầu có một linh cảm cực kỳ hoang đường: rằng Haruoki và Sakagami chính là kiếp trước của họ.

title: Koi Cha no Osahou
description:
Get ready for hot tea and hotter action in this tale of opposites attracting on the tatami mats. Poor Tokumaru Madoka is just a regular energetic guy that can't seem to go even five minutes without breaking something. One day, his hapless sister has had enough, and she forces him to join their high school's Tea Ceremony Club, hoping to instill a little discipline in her hopeless klutz of a brother.  
  
Tea Ceremony Club president Hasune Kazuma is Tokumaru's complete opposite. The tall, dark president is the pinnacle of restraint, having been taught from a young age how to uphold his family's traditions. The sophisticated president and his awkward pupil conceal a brewing attraction, but they can't avoid steaming each other up. Even full to the brim with passion, will the two of them be able to bridge their differences and get along with each other?

title: Koisuru Bicchi-kun
description: Sugiura-kun became an assistant for the manga artist he admired most, only to find out he is a complete slut. Being attacked every day in bed immediately after working, he must deal with the perverted and frustrating sensei. Despite this, Sugiura-kun finds himself thinking "maybe I like Sensei."

title: Saikyou Kyoushi
description:
Fujita is raising his elementary school son all by himself. His enemy is the stiff teacher, Ibuki, who is actually called a "dangerous type" and a feared retired Yankee! Ibuki's forceful and savage face as well as his sometimes gentle face, Fujita who is tossed around by the two faces is?!?  
  
The clumsy adult's real love is here. Yamato Nase's best book in history has finally arrived!!

title: Love And Trap
description:
1: Love & Trap  
After being bullied at elementary school, Mochida 'Maki' Masaki learns to use his own body to enchant and trap the most powerful person at school to protect him from potential bullies. However, a chance encounter sparks a complicated friendship with notorious classmate, Aihara Ryuuji, which soon changes Maki's life – and ultimately, his view of love.  
  
2: Love & Honey  
Maki begins to question the point of his relationship with Aihara.  
  
3: Love & Whip  
Maki discovers that Aihara's cousin, Aihara Kaede, has a thing for Aihara and a bit of contempt for Maki.  
  
4: Love Blood  
Sawaguchi Mirai takes a train to the countryside to get away from his own life, and unexpectedly finds love.  
  
5: Us, Blooming  
Now working at a flower shop, Murakami Takashi is very set on winning the heart of Sakurai Ryui, the beautiful object of his secret and burning love – but his pervy manager, Fujimori Haruhiko, keeps getting in his way.  
  
Extra: Let's Visit The Aihara House

title: Cinderella's Plot
description: Isn't Cinderella in the fairy tale who puts on high heels and becomes a princess? Why I'm a man, who just temporarily wore high heels for fun, became a princess also?

title: Ikujinashi no Kimi ni Sasageru
description: Hinata Karui and Seiji Matsuyama have been friends since childhood. When they were kids, Hinata loved Seiji innocently and affectionately, but one day he is attacked in a park by an unknown pervert. From then on, the relationship between the two changes drastically.

title: Chiku Bingo
description:
Kishiwada-kun is strong, feared by everyone and seems to have no weakness.  
WRONG.   
He actually has ULTRA SENSITIVE nipples!  
A game he played in his childhood, Nipple Bingo, which he played with his friend Andou, led to his condition.  
Now what will happen when Andou, the only one who knows about his weakness, comes back?

title: Aoi Haru yo Saraba!
description:
Tochimo began going out with the optimistic and spontaneous Yoshino. While their trivial day-to-day repeats itself, their problems increase by the day. “I want to stay with you.” “This is how I truly feel. This is how I truly feel, but…” “Someday, someday, I’ll have a ‘normal’ relationship with someone, get married and…” “I wonder if this won’t work out…” “I’m just thinking about the end.” While Tochimoto was feeling troubled, Yoshino suddenly appeared. “Hey, Tochimo… Let’s run away.” “...I wonder if this is ok.”
This is a story about their bittersweet youth.

title: Choose Wood and Dwell
description: Eight years ago, the innocent, rich heir Jiang Yumian pursued his tutor Qin Heng; eight years later, the roles are reversed. The nouveau rich Qin Heng reunites with his first love Yumian by chance. This time, he decides he will hold tight to him and not let go.

title: Sono Ki De Ite Yo
description:
The latest work from Yamada, creator of Tashiro-kun, Kimi tte Yatsu wa, featured in onBLUE vol.72, is finally available digitally!
A short but sweet 11-page high school BL story unfolds as class rep Nanoka gets roped into asking the stunning new transfer student, Ayami, a series of flirty questions at the insistence of his classmates. But when Nanoka finally works up the nerve, Ayami fixes him with an intense gaze and smirks—
"A class rep with that many piercings? That’s pretty willful, huh?"
A heart-throbbing love story between an unintentional flirt and an enchanting transfer student!

title: Are wa Senkou, Bokura no Shinjuu
description:
Shima Yuki, 15, attends a junior high school attached to a music college. His life, which had been all about piano, takes a dark turn, and he runs away from home on his bicycle on a winter night. He gets lost and is chased by a delinquent, where he encounters Miroku, a 25-year-old host who shines brightly in the night sky. He clings to the drunk Miroku and tumbles into his room, where he finds himself.

A heart-warming original novel woven by two people with their own problems and nowhere to go.

title: Natura-turaly
description:
1: Natura-turaly  
My twin brother and I, we like and dislike the same things. Whatever we do, we do together. I thought we'd always be together – it seemed obvious. But a man appeared, claiming to love my brother. Is the world I thought would go on forever starting to collapse?!  
  
2: Veranda Nite (On The Veranda)  
A boy moved to a new apartment but when he goes out on the veranda to smoke, he encounters something out of this world.  
  
3: Count 3632  
A boy is trapped in an elevator with a very unfriendly novelist.  
  
4: Step One  
Suichi does not like to socialize with people. Why does Hana keep finding excuses to talk to him?  
  
5: Test Play from Itai Ero  
A couple's relaxed routine is disrupted when the one partner proposes a new kind of play. To his surprise, his significant other discovers a higher affinity to his role than expected.  
  
6: Michidzure  
A boy who is easily roped into things meets a cool beauty who is a natural asshole.

title: Walking With You
description: Ken and Yuu are childhood friends. They have always been together: they went to the same kindergarden, the same elementary school, the same middle school and now the same high school. Ken is really good at soccer, but he's hiding something from Yuu. What is it?

title: One Reason Why He Hates Me
description: Seowoo is head over heals in love with Doyoung, except there seems to be a major problem… Doyoung hates him. After a love fairy visits Seowoo, he's given a chance to make Doyoung fall in love with him, but only on one condition- he needs to find out the one reason why he hates him.

title: Boku to Neko to Hatsukoi Kousa
description: Kirishima "Maa-chan" Masao and Kurokawa "Tai-chan" Taisuke have been friends since they were little, both looking out for each other – but when Maa-chan catches his friend being assaulted by a teacher, he can't help but blame himself for always thinking and never acting on his desire to protect his friend.

title: Forced Strategy 100%
description:
An accident forced two handsome schoolboys who originally disliked each other to bind together in a love game. Chi Che became a game player, while Cen Huang’s soul left his body to become a game system. In order to return back to normal, both player and system can only brace themselves and complete the rest of the game’s strategy missions. What’s outrageous is that the attack target is unexpectedly Cen Huang’s soulless body?! Thus, a straight guy helping another straight guy pursue his own dramatic love game has now begun…

A dangerous control freak senior who refuses to socialize x an optimistic talkative junior who lacks love.

description:
