title: Itoshii Akuma
description: Super handsome and charismatic Naruse Fuuta, who harbors feelings for honor student, Akiyoshi Tooru, advances to the same university. However, due to their different majors, they begin seeing less of each other. What happens when Akiyoshi becomes acquainted with Naruse’s old friend, Hiyama Chiaki, and goes along to his mixer party?

title: In Search Of The Twelve Golden Hairpins
description: Zhou Shen Ying, a celebrity chaser pawned away his late grandfather’s “twelve golden hairpins” to clear his debt. Yet a week later, an unexpected call forces him to reclaim back the sold hairpins. In order to retrieve back the pins from its new twelve male owners, should Ah Ying sacrifice “his body” or “his body”?

title: Goshujinsama ni Ki wo Tsukete
description:
When his twin sister breaks her leg, she forces Tsuda to substitute her at her secret job as "Ruu", a waitress in a maid cafe. Of course, on his first day, classmate Kaname shows up! But they're not close and Kaname has a hard time remembering people's faces…  


---

title: Oujisama no Seitai
description:
Collection of stories:  
  
1-3. The Prince's Lifestyle  
4. Your side even the stars don't know  
5. Twinkle Star's Troubles  
6. The Love Letter Murder Case

title: Sokuochi 2 Koma No Kaede-Kun♂
description: Manga 2 Koma About Kaede-kun and Ryuu's Fun and Funny Daily Life, And A Little Romance

title: Seishun Sanka!
description: Hoshiro, who had studied earnestly in order to impress girls with his brains, ended up in an all-boys high school! Now what? Well, it's off to the school's legendary wish-granting Tanuki Statue to pray for love! But what happens when his earnest wishes are overheard by the school idol?

title: Hate no Kouya de Bakansu o
description:
A collection of one shots: 

1. Futaribocchi no Ever After (ふたりぼっちのエバーアフター) (2019) 
A fairy tale about a mysterious young man and a child living deep in an enchanted forest. 

2. Kaeru no Ouji-sama (蛙の王子様) (2019) 
High school story loosely based on the Brothers Grimm's "The Frog Prince". 

3. Hate no Kouya de Vacances wo (果ての荒野でバカンスを) (2020) 
Shin, who is on a solo mission to cultivate a planet, regularly reports to engineer Rukiya, an engineer who remained on earth. 

4. End roll (エンドロール)

title: Kagerou ga Yureteiru
description: One day, a transfer student named Atami suddenly appeared in the countryside. Everyone is intrigued by the rare existence of a transfer student. He hurt his leg as a result of an accident and is still suffering from the after effects. He is sincere to everyone, and those around him have always cared for him. On the other hand, Kamonomiya, who is part of the track and field club, is a straightforward and obedient person who is unable to tell lies. For some reasson, he is the only person who can see the true feelings of Atami, who thinks the current situation is '' depressing.'' It has something to do with their past together... A boy who wants to run and a boy who can no longer run meet and are growing into adults. A story of friendship that sweeps through youth.

title: Te wo Tsunai de Koi wo
description:
Sekiya never really had any problems with his kyuudo club teammates. Until one day, he overhears fellow club mate Nagashima saying that he doesn't approve of Sekiya.  
  
Aggravated by it, neither of them can concentrate on archery practice, and so the cheerful club president Tatsumi-senpai tells them to become friends by holding hands on their way from school every day.

title: Dash!
description:
Akimoto has just started his high school career at Miya High and he is burning with enthusiasm. Not because he's in the springtime of his youth, or because he has his eyes set on some beautiful upperclassman; rather, Akimoto is overjoyed to finally be able to meet his long time Judo idol Saitou! Akimoto has watched Saitou ever since his middle school days, but the real Saitou isn't matching up to the Saitou of Akimoto's dreams. Foul-mouthed, with a bad attitude and a superiority complex, Saitou decided to use Akimoto's admiration against him and turn him into his slave.   
  
But Saitou has a deep, dark secret that he is hiding from his kouhai. Will Akimoto still look up to Saitou when it is revealed? Join Akimoto, Saitou and the rest of the Miya Judo team in this charming tale of high school love between senpai and kouhai.  


---

title: Saa Koi ni Ochitamae
description: Noboru seems to have rotten luck at school when it comes to girls, because they all have eyes only for Yuuki, the resident Prince Charming. Tall, dark, rich and handsome Yuuki seems to be the exact opposite of the poor, short and not very manly Noboru. Because Noboru is from a poor family, he had to work extra hard just to get into this prestigious Seihou Academy, which is mainly reserved for the rich and elites of society. Before admittance, it was a dream of Noburo's to hook up with one of the rich girls at Seihou Academy, but his plans seem to have gone awry, especially since all the girls seems to not pay him much attention while doting on Yuuki the most. But for some reason, why does this drop-dead gorgeous hunk, Yuuki, seem to want to get close to him?

title: Kiss mo Dekinakatta
description: Sagara, a student residing in Mikazuchi Dorm, has never had any problems finding a partner. After experiencing heartbreak for the first time, it was hard for him to stay at the dorm. As such, he ventures to his childhood friend Hibiki's dorm instead. But as Sagara realized that Hibiki looked like the vice dorm leader – the one who broke his heart – when he wears his glasses, he asked Hibiki to "comfort me" as a joke. To his surprise, Hibiki agrees. Drunk in Hibiki's erotic expressions, they have sex. After, Hibiki actually confesses to him, saying he's always loved him!?

title: I Like You
description: I moved to a new school to start a new life, but how'd I end up becoming the school top dog's boyfriend?!

title: Wild to Strawberry
description: It takes all of Yuusuke's courage to approach super cool and brash classmate Mukogawa. But with a casual "okay", Mukogawa agrees, and suddenly Yuusuke is being pulled along at Mukogawa's pace.

title: After The Work Is Finished
description:
The freshman Taeyong, who he met at the theater club, believes thoroughly in Korean superstitions (?) He creates unusual situations where he always gets entangled with Seonho.   
However Taeyong, who was trying to find marital compatibility through a fortune teller wrote Seonho’s name with red letters.

title: Shimapan of Destiny
description: A boy looks at an idol pic and becomes obsessed with the underwear she is wearing, his obsession leads to him discovering his fetish and new life style( Its a trap manga)

title: Hebikui Tori
description: Nijo accidentally witnessed two men have sex at night. The next day, he saw one of the men at his university, Chidori, and learns he is a member of the school staff! Nijo saw both Chidori's face during the day and at night and begins to grow infatuated with his two faces. Nijo starts talking to Chidori at his part-time job and noticed his sexy nature. He finds Chidori's smile intoxicating and can't help but want to see his other faces…

title: Yuri Danshi-kun
description: Listen to this. While we were at a Yakitori place talking about otaku stuff, we were blown into an alternate world. You may not believe what we are saying, but what is more unbelievable is that there are no girls in this world!! None! Nada! Zilch!!! Auuuugggghhhh! A bunch of good-looking dudes who like yuri: Kagome, Fuuga, Kamakura, Sakuragaoka, Ototachibana, Musashino, Hanadera. How are they going to live in a world full of only dudes!? It’s full-on survival of the fittest! Not! So it’s just your average unusual manga! Rest assured!

title: Sekai no Oto ga Shinai
description: Sennen is quite popular and yet he has nothing he could get himself into and had no experience of falling in love. This made Sennen annoyed with himself. One after school, he found Noiri in the music room, playing the piano and decided to learn the cello from him. It was just something that started from a whim but as they spend time together, Sennen fell for Noiri. But it seems, Noiri is hiding a secret…?

title: Rin!
description: Katsura, a second year in his high school's archery club, has a hard time controlling his nerves. His "secret weapon" is his brother's best friend and childhood buddy, Sou! One hug from Sou and Katsura's nerves are soothed to a peaceful calm. But he can't keep Sou around him forever. As he wonders how he'll survive without Sou's hugs, his friend Kouichi suddenly asks if he can be the one to save him, and kisses him! What now?!

title: Beyond Your Pheromones
description: During their heat, Alpha and Omegas will release their pheromones to attract each other and form a mark, but betas do not have pheromones. But the beating of the heart tells the body where it belongs; thus, everything becomes irrelevant, no matter our gender or pheromones.

title: Who the Devil Is
description: Jiao Xifan, the leader of an underground organisation was betrayed, prompting him to fake his own death. Assuming the guise of a student, he started to investigate events from over a decade ago to unravel the truth. Jiao Xifan's quest for truth takes an unexpected turn as he fell into a trap unbeknownst to him when he befriended his classmate, Xue Zhi.

title: Shishunki na Omaera no Muda na Doryoku
description: There's a new game in Bossa's class. The only objective is to make your opponent hard. Will Bossa be able to escape the game?

title: Tsuki ni Hoero
description:
1-2) Howl at the Moon  
Miki is the bodyguard of the super-model, Ran. He's also the only person who knows that the golden-eyed Ran is in fact a werewolf. Not only does Ran have an animalistic sex-drive, he's also inhumanly strong. “Then, why does he need me as his bodyguard?” Miki wondered… And then, Ran was stabbed by a fan while protecting Miki…  
  
3) Intoxicated by the Moon  
Luke, the owner of the modeling agency where Ran works, is also a werewolf. Madoka, his assistant/secretary is always walking in on Luke seducing women in his office… but when the full moon appears, Luke is always at Madoka's house… why!? The appearance of a young new model complicates things even further…  
  
4) LOST  
Every night, Ray relives the nightmare of shooting his detective partner Steve. Unable to sleep at night, he constantly needs sleeping pills to survive. His new partner, Brad, is tortured watching Ray growing more gaunt every day. When undercover FBI agents start showing up dead, Ray's night

title: High School Lala Love
description: "I've always dreamed of falling in love at an all-boys school!!" Right when Hinata finally gets accepted to a boys' school, his dad gets transferred overseas and Hinata's sent to live with a family friend. A little nervous, he heads to the address, only to find a guy who's just his type waiting at the door! A lovestruck Hinata forgets all his worries in an instant. Excited, Hinata starts fantasizing about all the ways things might go, getting very turned on. He can't help touching himself, and gets caught red-handed by the guy of his dreams! What will become of his life as a strapping young schoolboy!!?

title: Darenimo Iwanaide
description:
While taking a shortcut across campus to get to work, Shirahama Miharu interrupts a rendezvous between playboy Sumikawa Kaichi and his girlfriend, accidentally witnessing their breakup. Kaichi is not only unconcerned but he actually helps Miharu jump the locked gate so he can make it to work on time?!  
  
As Miharu thanks Kaichi, offering to repay him with lunch, he blurts out that Kaichi is always with different girls because he's too fickle. No one's ever been so candid to Kaichi before and the novelty and Miharu are fascinating. Is this the beginning of friendship or…?

title: Sugar Milk
description: For as long as we could remember, we have always been together. So it seemed only natural to assume this would last forever… but it might actually be by my fault that it all started to slip away…

title: Time of Rose-Colored Cheeks
description: Paul, a serious honor student, meets the violent and rebellious Andrew in their all-boys school. What follows is a story of the struggles of youth and of painful but powerful self-discovery.

title: Nitamonodoushi no
description: It began with a mistake. When Tanaka and Nakata are given each other’s papers back, they come to a horrible realization... They have almost identical names. And test results. And body types. And taste in fashion. And sports scores. And hobbies. The list goes on, and as annoying as it is, at least they know they always have each other. And maybe, just maybe, their similarities run even deeper.

title: Summer Scent
description: It was just another ordinary day for Choi Hahyun, who was on his way home, when suddenly a strange boy appears! The love story of one man and one soul.

title: Senpai, Ore ja Dame desu ka?
Unbalance na Netsu
description: When Ryuu Kagaya tries to befriend the boy seated next to him, honor student Yoshito Naruse, he is promptly shot down. Only after Yoshito visits Ryuu's workplace does he think they might become friends. However, Yoshito's brother might have something to say about that…

title: Tomodachi Hitori Dekirukana
description: As a member of the discipline committee, Akira makes a round of the school every day after class. Even though he'd planned on going home after a quick check, his finding Mitsuru, another second year, coming out of an unused room completely changes his life. Learning that, out of boredom, Mitsuru calls other students to empty classrooms after school to do naughty things, Akira warns him to stop before he ends up getting in trouble. But not only does Mitsuru not heed his warning, he gets even wilder… Can this naughty and twisted friendship develop into something more?

title: Kare to Kare no Ijiwaru na Kyori
description:
Moriya Shigeru's hobbies include reading BL and cross-dressing. He's a twisted guy who loves to harass others. However, there's one guy he's been feeling bothered about: Sahara Masatoshi, an idiot who clings to his one-sided love for his childhood friend.  
  
Shigeru, who can't help but feel excited about the prospect of teasing Masatoshi, gives Masatoshi a blowjob to harass him, but Masatoshi looks at him as if he despises him?

title: CUT
description: Chiaki Sakaguchi is a highly sociable and popular high school senior who has a dark secret in his heart. Chiaki is not at all acting like himself. In fact, he recently skipped his college entrance exams. Is Chiaki's classmate the only one who may be able to unveil the unholy perversion that has secretly crept into Chiaki's life?

title: Junjou Escape
description: Aki Kitagawa was outed as being gay by his best friend in middle school, after which he moved away to get a fresh start. Since Aki began attending high school, he desperately tried to hide this secret from everyone. However, one of the students at his school, Yoshida Koutarou, discovered his past and forced him to become friends with benefits.

title: Haikyuu!! - Hatsukoi Combat (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

title: November Gymnasium
description:
A compilation of early one-shots by Moto Hagio. Includes the famous "November Gymnasium" as the leading one-shot.

Contains:

- **November Gymnasium** (11月のギムナジウム, 11-gatsu no Gymnasium) - Serialized in Bessatsu ShoComi in the November 1971 Issue
Description:
When a tough, rebellious Eric arrives at a German boarding school, there is one fellow student he hates: Thoma. Thoma bears a striking resemblance to Eric, but is gentle, delicate, and idolized by his classmates. 

- **Snow Child** (雪の子) - Serialized in Bessatsu ShoComi's March 1971 Issue

- **The Home Where the Tower Is** (塔のある家); ShoComi 1971 Issue #12

- **The Girl Who became a White Bird** (白い鳥になった少女) - Serialized in Bessatsu ShoComi's December 1971 Issue

- **The Flute of the White Boy in the White Forest** (白き森白き少年の笛) - Serialized in ShoComi 1971 Issue #45 - 
**Note: Included in the French Moto Hagio Anthologie De la rêverie under the name ''Le petit flûtiste de la forêt blanche''**

- **Bianca** (ビアンカ); Serialized in Weekly

title: Mobile Sweet Honey
description: Yui is an engineer major with no girlfriend. He also hasn't fallen for anyone because he gained a texting pal named Miki – through a misdirected text message – whom he now talks to regularly.

title: Sora o Daite Oyasumi
description: On the school rooftop rumored to be haunted by the ghosts of twins, Shuji Yashiro meets Roku Ichinose, a popular boy Shuji always thought of as belonging to a completely different social world. Unable to take his eyes off Roku's face, Shuji takes his picture on impulse. The following day, while organizing old photos in the clubroom, Shuji finds a shocking photograph that unexpectedly brings his world a little closer to Ichinose's…

title: Don't Leave After School
description:
In order to repay a favor, Yu Le ended up being a scapegoat, severely insulting the school idol Gu Yan.  
Gu Yan has been glaring at him, from the beginning of class, all the way till the day's end.  
In order to get his "revenge", Gu Yan kept finding trouble with Yu Le.   
Originally, it was just to teach Yu Le a lesson, but who could have expected the "revenge" would actually change. Gu Yan felt that Yu Le was gradually pleasing to the eye, making it harder to make a move…

title: Planetary Eyes
description: The arrogant and cold Yu Xingji, the leader of the Twelve constellation deities, traded his memories in exchange for reincarnating a thousand times in order to find his true love. During his 1001st reincarnation, he's reborn into the life of a college professor, where he meets Qin Ling, an aloof young man in possession of strange spiritual powers. When a strange event suddenly happens on the school campus, Yu Xingji couldn’t help but find himself standing in front of Qin Ling to protect him during the most critical moment!While the relentless reincarnation cycles may have erased the memories and appearance of his lover, only the emotions carved in his bones and engraved in the heart will guide them to reunite once again.

title: Nandaka Ii Nioi
description:
1-3) Somehow Good Smell  
Konishi's colleague Nagumo is a first rate slob, unable to keep himself or his surroundings clean at all. But for some inexplicable reason, the scent of Nagumo's body makes Konishi feel relaxed and safe. Is it just a scent fetish or…?  
  
4-5) Not Loveiy*  
Michiya is always getting in fights at school because he wants to get stronger to protect his beloved neighbor Natsuki. Natsuki has suffered from asthma attacks since Michiya was little, but now he's an elite saleryman…  
  
  
*lol this isn't a typo, this is the English title that the mangaka wrote

title: Hito wa Sore o Koi to Yobu
description: His cute appearance always brings trouble to Tominaga Jun. The moment he enrolled in an all-boys high school, he got confessed to by classmates and upperclassmen alike. The manly Jun, whose appearance is totally the opposite of his character, bluntly rejects all the confessions, sometimes having to resort to his fists to make himself understood… but he eventually begins to feel something for the student council president, Sakuma…

title: Sweet Monster
description: They're called Monsters: people with the power to assume animal forms, kept segregated from the rest of society. When he was young, Riku befriended a Monster boy named Tsukasa, only to be separated from him. Now, at an academy for Monsters, Riku has finally found his childhood friend. But can he overcome the distrust of his more-than-human classmates and reconnect with Tsukasa? And will their adult relationship be as close as their childhood friendship…or even closer?

title: Immoral Curriculum
description:
"Is it true that you're having an affair with him…?"  
  
"The professor's lover…"   
  
Kashima, a university student belonging to the faculty of pharmacy, was assigned to a laboratory with the rumored assistant professor, Ayakawa.  
Kashima's interested in the elegant Ayakawa, but when trying to make advances on him, he's treated coldly.  
  
However, Kashima witnessed by chance the professor and Ayakawa kissing in secret, confirming the rumor is true.  
  
Since then, he can't help but want to know more about Ayakawa…  
While thinking that way, he was called by the professor to a certain data room and for some reason, Ayakawa is there…?  
  
Also contains the one shot *Yasashii Naraku* from [Maou Uke BL](https://mangadex.org/title/24425/maou-uke-bl).

title: 1 Milky Way Street
description:
Milky Way Village is a charming, rustic town where the Milky Way galaxy illuminates the night sky. At its heart stands Night Compass, a cozy doll shop run by Baek Young-ha and his family. While Young-ha is passionate about creating and repairing dolls, his skills aren’t as refined as his parents’. Still, he’s determined not to let that stop him from pursuing his dream of sharing the joy of handmade dolls with the world - starting with his own community. Welcome to the Milky Way High Doll Club, where Young-ha and his friends navigate the rough patches of youth, one stitch at a time!

---

title: Ameiro no Toge
description: The story of a quiet, sensitive high-school guy who enjoys painting, and his complicated feelings.

title: HEN - Suzuki & Satou
description:
Ichiro Suzuki, a straight young man who becomes besotted with another guy, Yuki Sato, convinced his bishounen love is a girl trapped in a boy's body. Interestingly, author Hiroya Oku is one of the characters in the story, the best friend of Sato.  
  
The first three volumes of this series collect Oku's early short stories, including prototype versions of both Hen series.

----

* [Hen (1993)](https://mangadex.org/title/eb89077b-78fb-4404-a6d7-a70200f663a3/hen-suzuki-kun-to-sato-kun-no-baai) - Suzuki & Sato
* [HEN (1997)](https://mangadex.org/title/91bbcc02-bc0f-4492-bf5d-e42cfe03dfe5/hen) - Chizuru & Azumi

title: Nani mo Iwanai
description: A collection of oneshots with a unique spin on some typical BL tropes.

title: Critical Lovers
description: Mizuno Chihiro is unable to control his urges and becomes erect very easily. Because of his constant tardiness, he was sent to participate in the re-development system together with two other problematic senpai: Takatou Shinobu and Kandori Akira. Sharing a room with Takatou, Mizuno became erect when he helped Takatou, a manga artist, with his smutty works. Takatou tried his best to help Mizuno, falling in love with Mizuno along the way. However, he refuses to admit his own feelings, hurting Mizuno in the process. What should Mizuno do?

title: Midnight Make Love
description:
*Collection of stories:*  
  
*1. Sleeping forest Vampire*  
A bunch of vampires sleep in their coffins at one place in an enchanted forest. Alexander's sleep got disturbed by Miharu, who keeps getting into his coffin when he's drunk. What will become of the two of them tonight?  
  
*2.Help me, Alice!*  
Kazushi is sorting his things before going to university. Suddenly, he finds his favorite book "Alice in Wonderland" and falls asleep while reading it. He dreamt about the scenario from the book and meet the Rabbit, who proposes him something kids shouldn't read about.  
  
*3. Sasakawa-kun's lucky item*  
Sasakawa Yukinari, despite his name, keeps getting into dangerous accidents. Upon finding Fortune Club Card, he decides to take his future in his hands and follow the fortune teller's advice. But why do his lucky items must always be so embarrassing?  
  
*4. Fall from grace ~From the world you fell~*  
A member of popular idol group "Sirius" created a scandal. As punishment, he had

title: Gakuen Heaven
description:
Keita Itou—a boy with no special qualities other than superb luck—suddenly receives an acceptance letter from the renowned all-boys Bell Liberty Academy (a.k.a. BL Academy). Attracted by the school’s prestige, he decides to attend. However, on the day of his transfer, he gets into a freakish traffic accident. Luckily, no one is injured…but the incident arouses the attention of both the Student Council’s president, Tetsuya Niwa (a.k.a. the king), as well as the head of the Budget Council, Kaoru Saiyonji (a.k.a. the queen).  
  
Keita works to discover the reasons behind his invitation to such a remarkable school, struggles to find his niche among such brilliant and beautiful young men, and attempts to win the school-wide contest that will grant his wish of permanent placement at BL Academy! Along the way, he develops intense relationships with the rest of the hunky characters: clever Naruse, the captain of the tennis club; pensive Shinomiya, the captain of the archery club; sensitive Iw

title: Houyou Jikken
description: Takahashi Miya is sick and in need of regular check-ups. At university, he comes across Kanou Rei. Rumor has it that he is part of a dangerous club that distributes drugs and organises sex orgies. Is this true? And why does Rei seem to know Miya?

title: First Love Makeover Log
description:
Haejin and Kihyuk met at the same Taekwondo dojang when they were young. At one time, the two had been quite close, but as they went their respective paths in life, they became more distant, no better than strangers now.

In truth, from the days they went to taekwondo together, and even now, Haejin had always looked up to Kihyuk. And finally at the start of the 1st year of high school, the two reunite, now attending the same school, in the same class. However, his anticipation is hopelessly shattered when Kihyuk appears, looking by all means like a total trainwreck.

Still Haejin's feelings for Kihyuk refuses to fade, rather sparking his obsessive and control-freak side. Haejin vows to restore the object of his admiration to his former glory. So begins the inexplicable crackdown - Haejin's great Kihyuk makeover project.

title: Houkago, 2-C no Kyoushitsu de.
description: It's the third in Araragi's yandere trap series after Hatsukoi Lovers and Onii-chan Complex. In it, Yuuto Sasaki is a trap who forces his homeroom teacher Sasaki Tsukimori to spend some quality time after school, which usually entails Sasaki playing a domineering role over Tsukimori.

title: Count Love
description: After an accident, Agatsuma discovers that he can see numbers above people's heads – numbers that indicate the number of lies the person has told. Due to this, he finds it hard to trust anyone. Until one day, he comes across someone with a perfect 0!

title: Countdown to Love
description:
If only I could be the one to reach you...
After an ankle injury dashes Hoon's hopes of becoming a basketball star, he begins to see a timer in the sky. He believes it’s a countdown to the day he dies, until he discovers one day that his classmate Haedam can see it too...

title: The Polaris
description: On a pitch-black night, corporate wage slave Qi Yan sees his first love — the one that had passed 10 years before. After quite a bit of pestering and persuasion, he finds himself forced into the miserable lifestyle of working during the day and investigating at the night. The topic of the investigation? Finding out who the culprit is. Can the top who had passed years before successfully manage to be resurrected?

title: Ai ga Love Shite You Nano sa
description: Oono, a member of the school's disciplinary committee, is unable to perform his uniform inspection duties because his adoration for Takeuchi distracts him. Takeuchi mistakes this for Oono hating him and is sad at the idea of being disliked by the model student. Thus, Takeuchi is relieved and willing to reciprocate when he finds out that it isn't hate but instead love that makes Oono so very awkward around Takeuchi.

title: Koi ni Naru Mae ni
description: The romance with the students is not permitted. What should have been decided? I, however, why I have not renounced?

title: Baby★I Love You
description: After sensing Hirasaka's hidden rejection and anger, the younger brother Akio sets his sights on making the rejected coworker Akio's "bride." Just wait until Papa finds out!

title: Law of First Love
description:
“Can I sit next to you?”

As one lives, there are these moments in life… Where suddenly, the world feels like a coming-of-age romance painted in pastel hues, when the sunlight shines through the leaves of trees, and everything starts to sparkle. When you're slowly drifting through water... As well as when someone, in particular, starts to shine brighter than the rest.

People who haven’t experienced this won’t know… That when one falls in love at first sight, new opportunities raise without notice. So, this is our story about our first love.

Witness Haejun, Yoon, and Chanwook’s story about their first love through a webtoon.

title: Cello Mellow
description:
1: Her Carriage  
Everyday, Kouta comes to pick up his best friend Aya on his bike. Aya is in love with Kouta, but Kouta is looking for a girlfriend. Will Aya ever be able to tell Kouta how he feels?  
  
2: Make-Believe Brothers  
Yuuta and Tomo are neighbors and childhood friends. The simple Tomo is always smiling and always persistently invites Yuuta to go out and do things with him, even though Yuuta always turns him down. Yet, that simplicity also seems courageous to Yuuta. Will one bike ride change everything between these two…?  
  
3: After-School Strawberry Flavor  
After finding candy in his desk for a few days, Tsuduru decides to leave something for the other person who uses the desk. When the candy remains untouched, Tsuduru writes a note on the desktop. One evening, while running errands for a teacher, Tsuduru meets his mysterious desk-mate Keigo. Tsuduru and Keigo continue to converse through notes on the desktop, but what is the significance of the strawberry-flavored ca

title: Interval Zero
description: General Course Student Kadokura spends his days stressfully looking after the Sports Course students who live in his house, at his father's (their coach) behest. Although he doesn't get along with the Athletics ace Kima, after a meaningful conversation one night, he kisses Kadokura.

title: Ushirogawa Kara Koigokoro
description: Stranglely, Naoki can't stop thinking about his classmate's broad back…

title: Poyopoyo ni Sawaritai!
description:
The story of a Yankee trying to touch a chubby high school boy's belly. 

---
Note:This is the electronic version of the doujinshi published at COMITIA149. Total pages: 54

title: Itoshi no Mirai-kun
description: Shin Mirai, no matter how many people you have encountered, you will still end up with the one who, no matter what, will never betray you.

title: Tonari de Hanasaku Oto ga Shita
description: Love. It comes all of a sudden, even to delinquents. A pint-sized punk is fascinated by the earnestness of the black-haired, pessimistic committee chairman; two punks start going out only as a defiance to everyday monotony; two boys cut classes at their usual spot, the rooftop, where they end up having an adult relationship.

title: I'm Telling The Teacher
description: Lu Bei, the delinquent big brother who dominates the entire district, suddenly declares that he wants to be a good student! Carrying the "Student Rulebook" like a Bible everyday, swearing not to get into fights again. When the Boss of a rival gang came to seek trouble, Lu Bei couldn't bear it and finally... goes to tell the teacher?! At the same time, 700 points scorer Ye Siya transferred to this delinquent school to continue his studies. Getting preferential treatment from the principal and teacher, this perfect student, however, always speaks bluntly. In the end, Lu-ge, the only one with most courage took the initiative: hey, Ye Beicui classmate, teach me how to study? Transferred Student: Let go. My name is Ye Siya, not Ye Beicui.

title: Haikyuu!! - Usotsuki Canon (Doujinshi)
description: Hinata blurts out a confession–but is soundly rejected. When he realizes why Kageyama rejected him, though, he quickly takes it back to avoid hurting Kageyama, convincing him it was a misunderstanding. Both Hinata and Kageyama are caught up in lies, to themselves and others.

title: The Red Thread
description:
When Dean, the captain of the swimming club, takes the podium during Pharm’s university orientation, something unusual happens. Though the two have never met before, they’re unable to hide the turmoil that suddenly wells up inside them as they can’t help but feel that this isn’t the first time they’ve laid eyes on each other. Perhaps the red thread of fate links them together from their past lives...

**Note**:
This is the manga adaptation of the Thai novel "*The Red Thread*" and it's drama adaptation "*Until We Meet Again*".

title: Fuuki no Okite
description: On the first day of high school, because of a conditioned response, Kunie Hokuto injured Yachigusa Shissa, the disciplinary committee chairman feared by students throughout the school. He listens to Shissa's remarks and agrees to be appointed to stay with him as his servant, in compensation for the injury. In addition, without knowing why, he is designated as a first-year representative to the disciplinary committee, but the disciplinary committee vice-chairman, Shissa's younger brother, Zento, declares: "I do not approve"…!?

title: Chinko no Tsubuyaki
description: While on a high school field trip, a school bus crashes into the shrine of a penis God. This serves as the catalyst for a group of four high school boys to switch penises with each other.

title: Renai Game
description: Very determined Kaji decides to become an apprentice shoemaker with rumored is the best in the field. Mao accepts it after verifying the sincerity in Kaji's words regarding his intention of wanting to learn. Mao shows your "castle" in making the shoe making, there Kaji gets his first kiss under the context of "If you stay here you have to do the work of an adult."

title: Eccentric Hobby
description: One day, high school student Nagakura (normal dude) receives a love letter. Heading to the promised tree, the one who was waiting for him is Nishioka (super otaku) …dressed in a sailor girl uniform!! Super eccentric "campus love" comedy in 4-panel comics~

title: Omae Allergy
description: Kanou Hiroto, a high school student, experienced sexual harassment as a child, which led him to develop an allergy to men. Due to this, he isolated himself from guys until he met Ohshiro Kei, who approached him without knowing about his condition. Ultimately, Kanou struggles as Ohshiro relentlessly pursues after him. Will Kanou accept this twist of fate?

title: Moshi Moshi, Kame-San.
description: Career, dreams, the future... Kameyama decided to skip this pointless discussion and headed to the rooftop to escape from the approaching reality. There he meets the boy "Rabbit", who he has never seen in school before and somehow doesn’t even own a phone!? Who is this handsome stranger?... A tear-jerking one shot about the threshold to adult life.

title: Liànliàn Xiǎo Tián Gěng
description: Odinary university student Lin Xian and the campus' Prince Charming Yan Yu Sen are of two different worlds that will never collide, yet one day, they met each other unknowingly. Until an unexpected encounter, Lin Xian found out that this so-called Prince Charming had another side that no one ever knew about. Just which side is his true-self? Lin Xian's originally undisturbed campus life has begun...

title: Toshokan no Yokai
description: Hashimoto, the librarian, has a little kamaitachi on his shoulder that’s been causing havoc in his life. Now, he has to reign his emotions in before the power he inherited from the demon hurts someone he has affections for!

title: Hide Your Heart
description:
Behind every beautiful young man out there, there's always a bad experience in love that they've gone through and want to hide. So what kind of stories do they have?  
  
Chapter 1-89  
After Xiaomin Fan's family went bankrupt,he had to come back to from England to study at a local private school, but he didn't expect to find Lin Yin,who seems to have forgotten everything that Fan did to him when they were little…

title: My Dear Fluffy Fox
description: Naturally attractive human child vs arrogant and innocent nine-tailed fox! When a human is studying in a school full of monsters, it is like a sheep falling into a wolf's den, weak and helpless? No no, the cute character Wei Zhi said, can brush the furry hairy every day, it's not that bad~ but he actually stroked the bully nine-tailed fox and brought him back home? Duan Jingtang explodes: Let go of my tail Wei Zhi!

title: Yorimichi
description: A sweet, sincere story about a developing high school love.

title: More Than Just "Like"
description: An Shen, who is constantly ridiculed for his weight and has always been looked upon as inferior, secretly likes one of his cold, mysterious seniors. However, what An Shen doesn't know is that this male student has secretly been observing him as well. Between these two, could it be more than just simply "liking"?

title: Boku no Kawaii Stalker
description:
Ikeda, high school student, is the stalker of a nice, easy-going guy named Aizawa Kentaru…  
  
Aizawa's things suddenly started disappearing one day. He informed his friends of this, only to find out later that all his things were taken by Ikeda who clumsily claimed to be his stalker and asked his permission to be appointed as his "official stalker". Will Aizawa accept Ikeda's offer?

title: Sayonara Note
description:
"Taku-chan is my hero."  
  
The cheerful and caring Takumasa and the quiet Ken: there's a deep reason why these two started exchanging diaries, although it may seem childish. They've been doing it for five years and now it has become their special daily routine, which connects them to each other. That's why they should've known everything about each other… but Takumasa is surprised to hear from his classmate that Ken's in love!  
  
*There is an extra about another couple that is still untranslated.

title: Haikyuu!! - Insensible Fight (Doujinshi)
description: The entire team knows that Hinata and Kageyama are dating. Except for Hinata and Kageyama.

title: Reizouko no Naka wa Karappo
description: Shimizu, a spoilt rich high school boy, leaves his home to become a comic artist and ends up rooming with his friend, Umeya. Umeya is so poor that he's got nothing in his fridge except mayonnaise to eat with the rice!

title: Haikyuu!! - Hyakuman Kai Ai wo Sakebe (Doujinshi)
description: Iwaizumi Hajime x Oikawa Tooru

title: Inu mo Kuwanai
description:
Utsugi is an investigator working for a detective agency. When he's asked to track the wife of a college professor, Yamashiro, he discovers that she's cheating on him with another professor from the same university named Okuzono Shuji.  
  
This isn't the first time this has happened: Okuzono has stolen away the women Yamashiro loves countless times before. These intellectuals are embroiled in a twisted and convoluted relationship, and now this young investigator finds himself thrown into the mix.

title: Suki Dakara Kisushita no?
description: It happened on a sunny day right before summer: Fujisawa Souta's first kiss. It was with his older classmate, Ayase Chihiro. It's now their summer vacation, and yet, nothing has happened between the two of them! What's worse? Fujisawa discovers that he wasn't actually Ayase's first kiss, and now regrets kissing him.

title: Kedamono Kareshi!
description: Tada's friend Enami is a very popular, perfect, good-looking guy among guys and girls alike. Tada, who admired him, found out that Enami's actually a very selfish, pushy person who refers to himself as "Ore-sama…!!!" What is Enami's real intention, showing his beastly side to Tada and expressing his lust without any concern for the place they're at?!

title: Wakaba no - Shounenki
description: Cool, friendly Mariya is the undisputed king of his year! But why does he always hang around with shy and painfully awkward "Mr. Mannequin" Nachi? Can these boys withstand the non-stop judgment of a school filled with jealous rivals and confused classmates? A New Season of Young Leaves follows every sweet high and lonely low in the growing relationship of unlikely best friends. How will the most popular guy in class deal when his wallflower confidant suddenly steals the social spotlight…and a beautiful girl's affection?

title: Dress Him Up
description: Yeonwoo's plaid sense of style is a lost cause, but a Stylist for Hire ad just might save his social and romantic life. Designer Jaehee starts the makeover project of a lifetime, but can he transform this walking fashion no-no into a runway model for the graduation show —without falling for his handsome charms?!

title: Daybreak
description: Marcus has a crush, and Cog is completely unprepared for the hijinks that follow. Hopefully in their efforts to grow closer, they can brighten each other's day.

title: We Are Not Friends
description: Originally these two men who meets up always end up fighting, fated never to be friends, what kind of relationship would this start? A cold and proud elite young master faced with a radical rebellious teenager

title: Senpai
description: Fujinami Kou is a high school second year who has lost his boyfriend, an upperclassman schoolmate, to a car accident in the previous year. On the anniversary of Misumi-senpai's death, Kou is dispirited and contemplating skipping school. Kakitsubata Saki, a first year student, sees him and offers help, assuming that he's ill. As Kou startles at the sight of Saki's face and mentions that he resembles "the person I used to go out with", the younger boy is instantly intrigued and resolves to discover his sorrowful, introverted upperclassman's secret.

title: Gunjou no kageri
description:
The Joushin High School rowing club is small in number, but full of enthusiasm.
New freshmen have joined the club, and the members are enthusiastic about the competition.
The presence of a boy causes a change in the club...

title: Shiro no Koro
description: Fuji moved to the countryside from the city. There he met Daichi. It was their youth, the time when both were still white. One with innocent love and kisses, another not aware of what first love feels like. The distance between city and countryside seems to be the same as the distance between the two of them. Will they be able to overcome the hardship?

title: Little Butterfly
description: Kojima seeks to befriend the class outcast and soon learns of Nakahara's troubled family life – of his uncaring, abusive father and mentally unstable mother. As Kojima yearns to somehow comfort Nakahara, he gradually becomes aware that his feelings for the other boy arise from more than mere sympathy. When Nakahara declares his own romantic feelings for Kojima, their relationship becomes one of sexual exploration as they face their first steps into adulthood together.

title: Riesgo en zona de trabajo
description:
"Esta tarea final del semestre es una tarea de equipo"  
Cho Chan-hee, quien es un estudiante que regresa y no puede llevarse bien con la gente debido a su personalidad tímida, debe tomar la inicativa de encontrar un compañero de equipo, lo cual le preocupa.  
Mientras suspira y mira a su alrededor, encuentra a Lee Juwon rodeado de mucha gente, y siente una profunda envidia. Sin embargo, una vez terminada la conferencia, Chan-hee inesperadamente se le acerca primero y le propone trabajar en un proyecto en equipo…  
¿Cómo se volvió peligrosa esta tarea en equipo, mil, diez mil?

title: Kisu Yori Yasashiku
description: Chihiro Ayase and Sota Fujisawa are lovers. They like each other, kiss each other, and touch each other often. When they decide they want to experience something better, they find that the reality is that sex isn’t as easy as it seems. Chihiro and Sota are scared to go further, and they’ve even been interrupted during their attempts! But even though some obstacles stand in the way of their goal, they still share the same love.

title: Kakugo wo Kimete
description: Tetsu is the son of a Yakuza boss who yearns for a 'sweet love ', and meets his exact type of man, Senou. Senou, however, makes a living by scamming people and in turn, he attempts to force Tetsu into making an adult video. A strong couple appears: "A no need to hold back" kind of chivalrous love!

title: Empty Heart
description: Jun's unspoken love for Ryuuta is a secret to everyone – except Ryuuta's little brother, Takumi, who would love to have Jun to himself. Now in high school, Takumi is student while Jun is teacher, and Ryuuta is moving on with his life. Takumi offers himself to Jun as a substitute for his brother, but will it be enough to fill their empty hearts?

title: This Fluffy Love
description: There are delinquents in every school. Ashen is one of them. To make it worse, his father is a powerful politician, meaning he can get away with basically anything. To Sarith, who just wants to lead a peaceful school life, Ashen is someone that should be avoided at all costs. But what happens when they’re forced into situations together and Sarith sees a whole different side of Ashen - One which is cute and needs to be protected? Chubby Kind Seme x Cute Feisty Uke

title: Yabai Kimochi
description: Tooru is a shy and quiet student who has developed a special crush on his close friend Ryouji, the most popular member of the high school swim team. In front of Ryouji, Tooru hides his feelings and acts as if he is just one of Ryouji's good friends, but in a moment out of the blue his world will be turned upside down as Ryouji will confess a secret desire for Tooru. Dazzled, Tooru can barely hide his excitement for Ryouji and quickly accepts his offer. As time passes, Tooru's happiness begins to fade knowing that his affair with Ryouji was just a fling based out of Ryouji's sexual curiosity.

title: Shanhai High School
description:
Lin Jing was pretty much your average model student: serious, diligent and polite. However, after transferring to a new school for his sophomore year, he was forced to become a minion for the trouble-making student who ranked last in the year.

 Lin Jing was completely baffled. How did this happen?

Ji Xingling wore his school jacket draped across his shoulders as the golden sun shone over his head. He leaned back and pressed his shoe against the wall.

"It can’t be helped then... You really are quite a clumsy little demon."

 Lin Jing: What??? He’s nuts..

For his 18th birthday, Young Master Ji styled his hair with spray and showed up at Lin Jing's door. With a domineering president-like attitude, he asked boldly, "Are you free tomorrow?"

Lin Jing was nervous. "Ji Xingling! Ji Xingling, your Qilin tail is showing again!"

title: Aozora no Sunda Iro wa
description: Aiming to become a sensei like his former sensei, Sugiura Sakae came to an elementary school as a contract teacher. Coincidently, his former sensei, Fukada Ryuuji, is currently teaching here. Ryuu-sensei is Sakae's idol, as well as his pillar of support. However, the "Ryuu-sensei" he'd once so admired is totally different now. Feeling bothered, Sakae slowly realizes that his feelings for sensei have transformed into love. But what about Ryuu-sensei?

title: Chew and Swallow
description: Minjae Kim was the kind of guy who caught your eye. That’s where all the trouble began for Taehwa Lee. The two met in high school, hit it off and then some. All the rumors said that they were together. Intimate. Abuse, betrayal, lies and love, if that was the only truth, they wouldn’t be in this mess.

title: Michiru Heya
description: Reno has a new roommate: his name is Roje, and there seems to be a lot of nasty rumours about him in this boys' school. They call him "Casanova" – he sells his body to almost anyone willing to pay for it. Reno is surprised to find that, for Roje, this is only business. The transaction is over when people get the wrong idea about something that's just sex. Reno just wonders how such a nice person can be so cold at times – and why is it that he can do those things as if it means nothing?

title: Gēnbān Jiànxíshēng
description: Qin Qianliang was unjustly labeled as the school bully due to persistent rumors. One day, while working part-time, he found himself saving a boy named Cui Yucan. Shortly after, a new transfer student arrived at school, and to Qianliang's surprise, it was Cui Yucan. From the moment they reunited, Cui Yucan latched onto him, insisting they become best friends. Qianliang, who always kept his distance from others, thought a simple rejection would make him back off. But Cui Yucan didn't give up. Instead, he boldly declared that he would become Qianliang's "sidekick"...?

title: Nee, Sensei?
description: This story is about a relationship between a teacher and his student, Homura. It just so happens that Homura's older sister Kaori was the teacher's first girlfriend. Back then, the teacher would always use Homura as excuse to run away whenever something happened and he would never get in the "mood" whenever he was with Kaori. One day, he saw Homura's exam paper and noticed that Homura wrote "I like you, sensei" in the upper right corner. Will he accept Homura's confession?

title: Otouto ja Irarenai!!
description: Kai loves his stepbrother Riku from the bottom of his heart. However, Riku treasures “the bonds of siblinghood” more than anything, so Kai must hide his feelings and instead act as a "good brother"… but skinship no longer satisfies him!

title: Dame Inu Renairon
description:
"I can't do as my master says!!"

Shiro, the dog god, met Kiyoto when he was little. At his request, they lived together as humans. However, recently, Shiro has noticed that Kiyoto has been acting strange. And then, impossibly, Kiyoto appears in front of Shiro with dog ears?! Shiro is shocked, and Kiyoto pushes him down, saying, "I want to defile you."

A story of master-servant love between the possessive master Kiyoto and the tsundere dog god Shiro!!

title: Koi ni Ochiru 5byoumae
description:
"How would it feel to be touched that hand?" Matsushima, the eldest son of a large family, has a crush on his perfect classmate Tsujimoto. 

A prequel to Shokuinshitsu no Himegoto

title: Momokuri (Web Comic)
description: Yuki Kurihara is a girl who has finally been granted her wish of dating her crush Shinya Momotsuki (Momo). At first glance, she just looks like a normal but very cute girl. However, she is in fact a maniac over Momo, taking notes of his activities and never missing the chance to see him in a cute moment. Momo, on the other hand, is inexperienced in love, and just wants to make Yuki happy.

title: Shinkuu Yuusetsu
description: In this country, every person has to be matched up with a partner. Partnerships are made around when you turn three or four. The doctors decide who gets paired together. One person acts as the 'supplier.' The other as the 'receiver.' It is impossible for a 'receiver' to continue to live without periodically being given power from the 'supplier.' And in the same way, it is imperative for a 'supplier' that a 'receiver' accept some of the power generated within their body. This 'power' can't be made anywhere other than inside a 'supplier's own body… So for the 'receivers,' we 'suppliers' are completely indispensable…

title: Spring's calming blue
description:
"They're blue, and sparkling."
—Those eyes, which I had always thought were ugly...
He looked straight into them and said those words.

Sowa has no friends.
Because of his sharp, intimidating glare, he constantly gets targeted by delinquents, spending his days caught up in endless fights. But one day, he is approached by Kyoshiro, a senior at his school.

Kyoshiro is bright, reliable, and popular—the exact opposite of Sowa in every single way. At first, Sowa gives him the cold shoulder, but...

An overly caring, handsome upperclassman × A cool, clumsy, lone-wolf underclassman.
A pure, heart-fluttering youth BL romance that will gently melt your heart!

title: Nar Kiss
description: Honjou Naru is an 18-year-old young man who studies at Libre University. For his entire lifetime, he never once had a girlfriend. The reason for this is due to his abnormality: extreme narcissism, which is only triggered if he sees a reflection of himself. To prevent that, he needs to wear contacts all the time. One day, his contacts fell off and they were stepped on by the most handsome guy in school, Takashina Mamoru! This chance encounter would change his life forever…

title: Honki ni Natta Merryman
description: One evening while hanging out, Oku confesses to his friend and neighbor, Kanbayashi, that he is not attracted to women at all and thinks that he might be gay. One thing leads to another, and the two find themselves between the sheets sharing a night of passion. From that day on, though, the pair act as if nothing at all happened. Kan goes on to date a string of women while Oku begins seeing several different men. Three years on, things come to a head during Christmas break, with secrets laid bare between them. Where will things go from there? Two university students explore love, sexuality and friendship in this gentle coming of age tale.

title: Miterannee yo
description: Natsume is the loner type. He doesn't like to get involved in people's issues, nor does he put himself in the spotlight. Kudou is the exact opposite. He uses his looks and charms; a perfect player. These two don't know each other, despite attending the same college… until Kudou steals two of Natsume's girlfriends, consecutively. Now that his pride has been hurt by the same man, what will Natsume do?

title: Kagakushitsu no Ouji
description: Inuzuka is known as the eccentric prince of the school's chemistry room. His classmates always stayed away from him because they see him as a weirdo. The class committee member, Akai, is asked by the teacher to "Please get along well" with Inuzuka. However, Inuzuka's interpretation of "Please get along well", turned out to be "Please go out with me" and hence begins the high school love comedy!

title: Kikoenai Koe
description: Imai, a member of a baseball team, has his eyes on Hikita, a younger member who works so hard despite how awkward he is. Whenever Hikita gets nervous, he seems to glare at people. Imai just finds him so cute. "I'm the only one who's noticed how sexy you are…" He tries to get close to Hikita, looking after him in the way a more experienced member should, when deep down, he just really wants to touch Hikita's naked body!

title: Demian Shoukougun
description: Azuma and Takayama used to be really close friends as children, until one day Takayama disappears to the USA without telling Azuma. Unable to forget about Azuma, Takayama returns years later and enrolls in Azuma's school. He finds his old friend cold and unwilling to restart any kind of relationship… but why? Takayama is a light hearted, happy guy who gets along with everyone around, even though Azuma's odd behavior hurts him. Azuma is cool and distant, and seems not to care about anything around him…

title: Renai Kyoutei Nukegake Nashi!
description: A childish student, Shirou carries a torch for his teacher, Oka. Masami, a good friend of Shirou's, who has cherished him like a brother, is confronted by Ryuuji, another friend of theirs, concerning his true feelings for Shirou. Masami and Ryuuji conclude a gentlemen's agreement, in which neither of them can hit on Shirou. Ryuuji orders Masami to act as a substitute and take care of his sexual desires in Shirou's stead.

title: Love Allergy
description: Damwoon's sudden allergy to chlorine forces him to give up his swimming career, but when he develops an allergy to his best friend Haesoo, will he be able to give him up too?

title: A High School Boy's Life!
description:
Hyoseob and Suengmin begin living together in an unexpected twist of fate.   
Both of them spend their time together at home and in the school's art club. After reuniting after such a long time, could something more grow between the two?

title: Okujyou no Bye-Bye
description: Nogi is a fearless and respected karate black-belt who beats up bullies without breaking a sweat. But to Fujiwara, he's just "Kei-chan": best friend and object of his secret affections. Can their friendship survive? Or develop into something more?

title: Honto no Bokura
description:
Sueoka is popular and friendly to all of his classmates, but he hates being around people. Hiding during lunch in the bathroom, Sueoka ends up hearing two of his male classmates having sex! Stuck in the bathroom, Sueoka has no choice but to endure through the entire thing. However, he is somehow caught!  
  
"If you don't want me to tell anyone, suck me off." Blackmailed by the quiet Oohashi, what will be Sueoka's decision? Hide his true self, or let it be revealed to the world?

title: Devil x Devil
description:
1-2) Devil x Devil  
Hotei is a low-level devil that lives off of human energy. But lately, he’s having trouble getting any, due to a newcomer in town named Suzaku. Suzaku has been hogging up all of the girls in town, leaving Hotei hungry and desperate. One day, a human boy gives Hotei a piece of candy. Although there is a danger he’ll have a bad reaction, Hotei eats it, and turns into a young boy! Knowing that Suzaku prefers young boys, Hotei decides to use his appearance to leech off of Suzaku and have revenge. But with a turn of events, Hotei finds himself at the receiving end of his prank!  
  
3) Spirit Mage  
  
4) Transformer - not scanlated  
  
5) Start From the Fingertips…  
  
6) Heartshock

title: Tenkousei Jinno Murasaki
description: Midori is known for his ability to fight. What can a guy do when a transfer student claims to be his childhood friend and suddenly confesses? Also on top of that says he wants to protect him!!! Strange and dark things keep happening around the guy, who is he really? A mix of violence, death, humor and curtness!!!!

title: Timing
description: Woojoo is conflicted by a one-sided crush on his childhood friend, Inyoung. He is worried about confessing his love to Inyoung and losing his friendship with him entirely. That’s how the school semester begins, and a new problem arises… a love letter?!

title: I Live in Isekai Zero: Will the Reincarnated Save the World?
description: Events prior to the main series from 10,000 years ago , how the first generation of outlanders come , who summoned them and for what purpose and the link with the current time and events!!

title: Musubenai Necktie
description: Two boys from different schools have developed a routine: Ren, the elder of the two, assists the younger Nachi in fixing his necktie before they board the morning train for school. When Ren begins to worry that they may be giving the public a wrongful impression of their relationship, he realizes that he does indeed possess romantic feelings for Nachi and decides to put some distance between them before things go any further. But is that what Nachi really wants?

title: Zetsuai
description:
When he was very young, his mother killed his father and also hurt him badly; that may be the reason why Takuto Izumi, high school soccer star and the girls' idol, is so cold towards other people. He trusts no-one, and refuses to love anyone, so he leaves his adoptive family and goes to live on his own as soon as he's capable.  
  
As he's struggling to put the past behind him, a certain incident on a dull rainy day turns his life around completely. The drunk he helped out on a whim turns out to be the famous idol popstar Nanjou Kouji, and ever since that encounter, Kouji has taken an interest in Izumi… An interest that seems to grow deeper every day until it becomes what can only be described as "obsessive love."

title: Evergreen Days
description: Chemistry teacher Kousaka appears before Takuma, who is living the peaceful life of a high school student. This teacher who doesn't act like a teacher captures Takuma's interest, but unexpectedly Kousaka's words touch his heart, and interest transforms rapidly into love. These two, who met over a shared cigarette, go beyond their respective roles and begin a new relationship!

title: Doggerel
description: Higa and Nonami are classmates. Nonami is quiet and seems to get separated from friends in class. Unlike Nonami, Higa is friendly and nippy. One time, Nonami – being the most intelligent student in class – reluctantly helps Higa with his studies. After that, he starts to develop feelings for Higa…

title: Futari no Tokubetsu Jugyou
description: Udagawa is scared of being hated by people, and acts a lot brighter than he is. One day, he is paired with the unsociable Watabe for an assignment, and is told “I hate people like you” when he tries to talk to him. After receiving such a shock, he gradually starts speaking more frankly to Watabe and finds himself feeling comfortable around him. Wanting to be liked by him, Udagawa tells him his true feelings. Before he knew it, Watabe had turned into a precious “true friend” to him…

title: Warera Nishizaki Kiba Gundan
description: Its a Trap one shot from oto Nyan magazine, which basically involves a boy dressed in bloomers during a Calvary battle in an effort to win this battle, the strategy of his class is to dress the boy as a girl to throw everyone's game off

title: Himitsu ga Hanazono
description: Seven men have entered a school exclusively for girls. Irie, a man who fantasizes about his own harem, harbors a great dislike towards Koga, the number one popular ikemen at their school, so he always tries to avoid him… But a rumor starts to spread that Kouga likes Irie…!?

title: Honey Sour Flavor
description:
You're not only interested in my legs, right?  
  
The new coach of the track and field club, Hayashida, sexually harasses Imai every day, saying: "Your legs are the best!" Imai always responds with glares, but the problem is, when Imai hears about Hayashida's past career in track and field, he becomes interested?

title: Quick Transmigration: Addictive Relationship
description: Ling Qi, a mischievous rabbit spirit, stole the Celestial Emperor's prized carrots and was punished with trials across three thousand lesser realms. In each realm, he diligently cosplays various roles, from pervert to villain, with one goal: sabotage the central couple! However, despite his intentions not to seduce anyone, his attempts often fail. As the trials progress, Ling Qi realizes that everything was manipulated by the Celestial Emperor…

title: Boku wa Kimi no Iinari
description: "I'm the only one who gets to see you so filthy, when you're usually so serious." Danno realizes he's gay in junior high school and professes his love to his crush, but is deeply hurt by rejection. Still disgusted by himself in his second year of high school, he ends up falling for another guy that spring. He tries to keep from being found out and to stop his feelings developing any further by pushing away the object of his affections, first-year student Tsukasa. One day, Tsukasa finds Danno jerking off in the nurse's office. "Does it turn you on? Being watched by your crush?" Tsukasa's torturing and teasing makes Danno dizzy with pleasure, robbing him of coherent thought!

title: Taka to Tonbi to Aburaage
description: Hanajima is the most popular and sought-after guy in school. But he has a secret: a hidden self, who is unbearably egoistical in both words and thoughts! The only one who knows that is a fellow schoolmate, Nodate!

title: Half of Me
description:
From 7 AM to 7 PM, 
I have to live in someone else’s body for 12 hours…?!

Due to a car accident, Taekin, a teenager in high school, and Heechan have switched souls.
Due to this, Heechan’s vegetable business, to which he’s dedicated his entire life is in trouble!
In order to recover his body, Heechan heads to Taekin’s school…

‘That gym teacher, why is he here…?’

He sees his old classmate, ‘The ultimate nice guy’, working as the school’s gym teacher.
Heechan excitedly tries to ask for help but…
‘Kim Taekin, bend over.’

This… This isn’t it…?!
Will Heechan be able to recover his body through this difficult journey?

title: Nigireba Kobushi Hirakeba Tenohira
description: *Debuted on equal Vol.8*

title: Prince Cinderella
description:
From Lezhin: Outgoing and athletic, Darim’s always surrounded by friends. But back in elementary school, she used to be a social outcast—she only started making friends when Taehoo brought her into the fold. Now in high school, the two have drifted apart, but Darim is waiting for a chance to reunite with her icy Prince Charming. There’s just one issue: Darim’s body transforms into a boy’s at noon every day, only to turn back at midnight! Well, if she can’t get close to Taehoo as a girl… Why not try as a boy?!  
  
Principe Cenicienta.   
  
Extrovertida y atlética, Darim siempre está rodeada de amigos. Pero en la escuela primaria, solía ser una anti social; solo comenzó a hacer amigos cuando Taehoo la incorporó al grupo. Ahora en la escuela secundaria, los dos se han distanciado, pero Darim está esperando la oportunidad de reunirse con príncipe azul de hielo. Solo hay un problema: el cuerpo de Darim se transforma en el de un chico al mediodía ¡Todos los días! ¡solo para regresar al suy

title: Nabigatoria ni Koi
description: Kei, a hot transfer student from the U.S., mistakes Yuri for a girl. Even when he realizes Yuri's a guy, he won't stop making passes at him! Yuri's always had a complex about his cute name and appearance, and Kei keeps pushing Yuri's buttons from day one at school! Kei's weirdly attached to Yuri. He's way too touchy-feely, and on top of that, he loves to call Yuri "cute"…! One day, they're alone together in the library, and Kei can't resist making a move…! "I've never been with a guy, either… Wanna try it?" A handsome, half-Japanese playboy from the U.S. meets a cute-but-ballsy Japanese high-school boy. One just can't seem to say no to the other. A bewildering yet oh-so-sweet teen romance!

title: Amayadori wa Basu-tei de
description:
This whole incident began with a phone call from Ikushima's younger siblings while at the bus stop, where Ikushima had the most unfortunate luck of meeting a happy-go-lucky boy, Ariie. Ikushima may look pretty, but his seemly bad and cold attitude earned him the nickname "the queen". Even though he doesn't think that he is wrong (actually what he says seems right, justified even) but his good intentions are always taken the wrong way. He blames this on his extremely serious look.  
  
Stumbling upon the queen's soft side, Ariie uses this information to his advantage and starts following poor Ikushima. Will love blossom from this seemingly weird pair…?

title: Dounimo Naranai
description: Yosemine Takumi is a difficult student to handle. He's used to getting what he wants by using his family's status. The new infirmary nurse, Tsutsui, is determined to change all that. He's not going to let himself be bullied by Yosemine – or anyone else, after all these years. But Yosemine has fallen head-over-heels in love with Tsutsui-sensei, determined to possess the nurse for himself!

title: Hoshikuzu to Hatsukoi Hyaku-nen Sou Monogatari
description:
When Takamori Yuuri was a child, he visited the Century Manor, which was owned by his grandfather. Forced to spend the summer there while his parents went away, Yuuri immediately wanted to go home – until he met a kind boy already living there. He teaches Yuuri origami, and promises to write him letters when Yuuri has to leave again.  
  
Now 18 years old, Yuuri finds himself at Century Manor once more. There, he meets his cousins, Fujiwara Yamato and Takamori Asao. As Yuuri slowly adjusts to his new life, he can't help but think Yamato's kindness is nostalgic, and then he finds familiar origami collected in one of the rooms… What memories and feelings will be remembered in this manor?

title: Mahoroba no Hibi
description: Taka is depressed over the loss of his cat. His best friend Tetsu is at a loss as to what he can do to make things return to normal. Then he meets Hana, a ditzy but adorable "Denpa Onna"…

title: Kimi wa Boku o Suki ni Naru
description:
The cheerful and open high school freshman Nakazato Haruka has fallen in love with his classmate: the basketball club's Tajima Kaoru. Haruka started fiercely courting Kaoru, declaring: "You will like me for sure!"  
  
How will the cool and quiet Kaoru react after knowing about Haruka's feelings?

title: Similar Terms
description: Song Yao is a high school boy whose parents mysteriously disappeared four years ago. He cooks, cleans, provides for himself and lives alone, and yet he always has the strange feeling that someone is following him…

title: Wagamama Honey
description: High school teacher Igarashi and his colleague Ousaka are lovers, but the super arrogant 'queen' Ousaka treats him like a slave… How will this romance that causes this teacher such frustration develop!?

title: Bikkuri Suru Hodo Doji na Koi
I want to go see the stars
description:
“I found someone I like.”  
As soon as Junsoo became a university student, his friend Han Byul, who liked Junsoo in high school, told him he found someone else he likes now. What was this strange feeling…? Did Junsoo also like Han Byul? Unable to understand, these feelings became even more complicated. After seeing a club advertisement, he found out about the Secret Reading Club… and suddenly he was dragged to the club room…? Now begins a story about youth and the struggles they find trying to reach for their stars.

title: Miwaku no Ringo
description: Ichijou Kei is the son of a famous and powerful family. He's disgusted by everyone always sucking up to him, even teachers. But new teacher Hayashi Satoru isn't interested in Ichijou's family connections – in fact, he doesn't seem to like him at all!

title: Shiranu wa Omae Bakari
description:
1-3) Shiranu wa Omae Bakari & Kare no Mizo Shiru (from Echochi Scans)
Yoshikawa Taiki and Komiya Kazuyuki had sex once almost every week, but they were neither lovers nor friends. What started off as a drunken escapade back during a university get-together scaled into something bigger than either of them could have imagined. Though he wished for more, Kazuyuki felt that there was no hope for something deeper between the two of them, because Taiki was as straight as a ruler. For someone like Kazuyuki, who knew that his sexual orientation wasn't generally accepted by society, he planned to give up and stop whatever sexual relationship he had with Taiki. But what’s Taiki’s say in all this?

4-5) Dakara Kao mo Mitakunai & Nano ni Te wo Furarenai
After getting dumped, Kataoka Takeru's best friend Yui confesses to him. But Takeru doesn't know how to cope with this situation. What will become of their friendship?

6) Otonari Kara Koi no Koto

title: Sugar Pain
description: Riku, who looks forward to a sugar-sweet romance, actually hides an unspeakable trauma!?

title: A Lucky Coin
description: High school dropout Hank Yan has a lot of hobbies. Studying, live streaming his day to day, and beating up bullies as a hero vigilante?! One day, Hank saves a young man named Junior. Shy and suffering from a dark past of abuse, Junior is a lot like Hank. Both barely have parents, if they are alive at all, both are interested in one another. Is it luck that they met or…fate?    [Adapted from Wu Zhe's novel of the same name]

title: Love Interest Zone
description: Myungha Tae is going to die in 300 days. Well… maybe. After getting sucked into his friend’s novel, "Love Interest Zone," 29-year-old Myungha becomes a 19-year-old high schooler again with one mission—make Yeowoon Cha happy or die. With only 300 days to succeed, Myungha must break past Yeowoon’s barriers and prevent him from experiencing the same tragic fate as he did in the novel. But with Yeowoon’s favorability toward him in the negatives, will he be able to survive?

title: My Boyfriend's Love Complex
description:
Xiang Nan, who's an absolute idiot when it comes to love, has had a crush on Hong Xiao for a very long time. In order to increase his eligibility as a boyfriend, he decides to seek help online from the top four male gods of the internet. "Masters, please teach me about love!" What surprises him the most is how all four of them say yes immediately.
Number One says, "Overbearing CEO, Contract Lover, which one do you want to be?" 
Number Two says, "Midnight shower, personal bedroom, which one do you want a peek at?" 
Number Three says, "Kneeling, squatting, sideways, and prone. Which way do you want to be positioned?" 
Number Four says, "Chest muscles, abdominal muscles, pelvic muscles, which one do you wanna train first?" 

Erm...why is this path to knowledge filled with so many obstacles?

title: Mirai no Kioku
description: A romantic lover awaits you… in the future. Kento Kumagaya wishes for the simple things in life: to have a happy family with the ideal housewife, loving kids, and kind grandparents all living together, happily ever after. Fate, however, has other plans. Enter Akira Kazuki, a smart, beautiful and unrestrained gay man who shatters Kento's dream with a single night of wild and passionate homosexual sex. This is a romantic, sweet and funny story between two different people (in more ways than one) who unexpectedly find the same future together.

title: Haikyuu!! - Ou-sama no Kiss (Doujinshi)
description: Kageyama’s scowling face makes it really hard to kiss his boyfriend, who’s always convinced Kageyama is pissed at him when he tries to make a move. So their sempai give him some advice. (contains brief mentions of Asahi/Nishinoya)

title: Mr. Flower Groom
description: The Souda family tradition of marrying off its younger sons to male clan members leaves no generation untouched! Childhood friends Ritsu and Kouichirou may have taken their first, tentative steps into married life in Mr. Flower Bride, but now they have to wrangle with past loves, new misunderstandings…and each other (!!) to get to matrimonial bliss!

title: Edith (Anthology)
description:
Edith is an “Original School Love Anthology”. Not all stories contain BL and vary greatly in terms of theme, mood and characters.  
  
Two Colors:  
The first time Tsujiya met Hayashi, it wasn't a pretty sight, at least for him. He had his clothes blotched with paint and was blown away by his senpai’s frankness. Tsujiya asked Hayashi whether he could practice in the studio once in a while. Before they knew it, their relationship started to blossom…

title: Inu to Tsubame
description: Kaede is still mourning the loss of his brother when he is suddenly reunited with his childhood friend, Noro. As they get closer, Kaede shares his suspicion that he may have caused his brother’s death. After hearing this, Noro recommends animal therapy and lets Kaede use him as a pet dog. But one day, the dog suddenly kisses his owner…?

title: Sweet Bitter Candy
description:
1-3) Sweet Bitter Candy  
Kawaguchi spent his entire life in high school as the short chubby kid, "Chidebu". His one secret was his admiration of the rebellious, openly gay Kanaya. Five years have passed and now that Kawaguchi has lost the weight (but is still short), does he have a chance of catching Kanaya's attention?   
  
4-5) Wait a Little Longer  
Student council president Tone is used to being a slave driver, and he's sure being stuck with overly persistent kouhai Ninomiya is just another cross for him to bear. After all, Ninomiya already confessed to him and he's only joining the student council to be close to Tone. But even though Ninomiya turns out to be a great worker, Tone relax around him…  
  
6) Just as God Said  
Two long-time lovers face a heart-wrenching breakup when one of them decides to get married.  
  
7) Sasoku  
A mangaka doesn't want his new assistant to fall for his secret lover.

title: Bitter Lemon
description:
"Why is he always hovering around me? He also suddenly proposed that we move into the luxurious studio in front of our school together...?!"

 First love and the sweet suggestion of cohabitation by a perfect man...! Will they be able to resist each other?

"Eun Jae-Rim, will you please bring me back to life?"

When they were very young, Keito and Tomoya made a promise to be together forever, but after Tomoya disappeared one morning, Keito lost his faith in people. Years later in high school, Tomoya makes a sudden return, but now Keito's no longer a cute little kid Tomoya seems to have forgotten who he is!

High-school student Akito is too cute! So cute that he's been traumatized by attackers both male and female. When Akito's mother convinces laid back college student Kunugi to tutor him, is Akito destined to be attacked again? Or is Kunugi really just a nice guy?

4. Hitomi no Ori
