title: Color Chart wo Kimi ni
description:
Komiya's had a crush on Nishiyama, ever since his senpai defended him in front of a bullying teacher. Now, years later, when they meet again, Komiya blurts out about his one-sided feelings in a drunken haze. But Nishiyama replies with a "Sure, I'll go out with you." Is Nishiyama serious or is he just playing around?  
  
Serialized as "Ore wa Senpai no Nan Nan Desu ka?!"

title: Around
description: An ensemble cast BL manga telling several stories about how high-school boys found love developing between themselves and unexpected partners, in surprising circumstances.

title: Soshite Koi ga Hajimaru
description: Miki Tamura can read people like a book. To maintain his happy home-life and to please people, it's a skill he's learned to acquire. But what happens when he meets someone that he can't read so easily?

title: Dog Style
description:
Miki Terayama saved Teru from getting roughed up by some punks. They're both in love with other guys… but one thing leads to another, and they're fooling around. Teru acts like a stray dog that hasn't been fed in ten days. He consumes Miki's love quick and rough and that can be quite a pain in the butt!  
  
—  
  
An entertaining romp from Modoru who has once again veered away from her dark side and visited the side of her humorous stories. Of course it's still rather twisted.   
  
A couple of high school delinquents (Teru and Miki) discover that despite being from opposing sides, they have no objection to a bit of a sheet tumble with one another. Doggie-style refers more to how one of them is referred to as a dog by the other.   
  
After their fourth time together, Teru and Miki finally have sex good enough to melt them both. However, they're still stuck in a weird place… more than friends with benefits, but not quite lovers. But now Miki's friend Kashiwa is demanding a meeting. Wh

title: Yugawara-kun wa Ooyamada Danshi Koukou de Moteru Houhou o Kangaeteita ga
description: "I've liked you for a long time. Please go out with me!" These were the words second-year high-school Kazuki Yugawara heard when one day out of the blue, someone confesses their feelings for him! But, wait just a minute… I go to an all-boys school. And the one who confessed to me was Sakurada-kun, who… is also a boy! I’m happy someone told me they liked me, but there's no way I could ever go out with a guy! But this guy Sakurada looks like a girl. What to do?

title: Close Your Eyes
description: Two childhood friends and neighbours suddenly stopped talking to each other after summer break. What could have happened between these best friends who used to be joined at the hip?

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion - Susumihajimeta Bokura no Jikan (Doujinshi)
description:
This story is based on the thorie that somewhere exist a alternative dimension for everything which happen.   
Kaworu and Shinji are not became Children 'cause the Angel never attacked the humanity and that's why they are spared from their cruel fate in which they had to fight and had to go trough pain.  
So in this dimension they live a normal school life, but not quite 'cause Kaworu recalls his past with the EVAs and Angels.

title: Shuchaku Ai no Susume
description:
"Aren’t you afraid of being attacked again?" A young man being attacked by a Professor in an empty classroom.  
Reiji Saga, who accidentally saw the sight, took a picture of the evidence and saved the young man, Yuki Hayase.  
Yuki Hayase is called the “Pheromone Prince” and is popular regardless of gender, especially with the men and it is not the first time that he has been attacked like this.  
Saga worried about such a good rabbit-! ?

title: Kiss mo Shiranai Kuse ni
description: Fujisawa Satou, a high school freshman, was molested while boarding the train one morning. However, that was only a misunderstanding on his part. He eventually found out that it was only a racket. The one who informed him of this was Ayase Chihiro, the transfer student who started school a month late. It was awkward between the two of them at first, but they gradually became closer.

title: Arashi to Snowdrop
description:
Taikuni was a promising basketball player, but after injuring his leg, he quit the basketball club and entered the spring of his third year feeling somewhat lethargic.

Amidst all this, he is appointed to the class beautification committee along with Haruki, a boy who is a bit of a shadow due to his frail health. Gradually, Taikuni finds himself unable to leave Haruki, who seems somewhat otherworldly and unsafe, alone...

A heart-cleansing story of first love told by two high school boys!

title: Imamade, Korekara
description: A compilation of original doujinshi by Hayakawa Nojiko set in the same universe as her previous works.

title: Sensei no Iinari
description:
c.1-4) Sensei no Iinari.  
  
c.5) Zenbu Omae no Sei da  
  
c.6) Ono-sensei no Iinari.

title: Gakuen Heaven - Revolution
description: Itou Keita is a boy with no remarkable talents beyond his better-than-average luck, until one day he receives an acceptance letter out of the blue inviting him to attend the prestigious all-boys academy, Bell Liberty School (BL School). Why has he been admitted to this amazing academy, and how can he possibly live up to the expectations of whoever let him in? As he settles in to his new life, Keita is sure to find companionship in his rather eclectic cast of schoolmates.

title: My Starry Sky
description:
Just when Yeonduk thought he was finally going to be free of his tormentor (and family friend and crush, might we add), Seo Skyler – coolest kid in school – saunters his way into the same classroom. Skyler might look blessed (his sister’s even in a girl group), but he’s got some family issues that only Yeonduk can understand. Yeonduk is more than just star-struck, though, and when Skyler starts acting nice and walking to school with him, he can’t help but hope there might finally be more between them.  
  
French   
Juste au moment où Yeon Duk pensait qu'il allait enfin être libéré de son bourreau (de son ami d'enfance et accessoirement son béguin, ajouterions-nous) : Seo Skyler - l'enfant le plus cool de l'école - se retrouve être dans la même classe que lui. Skyler a peut-être l'air béni (sa sœur est même dans un groupe de filles), mais il a des problèmes familiaux que seul Yeonduk peut comprendre. Mais Yeonduk n'est pas qu'une star, et quand Skyler commence à se comporter gentiment

title: Exciting Love
description: Childhood friends Chihiro and Keigo are living together under one roof. They're lovers, but they've only ever kissed once. To Chihiro, it hardly even feels like they're going out, and he's getting impatient! And on top of that, he suddenly has a rival!? It's ever-loyal Keigo and headstrong Chihiro's heart-pounding, heart-breaking love story.

title: Karada Meate de Warui ka
description:
"As long as Kakuno's willing to look at me, it's okay."  
  
Hazumi was helped by his classmate, Kakuno, who saw him being harassed by some upperclassmen. His heart stolen by Kakuno's strong and beautiful body, Hazumi told Kakuno that he wanted to see it all. Kakuno obliged, but as time passed their relationship became no clearer.  
  
They started out as strangers; neither lovers nor friends.  
  
Which would it be, if any?

title: Catboy Catday
description:
One day, I woke up to find that my cat has become a human!  
A new day with cat boy.

title: Kizuna
description: Three's a crowd. Ranmaru and Kei have a strong and passionate relationship built on years of trust, sacrifice and love. When the mysterious son of a Yakuza boss starts to have designs on Ranmaru's affection, tempers flare, and hidden emotions rise to the surface. Will Ranmaru and Kei's love for each other be able to survive this difficult test, or will the emotional conflict finally come to a head?

title: Haikyu!! - Heat Up, Cool Down (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata  
  
Kageyama gets mild heat stroke during practice, and Hinata helps see him home safely… and then into bed.

title: Abnormal Contact
description:
Seemingly gloomy and low-profile, but in reality, a proud domineering vampire queen —vs— a school heartthrob who appears poor but is actually a cunning "green tea" loyal dog.

The hunter becomes the hunted.

A "poor" university student plays the fool, hiding his true strength, all to make the vampire completely devoted to him?

When Shi An witnesses Jing Ying transform from a tiny bat into a human and straddle him, he finally realizes that vampires aren’t just myths. Jing Ying demands that he become his personal blood pet.

title: Kimi ni wa Fureru to Naru Toko ga Atte
description: Touji is an average high school student who is terrible at dealing with people and struggles with physical contact. On one rainy day, all of Touji's struggles come to a head when he encounters Itsuki Yato, a fellow classmate who touches him casually even when they first meet. Even though Touji isn't great at socializing, Itsuki goes out of his way to talk to him and spend time with him. Gradually, Touji starts to want to learn more about Itsuki…

title: Far Away From Cold
description: This is a story of Little Princess Luo trying to make a friend. Luo Linyuan is born with a silver spoon in his mouth and a pretty face. Yu Han is "straight", and he sleeps only three hours a day. Yu Han doesn't want Luo Linyuan to get close to him, but Luo Linyuan wants otherwise.

title: Okujou Fuukei
description: High schooler Minaguchi finds himself noticing the otherwise ordinary Andou and cannot keep his eyes off him. But this year, they were put into separate classes and Minaguchi is thrilled not only to see him again after a long time, but also to find out that Andou likes spending his Tuesday lunch break on the rooftop, sleeping… Now he finally has a place to meet the unsuspecting Andou at, and to snap photos of him with his new phone!

title: Koishii Akuma
description: Despite his best efforts, Akiyoshi Tooru has fallen for the very beautiful but sadistic and perverted demon, Naruse Fuuta. Not only do they attend the same university, they’re now living together! Though Akiyoshi has always tried to be careful about their night life, he never expected Naruse to stop touching him altogether, and then all of a sudden, Naruse is in an accident and reverts to his adolescent self!

title: Ichigo to Kobushi
description: Kobushi Bayashi, who has a crush on Ichigo-no-Kuni, who likes cute things. Despite being rejected numerous times, he never gives up and decides to become cute himself in order to catch Ichigo-no-Kuni's attention...?!"

title: Mizu no Haru
description: Can Shinomiya and Sunohara resolve their differences, admit their feelings, while harboring secrets?

title: Otodokemono Desu!
description:
1) Otodokemono Desu! (Delivery!)  
Competent president Kurokawa is hard to approach because of his fearsome demeanor. But the home delivery worker who brings parcels, Sawada-kun, with his angelic smile, is a soothing existence – he greets Kurokawa with a fearless "Hi there!" Thinking that he wants to somehow get closer to Sawada-kun, what does the president courageously resolve to do!?  
  
A hopeless, wild idea, with a sharp glint in his eye …  
  
2) Amagarai Unmei (Salty-Sweet Destiny)  
What will happen to this poor man who's about to turn 30 when he finds out he was born without the Red String of Fate.  
  
3) Rookie  
Sugou always had things easy in life until he meet his co-worker Atou.  
  
4) Futari no Kyoukai-sen no Iro (The Color that Divides Two People)  
  
5) Shiawase no Yakusoku (Promise of Happiness)  
  
6) Kuse ni Narisou na (It Might Become Habit)  
  
Extra) Otodokemono Uketorimashita! (Delivery Received!)  
  
Six works total with the title work included, plus an i

title: Isso Mou, Kudokitai!
description: Ayukawa has had nothing but trouble with women, from his first crush to the last girl that dumped him, so he's given up on getting a girlfriend. Now he's teaching at an all boys school and his cute student Hino is very friendly. Is a boyfriend the answer to Ayukawa's love troubles?

title: Yankee-kun To Yuru Fuwa Ojisan
description:
Hotaru hồi nhỏ bị côn đồ bắt nạt và được một anh đầu gấu ngầu bá cháy giúp đỡ.
Muốn gặp lại anh lần nữa, sau vài năm tìm kiếm, Hotaru trở thành đầu gấu và cứu một nhân viên văn phòng trông yếu nhớt đang bị tụi côn đồ bắt nạt.

Nhân viên tóc đen trông tẻ nhạt kia luôn cúi gằm mặt và nhạt nhòa, nhưng khi nhìn kỹ thì trên gương mặt ấy có nốt ruồi cùng chỗ với anh đầu gấu xưa!!
Hóa ra, người mà Hotaru ngưỡng mộ nay đã trở thành ông chú bông xù thích goods - Kyoushirou!?!!?

title: Hello My Seven Uncle
description: Seven Uncle is an ultra handsome Ancient God? A normal University freshman is forced to join the Committee of Monitoring Gods, and other than having to serve the arrogant and picky Seven, he also has to fight with every wit and strength against other eccentric Gods. God VS Human, Ancient God VS New God, the door to a new world is about to be opened…

title: Remembering You
description:
After a car accident, Yeowool loses fragments of his memories, especially Soohyun. After recovering, Seungho appears before him claiming to be his boyfriend. Soohyun, distraught and guilty from what happened to Yeowool, carefully watches the relationship budding between Yeowool and Seungho. Will Soohyun be able to get over his guilt? Will Yeowool remember what he has lost? Stay tuned as their story unfolds . . .  
  
[Project is dropped]

title: Mimitabu no Riyuu
description:
1: Mimitabu no Riyuu (A Reason For Earlobes)  
Yamaguchi is a notorious womanizer. Some men admire him; others can't stand him. Ishikawa is definitely one of the latter. Nevertheless, when Yamaguchi's latest girlfriend dumps him, Ishikawa jokingly offers to comfort him with his own body. Unfortunately for Ishikawa, Yamaguchi takes the offer seriously. And, to make matters worse, Ishikawa discovers that he can't say no!  
  
2: Yubisaki no Biyaku (Love Potion Fingertips)  
Ishikawa and Yamaguchi are dating, but Yamaguchi's lovey-dovey behavior makes Ishikawa sick. Hoping to put Yamaguchi in his place, Ishikawa suggests that they "see other people." But things take a turn for the worse when each one catches the other with a beautiful woman.  
  
3: Kuchibiru no Teppen (The Top Of The Lip)   
Ishikawa usually wears an irritable scowl. So why is he laughing and smiling so happily? Is it because he likes homemade sweets… or the cute girl who made them? Consumed with jealousy, Yamaguchi's pa

title: Koi wa Ina Mono Myouna Mono
description:
On the first day of school, Tamura Masafumi sees Seiwa Narumi and immediately passes out.  
  
It is discovered that when Tamura was a kid he had psychic dreams and could predict many events. He thought they had all disappeared but at the beginning of Junior High he has another one, and it shows him having sex with another man!  
  
Tamura refuses to become gay and swears to prevent it. When he sees Seiwa, he realizes that this is the other man in his (now frequent) dreams!  
  
So Tamura treats Seiwa quite badly in hopes that he will leave him alone, however, Seiwa has other plans. What will happen between these two?

title: Daydream★Nightmare
description: Meet Kusumi. He views Ichi as his god. He has no interest in real life girls because anime is his life. Meet Ichi. He has a secret that no one knows about, and he fights to hide it from others. He also has a past that seems to be surfacing through his dreams. But what does it mean when a guy promises to protect him by eating the "bad things"? Join Ichi in his adventure to find out about himself, and what his secret really holds.

title: Dramatic Maestro
description: All three of Mao's high school girlfriends have been taken away by the gorgeous-looking Yuu. But in retaliation to the slap that he gave this popular guy, a confused Mao gets a kiss..!? Soon he's dragged into the world of the school's "celebrities," who all have special talents, which range from "entertainment" to cosplay, and even pleasure!

title: Tomorrow's You Is Not Here
description: After failing Japanese history, Mio was forced to attend extra cram classes. Finding his Japanese history teacher, Fumichika, to be quite understanding and kind, Mio couldn't help but feel an attraction towards him. After he confessed, Fumichika told him that his feelings wouldn't last – but if he could accept the risk of not having his feelings reciprocated, then they could start a physical relationship. However, Mio desires more…

title: Oujisama, Dochirasama?
description: One day, Mizuki gets rejected by school prince and student body president Seima Takajo. While sobbing his eyes out behind the school, he meets Fuji, a fierce-looking upperclassman who wears a surgical mask. The older boy is awkward, yet kind as he desperately tries to comfort Mizuki. "I want to tell Seima how I feel, so help me!" Mizuki says, demanding Fuji's cooperation. Despite his appearance, Fuji's actually pretty soft, and he even thinks the sharp-tongued, mischievous Mizuki is cute. At some point, Mizuki starts losing track of his goals… Fierce, weak, and sickly, can a prince with a triple handicap find happiness with a mischievous "princess" of a boy!?

title: Adulthood
description: Best friends Alex, Mickey and Joe are up for a very eventful freshman year.

title: Momomimi Pheromone
description: When living in an all boys dorm, it's standard to do ecchi things with your roommate. Truth is, Mao wants more. How is he to keep his real feelings hidden when Hayato says, "I like your scent the most." The only problem, Mao isn't the only one whose scent Hayato likes.

title: Koi no Mimi Yori Chuuihou
description: Hajime can't wait to make the scene at his high school… but his dreams of coolness are soon dashed by the appearance of the weird and wily Nagura!

title: Harete Bokutachi wa
description:
High-school student Chihiro is small and cute, and gets molested by middle-aged men on the train. But it wasn't always this way – up through elementary. Chihiro was bigger than all the other boys and he defended his friend, smaller and gentler Keigo, from the bullies. That is, until Keigo was transferred to Vienna!  
  
Despite promising to write, Chihiro had long ago left behind the memories of Keigo. Now, Keigo is coming back to Japan – and what's more, they'll be living under one roof! Will Chihiro accept the confession from Keigo, who has become like a stranger to Chihiro?

title: Ice Cream Line
description: Kouta Natsumi had devoted himself to surfing, and after quitting he finds his days have become enjoyable but unexciting. Then, one day, he receives a gift from Michiru Oguri, the school’s honour student. Kouta becomes more aware of Michiru, but he can’t figure out Michiru’s feelings. With each summer, they close the distance between them, and before they know it, they find the other becoming special to them…

title: Love or Die
description:
If you want to live again, show me true love between two men?! Two guys that hate each other because of a car accident, must prove their worth with true love. They start a relationship to live again, but can they succeed in filling the angels criteria?

title: Sono Yubi Dake ga Shitte Iru
description: At Wataru Fujii's high school, it's all the rage to wear paired rings with the girl you love. Wataru wears one though he is single, and one day inadvertently discovers that his ring pairs up with that of tall, handsome and smart Yuichi Kazuki, the senior classman idolized by the entire school. Though Kazuki has a reputation for being kind to all, when dealing with Wataru, he is strangely harsh. Their paired rings somehow draw them together and the two alternately clash and attract, as they must sort out their budding feelings for each other.

title: Nibun no Ichi no Fuman
description:
'Dare Say You Like Me?' Side Story

Shota brings Toma to karaoke to console him after he’s heartbroken over Masaya. As he watches Toma cry over his unrequited love, Shota can’t help but take care of him. But then an incident happens.

title: Complex Tastes
description:
"You're the only one who can fix my complex!"

Su-jeong, a handsome boy who gains popularity with his mysterious atmosphere, suddenly visits the main character, Ma Eun-ha, and asks him to fix his huge xxx complex.

"Why must it be me?!" Eun-ha finally accepts the request because of Su-jeong's persistent attack, but this guy is crazy!! What is this awesome XXX?!

title: Gestalt
description: Akitsugu has been been in unrequited love with Kei, who only looks at Maya. After Akitsugu returns home from a party, he finds Kei in his room – but this "Kei" isn't the real Kei?! What will happen to both of them?

title: Tottemo Love Voice
description: Everyday, Haruya looks forward to the announcement made by the school's library. He can't help but fall for the beautiful voice that comes from the intercom. Lone and behold he meets the voice's owner one day at the library. It belongs to a student in the same year called Takashina who is labeled as unapproachable and cold by other students. But that is not what Haruya sees when he first met Takashina. In fact, he wants to get know the person behind the voice even more.

title: Tea Cup Toy Boy
description: 17-year-old Kento Toi awakes one morning to find he's shrunk down to the size of a doll, but his doctor says he's in perfect health… Except for one thing: Kento's love for an older boy at school has made his heart grow bigger, which could be perilous! Now, he's got to either get a boyfriend or get shot down, or the swelling could be his doom! Talk about an awkward first crush! Not to mention, his childhood friend Yuki seems to have something in mind for Kento as well…

title: Wagamama Dakedo Itoshikute
description:
This the story of childhood friends, Natsu and Shuuji, who finally come together.  
  
Oneshots in this manga:  
Vol. 1 - Please Express it Properly and Noise Nostalagia  
  
Vol. 3 - Futari Yuugi  
Mayumi is always having his boyfriends stolen by his twin Masaya. So why does he always introduce them to his brother, knowing what the outcome will be? Why doesn't he especially miss them when they're gone?

title: Don't Ignore Me
description: In a certain city there are such two school tyrants: One: not sociable, no early love, addicted to studying and progressively more withdrawn. The other: My partner must be dedicated, adorable and obedient. A certain day, these two school tyrants met. Jiang Yao: This brat, don’t know what’s good for you. Jiang Yao: This brat is actually quite cute. Jiang Yao: Brat... Yin Che: Get lost. Sunshine Big Bad Wolf vs Lonely Little Bunny Jiang Yao X Yin Che

title: Tough Mate
description:
Kihyun ends up in the school dorms after his family loses all their money. But his dream of being successful studying silently is destroyed by Go Seungjo, who always leads a group of journalists. Go Seungjo is the son of the president and the little brother of a celebrity. Due to Seungjo's uniqueness and superiority, Kihyun faces all kinds of suffering, shame, insults and problems...
