title: Heart Silent
description:
By Seryne299:   
A male high school student whose heart does not beat and a man who makes his heart beat.

title: Koi ni Ochite Kudasai
description: Lumiére's just moved in with his owner and wonders why Lluvia, the cat next door, won't have anything to do with him. Will Lluvia ever come around? A gentle tale of becoming friends, and perhaps something more.

title: Furue Tsumore Shiawase no Hana
description:
1-4) Furue Tsumore Shiawase no Hana  
Yuuri has always been attached to his childhood friend and neighborhood Onii-san; Aki. With a certain fondness for his friend, he enrolls in the same college where Aki is working as a lecturer. Yuuri immediately falls into the position of Aki's personal caretaker and not before long, he comes to realize that there is more to their relationship than he understands. Furue Tsumore Shiawase no Hana is a story of the delicate balance between friendship and love.  
  
5) Furue Tsumore Shiawase no Hana Extra  
Aki and Yuuri are trying to come to terms with their relationship and where to draw their lines.  
  
6) Shake  
Continuation of chapter 5 of Koi no Shizuku.  
  
7) One-pager  
The academics go on an onsen trip.

title: The Aesthetic of Good Looking
description:
“Hyung is pretty.” Even after being warned not to, Hong Seowoo, overdoes it and gets drunk at his club’s welcoming party. The next day, he wakes up in the clubroom and realizes that not only did he miss his morning class, but while he was asleep…he’s been holding hands with a stranger, who also happens to be a man — one of the club’s new recruits and Seowoo’s junior, Baek Dohyeon. Drawn into joining the club after seeing him, Dohyeon plans on gaining Seowoo’s affections, even if it is proving to be quite the challenge.   
  
(Snow Flower Scans)

title: Myuzu no Gakuen de Aou
description: Satoru Kidaka and Akitoshi Kazu have been together since school. Now they're roommates and Satoru decides they should break up, but still live together. Kazu agrees, but can it really be as easy as that?

title: Overnourished
description: Zhong Yi came across a young man eating in the restroom, his name is Rong Mian, and he's another male lead in his upcoming new drama. Rong Mian is a cool black-haired beautiful boy. But now he's holding a spoon and eating cat canned food? A story about a narcissistic but reliable person and a cat shapeshifter, who enjoys eating cat canned food.

title: Kimikoi - Gakusei-hen (Anthology)
description:
1: Kinoshita Keiko 『恋とは不思議なものだから』  
2: Kojima Lalako 『ハレルヤ ベイビー』  
3: Nekono Mariko 『消しゴム彼氏』  
4: Tsukahara Saki 『君に想ふ、碧』  
5: Takagi Yuna 『THE 普通の恋人』  
6: Maria 『思惑いろは』  
7: Tagura Tohru 『のみ×しば』  
8: Kurito Natsu 『囚われ少年』  
9: Kisaragi Ai 『ワンダフル☆アニキ』
An anthology ran alongside with [Kimikoi - Shakaijin-hen](https://mangadex.org/title/33ff16cb-3fb1-4bed-b621-63e729044499/kimikoi-shakaijin-hen)

title: Beyond Memory
description: Won Jun can read people's feelings if touching them. Ku Han, a colleague in the same program, tries to ignore Won Jun, which makes him suspicious. Won Jun try to read the feeling, but fails. What will happen between those two?

title: Sawattemo Ii Kana
description: After Shirou (and his best friend) accidentally witness their older brothers having sex together, his world is turned upside down. Masami, on the other hand, seems to be taking this way too calmly, while Shirou doesn't even know how to act around his friend anymore. What goes on between their brothers shouldn't affect their friendship, right?

title: Risou no Koibito
description:
In the Risou no Koibito series:  
  
V.1 - Risou no Koibito (Ideal Lover)  
  
Riku suffered a traumatizing experience after coming out and has since chosen to avoid love. That is until the super-confident and dominating pretty-boy, Yoshimi, walks into his life. He deliberately targets Riku's weaknesses, but what are his true intentions?  
  
This is a story of discipline, guidance and affection that fills both the heart and body of the handsome and brutish Yoshimi and the naturally timid Riku.  
  
6. Furueru Te no Saki (Before Trembling Hands)  
They were friends in high school. Now that they are university students, Kou and Ichi have become a pair of rather dysfunctional lovers. Kou enjoys making Ichi jealous and often keeps him at arm's length. But what will Kou do now that a new kid has captured Ichi's gaze?  
  
V.2 - Risou no Yuuwaku (Temptation of an Ideal)

title: Renai Junkie
description:
Renai Junkie  
Haruki was betrayed by his girlfriend Kiyuka and his best friend Ikeda. After retreating from them, he starts to become friends with Atsushi, one of the most popular guys in school. After a conversation with Atsushi, he realizes the mistakes he made. He reconciles with Ikeda and accepts his relationship with Kiyuka. Atsushi who eavesdropped on their conversation offers to take care of Haruki. They become very close and Haruki realizes that he's fallen in love with Atsushi. How will their relationship develop?  
  
Shadow  
Arata and Yoshiki are childhood friends. Yoshiki had an accident when he was still a kid, his genitalia did not develop after that and he cannot get an erection or ejaculate. The two friends have feelings for each other but things get messy when they start to explore them…

title: Ai no Kotoba mo Shiranaide
description:
1-3: What Is Love?  
Kojima, the student body vice president, always strives to be number one at everything in school. He normally gets along with the carefree Kurata… until one day Kojima snaps and forces Kurata to have sex with him. So starts their S&M relationship – or is it love…?  
  
4-6: You Are The Worst  
Hiroto and Kota's parents suddenly get married and the pair are forced to play nice and be the perfect brothers, but will it really work?

title: Koutetsu no Baby Leaf
description: Almost a year has passed since Tokio-sempai unexpectedly told Yousuke, a student and lover of plants, "I fell in love with you at first sight!" So every day, Yousuke is continually on the receiving end of Tokio’s relentless attacks. The handsome Tokio, who is also a good student and successful with girls, harasses Yousuke daily, pushing him farther and farther away … or maybe…

title: Pure Blue
description: Close childhood friends Baishan and Wangzi entered the same high school and made another good friend Yangyang. The three of them are getting closer by the day, but it seems like something is quietly changing…

title: Boku wa Sakana
description: A short 16-page oneshot about the relationship between two high school boys who are incapable of admitting their feelings to each other and the girl who perpetuates their anxiety.

title: Koi o Shita Sora no Majika
description:
They loved each other, but they couldn’t tell anyone until graduation...!

As a homeroom teacher, Yahaba was worried about Yumino, his beautiful student who couldn’t make friends. When he visited his dorm and tried to help with his problem, he felt that he could no longer stop.

“I can’t say it now, but I won’t let anyone have you.”

A love story between a popular teacher who was trying his best to conceal his feelings, and a determined, tsundere student~♥

title: We Will Always Find Each Other
description:
In their previous lives, Ivan and Lewis met each other in extraordinary circumstances, with a terminal disease getting in the way, their story ended before it could begin.  
  
Now that they have met again at the university, without a terminal disease and lovers hindering, could they be able to write their own story?  
  
Sometimes destiny can be very capricious…

title: Blind Beast
description:
Violence, splattering blood, homoeroticism, the decadent beauty of the Grand Guignol-esque erotic grotesque… this a collection of dark and dangerous short stories by the master of aesthetic horror, Osada Not.

1 • Moujuu (Horror M: Issue from 1994)

2 • Kaki Goori (Shoujo Friend Suspense & Horror: July 1994)

3 • D-Zaka Chuugaku Shounen Tantei-Bu (Horror M: August 1994)

4 • Mercuro Jigoku (Horror M: October 1994)

5 • 10-En no Shounen (Shoujo Friend Suspense & Horror: January 1995)

6 • Getsurei 15 • Horo Bino… (Horror M: December 1994 *Remake of a 1988 oneshot)

7 • Sasurai no Runna (Suspiria: Feburary 1995)

8 • Yoru no Dobutsuen (Horror M: April 1995)

9 • Shinkyouku (Horror M: October 1995)

10 • Afterword

title: Houkago Hachimitsu
description: Why am I in a place like this…… kissing HIM……?'' Awkward class loner Mitsuo Hanaori has a pet peeve - the handsome and popular Hachiya, who's always at the center of the class. He has soft hair and clear skin, everything comes easy to him, and his voice is easy on the ears - it's all just so irritating…… But Mitsuo can't take his eyes off Hachiya, who scores perfect shots in basketball class, and he twists his ankle as a result. After helping walk Mitsuo to the nurse's office, for some reason Hachiya suddenly brings his face close as if to kiss him!! Mitsuo's freaking out and his heart's pounding like crazy, and to his mortification, his JUNK is responding……! To make things worse, ever since that day, Hachiya's started coming onto him on a daily basis…… Just what the hell is going on!?

title: Who Is He
description: The cheerful and optimistic brother died suddenly. Mu Siyang lurked into the school to investigate the cause of his brother's death. The scares followed: his roommate was a friend; his brother's rumored boyfriend wanted to kill him; all the guests of his brother's work station wanted him... What did my brother go through before he died?

title: Gone with the Wind
description:
Gone with the Wind is a music band romance that revolves around the meteoric rise and eventual fallout of the vocalist-guitarist duo of an underground rock band — *West Wind*.

> "I was the one who made a mistake, and you're the one punishing me." 

The chuunibyo king and the guitarist whom he once betrayed. 

Set during and after *Dr.Solo's Soul Vibration*, it's part of the **Solo Universe** danmei series by Dr. Solo

Vocal x Guitar
Sui Qingchi x Fu Cuo

title: NAN&BEI
description: A muddle-headed father mixes up the paperwork of his fraternal twins. The brothers, living in the north and south respectively, are forced to change cities because of school and learn just how different things are. The new environments present all kinds of unusual problems. See which brother is your favorite in this hilarious manga about everyday life.

title: I Give Up On My First Love As of Today!
description: Adam is a high school boy who has been separated from his childhood crush since he was 9. One day, a handsome model transferred into his class, and the person turns out to be Beau!. Since Beau is so different now, Adam is unsure of how their love will play out

title: Puchi Puri
description: "Please don't cry! I promise, one day, I'll become a strong person, all for your sake!" These were the words of a cute, pure-hearted prince. However, Atsushi is nothing more than an elementary school student! For Yuuji to have his first kiss stolen by this kid, after the horrible experience of being rejected by the guy he confessed to…

title: Gin no Kajitsu
description: Kaede transferred to a boarding school so that he would be able to look for his brother. They had been separated when they were still kids. There, he got to know a popular guy named Senoo Subaru (Kou). Kaede did not really like the presumptuous Senoo at first, but later on he found out that in the underground room where Senoo and his buddies usually met, clues as to his brother’s whereabouts could be found. On top of that, when Kaede’s longing for his brother was getting stronger and stronger, Senoo suddenly said the exact same things that Kaede’s brother had said…

title: Tenderness of Winter
description: The male author of a BL manhua meets one of the men who he used as inspiration when he was finding subjects to draw for a college manhua. This particular subject was tall and handsome, which caused him to fall in love.

title: Dekiai Itokon!
description: Touji's daily routine consists of cooking, doing laundry, and cleaning… Before he knew it, he had become like a househusband, taking care of his extended family, the Udagawas. One day, Touji's cousin Yuuto joins the family and Touji cannot take his eyes off the innocent Yuuto. He even has erotic thoughts about Yuuto. With his feelings spinning out of control, what will happen to this Itokon?!

title: Koi wa Keiyaku no Atode
description:
Consists of a collection of oneshots.  
  
1) Love After Contract I (Koi wa Keiyaku no Atode)  
Kazuto wakes up with a hangover and finds himself lying in bed with a stranger. The stranger, Takasugi, is a young CEO and he announces to him that he bought Kazuto in exchange for one million yen for a month before his arranged marriage.  
  
2) Love After Contract II  
Kazuto continues the contract with Akihiko… Nothing has happened after the last time when they are in the bed together… Kazuto is actually expecting something more than just a dating…but it seems no responds from Akihiko besides kissing… What should Kazuto do…?  
  
3) Kiss Prescription I  
Mutsuki Yuasa, a very dependable & diligent student council vice-president has loved Gaku Tougou, his very soppy friend, since they were childhood neighbours. But now Gaku is taller than him, very popular among girls and bosses about Mutsuki.  
  
4) Kiss Prescription II  
Mutsuki & Gaku's relationship is getting closer but not yet stable

title: Shāshǒu Shèchù Liàn'ài Shǒucè
description: One night, an assassin disguised as a high schooler runs into his drunk neighbor, who plants an unexpected kiss on him. From that moment on, he must keep his secret identity hidden while figuring out how to deal with the “mister” living upstairs.

title: Omowaseburi na Kimi no Tonari
description: Through his friend's introduction, friendly and cheerful Nishino became roommates with Maki, his kouhai in university. Living with the unsociable Maki, whose personality is the opposite of his, makes him feel troubled all the time. But after realizing Maki's kindness and consideration, he gradually felt comfortable being with him. However, at that moment Maki told him: "I like senpai, so I can't stay with you anymore". He can't respond to his feelings but he wants to be with him. Nishino flatly rejected Maki's confession by saying "It's just your delusion" and continued living with him, but…

title: Haikyuu!! - Ichi Byoukan no Rendezvous (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Iwaizumi x Oikawa

title: Hug Kiss Akushu
description: At his older brother's behest, Kazuyuki started teaching English to the art teacher Kamisuwa-sensei. Somehow, it seemed that sensei was in love with his older brother… What was this gloomy feeling? To begin with, what is love? Do words come first, and then the physical part comes after?

title: Take Over Zone
description: Welcome to the lives and tangled loves of the track and field team: stern coach Wada; dedicated and enthusiastic runner Ogasawara; kind and gentle captain Takashima; playful, teasing second year Yamauchi; stoic and bad-tempered Konno; talented former runner Hashimoto Mizuki, who must overcome the past if he wants to run again.

title: Sweet vs. Home
description: Living with a whimsical mother is hard enough for Tatsuya, but he is soon faced with an even bigger challenge: he finds out that his mother has married his teacher, and that right after marriage she suddenly disappeared. The kind hearted Takaoka, her husband, now has the burden of taking care of Tatsuya. They live together and get along fine, but as their bond tightens Tatsuya soon starts having ulterior motives…

title: Ani no Yuujin
description:
The person I like belongs to my deceased brother…   
  
The growing love of the ones left behind.

title: My childhood enemy is acting unusual?!
description: The game anchor that I have always admired and liked is actually my biggest enemy that I have hated since childhood? ! And he has always had feelings towards me?

title: Nitamonodoushina Bokura no Iibun
description: Touma is long time friends with brothers, Yuuto and Akito. A year younger, Akito finally enters the same school as Touma and Yuuto, however, he has been watching Touma from afar... Is Touma being stalked by Akito?!  Akito sulks telling him, "You never pay attention to me," leading their tight friendship towards a closeness they aren't even aware of...

title: Kawaii Anata ni Amai Wana
description:
In the Keisei High School infirmary, the school's doctor is regularly visited by Atsuki, the frail and handsome school prince.   
  
They grow closer over tea and biscuits, but could Atsuki's feelings be real or are they merely being used to escape the loneliness caused by the death of his parents?  
  
Can love bloom successfully between a teacher and their student?

title: Kigurumi Planet
description: One day, university student Narumi Daisuke meets a pink kigurumi rabbit in the street. This kigurumi, named Arita, falls in love at first sight Daisuke! But, no matter where the two meet, it seems that Arita won't take off his bodysuit. To Daisuke, who finds this strange, Arita makes a shocking confession! If he takes off his costume, he will die… "The truth is, I'm an Undergrounder!" Is he for real?!

title: Koiike
description:
Omoigabuchi, a pond with a legend attached: "If two people go in together, they will be bound to each other for life."  
  
The story of three couples who get dragged into this love pond.

title: You are Beautiful
description: College is expensive. After his big brother sacrificed their life savings to pay for his tuition, the last thing Sujin wanted was to burden his new roommate. Little did he know, she was a beautiful older woman?! Minuk, famous writer, ex best friend of Sujin’s brother, and also very gay. She’s letting Sujin stay on one condition: don’t fall in love. More specific: with her. Can he do it? What is her past with his older brother? And why was Sujin chased out of the last college he entered…

title: Yuuwaku Sentiment
description:
Tsukihara, vice-principal of a high school, is having an issue going about doing his everyday job. That issue being, Subaru Hoshino, an A+ student, and vice-president of the student council… a ''good'' boy… at least when in the presence of his teachers and fellow classmates.  
  
But good ol' Hoshino has a rather naughty and possessive side that only Tsukihara knows. Hoshino, on a daily basis, has been harshly violating the confused and hurt Tsukihara. For no other reason but to fulfill his own sexual agenda. Or is there another reason for Hoshino to demand that his vice-principal spread his legs? Is Tsukihara wrong in thinking that his student hates him?  
  
What will be the result of this dangerous 'one-sided relationship'?

title: Koi no Shizuku
description:
1-2) Dripping of Love  
Maya and Narusawa, college students at the same university, start sleeping together in what was supposed to be a purely physical relationship. Maya, however, starts to fall deeper into the relationship and has started to want more. Will real love mess up the relationship they have now? The bittersweet story of two people troubled by love.  
  
3) The Distance That Your Voice Touches  
Miyakawa's upstairs neighbor Tsukasa is always dropping things onto his balcony, and of course Miyakawa has to return them, only to be fed dinner and sexually harassed! It's getting to be too much for the poor college student.  
  
4) I Want to Embrace  
High school student Takase is unwittingly drawn to cheerful energetic Sora. But as his interest and naturally protective feelings toward his friend become something deeper and more dangerous, Takase begins to pull away from Sora.  
  
5) Shake  
Kikusui is a waiter in a cafe with primarily female clientele, but lately a handsome ma

title: Haikyu!! - Clumsy!! (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama Tobio x Hinata Shouyou

Kageyama dreams with Hinata in his ero dreams. Just the though of him doing it with Hinata made him realize how much he loves. Although he starts avoiding Hinata; Hinata in other hand who doesn’t understand the situation gets pissed of. Will Kageyama confess?

title: Achira Kochira Bokura
description: One day, Majima, one of everyone’s favorite person in class, gets to see a surprising side to Sonoki, the class introvert. Since then, Majima can’t help but notice Sonoki and call out to him for no reason, hoping for any kind of reaction… When Sonoki turns red and gets all shy like that, how can Majima not fall in love with him? But when it’s time to go up a grade, they’re not in the same class anymore…

title: Baka Demo Kawaii Hito Dakara
description: Two boys with opposite personalities still manage to get along quite well… even if they each think that the other might be an idiot.

title: Tonari ni Iru no ni, Tooi
description: Nagisa's good friend, Igarashi Taiga, is the popular guy at their university. After being compared to Taiga, Nagisa keeps wondering who would in fact make a better lover. He questions Taiga, who demonstrates his skills with a hot kiss… What will come after that?

title: Love Letter Of Flowers
description:
1: Love Letter Of Flowers  
Someone has been giving the new music teacher origami flowers, and he's not quite sure who or why. But a single student comes to mind whenever he thinks about it.  
  
2: Your Prisoner  
Sasaki catches Mikami, one of his students, going through his things one day and accuses him of trying to steal test questions. He then uses this as a chance to get his hands on Mikami… by blackmailing him into having sex with him.  
  
3: I Don't Deal Well With Kinoshita-kun  
Kinoshita has fallen for his teacher and keeps trying to seduce him, which makes dealing with Kinoshita rather difficult. But no matter what his teacher does, Kinoshita just won't give up.  
  
4: Tomorrow Again In The Library  
Kigawa spends his time studying in the library to see the senpai that he likes. One day he helps younger student Adachi with his homework… just to get him to shut up. From then on Adachi just won't leave Kigawa alone.  
  
5: Craving Experience With Love  
Otsukawa has always

title: Nanda Koitsu!
description: Học sinh lớp 10 Kato, vì không giỏi ăn nói cùng cặp mắt dữ dằn nên cậu bị cô lập trong lớp.Một ngày nọ, lúc cậu đang chán nản vì những tin đồn thất thiệt thì thấy đàn anh lớp trên Usaki gặp rắc rối với đám du cônUsaki rất có hảo cảm với Kato vì đã giúp mình. Anh đã mời Kato vào câu lạc bộ, theo dõi, thậm chí là bắn tên vào Kato để thu hút sự chú ý!?Tình yêu trong sáng giữa cậu nhóc trông đáng sợ nhưng vụng về cùng anh chàng xinh đẹp kì quái.

title: Haikyuu!! - Jigsaw Puzzle no Ai to Yume (Doujinshi)
description: Hinata isn't getting much sleep these days because of a strange recurring dream–one that only Kageyama can free him from.

title: Alliance of Unrequited Love
description: Yu-han and Tae-yun form a one-sided love alliance as they enter High School. Yu-han, who falls in love quickly, immediately falls in love. Tae-yun, who always viewed Yu-han as pitiful, soon also develops a crush. And both slowly became more aware of each other.

title: What to Do if My Cotenant Is My Love-Rival?
description: Because of his cousin's "mistake", the good boy Song Shuzhi lives in a shared apartment with his rival, Zhou Xu. Zhou Xu is a cynical playboy, and Song Shuzhi disregards him. The lives of the two are also chaotic. But later, an inexplicable feeling filled the two of them...

title: Tian Zi Yu Dun
description:
Lu Qi An, I want you.  
(Adapted from Zhang Pei Literature Network "Tian Zi Yu Dun", Original Author "Jiu Yue Mai De Bing Gan")

title: Haikyuu!! - Caramel Panic (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Hinata and Kageyama are dating, and while Kageyama can be a little cold and aloof, Hinata is enjoying every aspect of their relationship otherwise–until he learns that in middle school, Kageyama was quick to dump a girlfriend whenever she became too annoying, so Hinata starts planning on how to make sure Kageyama never tires of him.

title: My Last Love Scenario
description: College is a time of freedom, learning, and, let's be honest, sex. Juhyun and Jigoo spent most of their high school years studying and keeping their relationship a secret from everyone in their lives. But now, they've moved out which means no curfew, no rules, and no roommates. But they're about to learn that taking their relationship to the next level means taking on some new challenges, too.

title: Trop Beau
description: He was perfect and had incredible beauty but a demon stole his beauty. To break the spell, he is convinced that he must kiss Prince Charming within the year!

title: Konna Otoko wa Aisareru
description:
Sonekawa Retsu, the high school karate club captain, has been in love with the student body president, Kaji Shogo, since junior high. He even went as far as volunteering for the position of student body secretary in order to be close to him.  
  
Retsu has never thought of confessing his feelings, but his constant heated stares don't leave Kaji unaware of the situation. However, this bashful late bloomer needs serious help…  
  
Would love finally blossom between these two men from different worlds?

title: Prism Spectrum
description:
From Attractive Fascinante:  
  
Oomura Yuu's first kiss was stolen by the beautiful Student Council president, Takamura Mitsuya. He later became his executive secretary and his duty was to do whatever Takamura wanted. Both loved cats and were slowly drawn towards each other. As much as Yuu wanted to acknowledge his own feelings, he realised that he might not really knew about Takamura at all. In the end, Yuu decided to follow his heart and reach out to Takamura.

title: Scarlet
description:
1-2) Scarlet   
College student Akio is dating his beautiful classmate, Ryou. Unable to stand the slightest loneliness, Ryou accepts any girl who approaches him. One day, Ryou introduces Akio to a girl he is thinking of marrying which makes Akio decide to completely break it off with Ryou. Instead, a heart wrenching love story takes stage!  
  
3-4) One Night Stand  
During the day Harumi is just a normal businessman but when night comes he changes into a different person.  
  
5) My Lover  
Keito wonders why he is still in a relationship with the overly depressive Naoki

title: Zantei, Koibito
description:
1-3:  
They'd been drunk. Or, more specifically, his boss had been drunk. So when Sakamoto jumped him, Kurahashi just went along with it. After all, it was just the alcohol…right?  
  
Wrong! At least, that's what his boss thinks…and said boss doesn't have a problem trying out a relationship with a colleague he thinks is in love with him. Unable to gainsay him, Kurahashi gets dragged into a relationship he never asked for – and finds himself getting deeper than he ever imagined.  
  
4:  
Two childhood friends who abruptly drifted apart years ago are reunited. One of them is now a Buddhist monk… What does his friend feel about this?  
  
5:  
The shy, reclusive, bespectacled Egawa confessed to Aoki on high-school graduation day…and was politely turned down. The two unexpectedly reunite in university, but to Aoki's surprise, Egawa has become a completely different person who's very popular with the ladies! But why does this cause strange, conflicting emotions within Aoki?

title: Don't Tell Him
description: It mainly tells the subtle emotional story between two boys. In this world, there will never be such a person who relays love for me.

title: Kanbinaru Okurimono
description: The fight-loving Mitsuru has two dreams. One: to inherit his mother's cake shop, and two: to make his childhood friend Shiota his. After making a satisfactory cake, his plan is to confess to Shiota, however, Shiota intends to attend a college far away?! This the sweet love story between a sadistic class president and a pure delinquent!

title: Haikyuu!! - Kimi no Tonari ni Itai na (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Kageyama and Hinata are now college students. This series looks at the development of their relationship as they grow closer.

title: You Benshi Ni Zai Xiong Yige?
description: The school tyrant Shen YiChen is looking for trouble with the genius student Ji YuMing?! The lives of two campus figures who originally wouldn’t have crossed each other’s paths in this lifetime, become entangled because of a particular “diary”. As Shen YiChen continues to pick fights with Ji YuMing, he realizes that this model student doesn’t seem like the type who’d “do such things to his younger cousin brother”. At the same time, looking at the easily ruffled wild school tyrant in front of him, Ji YuMing gradually gets the hang of smoothing out his ruffled feathers...

title: Uchi no Ouji Irimasen ka
description: Haruka was always weak as a child, unable to normally attend school. Nevertheless, he dreamed of going to school as a regular person, and his wish finally came true. As a result, he is a rare specimen, innocent in the ways of the world, giving him the nickname of "Prince". Follow him in his new school life as he makes friends and befriends one friend, Ryouhei, a little more specially. This is a cute, innocent story.

title: Sentimental Garden Lover
description:
Love is found in the strangest places and with the most unexpected partners. The men (and cats!) of Sentimental Garden Lover burst into heart-throbbing bloom!  
  
A scruffy stray cat wishes for big hands to hold an abused man, and a cute kitten begs for speech to comfort a broken-hearted stranger. Wander further into the garden, and you'll find close siblings upset by a love rival; a jaded delinquent flustered by a trusting bookworm; an evasive, glasses-hating man; and a president eager to find a weakness in his perfect secretary.  
  
For both cat and human, the quest for love is here!

title: Mahoutsukai no Koi
description: Without worries about girls or money, halfheartedly living Nishizaki meets the love of his life on campus. A lover who bites his lips when happy… Araya is always troublesome, gloomy, and without desire. Thinking of him, Nishizaki’s teeth always hurt…

title: Lick
description: Truyện kể về Murao, một cậu bạn thích người bạn cùng lớp -Adachi- của mình đến mức muốn liếm lông mi, mắt, môi, màu tóc và cả da của Adachi. Một ngày nọ, Murao bị thương khi đang học thể dục, Adachi đã bất ngờ hôn cậu và nói cậu muốn được Murao thích nhiều thứ khác của cậu hơn chứ không chỉ là khuôn mặt!?

title: Crown Craze
description:
In a room lie the two real brothers, the 17-year-old Kuruto and the 15 year old Enishi. —This is the good night kiss— They have been together since they were small. It was a natural thing for them to spend time together but that is slowly starting to change.  
  
The day the relationship between the two of them becomes awkward is when Kuruto returns home after a long time. The brothers attitude towards each other are so different and suddenly Kuruto tells the younger brother “Don’t think of saying you love me again”…?

title: Hate You, Love You
description:
I hate you!!  
The first word the strange little boy shouted at me?!  
We’ve been knowing each other since the early childhood. He’s been around me all the time.   
Does he hate me or love me?!

title: The Courage to be Disliked
description: The story of a boy who always worries about pleasing others on campus, Yu Gan Yi, often feels that his future is not bright, until he meets Cai Peixi, a boy who is the complete opposite of him…

title: Listen to You
description: While at the get-together party, Cheng Jiahong recalled getting acquainted with his close friend, Qi Wenrui. Due to his grades being in the last rank and having to repeat the same grade again, it was arranged that Cheng Jiahong be seatmates with the class committee member Qi Wenrui. The two became familiar with each other as they spent their days together. "A life under the pressure of both specialized and literacy classes is very tiring, but, thankfully I'm not alone."

title: Mamotte Banken-kun
description: “Masa chó dại”, một gã trùm trường sừng sỏ của trường cấp 3, lại từng có quá khứ là một cậu nhóc yếu đuối và mít ướt, luôn ám ảnh vì bị “tình đầu” từ chối. Masa tình cờ gặp Sora – một cậu ấm có khuôn mặt giống với cô gái tình đầu đã từ chối mình lúc nhỏ, và được yêu cầu trở thành “chó canh” – bảo vệ cho Sora. Những rung động chớm nở bắt đầu từ đây, liệu chuyện tình của họ có suôn sẻ?!

title: Akiru made Hanasou yo
description: Trying to avoid being so popular with women, the legendary girl-magnet Takeuchi transfers to an all-boys school. Once there, he can’t help but wonder why Iida, who he’s known for a while, always eats his lunch early. At first he only thought him a little strange, but before he realized it, he found himself following him with his eyes all the time. The two become close by Iida sharing his bento. Being with the fun-loving Iida every day turns Takeuchi’s dull days into fun ones?! A series about the tantalizing love between a wholesome young man sharing his bento with a girl-magnet, a gorgeous masterpiece compilation including an extra, and one of the first pieces written in the name “Uchida Kaoru”!!

title: Trompe-l'œil no Yubisaki
description:
1) *Dazzling*  
College student Keisuke often picks up his younger brother from elementary school, and talks with handsome Murakami-sensei. As they gradually become closer Keisuke finds himself thinking about Murakami in more than friendly terms.  
  
2) *The Flow of String*  
Yamazaki sensei finds himself paying special attention to archery club student Yagi. At first Yagi is just his cute student, but as his body matures Yamazaki's feelings for the boy begin to change as well.  
  
3) *A Cracked Pot with a Battered Lip*  
Super-pervert Haruto started his relationship with Masumi by asking him weird questions, and later graduated to kinky sex play. But suddenly Haruto starts asking other people his questions, is Masumi going to be dumped?  
  
4) *The Shadows Under the Tree*  
When Takuma's father remarried he acquired an older brother as well. But three years later his stepmother has passed away and Takuma is well on his way to becoming a deliquent. Something dark and disturbing is h

title: Hoshigarimasen! Katsumade wa
description: Beautiful and popular Nakatani Hiyori has fallen in love with his dormitory roommate and underclassman, Amano Kasumi. But being in the same room with the one you love day in and day out is a strain. From here, there is only one way to advance.

title: FanFic Sensitivity
description: A not-so-cute story of the cute ones.

title: Haikyu!! - Soushoku-kei Kareshi to Nikushoku-kei Kareshi (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Hinata is distressed about Kageyama’s current behavior, and asks help from his fellow teammates.

title: Ani wa Motokare
description: To please his crush, Kunishige Yuu, an ordinary middle schooler, stole his brother’s invitation to a photography exhibition. However, he never would have thought he’d encounter an intimidating long-haired guy at the very place, who seemed to be his brother’s acquaintance… or even more than that, his brother’s ex-boyfriend…?

title: Ai wo Kudasai
description:
"Even though you are a playboy, kissing so clumsily breaks the rules!"  
  
Uncommitted playboy teacher Kurosawa does not refuse anyone who comes to him. His serious student Mamoru hates playboys and is appalled by his teacher's behavior. After accidentally witnessing Kurosawa and his girlfriend fighting, Mamoru instinctively scolds him. But Kurosawa suddenly says "I like guys like you," and gently hugs him.

title: Obstinate Fellows
description: Yuu developed feelings for Aoyama, who saved from him ex-delinquent days. Everything has been going well until the appearance of Nobunaga who seems hell-bent on ruining Yuu's life. But what is Nobunaga really after…

title: Omae de Nakya Dame Mitai
description: For Suwa, a hunk like himself needs a pretty girl by his side. Theoretically. But in fact, he's going out with four-eyed, average looking Fujisaki. It's just a temporary relationship for Suwa – only until he finds a girlfriend… But then, why does he feel so guilty when he takes an interest in someone else?

title: Kawaru Sekai
description: Momose, a first year in his school's Kendo Club, finds himself attracted to his senior, Minagawa. However, knowing Momose's feelings, Ikeda flaunts the fact that he is going out with Minagawa. On the other hand, Fujiyoshi, Minagawa's classmate, happens upon Minagawa and Ikeda kissing, and finds himself harbouring new feelings for his friend, Yamashita. In the Kendo Club, Professor Izumi can't stop thinking about one of his students…

title: Momoiro Shoukougun
description:
Collection of stories:  
  
1) Big Brother is my classmate  
Hikari became brothers with his classmate Hyuuga through their parent's remarriage. Although he never had much contact with Hyuuga up till then, after they started living together, Hikari sees a side of Hyuuga beyond his imagination. Including his surprising weakness to skinship! After that, Hikari begins to make fun of Hyuuga, but…  
2) Pink Syndrome  
3) Teasing Suggestion  
4) VS the pastry shop across the street  
5) The cute rude person  
6) Cleanness library  
7) Cowardly warmth

title: Meng Never Falls in Love
description: This is the bitter story of Meng and his unsuccessful love life. He obviously wants to fall in love but it almost always doesn't go as planned.

title: Asobi Janai no
description:
1-2: Ren'ai Han'i 1%  
Kagami and Fukamachi are two friends who both secretly love each other. One day, Kagami tells Fukamachi that he's interested in his sister Lisa, upon which Fukamachi reluctantly decides to take Kagami home to see Lisa. Now Kagami is faced with showing Fukamachi how he feels before he's forced to go out with a girl he doesn't love…  
  
3: Urahara na Koi  
Kyouya, a socially awkward college student, has trouble smiling and gets bullied at school. What happens when he stumbles into high school student Akira when he's out drinking?  
  
4: S ni Ochita Seinen  
Kyouya is in love with Shirou, his business partner, but Shirou already has a lover?!  
  
5: Don't Worry About It!  
Ryuusei has long been in love with the carefree and friendly Nagisa, who on the other hand is oblivious of Ryuusei's feelings for him. The day comes when Ryuusei has had enough and he confesses to Nagisa by issuing an ultimatum: to become his lover or to stop all contact with him. Now, what wil

title: Menkui!
description:
It’s hard to be in high school, especially when you live in the shadow of your stunningly attractive older brother. It only gets worse when the really cute guy from the class next to yours starts hanging around your house, presumably to catch a glimpse of said older brother.  
  
But things are not always as they seem! Kotori is often teased for being superficial, and with a brother like Kujaku, you can’t really blame him for thinking that looks are everything. However, once Akaiwa steps into his life, Kotori is heading for a lesson in deep trust and abiding love.  
  
There’s a lot more under the surface that he’s finally going to get a chance to see!  
  
Also contain the following oneshots:  
  
V.1  
- Skip  
- Poem of the Red Poppy  
  
V.2  
- Flower Light  
- Flower Storm  
  
V.3  
- Endless Gaze (Gyoshi no Hate)  
- Muddy Stream

title: Boku wa Kimi no Tori ni Naritai
description:
Koyama Kei lost his mother when he was still in elementary school and never connected again with his distant, workaholic father. The only real light in his home life is his sister Moe: a bright college student who obviously adores him. But Kei has intimacy issues that even his sister can't pick up on.   
  
At 15 years old, Kei's never been in love, but he has sex with anyone who shows him interest. While he's in someone else's arms, he can forget the void in his own life. One day in late spring, Koyama discovers what's missing: a slightly spacey med-student named Fujii. Unfortunately, Fujii is his sister's boyfriend…

title: Yubisaki wa Koi no Aji
description:
1-5) Fingertips' Love  
Hajime and Eiji, who were childhood friends, have been reunited at an all-boy's high school (oh, the possibilities). Their friendship is still as strong, but it seems as Eiji is ready to confess. Will Hajime accept the confession? How many other boys in this school will be joining the boi love craze? And will anyone ever call Uncle Kai-Sensei?  
  
6) Playing with Fire  
Masao, who was dumped, decided to flee home to the countryside to get over his heartbreak.  
  
7) Extras

title: Shinshikyoutei wo Musubou!
description: Upon entering Takamanohara Academy, Waka meets Moriya, a strange boy who seems to know him, though the feeling isn't mutual. Despite not knowing who Moriya is, Waka feels a strange pull to him. When he gets an invitation to the mysterious "Gentleman's Meeting", Waka can't help but be fascinated and a little worried all in one. Upon entering the Shrine's archways, Waka's future becomes increasingly unclear.

title: I’ll Get My Deskmate to Hit You
description:
The poor little top-scorer was bullied, so he transferred from a high-ranked high school to an ordinary one.

Class teacher: Zhan Ming, look at the score you got!
Zhan Ming: I'll ask my deskmate to teach me.
Former classmate: Gu Qinan, don't think we can't find you just because you transferred.
Gu Qinan: I'll tell get my deskmate to hit you.

title: Reverse!?
description: A math teacher unwittingly formulates a love triangle with two diabolical variables divided over him. Unhappy teaching at an all boys school, the heterosexual Amamiya entertains his bitterness by toying with an adoring student. The surprising interference of the boy's fierce former friend, however, places Amamiya at the center of a wildly twisted tug-of-war. Teacher and student: a taboo love affair gone… comedy?

title: Kaze no Yukue
description:
Kento and Akira's sweet romance continues… Miraculously, it's been a whole year since the ultra-conservative Kento and the ridiculously flamboyant playboy, Akira, started dating. Though Kento's grandparents have, so far, managed to survive their grandson's gay relationship, Akira still has some secrets that just might send them to their early graves. Should Kento be more concerned about his family's opinion of him, or his high-maintenance lover's extreme complexes? Sweet and funny, this is the story of two people who couldn't be more different, or more perfect for each other.s opinion of him, or his high-maitanance lover's deep-seated social inferiority complex?  
  
An extremely sweet (and funny) story of two people who couldn't be more different, or more perfect for each other.

title: From the moon to the stars
description: Kim Jonghyun is a freshman student who just started questioning his feelings for his best friend, Ren. As the story progresses, both of them will or will not realize how they really feel, you'll have to read to discover!

title: Chou ni Naru Hi
description:
1) The Day I Become a Butterfly  
There is a rumor going around school that Mikami can “hear” when one’s death is near. Uka has just turned fifteen, but doesn’t know how much longer he’ll live… Will the budding love between Mikami and Uka have a happy ending?  
  
2) You At the End (Hate Ni Aru Kimi)  
A short story about a guy sick of this world and the silent, unlikely boy who anchors him to it.  
  
3) The Lonely War  
Can men and women have platonic friendships? Suzu is determined to try.  
  
4) Blue Cat's Tunnel  
A story about one girl's hope to find a way out of her life…  
  
5) Tokyo Alien Yulala  
A young student's trouble understanding his classmate makes him think the boy may be an alien.  
  
6) Planet Yours  
An abused boy has trouble relying on his friends.

title: Ijiwaru na Kuchizuke
description:
1) Kinou yori mo Sukoshi dake (A Little More Than Yesterday)  
  
2) Sono Te wo Hiraite (Open Your Hands)  
  
3-4) Ijiwaru na Kuchizuke  
One day Yuu, a second year high school student, meets his classmate’s older brother Maya. Being an only child, Yuu has always idolized the thought of an older brother. However Maya, who’s selfish and likes to pick on Yuu, is completely different than anything he’s ever imagined; saying things like, "you really are cute," and kissing him all of a sudden?!  
  
5-6) Mabuta wo Kurikaeshite  
  
7) Eine Kleine  
  
8) Matataki wo Kurikaeshite: Sono Ato  
  
Also comes with atogaki, and some copies come with an extra 4-page booklet for the story "Ijiwaru na Kichizuke."

title: His Feelings
description:
“I don’t want to fall in love with anyone.” That’s what Wataru told himself, not expecting his encounter with Satago, a tall, blond and thug-looking guy, who speaks his mind a little too bluntly and seems particularly interested in his schoolmate’s lack of expressiveness.   
Chapter deleted due to the demands of the author.

title: The Portrait of A and B
description:
In a village encircled by strange rumors of a certain estate, Yoon "A," an average high school boy, is suddenly dumped with a single handwritten letter. As A retraces the clues his (ex)girlfriend left behind in order to discover the reasons behind her decision, he becomes closer to Shin "B," the slightly gloomy and strange student librarian...

*The 1st Lezhin Comics BL Contest Grand Prize Winner!*

title: Senobi no Housoku
description: A transfer student enters the class of Kousuke, a second-year in high school. Raku is tall and good-looking, the exact opposite of the shrimpy Kousuke, and very popular with the girls. Kousuke was jealous of Raku at first, until Raku comes clean about a certain secret, and asks Kousuke not to tell anyone. Ever since then, Raku seems to have taken a liking to Kousuke, and all of a sudden, they become really close! This is a high-school romantic-comedy about a mismatched pair!

title: I Want a Painting Brush
description: Despite his family’s opposition, Cheng Qian runs away to attend a Fine Arts Academy. Penniless, he must work while also attending classes, pushing his mind and body beyond exhaustion. At that moment, he meets Xu Qiujin, who is the complete opposite of him. His art, and everything about him, is enviable. One single life-changing moment causes them to become tangled up in each other's lives...

title: Dousaibou Seibutsu
description:
1-3: Same Cell Organism, I Love You, Lullaby In My Hand  
Nakagawa and Yokota are two boys very much in love with each other. Yokota is more open with his feelings, while Nakagawa is easily embarrassed by public displays of affection. Though they may be outwardly different, their feelings for each other are the same. Their connection is such that they liken themselves to same-cell organisms.  
  
4: The Letter In The Attic  
Two lonely boys visit a favourite spot.  
  
5-6: To Make An Angel  
An angel follows a young boy throughout his life.  
  
7: We Selfish Two  
Sora is in love with Midori, a kindergarten teacher.

title: 6-banme no Megane
description: Chuunri's in a predictament - he's newest boyfriend doesn't seem to be interested in being intimate, so he goes to his previous boyfriend for advice. Of course, a little jealousy never hurts to get some action going.

title: Like Blue Like Summer
description:
《This is a story about the time I spent with that person, which was as quick as a blink of an eye, but which I will never forget.》

Dan was the basketball club's first-year ace and had been drawing attention from the club.

However, with the IH approaching, he was injured and needed a month and a half to recover, and now he was in the depths of despair.

He tried to attend club activities for the first time in a while, but felt uncomfortable, and just as he was about to leave, he was harassed by some delinquents.

Then, Kaito, a third-year student he had never met, suddenly appeared, helped him and asked him to come to the art club after school...!?

[Innocent basketball boy x mysterious art club member], an unforgettable summer love begins, a fresh depiction of the youth and struggles of a high school boy.

title: Yume wo Miru Hima mo Nai
description: Kawamura Kazuya had dreamt of being a pilot as a child. Thus, when he heard of an aviation school five hours from where he stayed, Kawamura enrolled without giving it much thought. He was assigned a room with his two new roommates. One of them, Itou, dropped out when he couldn't stand the tough life. This left Kawamura with Yoshitake, a tall, quiet and non-responsive guy.

title: Sekai wa Temee de Mawatteru
description: As a transfer student to a rough, run-down school populated by delinquents, Shindou tries his best to make friends. When he meets the ill-mannered Yousuke, heartbeats and tempers start to fly! It seems Yousuke is a "tsundere" – his gruff exterior hides a shy, sensitive side – and Shindou immediately finds himself dizzy over his combative new crush. Can Yousuke accept a relationship that goes against his tough-guy image? Or will his tendency to lash out at everyone around him drive even the earnest Shindou away for good?

title: Plus 20cm no Kyori
description: Hidaka Atsushi and Sakaki Youichi have known each other since senior high school, and are now attending the same college. They share a "rotten relationship", according to Atsushi, who, at one time, gave in to temptation and slept with his friend. Disgruntled about having to play the "bottom" role – since Youichi is 20cm taller than him – Atushi seeks out a smaller, cute boy to whom he can play the role of seme.

title: Thirsty for Love
description: Orie Nakano's girlfriend is cheating on him with two other men! One is the mysteriously untouchable Tatsumi, and the other is the basketball-playing upperclassman that Orie idolizes. But things are far from being as simple as they seem, and now the three men are inevitably pulled towards each other and bond together by their love for Yuka, which extends much farther than just the girl herself. Love, admiration and lust intermingle around them in an inescapble spiral in this coming of age sexy romance.

title: Koi o Kataranai Kuchibiru
description:
"Having sex without love. All gay men do this, right?"  
  
University student Kawamoto has had a string of one-night stands. One day, he meets a university employee called Kuroki, and tries to bed him. "Do you always do stuff like this?" Kuroki has been in love with one of the school professors for 7 years. "I'm happy just being by his side." That unwavering dedication captures Kawamoto's heart… If love is solely loving someone, doesn't that just invite pain…?

title: Trouble Love Candy
description: The experienced Inspector Kazuhiko and the pre-graduate Michihisa are a loving homosexual couple. But Kazuhiko is always busy and seems to constantly find himself in trouble while Michihisa gets into just as much trouble himself! Frustrated with the little time they have together, Kazuhiko seeks help from Michihisa but the latter, not wanting to bother the already work-overloaded Kazuhiko, continually attempts to solve these problems on his own…

title: Haikyu!! - Koisuru Wakusei (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Kageyama is being harangued by girls confessing to him–so Sugawara offers him a helpful suggestion: find someone to pretend to be dating to throw them off.

title: Dāng Bùliáng Lǎodà de Nánrén
description: Because of his involvement in a fight, the school's star student, Xu QingSong, becomes acquainted with the young delinquent, Zhu Chen, and falls in love with him at first sight. Then, for various reason, Xu QingSong becomes the boss of a gang. He launches an offensive against Zhu Chen, who is now his second-in-command, and leads the Sea Flower Gang on a rampage to… er… to rectify the town of Taifang.

title: Soshite Boku wa Koi wo Suru
description:
1, 5 - Catamountain  
Even though the President of the Student Council, Aoyagi, isn’t much of a fighter, he's still determined to bust any troublemakers in school. It’s a good thing that he can always rely on his strong and dependable kouhai, Hayami, the Treasury of the Student Council, to watch his back. Until one day, Hayami drew him close and demanded, “I want to embrace you”…!?  
  
2, 3 - Moe Love  
Riku is in love with Chisato, a bishoujo anime otaku, that doesn't see anything other than his moe figurines. Will Riku be able to win his love?  

4 - One More Kiss  
Taiga comes home one day to find a stranger in his house, eating his cup nuddles. The stranger, Higuchi, is a very talented illustrator, and his style is very similar to someone Taiga knew when he was in high school. Someone Taiga had forced himself upon…

title: Haikyu!! - Itoshii Hanpi (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama Tobio/Hinata Shouyou  
  
Hinata has a problem–he’s in love with Kageyama, and he knows that’s just asking for trouble. Since he can’t stop loving Kageyama, he decides to be as annoying and frustrating as possible in the hopes that he’ll piss off Kageyama enough that he’ll eventually get fed up with him and hate Hinata, thereby freeing him to no longer be in love.

title: Neko no Me no Horoscope
description:
6: Saitei na Anata to Aki no Sora (The Worst You and the Autumn Sky)  
Nanami thinks his senior is a really awful guy, but still he can’t help but like him. When his senior gets dumped, what will he do?

title: Stargazing with You
description:
Also known as *Samoyed and Husky*, the story primarily revolves around a pair of childhood friends from kindergarten until university. It also touches on aspects of cybersecurity. 

Part of the **Solo Universe** danmei series by Dr. Solo

Bai Ying x Jiang He

title: Doko e mo Yukenai Ki ga Shiteta
description: Two students, one popular and the other an antisocial loner seemingly unconnected except by the window's reflection but looking past the surface perhaps they have more in common than either thought.

title: Meguriau yo Baby
description: Yoshizawa Kuuya, a high-schooler, grew up in a single-parent family. Because his mother was an unpopular actress, he had to work part-time as a pizza delivery boy. While making his deliveries one day, he accidentally met a gay couple arguing and one of them was his sensei, Kakei Yuuichi. After that, they started to get closer. Was it a coincidence or destiny?

title: Like Days
description: After attending his high school schoolmate, Qin Xiao Shang's funeral, Xu Zhou is back to the time when he was in high school due to an accident. This time, his family is no longer fallen apart, and his friends are still by his side. As for Qin Xiao Shang, who will meet his fate in a few years, he is still that teen who secretly draws Xu Zhou in a corner… Everything is repeating once again, Xu Zhou felt that regardless of his high school grades or his future, he could still be rescued.

title: Hachi x Ritsu
description:
Hachi & Ritsu were childhood friends who grew up in the countryside doing everything together despite their vastly different backgrounds. Hachi begins viewing Ritsu in a different light and, plagued by thoughts he deems impure, runs away from his beloved Ritsu.

Can Ritsu confront his friend and learn the real reason why he ran away all those years ago?

title: Yuukyuu no Kanata
description:
Collection of short stories.  
  
1-2. Yuukyuu no Kanata  
Yuki and Hisakuni are twin brothers. Kanata, their childhood friend, was abused by his father in his own home so is staying with Yuki, Hisakuni, and their grandmother. The three were always close, but after an accident Hisakuni loses sight in one eye. Also after the accident Yuki and Kanata become lovers. Hisakuni tries to hide his love for Kanata and watches over the two but still feels a large gap forming in between them, while Yuki’s love for Kanata begins to grow, it become too large to handle. One day, Hisakuni tries to ask Kanata for the whole story of the accident that cost him his eye, but Kanata pushes him away and runs. A truck is headed toward Kanata, and Yuki and Hisakuni both run to save him. What will be of their tangled fate —?  
  
3. Yunatama  
A yaoi little mermaid! French Orion washes up on the shore of a small Japanese island with no memories of himself, other than his name. He's taken in by pretty teenager

title: Haikyu!! - Do You Know Anything About TPO, Kageyama-kun?! (Doujinshi)
description: Kageyama has an annoying habit of kissing Hinata where all and sundry can see, and Hinata needs him to learn a thing about appropriateness regarding TPO–time, place, and occasion.

title: Tsureteke Tengoku
description: High school student Fumiya possesses the ability to see things normal people can't: ghosts and spirits. Each time Fumiya sees one, he turns to the tall, handsome, and popular Shogo, the son of a temple priest, for help. After being rescued time after time by Shogo, Fumiya can't resist developing certain feelings toward his savior. Watch as ghosts and spirits work to drive these two together!

title: Gotsugou Simulation
description: Riku spends his high school life with his cute and outgoing boyfriend, Yaichi. However, there is a secret linked to their happy relationship…

title: Shouten
description:
A 6-book dojinshi mook series by CLAMP. Each book consists of manga and text Short stories.

List of stories:
Shoten  1:
1. となりのいんど人 (Apapa Mokona, 17p)
2. 302号室の変人 (Mick Nekoi, 4p)
3. カルラ舞う! (Tamayo Akiyama, 5p)
1. RG VEDA外伝 (Sei Nanao, 10p)
3. 日常茶飯事I (Leeza Sei, 1p)
4. 日常茶飯事II (Leeza Sei, 1p)
5. 青年の末来 ([Short story] Text: Satsuki Igarashi, Illustration: Tamayo Akiyama, 7p)
6. 誕生日 (Shinya Ohmi, 2p)
7. 101号室の住人 (Mick Nekoi, 4p)
1. 人生いろいろ (O-Kyon, 2p)
1. [Illustration] (Shinya Ohmi)
1. Y'S (Tamayo Akiyama, 3p)
1. [Illustration] (Shinya Ohmi)
8. ウィ一クエンドスクランブル (Leeza Sei, 48p)
9. 初恋/はつこい ([Short story] Text: Kazue Nakamori, Illustration: 福本睦 Mutsumi Fukumoto, 14p)
10. PASSENGER! (Soshi Hisagi, 8p)
1. PASSENGER 番外編1 (Soshi Hisagi, 1p)
1. PASSENGER 番外編2 (Soshi Hisagi, 1p)
1. 妹之山家の一族 ([Short story] Original story: CLAMP42年組 CLAMP 42 Nen Gumi, Text: Ohkawa Nanase, Illustration: Leeza Sei/Sei Nanao/Apapa Mokona, 26p)
1. 妹之山家の一族 NG (CLAMP 42 Nen Gumi, 2p)
1. SECRECY (CLAMP 42 Nen Gumi, 6p)

Sho

title: Sekai wa, Kimi no Toumei
description:
During the spring of his senior year in high school, Keito tours a nearby college campus and has his heart stolen by the acting performance of Yukichika when his film club's shooting a scene in the middle of falling cherry tree petals...

Yukichika was in the middle of acting out the scene, but since Keito walked right into it, they stopped filming and started searching for a different location.
When Keito asks who he is, he says, "I'm just a creator."

It turns out this chance encounter is what changes Keito's destiny and begins a "love story" in the "world" he lives in...

title: Kusatta Kyoushi no Houteishiki
description: Atsushi Arisawa enrolls at Jougaouka High School to be near Masami Shibata (Ma-chan) who was his childhood crush. Unbeknownst to Atsushi, however, Masami no longer works at the school and his brother, Masayoshi is now the nurse. Atsushi mistakes Masayoshi for Masami and is horrified because to him, it appears that Masami's personality has done a complete 180. Add to the fact that Atsushi's friend, Kouji Inagaki is totally in love and constantly trying to make-out with him, Atsushi's life at Jougaoka is hell until he starts thinking that maybe the new Ma-chan isn't so bad after all and that, maybe he actually likes the way Ma-chan is now. Until of course, he finds out that Masayoshi isn't Masami.

description: High school student Yuki Mukai is gay and out of the closet. His classmate Makoto Moriya can't stop thinking about him. Why? Because the two of them are "the same". A series depicting the lives of authentic youths in modern-day Japan.

title: Nise Moteo ni Renai Shinan wa Nigaomoi

"Master, please make me a man."

Yuma Hotaka has been changing schools all the time and has little connection with his friends. Not wanting to be forgotten after transferring schools, he came up with the idea of creating a strong character to live his school life.
He now plays the role of a popular guy who has girlfriends all over the place, and together with his prince-like appearance, he has succeeded in becoming a popular guy.
In reality, however, he is a pure-hearted boy who has never been in a relationship, let alone kissed anyone.
Then, a real popular guy, Tadashi Someya, transfers to Hotaka's class!
Hotaka is impatient with Someya's attention-grabbing presence, but Someya begs him to teach him a technique to make the guy he likes fall in love with him.
He asks Hotaka to teach him some techniques to make the guy he likes fall for him. The contents of the lesson are all practical exercises such as kissing and licking his chest...?

description: The cool and pushy astronomy club member, Takayanagi, always begs the hardworking student council officer, Kamijou, to "give them more funds for the cultural festival", but always receives the answer: "absolutely impossible!" Like cats and dogs, Takayanagi goes to pick a fight with him every day because the adorable sight of Kamijou turning red with anger makes his heart race… A cultural festival romance featuring the pushy astronomy club member vs. the tsundere student council officer!

title: Breakfast Club
description:
Yaoi series of stories about life in a boy's dorm at a high school. The main couple in the first volume is Masamoto and Izuka, who are roommates. Masamoto saves Izuka from prostitution. There is also Hiroki who is sleeping with his teacher, the dorm manager.

One day, he begins pummeling a boy who suddenly appears in his yard, not realizing the boy is none other than world-famous, super-popular actor Togo Kihara! Togo takes to Kota despite their first meeting and tips him handsomely to work as his attendant. Kota can't help but accept Toga's proposition – but when he sees Togo display his star aura on the set, Kota sees a Togo completely different from his snobbish, pushy, normal self. What happens next? This comic puts a super star and a high school pauper side-by-side for a story of star-crossed love.

Kouji is satisfied with any chance to spend time with Mizuru but one day, he suddenly realizes that his time with Mizuru will be coming to an end. Will he finally confess his love or will he let this love remain buried?  
  
3: Cruel Love  
Kiichi's parents died when he was a child. For the past ten years, he's lived with his uncle whom he loves. Even though they have sex, Akumitsu never tells Kiichi he loves him. Is Kiichi just a toy?  
  
4: School Scandal  
Uemura is the only one who treats his classmate Atsushi like a friend instead of star actor. But is friendship all Uemura feels?

Kei is considered a troublemaker at school. When his senpai Kagami catches him smoking, Kei has to do what he says, or risk getting expelled. But to be senpai's pet dog? And how is Kei's brother involved?

2-4) A Season For Three  
Clueless Yukihito has always relied heavily on surrogate old brother and songwriter Reichi, but he worries about what will happen when Reichi gets a girlfriend. Reichi is pretty closemouthed about his love life, and when Yukihito finds naked male composer Oono in Reichi's bed, he thinks he's figured out why…

Aachan is in love with his best friend, Kei. Sadly, he doesn't think he has any chance with Kei at all. Aachan tries his best to bring happiness to Kei by supporting his love interest instead.  
  
It appears that Kei is in love with Sagawa-senpai. In order to bring said happiness to Kei, Aachan uses any method he can think of to bring those two together, completely disregarding his own feelings. But what about his own happiness?

“Tôi muốn cậu trở thành nguồn cảm hứng của tôi!”

Ở cạnh nhau, Yuji và Masa, hai con người yêu cái đẹp, được sống là chính mình. Cùng niềm đam mê quá đỗi đặc biệt họ dần khám phá ra những cảm xúc chôn giấu và điều sẽ thay đổi cuộc đời của họ mãi mãi.

Enzou, the said transfer student, was raised in France: foreign-like features and gestures, stylish appearance—he’s really attractive.

Second, they cannot harm the students. Third and most importantly, no explosives or firearms. Poison and tranquilizers are fine. title: Natsuiro Moratorium

These two youngsters fought and contended against each other. "The one who falls first is the one who loses. I knew that since long ago, but I’m willing to.” In a blink of an eye 10 years passed by, a 28 year old Tang Jun He and 29 year old Yang Xuan met again. Things remained the same but the people were no longer the same. Two people who remained in the darkness can never be each other’s light. Then let’s walk together, and find the light.

Unrequited love is bad enough but it seems like Kai-sensei can't stand him at all. One winter night, in a dormitory room, Wakana and Futaba were forced to wrap themselves up in a blanket as they continued studying because the heater had broken down. "I've saved myself for you because you're my only master for life!"  
  
Sera was acting out his rebellion against his parents, when Makieda, a former butler, came into the picture as a substitute teacher.  
  
Under Makieda's guidance, Sera learned more than just becoming a gentleman. He also fell in love with this butler-turned-instructor. However, will Makieda choose duty to serve his former master over love? See how these two struggle to master the lesson of love.  
  
3-5) Social Dance for Men  
Thanks to an unfortunate accident the President of the Social Dance Club is now allergic to women, but that's not going to stop him from finding the perfect dancing partner.  
  
Extra) The Butler Becomes Jealous at Night

title: Signal To Love
description: Zhong Xinhuai, who never believes in fate, helps his cousin teach a lesson to a scumbag who askes for a "Fated Mate" and broke up mercilessly. Only to find out he's the scumbag's real "Fated Mate"?! Since then, the cool senior has been entangled by the fate-believing "scumbag". But, he's also the new student in the same major he's a Teaching Assistant. He runs away... He chases... Can they get rid of this entanglement of fate...

title: Bitansan Renai
description:
There's a guy that's been on my mind – Michinaga. One day, he told me, "Taka, I have a crush on our teacher." But it hurts me to see his pained expression. Forget about that teacher. Forget about this love that'll never bloom. Choose me instead…  
  
Taka and Michi, Michi and his teacher, the teacher and Taka's older brother… Where will all their one-sided feelings take them?

title: Ii Kankei de Komatteru
description:
1: Coworkers in an easygoing relationship.  
2-3: Childhood friends go to a planetarium.  
4: A responsible salaryman enjoys the unconventional attitude of a new intern.  
5-8: A school librarian is tempted by a determined student.

title: Sweet Chapel
description: Haruma Shinohara has always been looked at as someone who is frightening and cold. With his attitude, no one would have figured out that a first year, Tetsubei, had crumpled that exterior by stumbling upon Haruma's weakness.

title: Cat & Dogs!
description: Shiba is in love with his kendo senpai, but when he enters university he doesn't want to be in the kendo club anymore. How can Shiba convince him to join the club again? And why does the annoying Akito-senpai have to be in the club instead?

title: My Roommate’s a Zombie
description: As roommates and best friends who grew up together, Elijah and Ivan know everything about each other and their funny little quirks. Ivan cooks delicious food for Elijah (beef stew and crab are his favorites!) and Elijah loves teasing Ivan and getting spoiled as an adorable little angel (<– self-proclaimed title). When Ivan returns after a rainforest expedition a little… changed (he uh… eats brains now), they've gotta learn to adjust to a different life. So what if he's a Zombie, big deal!

title: Boku wa Konomama Kaeranai
description: Upbeat Ritsuro and downbeat Ken have been longtime friends. Although Ken leads a dark life of prostitution after dropping out of high school, Ritsuro still cares about him. When Ritsuro realizes that what Ken wants is something more than friendship he vacillates between Ken and his girlfriend Moeko, setting the stage for a bizarre love triangle.

title: Yatteranneeze!
description:
Fujimoto Hiroya is at the top of his class. He's the Student Council Vice President, spends all his time studying, and is the idol of all the "good girls". But the truth is, he'd trade it all just for the chance to be someone else… someone popular, outgoing and carefree… Someone like Masaki.  
  
Masaki's what Fujimoto's friends would call an "idiot". He'd rather play soccer than study, almost never cracks a book, and is popular with all the "normal" kids. He's got flashy clothes, bleached hair and a reputation just as lousy as Fujimoto's is good.  
  
In the summer of Fujimoto's freshman year of high school, he resolves to change his image and his life… all to make friends with Masaki. But can dyed hair, new clothes and a piercing really change a person inside?

title: Keppeki Danshi Kouryaku-hou
description: Takumi is a neat freak who shies away from touching others, while Sakura is a goofball who tends to overstep personal boundaries. Even though it pains him to do so, smart and successful Takumi finds himself tutoring Sakura on a regular basis. Over the course of their study sessions, they finally start to break the ice. But then, Takumi discovers that Sakura is actually a...The love story of a guy with no sense of personal space and a stoic student council member trying to overcome germaphobia.

title: Yankee to Matsuge Egaki Oroshi Doujinshi
description: * Alternative Official Raw - [CMOA](https://www.cmoa.jp/title/211618/)

title: Katakoi × Alliance
description: Akito fell in love the moment he saw Kiriya, a part-time math instructor, while on the school's rooftop. Even though they have never talked, Akito looks forward to every time he can spy on Kiriya from the rooftop. One day when Akito sees Kiriya, Akito rushes in to see why this math teacher is crying alone. In a panic, Akito asks Kiriya to teach him math. As they spend more time together, Akito realizes Kiriya is in love with another teacher at their school. Akito refuses to give up on Kiriya, though, and proposes they enter a One-sided Love x Alliance!

title: Kimi wa Itoshi no Yuutousei
description:
Horikawa Kunihiro x Kashuu Kiyomitsu

High school AU (not reincarnation). A romantic comedy about Kashuu-kun, at the request of his homeroom teacher, becoming friends with Horikawa-kun, a top-performing honor student yet has a habit of cutting class.

title: Oujisama no Renai Jijyou
description: High school love has many obstacles… in this case they are mostly amusing.

title: Kare ga Megane wo Hazusutoki
description: "Could I take the place of my brother?" When Tomoe's best friend, Ichita develops an interest in the new transfer student, it affects Tomoe. Not knowing the reason for this, a corner of his heart slows. In the wake of all that, he becomes close with Ichita's younger brother, Kenji. The two of them meet, but one day, on top of pointing out Tomoe's feelings for Ichita, Kenji also confesses his own feelings. It's a story full of waves and waves of emotions and angst youth.

title: Mega Giga Panic Shiritsu Renshuu Gakuen
Gakuen Heaven - Double Scramble
description: Asahina Yuki, a young man with no special skills save for good luck, was invited to attend Bell Liberty, a legendary high school for elite students. Immediately after arriving, he was given an armband by a mysterious ninja who begged him to protect the school. That armband is the proof of being the Ace of the school - the student council president!

title: Katakoi Lamp
description: Kazuto Muronoi runs a cute little coffee shop, where many people enjoy doing some work or writing papers for school. Among his coffee shop's regulars is a college student named Jun, who often studies there. It was love at first sight for Kazuto! Will Kazuto be able to find the courage to confess his crush before Jun graduates college and stops frequenting the shop? And to make matters even more complicated... it seems Jun has his sights set on another worker at the café!

title: Dear Us
description: In the year 2110, universes and worlds are united. Two kids transfer into Tsuyo's (Omega) school, one is an Alpha, and one is a Degen.

title: Hush
description: It's the first day of the new school year and Juhyun… Well, he's not exactly enthused. In fact, the only things on his mind are girls. The girls at his school, to be specific. Jigoo, on the other hand, wakes up early and gets ready and stops by Juhyun's home on the way to school. And, as it turns out, Jigoo might not be as interested in girls as Juhyun is. Juhyun is about to find out that some secrets are hard to keep quiet. And sometimes, everyone needs a little help.

title: Sakuranbou ★ Rabu Inosento
description: Spin-off cặp phụ của Công cuộc khủng bố tình yêu

title: Uchi no Ko ni Narinasai
description: While buying food at the supermarket, Sunao Morihara is kidnapped by a strange man, Kuon Tachibana, who turns out to be incredibly rich! His motive? He wants Sunao to be his friend. However, Sunao realizes that being Kuon's "friend" actually means becoming his wife!

title: Suki de Shikatanai
description:
1. Can't Stop My Love  
"You like me. So I'm holding you now." Shiratsuka sensei held Isoyama after saying that. Holding each other without love, bodily contact without feelings… Even after sensei made Isoyama cry, the feeling Isoyama has just refused to back down. What does sensei really think of Isoyama?  
  
2. My Love Overflows  
Momozono was heart broken when Isoyama expressed his love for sensei. When Kuwana stumbled into his life, Momo started to get confused. Why is he thinking about Kuwana all the time? Is he not that into Isoyama after all?  
  
3. I Don't Come To Like You  
After Momo moved out, Yone got a new roommate, Kei. The only problem is, he ran away from Kei three years ago. Did Kei follow him here?  
  
4. My Love Overflows (Extra)  
Momo comes home sick… how will Kuwana help him get rid of the fever?

title: You're Mine
description: A rich young master and an abandoned son in an orphanage. Two people with different identities and positions, yet became good brothers for ten years.

title: Fujunna Renai
description: This story take place in a small village. Highschool student Inami Kazunori accidentally found out the secret of the newcomer, Udagawa Akihiro. In return for keeping quiet, Inami asked Udagawa to become close to the girl, Yoshimura, who Inami's best friend, Maruyama, likes. However, Inami ended up feeling bad about it and Udagawa revealed his secret to the class himself?!

title: Sky Link
description: The sky was a bright shade of blue on the first day of university and Ritsuki Ban hopes for a fresh start. As mysterious past regrets continue to linger in his mind, Ritsuki collides into a man who takes on an immediate interest in Ritsuki’s looks— a man whom he later discovers, is one of his new professors! The confident Professor Takagi does nothing to hide his feelings towards Ritsuki; however the reclusive Ritsuki refuses to become teacher’s pet. As Ritsuki and Takagi find themselves sky gazing together one day, they are moved by each others expressions and begin to find out more about each other.

title: Hakkou Seinen
description: Reiji Kubo is an undercover fudanshi who one day meets Yuya Yagasaki, a bookseller who is secretly in love with him. The story focuses on how Yagasaki starts, follows and finally reaches the depths of Kubo.

title: Rabbit and Lion
description: In a world where only animals live, a lion with a reputation of being the boss of the campus, Mu Wei, falls in love with a rabbit, Bailey. He is usually has a very domineering presence in school, but once he sees Bailey, he becomes a very shy big cat. Moreover, after constant mingling with lions, Bailey, who is normally timid, gradually opened his heart...... A very sweet school life romance manhua, so sweet you'll get a toothache!

title: Darling
description: Rio was living a perfectly normal high school life when cool and suave transfer student Tomo-chan entered his school. Rio admires his style, and watches as Tomo easily grabs the attention of the female student body – and of some teachers too. It's not until Tomo picks up Rio's dropped planner with a photo of his beloved idol, a male teacher, that they interact. Suspecting that Rio is gay, homophobic Tomo tells Rio he's going to 'cure' him by designing a special "Homo Fixing Training Regimen".

title: Dear My Mister
description: Unable to speak English, even though half of his lineage is from an English speaking country, Noah starts to learn from his sensei, Takamasa. Through the process of learning the language, will some feelings start to develop!?

title: Like A Hero
description: Keiichi and Kaname used to be cousins, but they became brothers when Kaname was adopted into Keichi’s family after his parents died in a car accident. The two of them have always gotten along well, but lately Kaname is acting strangely. He has become so cold and distant that Keiichi begins to wonder if his adopted brother hates him for some reason.

title: Green Peace
description: Kosakabe Chihiro is enrolled as a first year in an agricultural high school. In this all boys school, Kosakabe treats his admirer, Kawana Ginji, like a slave. One day, Kawana suddenly steals Kosakabe's first kiss! From then on, Kosakabe decides to skip morning duties. With a pale face, Kawana throws him into the storage room and then…! The real Kawana is actually…?

title: His First Love is Me
description: A few years ago, Xia Ke had a big fight with his family and heard a song. The gentle melody comforted his frustrated soul. From then on, he focused a lot on a music streamer. Who knew that the streamer he followed would be his classmate! "I want to be friends!" Aside from the college entrance exam, Xia Ke's life as a senior in university got one more goal. The daily school life of a music host and a fanboy.

title: Boku no Hero Academia - Hello Goodbye Again (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki x Midoriya

title: Romance no Hakoniwa
description:
1. Miniature Garden of Romance  
Masataka Chiyo is a Cultivation Art student whose latest submission has been rejected for being 'dispassionate and uncreative'. He struggles to find inspiration, which arrives unexpectedly in the form of his brilliantly innovative roommate, Kunitachi Hiromi.  
  
2. The Professor's Botany  
A reclusive artist renowned as "The Professor" lives in a secluded house that appears, at first glance, to be as bare and as empty as its occupant's heart. Knowing The Professor to be a difficult man, the company in charge of mass-producing his designs delegates the task of dealing with him to their newest employee.

3. Utsushigami (Tracing Paper)

4. Kousoku Kyori (Visible Distance)

5. to 6. Majutsu no Atosaki (Consequences of Sorcery)

title: Could the Boy Next Door Be a Vampire?
description: Navigating the uncertainty of early adulthood is no easy feat, as Hong Wooree is realizing on his year off from college. Not only is he trying to make it as a published author, but he also thinks that his best friend, Gong Minnee, is a vampire! After making some flawed assumptions, Wooree believes that Minnee's secretive behavior comes from hiding his "true" identity—he's completely unaware that Minnee isn't actually a vampire, and just has a huge crush on him.
