Taneda Kouki, who believes himself normal in every possible way, accidentally sees the latter while taking a shortcut. Isayama bewilders and fascinates Taneda, who also begins questioning his own normality…

title: Sonoki ni Sasenaide
description: College is filled with boys in love. Kina, a college student, and the graduate student, Megumu, have become sex partners. Will miscommunication and break up cause these two lovers to finally realize their true feelings? On the other hand, Megumu's assistant professor, Shibata-sensei, and fellow assistant professor, Kikugawa-sensei, seem to have been more than friends for many years. A lovely older couple versus a newly established couple – let the love begin.

title: Nigeru Hanayome no Shitsukekata
description: Right after his birthday, Sakuma Shunya, an extraordinarily ordinary high school student, was suddenly abducted by a man named Kirishima Reiri, who claims to be his “fiancé”. Just like that, Shunya was forced to transfer to his uncle’s Eirei Academy, more commonly known as “Bride Academy”. This school, designed to train male brides for men, is filled with First Night Manners, Naked Apron and other classes that Shunya can’t understand. More importantly, Kirishima, who is the school physician, also works in the academy…

title: Final Impression
description:
1-4: Final Impression  
During a time when I didn't know anything, there was still my beloved Hiro-kun. Leaving me with childhood memories, he moved far away… Time has passed since then and once again the boy from my memories has returned to this town, completely changed?!  
  
5: What The House Dog Says  
When Hiromasa finds Mano Kaoru lying in the park, he invites him into his house and tells him "I'll be your new owner"!?  
  
6: Not Even In The Heart  
After his ex-girlfriend brought Shouji to Kodaira's bar, he's been a regular. Kodaira is handsome, gentle, soothing, and cool… Is Shouji falling for him?

title: Happy Birthday Chitose-Kun
description:
"I'm going to celebrate Chitose's birthday so hard!"

Chitose, a college student, recalls the words of one of his high school classmates on the night of his birthday, which he spends in solitude.

Koutaka, a tall, handsome, and athletic boy who transferred to his school in his second year of high school, was a battery partner on the baseball team. When Chitose is assigned to be a battery partner with him on the baseball team, he learns of his unsociable nature and is attracted to him. The two gradually become aware of each other and begin dating.

Chitose is happy to be dating his first boyfriend, but he and Takataka cross paths when they start talking about their career paths.

Graduation comes and goes, and he no longer keeps in touch with Takataka. The message screen has remained static for two years. Chitose finally sends a new message to Takataka.

This is a painfully realistic adolescent love story of a blunt guy and a flawed college student! (Source MangaUpdates)

title: Koi Shika Dekinaiyo
description: High school teacher Umehara Akio drew Hataoka Kei, a problem child, out of his home and back to school. Years later, Umehara got transferred to a new high school and he met Kei again, who's now working as a delivery boy for a florist shop. Seeing his former student grown into a super good-looking college student, Umehara couldn't help feeling proud. What he didn't realize is Kei’s true colors… a pervert who molests his drunken, unsuspecting Umehara-sensei!

title: Haikyu!! - Nandemo Dekiru Mahou (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Kageyama and Hinata discover the magic that happens when they are around each other.

title: My Hero Academia - Feel Special (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Study Toverload
description: You use studies to get me, I use love to get you.

title: Aitsu to Ore.
description:
Takeru’s mother is about to remarry. That is a great opportunity for Takeru to live with a real family and, most of all, to have a big brother, Shin. Things do not actually turn out the way he expected, though.  
  
One day, while waiting for his girlfriend, Takeru hears a couple of people discussing about money for sexual favours. Curious, he turns around to check out the chick, but it turns that both parties are male. However, what shocks Takeru more is when he realizes that the one prostituting himself is Shin, his new stepbrother…  
  
First volume extra: Shounen S  
  
There is a oneshot at the end of the second manga that wasn't translated.

title: Koufuku no Ouji
description: When humans are at their happiest moments they emit an aura that is delicious for certain fairies. This story is about a guy who has a fairy follow him around because he will soon emit that aura and the fairy wants to eat it…but all this guy encounters is one-sided love or failed relationships, is he really ever going to emit that aura?

title: Omae no Hitomi ni Ikasareru!
description:
"I won't stop until you're humiliated. I'll definitely make you come!"

I get aroused when I look in his eyes?! My body heats up all on its own. It's mortifying, but… it sure feels good…!

title: Boku no Hero Academia - Shutter no Oto ga Kikoetara (Doujinshi)
description:
Bakugou Katsuki/Todoroki Shouto
A story about learning to keep things as memories, and take pictures to preserve those memories.

title: Nidome no Yakusoku
description: Jun was Hayato's servant and childhood friend, but it came to an abrupt end when Jun decided to go to a different school. Now, in high school, they've been reunited. Jun must now figure out what he means to Hayato after all these years.

title: 320F4
description: At well-known University 985, there's 320 dorm. Because the four people in the dormitory have different personalities but all look very handsome, they are known as 320F4. Here is their little story.

title: Yotsuya Scramble
description: Yotsuya is transferred to an all boys school. Koizumi, his friend, is always saving him… but the truth is that everything happened because of Koizumi. How will Yotsuya react?!

title: Waka!!
description: A multi-volume story about a couple of young men in a yakuza family. The family has converted from being yakuza to running a security services company. In trying to go straight, Hinoyama Takara gets a job as a school nurse, becoming the first person in the family to hold a "normal" job. With him is Saeki Shinnosuke, his bodyguard and the new school counselor. The story revolves around Saeki's pursuit of Hinoyama and the things they have to go through to become a couple.

title: Ai no DNA
description: Ever since he was young, Miharu has suffered from phantom pains. When his divorced parents decide to reunite after 15 years of separation, he discovers the exact reason why: his younger brother, Natsu. Apparently, he and his brother are astrological twins. Miharu feels Natsu's pain, but… Natsu doesn't feel Miharu's? That's just not fair!

title: Ame to Muchi
description:
5) Wake nado Shiranai  
A guy, who is madly in love with his father, tries to suppress his incestuous feelings and goes on to try to lead a normal life, i.e. get a girlfriend, get married, etc. Unfortunately he finds it very hard to forget about the love of his life…  
  
6) The passionate straight  
The return of the baseball couple from the second chapter of Damatte Naite Irunodesu.  
  
8) Sakanaya no ossan ga  
Haruto has been going out with the "old man" at the fish shop, Kurumi, for a month. But lately Kurumi always seems to have something else to do than be with Haruto. Is their relationship going to last?

title: My Hero Academia - Kon’ya 23-ji Yume no Naka de (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Ou-sama no Bed
description: A suite of emotionally resonant, romantic stories told by a critically acclaimed manga creator. In “The Bed of My Dear King,” an electrician called to a remote job deep in the mountains discovers the startling reasons behind the behavior of the house’s lone occupant, an eccentric young sculptor. In “Cherry,” an overachieving high school student forms an unexpected bond with a laid-back classmate. And in “Flowers,” the secrets surrounding a tragic death lead to an unexpected, and poignant, resolution.

title: Sequence
description:
From Tokyopop:  
As punishment for being late to class, Kanata has to ring a bell in an old, deserted church near his high school. When the floor breaks, Kanata falls into a vast room, where he discovers a coffin–and inside, the body of a vampire. The vampire rises, killing Kanata. But Kanata's soul is saved, and when he later meets the vampire, they realize that they are bound to each other through a magic spell: If Kanata dies, the vampire dies, too!

title: Gurechawanaidene
description: Tsukishita is completely dependent on his little brother. It's the first day of school, and his little brother has already had to find Tsukishita with the things he's forgotten. When a group of girls try to help him find his older brother, they mistakenly think he's Kagami's younger brother. When Kagami realizes who he is, he also remembers the day he confessed to Tsukishita. Tsukishita offhandedly said some heartless things to Kagami; did he really mean them the way they sounded?

title: Gerbera
description: Before entering High School, Ei and Yuuji had always been good friends, but it all started after Yuuji confessed to a girl and was rejected. The relationship between Ei and Yuuji has delicately changed. Boy’s worry when falling in love… particularly when the partner is also a "boy". What should they do…?

title: Memoirs of Romance
description: There are 5 famous pretty boys at school. Their odd natures disagree with their good looks. Now that Jun-Oh is their target, what will happen?

title: My Hero Academia - Kyoumi Nanka Nee wa! (Doujinshi)
description: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Mada Shiranai Ore-tachi
description: The feeling of not knowing a person is probably not that bad. The one moving in next door to Kita is his classmate, Saitou. Until graduation, Saitou didn't seem to even know Kita's name. Thus, Kita tries to avoid him. Without knowing why, he's hiding his hurt heart.

title: Haikyuu! - Sweet Bath Time (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Sawamura Daichi x Sugawara Koushi

title: Sukusuku Otokonoko
description:
Natsuyaki Hatsu is a first year student in high school. He's short, but he's in his growing period right now! As soon as he entered high school, he started to get curious about a boy who's even more adorable than a girl, Fuyuno Aki. It turns out that Aki likes him and wants to have a relationship with him. Hatsu vows that he will reply to Aki as soon as he has become taller than him.  
  
And then a tall and cool guy appears, Akimoto Kaname, who wants to make both Hatsu and Aki his. Aki doesn't like Kaname, but what about Hatsu…?!

title: Haikyu!! - Yasashii Ame no Hito (Doujinshi)
description: Oikawa Tooru x Iwaizumi Hajime

title: Suki Kamoshirenai
description:
First-year high school student, Haruki, joins the Astronomy Club to chase after the kind and always-smiling president, Hatayama. Once day, Haruki finds Hatayama napping and spontaneously tries to kiss him. But he’s seen by the club’s vice president, Mochida, who’s a blunt and terrifying senpai!! Even though Mochida is supposed to already have a lover in the Astronomy Club, why does he suddenly kiss Haruki?! Just who is in love with whom here?!  
  
This is the love story of seven boys!

title: Perfect Fit
description:
Mashimo is a senior in university, wondering whether he should apply to the school’s graduate program. Intending to collect papers to aid him in the decision, he goes to his professor’s office only to find a new face greeting him at the door.
Mashimo later finds out that the strange man he met in the office earlier is Yuuto Tanaka, a first-year star graduate student from another university. Mashimo quickly realizes that the personality he sees when he sees Tanaka is not the same personality that everybody else sees. But one night, as Mashimo stumbles home and wanders into an unknown street, he runs into – is that Tanaka?!

title: Kanashii Kotoba
description: After his mother passed away, Kyousuke decided to live alone and transfer to another school. There he met a rather peculiar classmate named Kaname who’s unable to talk. Although Kaname cannot speak, he was able to somehow convey his feelings clearly through writing and facial expressions that made Kyousuke more drawn to him. However, Kaname’s cousin, Satoshi noticed the intimacy developing between the two which he could not approve… A sweet ardent, story of pure love unfolds…

title: Yu Jian 20 Sui
description: Le jeune Nathan devient un garçon retiré et asocial à cause des circonstances de son enfance. C'est alors qu'il rencontre Sherwin, et peu à peu, sa vie commence à changer… Se pourrait-il que Sherwin soit ce que Nathan attendait tant ?

title: Innocent Maze
description: Haruto and Ikuto have just transferred to a boarding school. Beautiful Ikuto is instantly a target for the boys all around! And as his brother Haruto desperately protects him, the School King, Ouga, has his own plans in mind!! All-boys school has never been this dangerous!!

title: Werewolves, Mister!
description: Mr. Smiles, a top martial artist, is hired by a school whose headmaster is a vampire. At this new post, Mr. Smiles gets to teach a group of wolf pups, a 2-meter-tall giant, and many other strange students.

title: Truth or Dare
description:
A world without lies. A world where criminals are caught, where words are always true, and people always say what they mean. Of course, Saegye isn't like everyone else. He can lie. He can deceive and manipulate in order to get ahead. As long as no one else knows, he can do whatever he wants and get away clean. As long as no one else knows...

*[3rd place Winner of 1st Lezhin BL Comic Contest]*

title: My Hero Academia - Kiss Shitara Nakayoku Nareru ka to Omotte (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Sensei no Iutoori.
description: Beautiful but unemotional Ishimoro-sensei has always been chased by women and has become an "expert at romance", despite never being involved in it. Students and teachers both always ask for his advice. The only one who doesn't is gym teacher Yamada who seems to hate him with a passion for some unknown reason.

title: Escape
description: The amorous and versatile 17-year-old Yamato Majima lives by himself in the town where beastly and horny guys abound! Cute delinquent fellows, timid childhood friends, sparkling boy idols, hot hosts, and sexy teachers… Yamato's love and sex life is deliciously restless!

title: Kirai Kiraimo
description:
The Konoe and Kazuki families have been fighting like cats and dogs for generations. Masaya Konoe and Yuma Kazuki attend the same elite high school and are known to all as arch rivals, but do they really hate each other? Masaya still cherishes a childhood memory of a time when Yuma shared a "treasure" with him. Now they share a secret attraction. Can they hide their passion? Burning desire has a way of erupting into flames!  
  
The Deux published version of this manga does not include the short story called, "Water Lily". It's about two brothers where the younger brother is in a coma and the other takes care of him. The older brother molests his sleeping brother not realizing that his touches are being noticed.

title: Seinen 14-sai
description: Itou just found out that one of his best friends, Machida, maybe kind-of sort-of likes him. He doesn't say it, but he did orgasm when thinking of Itou, even as he was about to have sex with his girlfriend! Now, Machida has a complex about Itou and even kisses him, and Itou develops a complex about Machida because his first kiss was taken! On the edge of becoming men, will they figure out their feelings?

title: On the Quiet
description:
1-2) On the Quiet  
On a cold winter day, when Ikewaki Kou, a college student, forgot his key and couldn't enter his apartment, he was invited into his neighbour, Shiraishi Hiroya's room. But the room was so dirty that there wasn't even space for him to put his foot down, and Kou was really shocked by this gap from his neighbour's orderly image. Even so, Kou remembers the steady palpitation of his heart as he conversed with the bashful and unaffected Shiraishi. Things got heated when Kou realised that Shiraishi might like his brother instead.  
  
3-4) Tangerine Report  
Nakatani is a nice guy… to everyone else in school. For some reason, he seems to hate Ikeuchi. What could be the reason? Ikeuchi finds himself drawn to Nakatani after seeing the sunlight turn his hair a beautiful color, along with an arousing desire to touch him.  
"I always smile gently, because I'm scared of being shunned." Part two is told from Nakatani's point of view.  
  
5-6) Unreasonable Baby  
Sugimoto, from T

title: Hatsujoukei Drags
description: In the Royale School, Ayamoji Kokuei was being targeted by a yakuza's son, Shirogane Michihiko (real name: Kintarou). Ayamoji began to skip lessons and repeat grades to avoid running into Shirogane. When they meet again six years later, Ayamoji drugs Shirogane and they get intimate. Ayamoji left after that and reappeared five years later. Will the two lovebirds finally be together?

title: Not for Sale!
description:
1) Not For Sale!  
Nozomi is a boring and late-blooming college student. His classmate, Ryuji, is an extremely dangerous delivery host. When Nozomi witnesses a steamy kiss between Ryuji and a male teacher, he's thunderstruck! His eyes can't seem to stop following Ryuji's movements. If Ryuji has any say (and he does!), Nozomi is just about to get a taste of paradise.  
  
2) Go Home, Good Boy  
  
3) Love Slave  
  
4) Hitori de Yare yo!  
Comedy duo Masata and Naru aren't doing very well, but they're still together. Mainly because Masata is helpless and Naru can't leave him alone. But when Naru finds out Masata's been keeping secrets things may fall apart.  
  
5) Love Cocktail  
When unfortunately named Minami Haruo wanders into Sagawa's bar, Sagawa gives him his special aphrodisiac cocktail and has his way with him. But who is Minami really? And is he ever coming back?  
  
6) Air  
Nobuyuki and Yugi became a family 7 years ago, when their parents remarried. A year later after that,

title: Chiisana Garasu no Sora
description: Naoki was a bit of a loner kid. He'd been picked on because of it, but the looks he's been getting from Yada ever since he entered high school are the first he's ever experienced…

title: Irokoi Comedy
description:
1-2) Yuuma has psychic powers, and recently it seems, a spirit has possessed his body for the purpose of confessing to his childhood friend, Ritsu. Before leaving this world, the spirit would like to spend the night with Ritsu. Will Yuuma agree? If Yuuma crawls into Ritsu's bed, will Ritsu accept him? And when all is said and done, why does this spirit now have legs?  
  
3-4) What's a uke to do when his 79-year old grandpa, who is a mad scientist, creates a pill that can make him look 29? And the reason for looking young again - to go after his grandson's boyfriend. Will Grandpa's groping and kidnapping finally get our couple to heat up the sheets? Or will grandpa get himself a new toy?  
  
5-8) Some boy-love one-shots revolving around baseball, revenge, suppositories, and flower arranging.

title: Blind Spot Strategy
description: Hanseo is a college student who's in love with a handsome senior named Han Ji-yoon. One night they went to a mixer party, and Hanseo smelled Han Ji-yoon's jacket when no one was there. He gets caught by Jiyoon Yoon, who wants to live at his place in exchange for keeping his secret

title: Shiawase no Ashioto
description:
Collection of 6 oneshots:  
  
1) Shiawase no Ashioto  
  
2) Omoi no Yukue  
  
3) Magic Smile  
  
4) Travelers with Prince  
  
5) Kimi bi Yori  
Artist Okano has a crush on his roommate, feckless Tsukamoto. When Tsukamoto asks Okano to teach him to draw, Okano treasures their time together. But will it last?  
  
6) Seiten no Hekireki  
Aihara is afraid of his room, because it's making strange sounds. Fujito helps him to forget his fear…

title: Let's Go, ASMR!
description: Soohyun, who runs a popular ASMR channel, scouts some new recruits to help him film and produce videos. There’s Joonhyuk, an ASMR fan, Hyesoo, who has an amazing voice (but who only joins because he’s got a huge crush on Joonhyuk), and Chanyoung, who joins to protect (?) Joonhyuk from Hyesoo. From the creator of “Voice of Love” comes a new BL series full of budding romance and tingles!

title: The Good Life
description: Yoochang and Hoban are two opposite but extremely beautiful boys. Circumstances bring both of them together as their looks start to get in the way of a peaceful life. These two boys begin a project to become real ordinary folks, but will they succeed?

title: Afternoon Rays
description: Junior high school students Yodoi and Murase. One day, Yodoi witnesses Murase, also a member of the beautification committee, being bullied. Yodoi apologizes to Murase, saying that it is his fault that he is being bullied, and he begins to care about Murase. However, the bullying of Murase becomes excessive, and Yodoi, who is enraged--?

title: Uminari
description:
1) The Sound of the Sea  
With the sound of the sea in the background, pressed on by the overwhelming literary style, a pure love that is too bitter-sweet.  
  
High school student Shougo lives in a rural port city. The moment he meets the art teacher Asano, who was transferred here from the city… He is ruled by indescribably intense emotions. …Shougo masturbates while dreaming of violating Asano.  
  
2) Moon on the 16th Night  
  
3) Duplicate Key  
  
4) Last Kiss  
  
5) 3:00 am: Continuation of first story

title: Bashing Renai
description: Murakami Keisuke possesses beauty which cannot be missed. Many people admire him due to his beauty, but he has never accepted any one of these people. One day, student council president Masaki, due to some incident, started to become close to him…

title: Juusha to Ore-sama
description:
From Fantasyshrine:  
  
1-4. My Servant and I  
Extravagant third prince, Philnaldo frequently graces the cover of tabloids with his scandalous affairs with women. This annoys his personal attendant, Ralph, to no end! Then Philnaldo propositioned him unexpectedly; in exchange for dropping all his women, Ralph would take their place… in his bed! A royal love story of a prince and his servant, where both refuse to face the true feelings of their hearts… but what happens when a crisis occurs!?  
  
5. The Garden in the Past  
Ichika is in elementary school when his father dies. His mother takes him to live with Yuu, a mysterious young man who has a connection to Ichika's father. As his mother becomes more unstable, Ichika grows more dependent on Yuu…

Even though he became a salaryman without playing soccer, Nagi couldn’t shake the feeling that he was missing something more important. Despite not having seen him for years, the face of his wealthy high school classmate (Reo) kept flashing in his mind, and he began to feel that something was off.

There's a serial killer in my WeChat moments!
There seems to be a mysterious large organization behind everything. The only one I can rely on is my buddy who sleeps on my lower bunk.

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! - Summer Break (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Hibari x Tsuna

title: Jig + Zag
description: Fujisawa Kazui followed his recently departed grandfather’s will to stay in Seisou Gakuen’s Tsukigase Dormitory. The cowardly Kazui has two roommates- one is Kawasaki Ryouhei, who has a very big secret (!!) and the other is Mario Bertini, who talks in a strange Japanese accent. With these two as roommates, what kind of a school life would Kazui have?!

title: Banana wa Oyatsu ni Irimasen
description:
One day, I suddenly became a 'big brother' and everyday I am called out of my bed by a sweet and tender voice. The person who's been preparing my bentos and making me snacks is my adorable… little brother. That's right, he's much cuter than a real girl and he's actually my little brother! In spite of this grim fact, I still can't deny myself from falling for him…  
  
Living together seems like the ideal situation for love games, but it seems like I will have to put a stop to this?!

title: Venus Kiss!!
description: Ikumi has always admired his senpai but one day, his senpai rapes him…

title: Not Serious About Serious
description: Vasja es un estudiante de arquitectura en la universidad es tímido, modesto, y una persona muy amable. Es gracias Alexander que su día día en la escuela se lleno de aventuras y se hizo más ameno. Alexander es el centro de atención en todos lados y todo mundo lo adora. ¿Qué creó esta conexión entre dos personas de personalidades completamente diferentes? ¿Y por qué sus amigos siempre ponen a prueba su relación?

title: Gouin Dakedo Yasashikute
description:
From Fantasy Shrine:  
Taking care of his homeroom teacher, Wakasa-sensei, the kindhearted Kakeru is the only person who knows the outwardly charismatic teacher is in truth, a bully! Whenever they are alone, Kakeru tries unsuccessfully to evade Wakasa’s advancements. However, Kakeru couldn’t help noticing Wakasa’s tenderness at unexpected moments. And then, at the start of the 3rd year in high school, a new teacher from Wakasa’s past and a new student arrive…

title: Haikyu!! - Utsuwa no Ookisa Shindansho (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Oikawa x Kageyama

An Oikage book (in which Miya-san is very involved, though not romantically)

title: Itoshi no Boukun
description: Nagase Kazuya's homeroom teacher, Katsuragi sensei, is not much of a teacher - he would rather be working on weird and dangerous experiments in the lab instead of teaching class. He's bossy, selfish, likes to tease Kazuya and order him around… he also happens to be Kazuya's lover. Kazuya is in love with Katsuragi but how does his beloved tyrant feel about him?

title: Asayake no Diamond Life
description: Natsuhiko Sakurada, having won three billion dollars in lottery transferred to the Millionaire Private School, catered for the children from wealthy families. This is all for the sake of seeking his childhood friend, Shin, whom he used to play baseball with. This school is managed by a pair of twins, who are the very popular and smart young masters of the Jinnai family. But, unexpectedly, this school does not have a baseball team and hisroom-mate, one of the Jinnai's twins, is very distant towards him. In order to setup a baseball team to find Shin, what would Natsuhiko do? Find out in this lovely, sweet and hilarious story.

title: Tameiki no Kuchizuke
description: The classic love triangle gets a new twist in this school age love story. Tanabe likes Akira. Akira likes Tatsuya. And really no one knows who Tatsuya is lusting after! But when Akira decides that unrequited love isn't all that noble and responds to Tanabe's advances, Tatsuya confesses?!? Akira isn't sure which way is up let alone which way lies love!

title: Kimi ga Iru Basho
description: A young man lives in a small town, where he owns a small grocery shop and struggles through life alone with his small son. His childhood friend who'd moved away after graduation suddenly shows up on his doorstep, unemployed and on his last penny, putting his life into utter chaos.

title: BLT - Burning Love Twin
description: Nozomu is on a secret mission! After convincing his identical twin brother, Saku, to switch places for a day, Nozomu goes to his brother's school and confronts his enemy in the classroom! Meanwhile, Saku must memorize everything about his brother's school life and classmates so he can fit in without drawing attention to himself. Everything appears to be going alright, until Nozomu's close friend, Yoji Osawa, starts making some more than friendly gestures toward Saku! Afraid of blowing his cover, Saku goes along with it… What could possibly go wrong?

title: 2-14 Jiken
description:
Ikumi and Kunitachi are finally hitting it off steadily. However, trouble starts once again during Valentine's Day when Ikumi received a box of chocolates containing glass and became the victim several other pranks. In the end, when the person revealed himself to Ikumi, the past was unfolded.  
  
Unconsciously jealous over what he's afraid to know, Ikumi threw a fit and said something cruel towards Kunitachi. Unable to take it, Kunitachi raped Ikumi…

title: Harry Potter - Heavy Fucker (Doujinshi)
description:
1. Heavy Fucker to Oyaji no Gyakushuu (Heavy Fucker と親父の逆襲) - Heavy Fucker and the Revenge of the Father  
2. Heavy Fucker to Honoo no Dance Party (Heavy Fucker と炎のダンスパーティ) - Heavy Fucker and the Dance Party of Flame / Heavy Fucker and the Flaming Dance Party  
3. Heavy Fucker Gaiden: Ping Pong Wars (Heavy Fucker 外伝, "Heavy Fucker Side Story") - Oya Sedai☆Koi no Yukemuri Ryojou Hen (親世代☆恋の湯けむり旅情編)  
4. The Kingdom of Slytherin: Episode Red   
5. The Kingdom of Slytherin: Episode Blue   
6. Heavy Fucker to Aruchuu no Juujin (Heavy Fucker とアル中の獣人) - Heavy Fucker and the Drunken Werewolf  
7. Heavy Fucker to Fujimi no Dumbledore Army (Heavy Fucker と不死身のダンブルドア軍団) - Heavy Fucker and Dumbledore's Phoenix Army  
  
Various Pairings.  
  
Simply and Stupid Hilarious.  
<3

title: Shingeki no Kyojin - Orange Cider Evergreen (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Levi x Eren  
  
The daily high school life of Levi and Eren.

title: Love Making
description:
1: Love Making  
Student Shinobu loves cafeteria food and usually cleans his plate, the only thing he won't eat are carrots. When school nutritionist Tatsuya catches him throwing out food, he has to think of a creative way for Shinobu to eat his vegetables…  
  
2: The Pigheaded Deity  
Keisuke's grandfather always warned him about the Tengu living on the mountain, but that was when he was a child. Keisuke's an adult now, so why is he seeing a handsome man with wings?  
  
3: Let Me Drown In The Sea Of Love!  
Atsushi is a failing romance novelist whose active fantasy life has wrapped itself around fish shop employee, Sakurai. Can Atsushi wake up long enough to make a move?  
  
4: God, Give Me A Wife  
Kurachi Daisuke is a high school teacher with a problem: he's single. So he prays to the heavens to give him a wife, when a passing alien hears his wish and decides to help, Kurachi may have to think a little more exotically about his love life.  
  
5: The Kind Hearted Roommate  
Dorm

title: Itaike na Bokura
description:
From Attractive Fascinante:  
  
1-3) Kyoushi and Kou have been lovers for 3 years, and their relationship has been discovered and accepted by Kyoushi's older sister. Now can their love withstand an overbearing, intrusive fan girl? How about an adorable 5-year old cousin who wants to marry Kyoushi?  
  
4) Don't Touch Me  
Bittersweet one-shot about the possibility of living life again and finding a new love after being raped.  
  
5-6) Sou and Keigo have been friends for years, but Keigo never realized Sou's secret - his parents are both men. Now that Keigo is beginning to be more concerned about Sou, is it time to meet the parents? Even if both parents are men, will they approve of their son's preferences?

title: Honenuki ni Saretai
description:
1-3) I Want to be Emasculated  
Salaryman Hoshina has been sharing an apartment and bed with model Atsushi. Atsushi cooks, cleans, and remembers every anniversary, but Hoshina can't figure out why they are in this "type" of relationship. When Hoshina's younger brother moves in for a while, and the boys must endure until he's gone, will Hoshina even care? Will this time of separation be the turning point in their relationship? And which boy will be the one screaming, "Once is not enough"?  
  
4) Try to Say You Love Me  
Student Hasegawa has recently started noticing how cute his friend Hashimoto is, especially around homeroom sensei Sawa. Can Hasegawa cheer Hashimoto on, or will he take his adorable classmate for himself…  
  
5) Infection of Feeling  
Medical intern Ishiguro has been sleeping with his attending Sensei Sakuma for the past year. Their intensely physical relationship is all Ishiguro ever considered, but Sakuma thinks feelings should be involved as well.  
  
6-7) Refrain

title: Ichi Kara Oshiete Ageru
description: Chiaki left his phone at school, so he goes back that evening to retrieve it. While he's there, he hears soft moaning coming from a nearby room and decides to take a look, only to find Mr. Chiba, the math teacher, taking it from another man… Despite being geeky, all the girls love Mr. Chiba, who in turn constantly nags Chiaki about getting more tutoring. Although hesitant, Chiaki takes this chance to blackmail Mr. Chiba and snaps a picture of the two men in action. The next day, Chiaki shows Mr. Chiba the photo during his tutoring sesssion after school. Instead of freaking out, Mr. Chiba simply smiles and kneels down, then takes Chiaki in his mouth to "bribe" him! This is the start of extra-curricular lessons between a cocky fool and a two-faced teacher!

title: Hatsukoi Monogatari
description: Aratsuka Kaoru, a math teacher in an all boys middle and high school boarding school, is also known as "Alaska" because of his coldness. He has never been in love before because he's afraid to share his feelings with another. After some issues, he spent a night in the room of the infirmary sensei, Suzuki Kouta. It was the first time someone touched him. What will happen thereafter?

title: Kuroko no Basket - Kiss x Kiss - Kise x Kuroko Anthology (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kise x Kuroko

Anthology of doujinshi from different artists.

Cover illustrator: ASUTA Ritsuka

title: Love Crazy
description: When Wess decide to given up his feeling for Koane, and then he suddenly has to meet crazy man in mental hospital.

title: Fan
description: Youhei immediately fell in love with the actor from a late night advertisement, Satomi. After going through some random events, they became lovers. However, how will these two love birds face the upcoming events which involves costumes, a manager, a stalker and maybe an old crush!?

title: Haikyuu!! - Yakeru (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kuroo Tetsurou x Kozume Kenma

title: Replicant no Kiss
description: Tsutsumu Shisui is brought up by his grandfather, Dr. Yuujirou after his father, Dr. Hiromu died. But now Yuujirou also died with a lot of debt. At Yuujirou's funeral, Tsutsumu's cousin, Sou Takigawa suddenly appears and declares that he wants to take care of Tsutsumu.

Makoto, a short guy of 165cm height, confesses to Sei, a popular guy of 185cm height, who is tall, handsome, and kind, “I like you” and “Please go out with me!" Makoto is ready to have his heart broken, but he is not. Makoto is prepared to have his heart broken, but the answer is “yes.” The story describes the happy days of a couple with a height difference who have graduated from high school and are now university students!

title: Dekiai Rule
description: Miyashita-sensei was always an overachiever, but his perfect life was disrupted when he met his desirous student, Jindou. Trying his best to get Jindou back on track, sensei had to guide him personally and fend off his ex-partners. They grew to love each other as time went by, but sensei kept a distance from Jindou by trying his best to maintain an innocent relationship between them. Will Jindou succeed in breaking down sensei's territory?

title: Free! - Bokutachi no Senpai Tsukiatte Nai Wake ga Nai (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Haruka x Rin  
  
Rei is convinced Rin and Haruka are dating, and so he enlists the help of Nagisa in trying to figure out if they are or aren’t an item.

title: Hitotsu no Futon ni Yaro ga 2-ri.
description: I'm gonna lose my virginity during the school trip! …Or so I thought…… But turns out my virginity's being taken instead! I'm forced to climax…… And why's the culprit in my bed!? I was looking forward to this school trip, but I hate the fact that the popular Tsukasa is in my group. Although, something good came out of it - the girls come to our room at night! I'm totally in the mood, until the teacher comes to check on us. When everyone climbs into bed and pretends to be asleep…… Somebody wriggles in with me! Plus, they get real close and touch me down there…… When I can't take it anymore and lift the sheets, it's Tsukasa……!

title: Haikyuu!! - Connection (Doujinshi)
description: Kageyama and Hinata learn how to kiss, to the displeasure of everyone around them.

title: His Arrogance
description:
Ryo is helping out at his father's modeling agency. But, his classmate and rising rookie model at the agency, Ito, is openly antagonistic to Ryo's older brother, a very charismatic model. Ito finally corners Ryo and demands that he looks at him only! After a passionate kiss, he promises that crossing him will incur punishment! Ito may be an arrogant boy who does nothing but give orders, but Ryo is undone by his forceful and dominating approach!  
  
**First three chapters also published in Oresamateki**

title: Boku no Hero Academia - Puddled Fermata (Doujinshi)
Orangeheart
description: Orange Magic! Zouhan is a middle schooler who obtained the powers of turning orange juice into magic. Join his sparkling journey of vanquishing demons and oneself's discovery in a world of endless wonders.

title: G-Senjou no Neko
description: Riya Narukawa is a high school freshman with a tremendous talent for the violin and an equally large bag of mental issues. After injuring his own hand to compromise his playing ability, he winds up on the doorstep of college student Atsushi Ikeda, a nice guy who's maybe too nice and generous. He takes Riya in for the night and helps him with his hand injury. Atsushi realizes there is much more to Riya than is on the surface, and learns just how difficult Riya's life actually is. Not only does he have a personality disorder, but there's an aggressive senior at his school who has his eye on him. Atsushi becomes a sort of safe haven for Riya, an escape from the life of music he's been bound to.

title: Daikirai!! Demo Honto wa ne...
description: Kohashi Juri, a guy with a beautiful face, always gets irritated if someone calls out his girly name. But he is infuriated when Kouta, who is famous with the girls, started calling his name "Juri Juri" passionately everyday. Juri once thought "He's the opposite type of mine" but when Kouta said to him "Let's touch each other, this thing'll be our secret", he did something he shouldn't have done with Kouta…!?

title: When you Take a Picture of Me
description: Mio Torita, a first-year high school student in the photo club, fell in love with a beautiful girl he met while shooting. The true identity of her beautiful girl was Yumi Sakura, a shady boy who cosplayed as a woman! Torita, who can't forget the appearance of "her", asks Sakura to take her photo model. Every time he takes a picture of her, she becomes prettier, and Torita begins to feel more than just her friend. A youth love that cuts out a dazzling moment that   only you want to be photographed ! Also includes a newly drawn book! *This is a retitled version of the "comic marginal & h" series "I want to shoot Sakura-kun's skirt".

title: Bokura no Unsei
description:
Asahi might seem like your regular high school boy, but this kid's been down on his luck…his entire life! Thankfully, the sketchy but resourceful teacher, Rokujou, just so happens to have the right charm to cure Asahi of what ails him. Too bad it has to come in the form of a kiss! But when Asahi starts to want more than just a kiss, will Rokujou give in and break the delicate balance they've held so far?  
  
1) Our Luck (Bokura no Unsei) (3 chapters)  
  
2) The Mechanism of Love (Koi Suru Kikai)  
An Aphenphosmphobic living in the mountains receive the visit of his sister who brings him… a robot?… see what happens…  
  
3) The Uniform and You (Seifuku to Anata)  
  
4) Uwasa no Futari (The Rumour of Two)  
Oneshot prequel to the two volume manga of the same name.

title: Monochrome Diary
description: Yoojoon is a good boy. That's why he was destined to fall head-over-heels for the handsome and charismatic Jiho. When Jiho says "Jump," Yoojoon asks "How high?" And as the pair become more inseparable by the day, they solidify their master-dog dynamic. But little do they know, each boy is harboring his own dark secret. Jiho, who suffers from severe apathy resulting from childhood trauma, is using Yoojoon as an expendable toy, and Yoojoon is intensely and obsessively in love with Jiho. Despite that, can the two boys successfully remove each other's masks and break the cycle of abuse?

title: One Night Lesson
description: Takayoshi, a model, is currently employed by Kairi the photographer. Kairi's intense gaze makes Takayoshi flustered… why is he constantly looking at him like that?

title: Juicy Cider
description: High-schooler Takayuki is considered a cool elite; all his peers are sure his thoughts are about nothing but serious, important subjects. However, they're mostly just wild fantasies about his childhood friend, the cute but simple Ken. Using all his cunning and wiles, Takayuki's determined to win over Ken.

title: Sensei to Himitsu
description:
1-2) Sensei to Himitsu  
Kaji's woken up from his nap hearing popular Tsunoda-sensei getting hot and heavy with another guy! But it's his partner, the plain Aritou-sensei that Kaji can't stop thinking about. Kaji's eyes are being opened as he finds that the needs and dark desires that can bind together lovers aren't always about love…  
  
3-6) Hold me for all of Time  
A researcher, Sawatari Kaoru, runs off after finding out that there will be no more funding for his research. As he wanders around he sees an abandoned warehouse where he could use to continue his research with his remaining savings. As he walks inside the building, he meets an arrogant little boy. Surprise ensues as to the boys identity, and the unexpected result of his own research…  
  
Extra) And then…  
Continuation of ch.1-2, a little into their future.

title: Daikirai!
description:
1-3) A Hateful Person  
Third-year student Bai is the beautiful prefect with an angelic smile - that allures the students into obeying his orders. However, his kouhai Chiaki always defies Bai and the latter has no idea why Chiaki hates him. Nor does Chiaki understand why Bai hates him so much that he never reprimands him for his sloppiness. Each secretly wishes to know what's on the other's mind… but how will they go about it?  
  
4) The Day That Prince Charming Will Come  
The pitiful freshman has been dumped for the 4th time even though it has only been 6 months since starting school. While he was thinking that things can't get worst, he gets a bucket load of cold water dumped on him while he was crying his eyes out.  
  
5) Love Rivals  
The beautiful bartender has women throwing themselves at him even though he is openly gay and very monogamous. His partner on the other hand, is bisexual and busy chasing skirts. How will he handle his betrayal time after time?  
  
6) Emergency

title: JUST!!
description: Sekine is the captain of the judo team. His friend and roommate Kosakai is a popular novelist. They both attend school and seem to be pretty close. Tamura Maiko is a member of the judo team and falls in love with the one of them. A love triangle ensues.

title: Onborobachi
description: This is a one-shot doujinshi of Onborobachi, created before serialization. Nakamura Yurito, a college student, encounters a mysterious motorcyclist that he cannot speed by. Little did he know, that same cyclist would be the same person he knew in his childhood.

title: Haikyuu!! - toLOVE (Doujinshi)
description:
Hinata Shouyou/Everyone
Description from the author is 'A doujin in which Hinata tops everyone.' It's a gag 4koma.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen - Sensei!! (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Gojo Satoru x Itadori Yuuji

A story about Yuuji who confesses to Gojo-sensei.

title: Haikyu!! - Two Taboo Words To Silence The King (Doujinshi)
description:
Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

Kageyama is stuck with Hinata’s clueless of his feelings. The more hints he make the more he’s frustrated till the moment he snaps and can no longer control. “I like Hinata more than I thought”

title: Not Boyfriends Yet
description: Minho would never go out with another guy! Or so he thought, as surprising rumors about him and bookish class president Hajun spread. How long will they last before they must admit to their school mates — and their feelings?

title: Mitasareru Kuchibiru
description: Soft-hearted Takashi got caught up in a love game of the playboy, Kurose, all because he happened to see the love affair between those two boy at school! Kurose is such a dangerous guy, he even laid hands on the professor! The reason why Kurose cares about the unappealing Takashi is…!? A daring and touching serious love!

title: Kagi
description:
Consists of a volume with various oneshot.  
  
1- Key  
  
2- Alkaloid  
  
3- Breath  
  
4- Night, Midnight  
  
5- Dogs and Summer Clothes  
  
6- Key (epilogue)

title: Kamen Teacher
description:
Murooka is an elementary school teacher who carries a secret: He likes little boys, and not in an othodox way! Because of this he must wear a "mask" to hide his motives. But what happens when a temporary teacher with the body of a school boy starts working at the same school? Will Murooka finally find love? And how will he deal with the beautiful female teacher who begins to fall for him? Not to mention when his first crush and uncle of his favorite student volunteers to help with the school play. Will Murooka ever find peace? Hilarity and general craziness ensue.  
  
Not to be confused with the other [Kamen Teacher](https://mangadex.org/title/4217/kamen-teache)

title: Hatsukoi Elegy
description: Entrusted with an utmost mission to identify and to protect the next chief of their tribe, Ninja Sakura transferred to a high school and fell in love with the class rep Takagi. Can Sakura succeed both in his mission and in love?

title: Kimi ni Sachi Are!
description: Naruse Sachi left his student ID at Happy Villa. His kouhai, Kunisaki picked it up and wants to return it. But does Kunisaki expect any favor in return? Sachi-chan kawai-ness is making Kunisaki all nervous and excited. Will Sachi accept being pursued by this first love of his life, his kouhai, and a guy on top of that?

title: Yuuwaku
description: A short 4 page story about a boy who likes another boy.

title: Warito Yokuaru Danshikouteki Renaijijou
description: Welcome to Kinsei Private School: a respected, all-boys institution where it's rumored that ninety percent of the student body is gay (or bisexual). For the straight Nanase, this means constantly evading day-to-day advances from his love-struck classmates. Just what is a "normal" boy to do in this sea of abnormality? Enter Heiji, who proposes a unique solution to his senpai: namely, that he and Nanase pretend to be a couple, so as to deflect all of the unwanted attention. Sounds like a good plan, except that pretty soon Nanase finds himself performing all manner of embarrassing acts in order to keep up the "ruse." What's wrong with this picture?!

title: Yoru no Hanabira
description:
Collection of 7 oneshots:  
  
1) Yoru no Hanabira  
Host love.  
  
2) Kaika Zenya  
Back story about the host of the first chapter and how he met his guardian (no romance story)  
  
3) Junjou Escape  
Actors in love.  
  
4) Kimi ni Furu Yuki  
Art student in love with his sempai.  
  
5) Koi Suru Yajuu  
  
6) Kamu Otoko  
  
7) Haru wo Aisuru Hito

title: Turn the Page to My Heart
description: "I want you to fall for me." Higher-schooler Minato is having a spate of bad luck: getting dumped by his lover, losing his wallet, and getting water poured on his head… He meets a younger student, Hanamura, in the library, who is attractive, but hard to read. Minato, who hasn't gotten over his broken heart, agrees to go on a date with Hanamura as a distraction from his feelings. It was supposed to be a trial date, but ends up bringing the two closer. What lies in wake of the love that blossoms between them…? This is a sweet story about the clumsy romance between a junior who wants to believe in love and a senior trying to mend his broken heart.

title: Seeing Double
description: Ohn can’t stand men, and he’s determined to stay away from them at all costs. Little does he know that the shy, soft-spoken Seo-woo is crushing on him hard. So hard, in fact, that he’s recruited his more confident twin brother, Jae-woo, to act as his double and approach Ohn. But as Jae-woo starts putting a little too much of his own heart into the act, the line between who’s courting Ohn gets blurred. Will the brothers break through Ohn’s hatred of men? And if so, which twin will be the one to win Ohn’s heart?

title: Haikyuu!! - Sakura no Ato (Doujinshi)
description: Oikawa x Kageyama

title: Shiroi Ori
description:
1-6) Heita was secretly in love with his classmate, Komai, and was found out by the infirmary sensei, Tsuge. Tsuge threatened Heita, “If you want me to keep it a secret, you'd have to listen to me.” From then on, Heita lets Tsuge have his way with him. Soon, Heita found that his rationality could no longer restrain his own overwhelming urge and desire. Did he fall in love with Tsuge?  
  
7) Untold Love  
A moment of kindness in a train station made Miyami Shigo pay attention to shy bespeckled Maki Shuuichi. But when they meet again, Maki doesn't remember Miyami, and is cold towards him.  
  
8) Moonlight Melody  
Edgar Lockwood is a beautiful young man with light hair and porcelain skin, so he's a favorite object of affection at the all boy's school he attends. Problem is, Edgar is straight, and all this male attention is totally unwanted! He even has to have a bodyguard in the form of childhood friend/servant Dick Clay. When Edgar gets the bright idea to tell everyone they're dating

title: Kawaii Beast
description:
1: Cute Beast  
There's a tall and mysterious (and scary!) guy named Onizuka in Kisaki's class. He looks horrifying at first glance, but if you take a good look, he's actually pretty handsome! And yet he acts like a big lumbering animal all the time. Now, Kisaki's starting to feel like he wants to keep Onizuka's hidden charms to himself… but why?!  
  
2: The Prince's Commitment  
Girls always confess to Miki, then dump him within weeks because he doesn't care enough. So when adorable classmate Sakura (male) confesses to Miki, he decides to try it out. Will Miki learn to care about another person, or will Sakura leave him like all the rest? And why does the entire class know Miki's business?  
  
3: Ramune, First Love, And Summer Break  
Years ago, Aki and his cousin Naomi (male) were very close with the much older Naomi taking care of Aki. Now a third year high school student, Aki must spend time with Naomi again and confront the feelings he's been hiding…  
  
4: Alice Reunite  
When

title: Afuresou na Pool
description:
Iriya Tetsuo was the nice, quiet kid that everybody knows. Until well-meant prodding on the part of Hanada Satoshi made him choose the 'easy' way out. He purposely failed the entrance exam to a good school, and picked fights so that he wouldn't have to be around Hanada anymore.  
  
The last thing he expected or wanted was for strong-willed Kizu Ryouji to show any interest in him. The sparks fly between the two, while Iriya's best friend Kasuga Ryouta watches jealously…

title: Takaramono
description:
Volume 1  
1) Takaramono  
Naoyuki, a sincere and honest country boy comes to Tokyo for high school and stays with his cousin's family. At first everybody takes advantage of him, thinking that he's too naive to catch on. His cousin Satoshi, who's in college, is no different. He demands that Naoyuki have sex with him in exchange for tutoring him… In no time, despite his less than honourable initiate intention, Satoshi starts falling in love with the pure-hearted boy.  
  
2) Kimochi no Yukue  
Oneshot also found in [Koibito no Namae](https://mangadex.org/title/55801/koibito-no-namae).

Kinasuki Shin is a delinquent who always seems to get into trouble; though his martial arts skills usually save him from getting hurt during fights. But his "bad luck magnetism" is always active in full force, and he soon lands in deep debt for causing a car crash.   
  
Takami Ukon is a model and happens to be a student of Kinasuki's school (when he's not busy with photo shoots, at least!) One thing leads to another, and our hapless protagonist soon finds himself commissioned to act as Takami's bodyguard in return for the latter paying off his debts!?

In order to protect his brothers, Shuu devotes his life to raise them filled with happy memories. However, a fated meeting with his new homeroom teacher would turn his life upside down…

title: Ai ni Kidzuke yo
description: Yoshihara has again bumped into Hoshina, his high school kouhai. Once, when they were both drunk, Yoshihara slept with Hoshina. Since that time, Yoshihara realized that he loved Hoshina, but unable to tell Hoshina his true feelings and unable to withstand the pain of a superficial relationship, Yoshihara distanced himself from him.

title: Summer Boy Blue
description:
性行為を初恋相手の親に見られて数年後、
ミチルはアルバイトに明け暮れる日々を過ごしていた。
けれどその平穏な生活を壊すように、かつての親友・潤がやってくる。
「嫌ならやめるよ」
初体験の時と同じ台詞を言われて断りきれず
潤がアルバイト先の喫茶店に通うのを許すミチル。
彼こそが初恋相手──ミチルが忘れたい男なのに。
ミチルは大人っぽくなった潤に翻弄される。
（だめだ、だめ、もうこれ以上）
そう抵抗するのも虚しく、自慰に駆り立てられてしまう。
持て余した思春期と、初恋の再燃と。
心の第二次性徴を描いた若葉色ボーイズラブ。

title: Junjou Ookami-san to Kohitsuji-kun
description:
"Hurry up and ask me to kiss you one more time!"  
  
The pitiful lamb, Kusakabe was forcefully brought to the home of the school's most reputably notorious delinquent, Hayasaka-senpai. Just when it seemed like he's going to become the wolf's dinner ― unexpectedly the senpai ask Kusakabe to teach him maths. In the time shared under sunsets, Kusakabe saw another side of senpai that does not seem to fit into the rumours and felt that senpai is actually very gentle…? Just when he lets down his guard, Kusakabe is suddenly pushed down and under the caresses of his senpai, he gradually writhes in pleasure?!  
The love story of a seductively cute young boy's heart in blossoming spring is going to start.

title: Soshite Koi ni Naru
description: The beautiful yet aloof Midori and the very outgoing Takahiro are college friends. One day, during a drinking party, the astute Soejima senpai finally got Midori to admit that he is gay, even though he was trying to ignore that fact. As he slowly comes to terms with his own homosexuality, he also discovers the truth behind his friendship with Takahiro.

title: Toumei Shounen
description:
Vol. 1 - Somehow Nagi Tokieda, a student of a prestigious boarding high school, Ouka Gakkan, is loved by Yuushi Kitou, a perfect sophomore, chosen as a president of the school council though he is still a 2nd year. Nagi is a lonely boy, dumped by his real parents, and is always very sensitive about people's affection to him. Yuushi plans Nagi's birthday party to encourage him. But hearing the news of Nagi's father returning home, he suspends the party. It was a false alert. From shock, Nagi follows some strange students of another school without any definite purpose and gets into danger.  
  
Vol. 2 - Many allies and even more enemies… A scandal breaks out surrounding the tremendously popular, charismatic, and beautiful student council president! Under the scrutinizing and hostile eye of the journalism club’s Katakura, Yuushi’s plans have been recalled. On top of that, Yuushi’s become the target of the ever-capable and ever-cool vice president Takamura’s rabid fans’ jealousy!! How will

title: Pochi no Shiawase
description: Our cute Pochi [popular nickname for dogs in Japan] is always following our Math senpai around. For so many years, will he finally get an answer for his unrequited love?

title: Splish-Splash
description: Hee Soo is a 20-year-old college student who falls in love at first sight with Lee Kyung. However, it seems like Hee Soo is receiving affection from an enthusiastic freshman. Even though it isn't that easy to win Lee Kyung's heart, Hee Soo does not want to give up!

title: Haikyu!! - waltz. (Doujinshi)
description: Kozume Kenma x Hinata Shoyo

title: Pinka Ponka
description: Tatsukawa Ryuu & Kotani Taiga are high school boys playing ping-pong and talking about their favorite girl, school cafeteria set meals and many other things that interest them at that time.

title: Kanmitsu Danshi
description:
1-2) Candy Boy: Hyogo Sakura, the high school feather-weight champion in boxing, moved away from Yokohama, but now he's come back and is reunited with his childhood friend Tetsushi Kujuu, who does karate. And seeing Tetsushi again just spurns Sakura on…  
  
3) Innocent Boy: Hamuro Yuuki's family is financial trouble and he has agreed to sell his body in order to get money. But Yuuki wants his first to be someone he knows before he has to sleep with other men.  
  
4) The Scarlet Cresent Moon / The Crimson Cresent Moon: Fujifusa, the manager of the Sakura Inn's branch has a customer, Takamiya Seiji, who want's Fujifusa for more than just as a drinking company.  
  
5) Candy Boy Afterwards: The boys from Candy Boy, Tetsushi and Sakura have exams coming up and Sakura makes plans to celebrate the end of the semester.

title: Rival ni Ki wo Tsukero
description:
1-2)Rival ni Ki wo Tsukero (Beware of the Rival)  
Ren is in love with his younger cousin Sakae and has been for quite some time. On the day he plans on confessing he witnesses Kunimi, Sakae's classmate, confessing to Sakae. Upset that Kunimi stole Ren's perfect moment to confess he decides to find out who the guy is and hopefully what Sakae's answer was. When Sakae leaves the two together Kunimi tells Ren he knows Ren loves Sakae and that he will never hand Sakae over to Ren. The battle to win Sakae over is ON!  
  
3)Koishitatte ii janai (What's wrong with being in love?)  
Mei and Shouta are childhood friends. Mei is very clumsy and a little clueless so when he wants to move out of his parent's house and live alone, Shouta moves in with him. One day Mei comes home early and sees Shouta touching himself… while calling Mei's name! Everything changes after that…  
  
4)Suki Suki (Love Love)  
Toshikazu is very possessive over his lover, Hibiki. Hibiki starts to feel smothered but what

title: Pika Pika Days
description:
1-3. Shining Days  
The strong-willed Asahi and the easy-going Tetsuro have been close friends since kids. Now in high school, those two still “share” their bento. However, Asahi is asked to stop bullying Tetsuro, “because he’s too nice to tell you his true feelings!” But is that really how Tetsuro feels about Asahi’s bullying—?  
  
4. Fireworks  
Morio invite Saeki to the local fireworks festival but receives the usual cold response from Saeki. Follows Morio and Saeki-sensei from Vanilla.  
  
5. Anniversary  
Nakajima is unsure about his relationship status with Yajima, They have been going out for weeks but nothing physical has yet to happen between them. Follows Nakajima and Yajima from Vanilla.  
  
6) Lost Pain  
Nakajima is unsure of Yajima's love for him despite the constant declarations of love. The problem? Nakajima finds it hard to take Yajima seriously when all he can see is his poker face. Follows Nakajima and Yajima from Vanilla.  
  
7. The Prince's Secret  
The prince

title: Color
description: Tsuda and Sakae are both artists who coincidentally painted nearly identical paintings. Now they are students at the same school. Are they destined to be together?

title: Koi to Uso to Pride to
description: Kamio Shuuji, the heir to a rich organization, has just transferred to Hazuki's average public high school. When Kamio catches Hazuki's eye with an intense gaze Hazuki begins to wonder over his attentions. Especially when Akira, his lover, warns him to stay away from him. He intends to do just that, that is until Kamio claims to have fallen in love at first sight with Hazuki, giving him a kiss to seal the deal. But what exactly are Kamio's intentions? And why has Akira warned him against the heir in the first place?

title: Ore no kirai na yankee kun
He's Such A Tease!
description: The school bully has a nemesis—a rival in love who likes to snitch. The worst thing is that his nemesis is bad at recognizing faces and is oblivious to everything he does. Move aside, love rival. You're in the way of me pursuing my dream girl!

title: Uruwashiki Wana
description:
From Attractive Fascinante:  
Itsuki was one of the potential successors of the Toudou family, but was chased out of the family after being framed. Unknown to Itsuki, Kyouya, another potential successor, has been sending money to help him for the past year. Under any circumstances, the members of the Toudou family should never accept another person’s gratitude. Thus, Kyouya wants Itsuki to obey him for the help he has received from Kyouya. Is this a trap set up by Kyouya or does Kyouya really wants to help Itsuki to return to the family?

title: Jun na Kimochi de Icchimae!
description: Tomo's eyes chase after fellow teammate Tanji. He knows he has fallen for Tanji already but what comes with first love, makes him both expectant and scared of getting hurt.

title: Boku no Suki na Sensei (Gokurakuin Sakurako)
description: Kenmoto Kazuki is a 15-year-old high-school student who is late for school on his very first day. As he's running to school he sees someone on top of a wall that warns him not to go through the main entrance. Without a second thought he blurted out three words, "Please marry me!" From the shock the person falls off the wall where Kenmoto Kazuki discovers he just proposed to a man. This man was not just any man, but Morikeoke Akitou his homeroom teacher!

title: My Hero Academia - L'incident Chocolaté (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Hitomi no Mukougawa
description:
From Fantasyshrine:  
  
In high school I, Hayami Ren, was reunited with my childhood friend, Hikawa Yukito. I've always been charmed by him. However, Yuki-chan has become too involved in his Kendo club and is even being labeled as the “Hope” of the club. Now, I feel more and more like I have been cast aside. But I love him, so I want to be with him and become his equal. Struggling between love and dreams, what would be our fate being that we’re such a clumsy couple…?  
  
This book includes the stories of Ren and Yukito’s sweet reunion and also Ren’s brother, Satoru’s story.

title: My Precious
description: One day Minoto was passing by Mayue's place and heard the piano tune through the windows. Fascinated by the beautiful music, Minato approaches to the house and Mayue invites him into the house. Together, they become friends and depend on one another… however, Mayue later gets a proposition for studying aboard to Vienna….

title: Yareba Dekirusa
description: What would a prep school teacher do to encourage a student to study for a college entrance exam? Well he woos him of course!

title: My Hero Academia - Prismic  (Doujinshi)
description: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Resistance Passion
description: Sei is an accountant that helped the Takashiro family keep their assets in place. He always has his way with the older twin of the Takashiro family, Mizuha. Mizuha has zero resistance against the flaming passion that emanates from Sei. Will they open their hearts to each other? The other twin, Yuuya, has been fending off perverts who are interested in Mizuha. But is his classmate, Tsuzuki, interested in Mizuha or in Yuuya? What will happen to Yuuya's unrequited love for Tsuzuki?

title: Forget Me Now
description: Elliott woke up with his memories gone. His life, friends even his boyfriend Nate, gone. Can he piece his life back together before it all resets?

title: Free! - Unmei ja Nai Hito (Doujinshi)
description: Makoto x Rin

title: Love Record Book
description:
Jiyu has lived as a top student his entire life, but after entering high school he gets an unthinkable grade of being second in the whole school.


Jiyu, who was in shock, is trying to regain his top spot in the school. it's said that if you date, your grades will drop. so he made a confession attack on Dohyeon, the student who stole his first place tag.

Jiyu successfully seduces Dohyeon to date him. Can he get back the top spot in the school?

title: Anata wa Boku Dake no Hana
description:
1) You Are My Flower  
Yuuto has been living for years with Hisataka but he's wondering what are his true feelings for his lover since in the beginning, he accepted the relationship without being in love with Hisataka…  
  
2) Moving Forward Hand in Hand  
After changing shifting seats in the classroom, the shy boy finally got to sit next to the prince of campus. Will he be able to look beyond the facade and see him for his real self.   
  
3) It's Still Impossible to Turn Them into Memories  
He got the biggest shock of his life when he turned up for a rock concert only to discover his friend has invited his past lover without knowing that. Now they have to pretend to be nice to each other despite the bitter break up in the past.   
  
4) I Want You Only  
He doesn't quite get it why he is always getting dumped even though he is pretty popular. He jokingly tell his childhood friend that he might as well turn gay to avoid this terrible fate. Surprisingly, his friend volunteered for the

title: My Weird Roommate
description: He is a punk, and he is a nerd, can I make it any more obvious? When two complete opposites share a room.

title: Tonari no Jijou
description: That day, Miyata, who is still preparing for his university exam, got home and found not his brother, but an unknown man. That man, Shirai, has just moved into the neighbourhood. He looks at Miyata's messy test sheets and offers, "Shall I teach you?" With his airy smile and nearly perfect self, Shirai forcefully becomes Miyata's private tutor… and Miyata slowly becomes interested in Shirai…

title: Moony - Oukaryou Trilogy
description:
1-2.) Moony  
It all starts when Yuusuke Satou is forced to spend spring holidays at the dormitory along with Moriya. Then, one night Yuusuke discovers that Moriya has troubles seeing at night and while he takes care of Moriya he eventually falls in love with him, but he is worried that Moriya might not return his feelings and will hate him…  
  
3.) Frozen  
Jun Suwa notices another college student - Nozomu - who seems lonely, but possesses a beautiful profile. The two happen to attend the same party where Jun has a little too much to drink. Nozomu offers to take Jun home with him, then the night turns into a complicated romance.  
  
4.) The Spring Moon in a Night of Cherry Blossoms  
One restless spring night, Mamoru wanders the grounds of his dorm admiring the cherry blossoms when he happens upon Jun's room with an open window. He unintentionally peeps in on Jun and another man being intimate. Jun even spots Mamoru and Mamoru makes a hasty retreat. Why can't he get the images of th

title: Houkago Men's Harem
description:
Nagato Aoba enters the student council after much effort and heartache (Suki Dakedo!) but at what cost? Not liked by the rest of the council, incessantly pursued by Yura, and a hidden relationship with Maki, seems like enough trouble, but… is there more looming his way? You bet there is!  
Watch out, Aoba!!   
  
Enter After School Men's Harem survival of the fittest!

title: Akarui Kazoku Keikaku
description: Shibutami lived the life of an everyday high school boy, but with one chronic problem: He could never stay interested in his girlfriends. However, when Yoshizumi transfers into his class, the teenager's arrival strangely piques his interest. Yet, for some reason Yoshizumi seems awkward, even hostile, when Shibutami tries to be his friend. Meanwhile, another high school student with a mask fetish falls deeply in lust with his dentist during an appointment. In another part of the city, a man grows jealous of his own lover's best friend. And elsewhere, a young couple nearly breaks up because they can never agree who should be on top in the bedroom.

title: Harry Potter - Flying High Students (Doujinshi)
description: "Flying High Students" is a crazy gag doujinshi that's mostly about Harry hitting on Snape and other weird situations. There's also a short chapter that reveals how Sirius and Snape feel after James died.

title: Rapuntsel ni Fuku Kaze
description: Grandma told Tsukamoto that if he didn't start paying attention, he'd get into trouble. Now he seems to have joined a mysterious club at school that is headed by Higashi Jyuji, otherwise known as Rapunzel. Will Tsukamoto be the prince to bring this princess down from the castle?

title: Kuroko no Basket - Kimi to Koi Suru Houteishiki (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kise Ryouta x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Error Detected
description: 'Oh Seung-pyo', who never missed out on first place in his entire school until middle school, lost his first place in his entire school to 'Ryu Jae-min' after entering high school. Ryu Jae-min won first place in the school, and Oh Seung-pyo won second place in the school. No matter how hard you study, you cannot reverse this order. Seungpyo continues to watch Jaemin without realizing it due to his first feeling of inferiority. Then one rainy day, Seung-pyo and Jaemin accidentally collide on the street and an accident occurs where their cell phones change. But something is strange. "what's this?" Ryu Jae-min's pause for first place in the entire school.

title: My Hero Academia - Katsuki-kun no Koibito (Doujinshi)
description: Todoroki Shouto x Bakugou Katsuki

title: Haikyuu!! - Good Luck Days (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kageyama x Hinata

title: Kiss ja Tomaranai!
description: Wataru and Makoto are friends from early childhood. They are recognized as the gay couple in school, and while Makoto appears to be okay with it, Wataru is greatly troubled by it and by Makoto's attitude. Since Wataru will not permit anything more than a kiss, the anxious Makoto visits his prep school teacher and tries to consult him about this problem. However, he's not aware of the danger that awaits him!

title: Kawaii Hito
description:
1-5, 6-11) It's all the little things that Ikeuchi does that makes Shinoda want him. Shinoda's been gay for as long as he can remember, but he's still a virgin. Then he falls in love with Ikeuchi, a younger man on the same basketball team. However, Ikeuchi has a girlfriend… is there any way Shinoda can make him want him?  
  
5.5) Hotta-san is secretly in love with his co-worker Yoshi, but Yoshi saw Hotta-san and their boss going at it in the Archives Room. Is there any hope for Hotta-san and Yoshi?  
  
5.6, 12) 2 short stories about Shin and Haruhiko.

title: Go! Go! Kikaku
description: The wierdest, wildest, most-gratuitous orgy of teddy bears, super-heroes, pimp-outfits and vaguely underage sex we've ever seen. Includes sex through a pair of ripped pants, a teddy-bear hostage situation, and lots of scandalized kitty-cute uke boys who seem totally unaware of the kind of manga they've showed up to participate in.

title: Naruto - Rocket (Doujinshi)
description: There's a legend that says, if you kiss someone when the first firework lights up the sky on the last night of the Annual Culture Festival, you'll be with them forever. The students of Konoha Private School are preparing for their annual cultural festival. What they didn't expect was how the last night would turn out. SasuxNaru and KakaIru.

title: Only You
description: Kawai is trying to get the narcisstic Kikuhara but he’s playing hard to get. Will Kawai succeed?

title: Harry Potter - Cry For The Moon (Doujinshi)
description: James is in love with Severus, so on Valentine's Day, he decided to give him a present. But instead, it seems like someone else gave Severus an even better present! Guess who? Remus! What on earth is going on? James x Severus x Remus (Well, both are going for Snape…)

title: Koisuru Ikimono
description:
A series of oneshots.  
  
1. Traces  
After his roommate left, Katsumi feels a presence in the room that tries to violate him.  
  
2-3. Midori no Himitsu & The Day After  
Mizuki and Fumiaki are cousins that haven't seen each other for nine years. Now that Fumiaki transfered to Mizuki's school and stays at his home they should get closer but Fumiaki doesn't talk about his home and distants himself from his classmates. Moreover, the plants around Fumiaki act strange.  
  
4. Traces 2  
Continuation of relationship from chapter one (timeline after second story).

title: Rainbow
description: With the sweetness of mints, the two teenagers experienced a young and pure friendship in the summer, simple and beautiful, always remembering the summer that belonged only to them.

title: Blue Lock - 0812 & 0506
description:
Nagi ✕ Reo
Happy Birthday! Birthday booklets of Reo and Nagi.

Other volumes in the series:
1. Rapyutasu Ryuuseigun

3. Hiroki - Harusaki Meiro
4. Anata - Mahoroba Festival
5. Lunatic Cinema
6. Human Nore no Koe
7. Winter Locket
8. Aoi Ginga no Yoake

Hiroki and Kanata are childhood friends spending their lives in Ryokunohara academy with their friends, surviving super natural hijinx along the way along with a hint of romance between the two boys growing.

title: Koibito no Namae
description:
V. Koibito no Namae  
  
1. Lover's Name  
One night, Ei Ariga the private detective was hit on by an obnoxious stranger whilst out working on a case handled by his father's agency. Then the timid and very polite Ryouichirou, who is a dead-ringer for the playboy stranger, turns up at the agency and tries to engage their services to find out why and how someone is breaking and entering his apartment. Ei-kun discovers that the nasty, violent and annoying carbon copy is called Naruaki and things get extremely complicated when he starts falling in love with both Ryouichirou and Naruaki… Lover's Name is also found in Double Lover - Koibito no Namae  
  
2. Saikou no Kimi

2. Kimochi no Yukue  
It's been three years since Kirima walked away from his relationship with Kou. Kou's obsessive love was what sent Kirima running in the

title: From friendship comes love
description:
A história começa com Alex, nosso protagonista que retorna à sua cidade natal depois de 6 anos morando fora do país. Quando ele estava na Escola primária, havia um cara que costumava incomodá-lo, por causa de sua aparência delicada,  
Estar de volta para onde ele tem tantas lembranças ruins, não é algo que o alegre.  
  
From friendship comes love trata-se de uma webcomic postada originalmente no Tapastic e traduzida com a permissão da autora.

title: J-Boy
description:
Collection of one-shots
1) Indecent Encouter by Haruka Minami
