17) Rabbit Ear Kindergarten by Yogorouta Kamei
18) Shadows of the Forest by the Quiet Lakeside by Sakyou Yozakura

title: Star Catcher (pre-Originals)
description: The depressed-introvert Lucas meets and befriends the carefree-extrovert Thomas during their freshman year at Star Valley University. Now they are best friends! Totally just friends! Nothing... non-platonic here! Does contain themes of mental health struggles. (Normal world/College AU of Star Children)

title: X'mas wa Kirai
description: Fujikura Akira is aiming to be a photographer while Masaki Hiroyuki is a high school dropout. Akira takes an unknown picture of Hiroyuki last Christmas while Hiroyuki was crying… and all Akira wants to find out is why…

title: Kooporasu e Youkoso
description:
Yamanobi Apartments have a story behind them: Anyone who lives there will gain something big, but lose something big as well. This is a collection of stories about the various tenants and their love lives.  
  
1) Muroi Kaname has just moved into Yamanobi. The naturally unsocial Kaname doesn't care about stories, and also quickly manages to alienate himself from everyone in the building. But when his upstairs neighbor, talkative Fujimura, sees a different side to him, he's determined to be Kaname's friend. Kaname slowly lets himself grow closer to Fujimura, but will their friendship withstand the jinx?  
  
2) Kamimura Mizuki has always chosen lovers for their looks, and gotten nothing but trouble. This time he wants a sincere guy, and he already has one picked out: Itokawa from his work. But getting his attention is proving to be somewhat difficult. At least slacker apartment caretaker Akabame always listens to his troubles…  
  
3) Nojima is known as the life of the party, always lig

title: Kuroko no Basket - Koi wa Daitan ni (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Kagami Taiga x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Trap
description:
1-2+extra) Narushima, an elite detective of the Metropolitan Police Department who is guarding an important person at football stadium happens to meet his old friend, Fujisaki. When they were promising football players in same team, Fujisaki always dominated Narushima and deprived all of Narushima including of his pride and girlfriend. But Narushima realizes that Fujisaki becomes a sniper. He failed to catch Fujisaki and Fujisaki also failed to kill the VIP. They meet again and make love together…  
  
3) An ex-member of swimming club encourages a retired member by fatal injury to tell the ace swimmer his feeling. Ace swimmer accepts it because he loves injured butterflies…  
  
4) A teacher tries to find out the reason why his student acts rebelliously only against him…

title: Toiki ni Furete
description:
- Fragments of Happiness  
  
President Midou has been interested in waiter, Sakura Kaname, since he flew into his Midou's arms escaping a molesting relative.  
  
- Part 2.  
  
Persued by Midou, Kaname feels he can't trust him now matter how attracted he is.  
  
- Story 2.  
  
"I won't ever open up my heart to anyone else again. I won't like anyone else again. That is the only way I can protect myself from harm." Minato Yuuya refuses to accept the feelings of his kouhai, Takami Naota, because of his own past.  
  
- Forbidden Lust  
  
Asahina has been in love with Manager Kizaki ever since they met a year ago, but it could never be mutual, could it?  
  
- Heart Throbbing Love  
  
A teacher's promiscuous private life is discovered by a student.

title: Tameiki no Ondo
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
- Tameiki no Ondo  
Jun is always being compared to his older brother Ryou, and falling short. But when his brother's friend Yuuya starts to tutor him, his patient nature begins to get through to Jun. When Jun realizes Yuuya's feelings for Ryou, he must confront his own feelings for Yuuya.  
  
- Blind  
  
- Distance  
  
- Border  
  
- Bokutachi no Sotsugyou (Our Graduation)  
Umebayashi has been in love with Matsubara from the day they first met, but cramped by his rival, Takeshiba, he never got around to express his feelings. Now that graduation is nearing, the boys feel the need to confess to the ones they like.

title: Harry Potter - Love Songs (Doujinshi)
description: An indirect continuation of 'Tactics'. Harry has a nightmare in which he kills Draco. Does this dream have a meaning? Or is it just what it is, a dream? Sirius and Remus make appearances here.

title: Kuroko no Basket - Kunkou x Kunkou (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Akashi Seijuurou x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Natsuiro Danshi
description:
A new school year is often synonymous with new class and getting to know your peers. It is an opportunity to meet new people & making new friends. And sometimes it doesn't take much to bring two people together, who at first seems to have nothing in common, just like Tomoyuki and Aoi. Nothing seems to predestinate them to be more than just classmates, and yet the simple fact of sharing the same surname seems to make Aoi consider Tomoyuki his future best friend.   
  
Even though Tomoyuki is reluctant at first, he is gradually tamed by this exuberant boy. Until the day he realizes a new overwhelming feeling, but it's already too late to go back…

title: Naturalist no Kare
description: Himeji's older brother, Miyaji, meets the new dorm manager, Hatoya Sensei. Is Miyaji a pervert just like his brother or does Hatoya Sensei have his own plans. Just as Yeonwoo starts getting used to his new happy life, Seongwoon and his parents are in a tragic accident that leaves him orphaned with no memories. Now, it’s Yeonwoo’s turn to take care of the precious person who gifted him so many of his “firsts”—even if Seongwoon doesn’t remember a single one.

When he meets him again after a long time, Kouji has become a handsome man at the top of the social hierarchy by any standards. Konta is happy to see him again and ends up telling Kouji about the webcomic he has been secretly drawing. However, the next day, when Konta arrives at school, he sees his classmates laughing at his webcomic, along with Kouji himself... Why has his best friend changed? "To be honest, my dream is erotic, but it is horror as well…"  
  
Howon is a high school student who lives with his sister and his mom. As his dad passed away, his sister is supporting the family. He starts having very vivid erotic dreams, involving his current best friend, Jihyung, and his former one, Changwoo. Now, he must try to figure out if he is gay and the way this might affect his already frail family. Howon remembers the time Changwoo helped him in a fight, years before, making them become close friends and maybe more than that. As his friend Jihyung also has some important news to share, Howon's life becomes an emotional and sexual rollercoaster.

But despite such a flippant motto, he is actually a rather serious type who is madly crushing on his friend from junior high, Saki. Saki is on the school's volleyball team and is gentle and soft-spoken - the very image of Ayumu's ideal "type". But what happens when, instead of catching Saki's attention, he catches the interest of the lazy, chain-smoking volleyball coach? The coach's name is Kouga-sensei, and he's a weirdo who has no manners at all. This bastard sensei confronts Ayumu with a rude question - "You like boys, right?" - and then bullies Ayumu into joining the volleyball team. But what are his true motives for bullying Ayumu? He's tall, dark, devious and unpleasant - far from Ayumu's "cute and pretty" ideal. Why, then, does he make Ayumu's heart race?

Immediately feeling welcomed to his new school, Suou couldn't really ask for more. Until his new "buddy" Harashima suddenly turns on him in a deserted hallway and vows to make Suou "his property".

title: Harry Potter - Uchuuyuuei (Doujinshi)
description: A Harry Potter doujinshi.

title: Kuroko no Basket - Sairoku Hon (Doujinshi)
description: Reprinting of several Akashi x Kuroko (and some Kise x Kuroko) doujinshis by Praly/Tsuzuki Saaya.

title: Harry Potter - Gray Scale (Doujinshi)
description:
This brilliant Harry Potter doujinshi takes place between the “Order of the Phoenix” and “The Half Blood Prince” events. As Harry deals with the grief of Sirius’s death as well as the sequels of his possession by Lord Voldemort he starts isolating himself more than ever. Will Ron manage to break this invisible wall between them? Discover more in this neat HarryxRon story!  
  
Pairing(s): Harry Potter x Ronald Weasley

title: Harry Potter - Something In The Snow (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Remus x Severus

title: Harry Potter - The Sleepy Wizard (Doujinshi)
description: Snape & Lupin + Marauders

title: Kuroko no Basket - Yahari Seishun Suru Nara Nijigen ni Kagiru (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Mayuzumi Chihiro x Kuroko Tetsuya

title: Reboot
description:
With the arrival of Sou's free-spirited senior, a complicated love triangle begins...?!

Touma, who is now a third year, resets his troubled relationship with his boyfriend, Sou, who was his whole world. He has developed a good bond with his classmate, Maki, who was the reason for the breakup, and is now a best friend with whom he can talk about his true feelings. Touma wishes to become friends again with Sou... Though he still feels shaken every time he thinks about him, he decides to use this new starting point as an opportunity to face the past. Quite unexpectedly, he meets Sou again, who is working as a teacher at the cram school he's attending...!

title: Osoku Saku Hana
description:
"What's going on? I just don't get it. Ever since I met Hashimoto, my heart's been filled with emotions I've never felt before…"  
  
Since meeting Hashimoto, whose personality is the complete opposite of his, which is flippant and cold to others, high school student, Makino, can no longer hide the changes within his heart.

title: Kawaikutte Sukoshi Baka
description:
Collection of short stories:  
  
1-2) Kawaikutte Sukoshi Baka  
  
3) Koi nara Tsubomi  
  
4) Hatsukoi ni Tsugu  
  
5) 100% Pure  
  
6) Kawaikutte Sukoshi Baka extra

title: Ore ni Kamauna!
description: Ore ni Kamauna is a story about two high school students who were child prodigies and geniuses. However, growing up as such talented individuals had led them to deal with a lot of pressures in life, thus, now their one goal in life is to make money….

title: Prince Prince
description:
Two years ago, Ouji Shuichi, a highschooler who is a little eccentric, found Okamoto Kazuya and announced something strange, “You are my destined prince”. However, Kazuya did not fully fall in love with Ouji.  
  
Two years later, Ouji considers him a confindent friend.  
  
He goes to him to confide his heartaches. Kazuya has hidden his affection behind their friendship. Knowing that Ouji is fragile without his friendship and support, he fears revealing his love.

title: O Poder de um Tubarão (Free!)
description:
Uma comic feita por um fã baseada em Free!   
  
Rin quer exibir o verdadeiro poder do… gás de um tubarão. Ele procura por vítimas do seu ataque, até que encontra Nitori e Haru, e os ataca!   
Será que eles vão deixar barato?

title: Kimi wo Meguru Monogatari
description: Tonoe, a college student living alone, has dreams every night. In a place that wasn't Japan and wasn't in the present, he fell in love with a kind "teacher." However, the war brought a sad farewell to "Sensei"... Then one day, Suga, the new resident of the room next door, comes to say hello. The moment Tonoe sees him, he bursts into tears...?!

title: Unblossomed
description: Gyeongseong, 1920 - the early days of colonial Korea. When a young Japanese boy is found dead at a local school’s lantern festival, fingers start to point towards Kim Mugyeong. Despite the mounting pressure, Mugyeong refuses to talk, forcing officers to search for information elsewhere. Just what secrets have these two boys been hiding, and why does Mugyeong refuse to talk? In the midst of tumultuous social and political conflicts, the youth are just trying to make do. And while they say that some flowers bloom in adversity, perhaps there are also some that are destined to remain unblossomed.

title: A Thousand Thoughts
description: Seven years ago, Tang Xu met a boy dressed in rags and covered in scars. Even though he wasn't a nice gentleman filled with compassion, he still took the boy's hand before leaving. "I'll give everything I have to protect you for the rest of my life."

title: Shounen no Zankyou
description:
At that boarding school (gymnasium), the voices of young boys singing and the sound of gunfire echo through the air——.

The Augenblick Boys' Choir. Once an orphanage, it's now a boarding school (gymnasium) where children are taught academics and choir. Their voices are a soothing melody offered to the people. However, their songs had another meaning——. Erich, who suffers from stage fright; Karl, as beautiful as a girl; and Michael, who sings as if to dispel his vague anxiety... Like fragile, ephemeral days and lives that shine briefly like glass, the boys live on, unaware of what sorrow even is......

title: Haikyu!! - Boku wa, Hinata Shoyo to Iu Ningen ga Daikirai da. (Doujinshi)
I Want to be an Actor...!
description: Prequel to the upcoming indie game and visual novel, "Sam in New York" by Fortunus Games, this short comic tells the story of Sam Abramov, a young boy living in 1910s New York City. Always the new kid on the block with demanding helicopter parents who want him to be a lawyer, Sam worships the Yiddish theatre actor Boris Thomashefsky from afar. One day, he hopes, he can be just as audacious and bold…!

title: The Whole Universe Wants to Cuddle Me
description:
Jiang Zhao is suddenly transported to an interstellar era. In this age, nearly everyone is born through genetic modification and has become a beastman with powerful combat abilities. However, these modified genes also bring defects: from birth, beastmen live under the threat of “mental power rampage,” which can ultimately lead them to be completely overtaken by their beast instincts.
Jiang Zhao, as the only pure ancient human in the entire universe, has a special effect — just by being near him, others’ mental unrest settles, and they find peace and comfort. Jiang Zhao’s attitude: “Isn’t it just petting fluffy fur? I’m good with that!”

title: Ace of Diamond - DISTANCE -18.44 (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Miyuki Kazuya x Sawamura Eijun

title: [BL]Sinabro
description: When I was young, I happened to meet that child again whom I had seen at the hospital by chance. I had thought of them only as a friend, but for some reason, there was something bothering my heart...

title: Jungle Boy
description:
The forested buildings are a jungle, and the people who pass by are beasts. What is Japan and its schools as seen by Tokugawa Motonao, a child of nature who has been dusted off in the urban jungle?

(google translated)

title: Harry Potter - Winter Rose (Doujinshi)
description: Wounded in battle, Harry dreams of his winter with Draco.

title: My Hero Academia - 愚者の歩き方 (Doujinshi)
Katekyo Hitman Reborn! - Please Once More (Doujinshi)
description: Pairing: Yamamoto x Gokudera - 8059

title: Komisch
description:
A new teacher has arrived at Jyonomiya private school. He is Sanjoin Kunitake, who is protected by the mysterious and mysterious Sano, a gardener, and is innocent, cute, and full of secret smells!
Jotaro Inui, a sixteen-year-old yakuza gangster whose hobby is blackmail, is trying to find out his weakness when he accidentally sees his "white blood". ......?
The Boys' School Pop Comedy begins!

title: Nemurenu Yoru wa Dare no Sei
description: Miyabi, who doesn't like gays and Shuhei, a gay. They spent a night together thinking this is one time coming. But they meet again and become a roommate at a boy's school dorm. Miyabi thinks something is not right. But cannot leave him out. He cannot follow Shuhei, who is pure, but saying that the feeling and sex are different. The story at a secret flower garden, the forbidden relationship at the boy's dorm!This series has been published in Japan since 2009 which Japanese title name is "Nemurenu Yoru wa Dare no Sei"

title: Este corazón que nos unió
description: Un chico llamado Daiki tiene un accidente lo cual casi lo lleva a la muerte por una herida en el corazón, pero es salvado por una chica, la cual le donó su corazón cuando ella muere, Daiki quiere hacer todo lo que la chica había deseado a futuro lo cual esto le traerá problemas a nuestro protagonista.

title: Bàdào Xiàocǎo Qiú Wǒ Huítóu
description:
Crazy picky school hunk X Tsundere student.

Lin Shuo's Love Letter Was Sent Accidentally, And Since Then The School Heartthrob, Yun Yao Ze Has Been Chasing Him, He's Very Good To Him. But he didn't expect that the devil would live inside Yun Yao Ze, chasing him just because of a bet with his teammates. Yun yao ze originally treated their relationship like a game, the end was game over, it didn't matter. But then a new student arrives at school, the transfer student follows Lin Shuo every day and calls him “baby”, he is anxious!

title: Kami-sama no Ude no Naka - Strauss wa Ichinensei (Doujinshi)
description: Doujinshi about the dorm leader Strauss and his senpai, Ginger.

title: Between us
description:
Emotionally ? He wants to leave
Psychologically? He can’t leave
Physically ? He stays
NOT BECAUSE HE CHOOSES TO BUT BECAUSE HE CANT CHOOSE ANYTHING ELSE

title: Onbu ni Dakko! Bye-Bye Icarus Mata Kondo
description:
Nagi ✕ Reo
…Nagi used to look at the sunset and feel that it was nothing more than just blinding.
However, on the way home from practice one day, he watches the sunset alongside Reo, who calls it "pretty." As they look at it together, Nagi starts to feel that the dazzlingness isn't so bad after all.

title: YANGSHENG XIAOXUE
description: Yang Sheng, un oficinista urbano de 28 años, es engañado para que vuelva a su pueblo natal y organizarle una cita a ciegas. Él, que ha decidido quedarse soltero porque no puede enamorarse de mujeres, conoce a su vecino Wen Xiaoxue, un joven que sufre violencia por parte de su padre. Movido por la compasión, Yang Sheng se lo lleva de su pueblo natal. Los dos forman una familia peculiar, y a través de la comida y los pequeños momentos de la vida, van experimentando poco a poco la felicidad cotidiana. Sin embargo, las sombras de sus familias de origen siguen acosándolos sin descanso. Al mismo tiempo, a medida que Wen Xiaoxue crece, entre los dos empieza a brotar un sentimiento extraño...

title: Yandere Onii-chan
description: One day, out of the blue, I ended up with a yandere older brother…!?

title: Ouji no Sairen
description: Even though he should hate him, his heart started beating. Saionji Rio, a student at Meihou High School, a school for the sons of prestigious families, stands out among them for his exceptional lineage, talent, and looks. Along with his sworn enemy, Nijou Kazuyoshi, he is revered like a prince, known as "Nikario." Rio has only two years of freedom left, his future already decided. He has a wish he desperately wants to fulfill before graduation. The precious coming-of-age love story spun by two princes begins!

title: Penganggu Cintaku
description:
Hubungan pertamaku, aku pikir akan dipenuhi dengan kebahagiaan saja.
Tapi… aku rasa pacarku lebih suka dengan “teman perempuan terbaiknya”…
Kesal, aku mencoba menggunakan aplikasi saran kencan AI bernama “Meddler.”
Dan dia bilang aku mudah dibujuk? Apakah ini benar-benar AI?

title: Show me your Emotion
description: A series about an emotionless boy and an expressive boy.

title: Netoge no Seibetsu wa Sensaku NG desu!
description:
Shishido Reiji, the heir to a massive conglomerate, is a high school student who falls in love in an online game. Using the premise of an event inside the game, he proposes to Sakura, a player he has feelings for, and they become a couple. However, he inadvertently learns that Sakura's true identity is Asakura Ryogo, a delinquent boy from his class?!
The line between digital and real world romance gets blurred in this teen heir x delinquent BL!

title: Zombie Stage
description: A collection of comics and official arts from the web-series ”Zombie Stage” by VIVINOS

title: Konse de Saigo no Koi wo Shiyou
description:
“Hey... don't leave me behind this time.”
Omi is a college student suffering from insomnia due to nightmares of his “past life.”
Exhausted from lack of sleep, he nearly collapses on a train platform only to be saved by a mysterious man named Chihiro. 
Omi finds himself drawn to Chihiro, who always seems to be looking out for him. But one night, Chihiro's demeanor changes completely... 
“I’ve waited 200 years for you.” 
That's when Omi realizes the truth... Chihiro is something other than human. 
This is a reincarnation BL about a young man who remembers his past life and a non-human consumed by a 200-year obsession.

title: Ocean Hues
description: Eunhwan Choi, a transfer student from South Korea, moves to Marella Town to live with his estranged father. There, he meets a boy with eyes like the color of the ocean. At first, it is curiosity that draws him in, but behind those beautiful eyes hides a familiar feeling. (BL/LGBTQ+)

title: Love Eyes
description: In a world of love, a REDACTED appears dictating every individual eyes. A story about two idiots falling in love and navigating a corrupted society. Will they be able to save themselves from this REDACTED?

title: Isanggihu
description: One day, in the middle of summer, it suddenly starts to snow. What sort of changes will the snow bring?

title: Punctum
description:
Ukawa, a first-year oil painting student at an art university, is blessed with promising talent, yet feels a disconnect between his own attitude towards romance and that of those around him, leading him to spend his days alone. He is drawn to the beauty of Kou, an upperclassman he meets at university, but keeps his distance due to Kou's apparent womanizing. However, after a chance encounter, Ukawa learns that Kou harbors a secret desire to be embraced by a man, and makes a proposition to him...?

A BL story about two college students who are awkward in love, brought to you by the up-and-coming author Hatoko Koniwa.

title: Go For It, Nakamura! Audio CD Bonus
description: This 12 page one-shot is an addition to buying the Go For It, Nakamura! Drama CD.

title: Sukina Hito ga Bouzu ni Natta Hanashi
Kimi to Mimi kara Koi o Suru
description: Riku is a huge fan of HARU, a popular voice actor from the animated series called "Hako Ao" and whose appearance and personal info is unknown to his fans. One day, a transfer student named "Harukawa" arrives in Riku's class. He's handsome, but somewhat unfriendly, and for some reason, Riku can't seem to stop thinking about this new student.

title: Donbrick Yuri
description:
Han Yu-ri lives a flawless double life: by day, he’s the invisible, glasses-wearing otaku at Jijon High; by night, he works a part-time job. But his peaceful routine shatters when Chan-wook, the school's most feared bully, falls head over heels for Yu-ri's part-timer persona—with absolutely no idea who he really is.

To make matters worse, the two are forced to pair up for a school learning program. As if hiding his identity from his new partner isn't stressful enough, Chan-wook’s best friend discovers Yu-ri's secret, throwing his life into absolute chaos. Now, Yu-ri must juggle a dangerous double life where getting caught means getting beaten up. Will he be able to graduate safely without Chan-wook ever finding out the truth?

title: Urokoboshi-kun wa Uchuujin
description: A boy of superhuman beauty, Urokoboshi Ao, transfers to second-year high school student Tsuchiya Chikage's class... Or so it seems. Urokoboshi is actually an alien! He scatters stardust from the corners of his eyes with every blink, causes electrical appliances to malfunction with radio interference, and physically floats when he falls asleep! And for some reason, he's become attached to Chikage, expressing his affection honestly every day...

title: Tarou DON'T ESCAPE!
description: Tarou, a shy high school student, has drifted apart from his best friend and finds himself spending his birthday alone. Feeling lonely, he turns to social media, where he becomes drawn to someone named "Ai." They make plans to meet on his birthday, but the person who shows up is... a man in a mascot costume!?
